articles.title: Karl Bushby returns home after 28-year walk around the globe

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Fifty-six-year-old Karl Bushby returned to his family's home in Britain on Monday after spending 28 years becoming the first person to walk continuously around the world.
paras.zh: 11月2日（UPI）——56岁的卡尔·布什比周一回到了英国的家中，此前他花了28年时间成为第一个连续步行环游世界的人。

paras.en: Bushby, a former paratrooper, set off from the southern tip of Chile in November 1998 on what was supposed to be a 12-year trip by foot up through the Americas, across the Bering Strait into Russia and into Europe, traversing 36,000 miles and visiting four continents and 29 countries.
paras.zh: 布什比曾是一名伞兵，1998 年 11 月从智利南端出发，开始了本应为期 12 年的徒步旅行，穿越美洲，越过白令海峡，进入俄罗斯，进入欧洲，行程 36,000 英里，访问了四大洲和 29 个国家。

paras.en: His progress, however, was slowed several times, including an arrest in Russia on allegations of being a spy where he was threatened with deportation. He also encountered a polar bear, was held at gunpoint and had to replace the trolly he used to transport his belongings after it broke down, The Guardian reported.
paras.zh: 然而，他的进展多次放缓，包括在俄罗斯因涉嫌间谍而被捕，并受到驱逐出境的威胁。据《卫报》报道，他还遇到了一只北极熊，被枪指着，他用来运输物品的手推车坏了，不得不更换。

paras.en: The BBC said Bushby walked the last few miles from Hull City Hall to his mother's home, where he created her for the first time in 28 years.
paras.zh: BBC 称，布什比从赫尔市政厅步行了最后几英里来到了他母亲的家，这是他 28 年来第一次创造了她。

paras.en: German filmmaker Werner Herzog was also in attendance at the reunion. He's planning to make a documentary about Bushby's adventure.
paras.zh: 德国电影制片人沃纳·赫尔佐格也出席了聚会。他计划制作一部关于布什比冒险的纪录片。

articles.title: Look: Hawk found grounded in Virginia driveway was 'too darn fat to fly'

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Animal rescuers in Virginia solved the mystery of a hawk found on the ground in a resident's driveway: the bird was "too darn fat to fly."
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（UPI）——弗吉尼亚州的动物救援人员解开了在居民车道上发现的一只鹰的谜团：这只鸟“太胖了，飞不起来”。

paras.en: The Southwest Virginia Wildlife Center said on social media that the adult red-shouldered hawk, identified as RSHA 26-2599, was found apparently grounded in a resident's driveway about a mile away from the center in Roanoke.
paras.zh: 西南弗吉尼亚野生动物中心在社交媒体上表示，这只成年红肩鹰（编号为 RSHA 26-2599）被发现停在距罗阿诺克中心约一英里的居民车道上。

paras.en: Rescuers checked the hawk for broken bones, lead toxicity, eye issues, head trauma, emaciation and bruising, but she showed no signs of injury.
paras.zh: 救援人员检查了这只鹰是否有骨折、铅中毒、眼睛问题、头部创伤、消瘦和瘀伤，但她没有受伤的迹象。

paras.en: Veterinarians at the center's wildlife hospital examined the bird to get to the bottom of the mystery, and determined "she was too darn fat to fly."
paras.zh: 该中心野生动物医院的兽医对这只鸟进行了检查，以找出谜团的真相，并确定“她太胖了，无法飞翔”。

paras.en: "We couldn't even palpate her keel due to the heavy layer of fat covering it," the post said.
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“由于覆盖着厚厚的脂肪层，我们甚至无法触诊她的龙骨。”

paras.en: The resident who found the hawk in her driveway questioned her neighbors and discovered another resident's "free-roaming chickens were disappearing at an alarming rate over the last few weeks."
paras.zh: 在自家车道上发现鹰的居民询问了邻居，发现另一名居民的“自由漫步的鸡在过去几周里以惊人的速度消失”。

paras.en: Veterinarians said the hawk tipped the scales at 2 pounds -- nearly an entire pound heavier than normal weight for a female of the species.
paras.zh: 兽医表示，这只鹰的体重达到了 2 磅——比雌性鹰的正常体重重了近一磅。

paras.en: "This queen was picking off the buffet of easy prey set out before her, eating her fill, and then snoozing in the trees nearby until she was ready to eat again," officials wrote.
paras.zh: 官员们写道：“这只蜂后正在吃掉摆在她面前的简单猎物自助餐，吃饱了，然后在附近的树上打瞌睡，直到她准备好再次进食。”

paras.en: The hawk is now on a weight-loss diet and the center urged residents to avoid "indirectly" feeding wildlife by keeping chicken runs covered.
paras.zh: 这只鹰现在正在减肥，该中心敦促居民避免通过遮盖养鸡场来“间接”喂养野生动物。

articles.title: The case of the missing oxygen: Hubble telescope research highlights mystery

paras.en: Nov. 2 (UPI) -- Researchers using NASA's Hubble Space Telescope to study nearby dwarf galaxies discovered a puzzle: Those galaxies have far less oxygen than expected.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日（合众国际社）——研究人员利用 NASA 的哈勃太空望远镜研究附近的矮星系，发现了一个谜团：这些星系的氧气含量远低于预期。

paras.en: In a study published Monday in The Astrophysical Journal, scientists said they studied 27 dwarf galaxies and found that, although simulations predicted those galaxies should have significant amounts of oxygen, they actually had far less.
paras.zh: 在《天体物理学杂志》周一发表的一项研究中，科学家表示，他们研究了 27 个矮星系，发现虽然模拟预测这些星系应该含有大量氧气，但实际上它们的氧气含量要少得多。

paras.en: "Oxygen is produced by stars, which are inside of galaxies," said Grace Telford, co-investigator and assistant professor in the Department of Physics and Astronomy at the University of Utah, to NASA. "We know that the oxygen had to be inside of the galaxies at some point in the past, so the oxygen must have been ejected. And to do that, you need energy from massive stars and supernova explosions to drive material out of the host galaxies and into the space between galaxies."
paras.zh: “氧气是由星系内部的恒星产生的，”美国宇航局犹他大学物理和天文学系的联合研究员兼助理教授格蕾丝·特尔福德说。 “我们知道，氧气在过去的某个时刻必须存在于星系内部，因此氧气必须被喷射出来。要做到这一点，需要来自大质量恒星和超新星爆炸的能量，将物质从宿主星系中驱赶到星系之间的空间。”

paras.en: The new study shows that galactic winds seem to be far more effective at removing oxygen from these small galaxies than predicted.
paras.zh: 这项新研究表明，星系风在清除这些小星系中的氧气方面似乎比预测的要有效得多。

paras.en: The researchers in the Galaxies Losing Oxygen via Winds project, which is funded by NASA and the National Science Foundation, studied oxygen to better understand its role in space, including how it's distributed. Scientists said oxygen was a practical choice: It is a reliable indicator of how elements are spread out in galaxies and is relatively easy to find and measure.
paras.zh: 由美国宇航局和国家科学基金会资助的星系通过风失去氧气项目的研究人员研究了氧气，以更好地了解它在太空中的作用，包括它是如何分布的。科学家表示，氧气是一个实用的选择：它是元素在星系中如何分布的可靠指标，并且相对容易找到和测量。

paras.en: "Oxygen is one of the primary elements formed by stars," said Kristen Wingfield McQuinn, principal investigator for GLOW and mission head of the Science Operations Center for the NASA Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope at the Space Telescope Science Institute in Baltimore. "Being able to trace how much oxygen gets made, and then how much is distributed inside and outside of galaxies, helps us understand galaxy evolution.
paras.zh: “氧气是恒星形成的主要元素之一，”GLOW 首席研究员兼巴尔的摩太空望远镜科学研究所 NASA 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜科学运营中心任务负责人克里斯汀·温菲尔德·麦奎因 (Kristen Wingfield McQuinn) 说。 “能够追踪产生了多少氧气，以及有多少氧气在星系内部和外部分布，有助于我们了解星系的演化。

paras.en: "It also helps us learn where and how much galaxies are enriching the space between galaxies, called the intergalactic medium."
paras.zh: “它还帮助我们了解星系在哪里以及有多少星系丰富了星系之间的空间，即星系间介质。”

paras.en: A previous study showed that, for star-forming galaxies like our own Milky Way, some of the missing oxygen is found in the diffuse haloes of gas surrounding galaxies outside their discs, which is called the circumgalactic medium. It's still unclear if most of the missing oxygen is in this medium for the dwarf galaxies or if it's been completely ejected.
paras.zh: 之前的一项研究表明，对于像我们银河系这样的恒星形成星系，一些缺失的氧气是在其盘外星系周围气体的扩散晕中发现的，这种气体被称为环星系介质。目前还不清楚大部分缺失的氧气是否存在于矮星系的这种介质中，或者是否已被完全喷射出来。

articles.title: Timbaland Sues Ex-Managers for $15M Over Accusations of ‘Financial Misconduct’
articles.author: Bill Donahue

paras.en: Timbaland is suing his former manager and business manager in a $15 million lawsuit that alleges the pair committed widespread misconduct in order to “enrich themselves” at the star’s expense.
paras.zh: 蒂姆巴兰正在起诉他的前经理和业务经理，诉讼金额达 1500 万美元，指控两人犯下广泛的不当行为，以牺牲这位明星的利益为代价“致富”。

paras.en: The lawsuit, submitted Friday (Oct. 30) to a Los Angeles court and reviewed by Billboard, claims manager Gary Marella “stole millions in unauthorized commissions, fees, and reimbursements” and “falsified financial records” to conceal misdeeds.
paras.zh: 该诉讼于周五（10 月 30 日）提交给洛杉矶一家法院，并由 Billboard 审查，声称经理加里·马雷拉（Gary Marella）“窃取了数百万美元未经授权的佣金、费用和报销”，并“伪造了财务记录”以掩盖不当行为。

paras.en: The case also alleges that business manager Bruce Seckendorf caused big tax penalties by failing to pay federal taxes and also nearly caused the star’s house to be foreclosed, all while continuing to pay himself and Marella “millions” in fees.
paras.zh: 该案件还指控，业务经理布鲁斯·塞肯多夫(Bruce Seckendorf)因未缴纳联邦税而受到巨额税收处罚，还几乎导致这位明星的房子被取消赎回权，同时继续向自己和马雷拉支付“数百万”的费用。

paras.en: “This is not a case about ordinary business losses or bookkeeping errors,” Timbaland’s lawyers write. “Defendants used their entrusted authority to enrich themselves and others, conceal financial misconduct, and deplete Timbaland’s valuable assets.”
paras.zh: “这不是一个普通的商业损失或簿记错误的案件，”蒂姆巴兰的律师写道。 “被告利用其委托的权力为自己和他人谋取利益，隐瞒财务不当行为，并耗尽 Timbaland 的宝贵资产。”

paras.en: In a response statement to Billboard on Monday (Nov. 2), Marella denied the lawsuit’s allegations, saying the “allegation that I paid myself without his knowledge is not true.”
paras.zh: 在周一（11 月 2 日）向 Billboard 发出的回应声明中，Marella 否认了诉讼的指控，称“关于我在他不知情的情况下给自己付钱的指控并不属实”。

paras.en: “When I began managing Tim in 2017, long after he had produced his biggest hits, he was already in a bad financial place,” the manager said. “His financial problems did not begin with me. I came in to help rebuild his business. Over approximately nine years after I started working with Tim, we generated roughly $75 million in business.”
paras.zh: “当我在 2017 年开始管理蒂姆时，在他创作出最热门作品很久之后，他的财务状况就已经很糟糕了，”这位经理说道。 “他的财务问题并不是由我开始的。我进来是为了帮​​助他重建业务。在我开始与蒂姆合作大约九年的时间里，我们创造了大约 7500 万美元的业务。”

paras.en: Timbaland (Timothy Zachery Mosley), a hit-making producer behind smash singles like Jay-Z’s “Big Pimpin’” and Justin Timberlake’s “SexyBack,” was managed for a decade by Marella, a veteran manager at Mono Music Group. That included Timbaland’s catalog sale to Hipgnosis Songs Fund in 2019, as well as his success with and later sale of Verzuz, a battle rap livestream series that spiked in popularity during the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: Timbaland（蒂莫西·扎切里·莫斯利饰）是一位制作人，他是 Jay-Z 的“Big Pimpin”和 Justin Timberlake 的“SexyBack”等热门单曲的制作人，由 Mono Music Group 的资深经理 Marella 管理了十年。其中包括 Timbaland 在 2019 年向 Hipgnosis Songs Fund 出售的目录，以及他在《Verzuz》上取得的成功和后来的销售，《Verzuz》是一个战斗说唱直播系列，在 COVID-19 大流行期间人气飙升。

paras.en: The discord between them first became public in August, when Timbaland lodged accusations against the manager as part of a wrongful termination lawsuit filed against the star by DJ E Feezy. In that filing, made in Florida state court, Timbaland blamed Marella for Feezy’s accusations, leveled allegations of financial impropriety and said he had terminated him as his manager more than a year earlier.
paras.zh: 他们之间的不和第一次公开是在八月份，当时 Timbaland 在 DJ E Feezy 对这位明星提起的不当解雇诉讼中对这位经理提出了指控。在佛罗里达州法院提交的文件中，蒂姆巴兰将菲齐的指控归咎于马雷拉，提出了财务不当行为的指控，并表示一年多前他已经解雇了他的经理职务。

paras.en: In Friday’s complaint, Timbaland doubled down on those accusations, claiming Marella had “treated plaintiff’s income and business ventures as his own checkbook.” The lawsuit claims Marella charged personal expenses to an American Express card, took improper compensation from both the Hipgnosis and Verzuz deals, and then covered his tracks with “falsified financial records” designed to “mislead” the star: “Defendants knew where the money went. Mosley did not.”
paras.zh: 在周五的投诉中，蒂姆巴兰加倍强调了这些指控，声称马雷拉“将原告的收入和商业投资视为自己的支票簿”。诉讼称，马雷拉用美国运通卡收取个人费用，从 Hipgnosis 和 Verzuz 交易中获取不当补偿，然后用“伪造的财务记录”掩盖他的踪迹，旨在“误导”这位明星：“被告知道钱去了哪里。莫斯利不知道。”

paras.en: The lawsuit takes particular aim at their work on Beatclub, an online marketplace Timbaland and Marella co-founded in 2021 to help creators and producers monetize their beats and music. The producer’s attorneys say Marella “grossly mismanaged” the company and “treated Mosley as a piggy bank to repair the problems he created.”
paras.zh: 该诉讼特别针对他们在 Beatclub 上的工作，Beatclub 是 Timbaland 和 Marella 于 2021 年共同创立的在线市场，旨在帮助创作者和制作人通过他们的节拍和音乐获利。制片人的律师表示，马雷拉对公司“管理严重不善”，并“把莫斯利当作一个储蓄罐来解决他造成的问题”。

paras.en: “Marella depleted investor funds, spent company money contrary to how he represented it would be used, incurred obligations Beatclub could not pay, failed to pay employees and creators he hired, and spent money contrary to board restrictions,” the lawsuit claims. “Instead of disclosing his misconduct and correcting it, Marella repeatedly lied about Beatclub’s financial condition.”
paras.zh: 诉讼称：“马雷拉耗尽了投资者的资金，花掉了公司的资金，与他所表示的用途相反，承担了 Beatclub 无法支付的义务，未能支付他雇用的员工和创作者的工资，并且花钱违反了董事会的限制。” “马雷拉没有揭露并纠正他的不当行为，而是多次对 Beatclub 的财务状况撒谎。”

paras.en: In his response statement to Billboard, Marella disputed those accusations, saying the pair had together “hired a bad CTO who spent a significant amount of our capital, repeatedly missed deadlines, and ultimately failed to build the platform properly.”
paras.zh: 在对 Billboard 的回应声明中，马雷拉对这些指控提出了异议，称两人一起“聘请了一位糟糕的首席技术官，他花费了我们大量的资金，屡屡错过最后期限，最终未能正确构建平台。”

paras.en: “These setbacks created substantial financial challenges for the company,” Marella says. “Beatclub faced the challenges and setbacks that many startups experience. Those difficulties should not be confused with financial misconduct. “
paras.zh: “这些挫折给公司带来了巨大的财务挑战，”马雷拉说。 “Beatclub 面临着许多初创公司所经历的挑战和挫折。这些困难不应与财务不当行为相混淆。”

paras.en: Seckendorf, who has been named a Billboard Top Business Manager for several years running, was the star’s accountant from 1998 onward before also becoming his business manager in 2016, according to the lawsuit. Timbaland’s attorneys claim that move came in the wake of the star discovering “millions of dollars of misconduct” by his previous managers and looking for new advisors.
paras.zh: 诉讼称，塞肯多夫连续几年被评为公告牌最佳业务经理，从 1998 年开始担任这位明星的会计师，并于 2016 年成为他的业务经理。蒂姆巴兰的律师声称，此举是在这位明星发现他的前任经理存在“数百万美元的不当行为”并寻找新顾问之后做出的。

paras.en: “Seckendorf presented himself as the person who already knew Mosley’s finances, could repair the damage, and would prevent the same thing from happening again,” Timbaland’s lawyers write in the court filings. “Instead, defendants recreated, and substantially worsened, the very circumstances that Mosley had trusted them to prevent.”
paras.zh: 廷巴兰的律师在法庭文件中写道：“塞肯多夫自称已经了解莫斯利的财务状况，可以修复损失，并会防止同样的事情再次发生。” “相反，被告重现了莫斯利原本相信他们能够阻止的情况，并且使情况变得严重恶化。”

paras.en: Seckendorf did not immediately return a request for comment on the accusations.
paras.zh: 塞肯多夫没有立即回复对这些指控发表评论的请求。

paras.en: In technical legal terms, the lawsuit accuses both men of breach of fiduciary duty, fraudulent concealment and civil theft. It also accuses Marella specifically of fraud, breach of contract and misappropriation of his likeness, and accuses Seckendorf specifically of professional negligence and aiding and abetting a breach of fiduciary duty. It seeks at least $15 million in damages, as well as other monetary penalties and injunctions.
paras.zh: 从专业法律术语来看，该诉讼指控两人违反信托义务、欺诈性隐瞒和民事盗窃。它还特别指控马雷拉欺诈、违反合同和盗用他的肖像，并特别指控塞肯多夫职业疏忽以及协助和教唆违反信托义务。它寻求至少 1500 万美元的赔偿，以及其他罚款和禁令。

articles.title: Cardi B Tells Students to Pass Exams Without Using AI: ‘Don’t Ask ChatGPT for the Answer’
articles.author: Angel Diaz

paras.en: Cardi B isn’t a fan of students leaning on AI to pass their classes.
paras.zh: Cardi B 不喜欢学生依靠人工智能来通过课程。

paras.en: During a recent performance at Johns Hopkins University’s Hoptoberfest, the Billboard Hot 100-topping Bronx rapper had a message for the students in attendance. “Y’all better pass y’all motherf–kin’ semester,” she told the crowd. “And don’t ask ChatGPT for the answer.” This isn’t the first time Cardi has shown her disdain for artificial intelligence. Back in February, she tweeted about having to deal with seeing family get duped by AI on Facebook. “Free my older family members from facebook Ai,” the Grammy winner wrote while adding a robot and weary face emoji.
paras.zh: 最近在约翰·霍普金斯大学 Hoptoberfest 的一场表演中，这位位列公告牌热门 100 名的布朗克斯说唱歌手向出席的学生们传达了一条信息。 “你们最好度过你们所有的学期，”她对人群说。 “并且不要向 ChatGPT 询问答案。”这并不是卡迪第一次表现出对人工智能的蔑视。早在二月份，她就在 Facebook 上发推文称，她不得不面对家人被人工智能欺骗的经历。这位格莱美奖得主写道：“让我年长的家庭成员摆脱 Facebook Ai 的束缚，”同时添加了机器人和疲惫的表情符号。

paras.en: Cardi was a late addition to Hoptoberfest, the annual Halloween event put on by the university’s Hopkins Student Organization for Programming (HOP), after Canadian singer Daniel Caesar had to suddenly cancel. The student paper, The News-Letter, reported that ticketholders learned about the change in an email that read, “Due to unforeseen circumstances, Daniel Caesar is no longer able to perform. However, we are excited to announce that our new headliner is none other than…CARDI B!!!”
paras.zh: 在加拿大歌手丹尼尔·凯撒突然取消后，卡迪是霍普金斯大学学生编程组织 (HOP) 举办的年度万圣节活动霍普托啤酒节 (Hoptoberfest) 的最后补充。学生报纸《新闻通讯》报道说，持票者在一封电子邮件中得知了这一变化，其中写道：“由于不可预见的情况，丹尼尔·凯撒不再能够表演。但是，我们很高兴地宣布，我们的新主角不是别人，正是……卡迪·B！！！”

paras.en: Students didn’t mind the last-minute change, though.
paras.zh: 不过，学生们并不介意最后一刻的改变。

paras.en: “I was actually pretty excited about Daniel Caesar, I do listen to a good amount of his music,” sophomore Bhavya Guru told the paper. “When they switched it to Cardi B, I was a little surprised and honestly thought it was fake. I’m honestly really hyped for Cardi B and think it’s going to be a lot of fun. I feel like it’s going to be really good to hear a lot of throwbacks.”
paras.zh: “我实际上对丹尼尔·凯撒感到非常兴奋，我确实听了很多他的音乐，”二年级学生 Bhavya Guru 告诉该报。 “当他们把它换成 Cardi B 时，我有点惊讶，老实说我认为这是假的。说实话，我对 Cardi B 非常兴奋，认为它会很有趣。我觉得听到很多复古的声音真的很好。”

paras.en: Sophomore Lana Hakma was also hyped about the switch and didn’t mind that the event had to be rescheduled from Saturday, Oct. 31, to Sunday, Nov. 1. “I am personally really excited about the change,” she told The News-Letter. “I like Cardi B a lot better and I know her songs.”
paras.zh: 大二学生 Lana Hakma 也对这一转变感到兴奋，并且不介意活动必须从 10 月 31 日星期六重新安排到 11 月 1 日星期日。“我个人对这一变化感到非常兴奋，”她告诉《新闻快报》。 “我更喜欢 Cardi B，而且我了解她的歌曲。”

paras.en: In other Cardi news, she’s been making headlines lately through X Spaces and Instagram Live, respectively. First, she talked about how rap beef is boring. “I don’t even give a f–k about these b—hes anymore,” she told fans. “To be honest with you, it’s like, I don’t even like beefing with rap b—hes anymore, because it’s kinda boring.” Then, about a week later, she spoke on how fame and fortune can change how those around you view you. “Being successful, it is so scary,” she said. “Not even because you just don’t know who’s genuine anymore. You just don’t know who got that secret animosity for you. And it’s so crazy, because you could be cheering for somebody, you could be loving on somebody, and they don’t want that.”
paras.zh: 在 Cardi 的其他新闻中，她最近分别通过 X Spaces 和 Instagram Live 成为头条新闻。首先，她谈到说唱牛肉是多么无聊。 “我什至不再关心这些混蛋了，”她告诉粉丝。 “说实话，我什至不再喜欢抱怨说唱了，因为这有点无聊。”然后，大约一周后，她谈到名誉和财富如何改变你周围人对你的看法。 “成功真是太可怕了，”她说。 “甚至不是因为你不再知道谁是真诚的。你只是不知道谁对你有秘密的敌意。这太疯狂了，因为你可能会为某人欢呼，你可能会爱某人，但他们不想要这样。”

articles.title: Tate McRae’s ‘Housewife’ Scores Second Week at No. 1 on Billboard Global Charts
articles.author: Gary Trust

paras.en: Tate McRae’s “Housewife” adds a second week at No. 1 on both the Billboard Global 200 and Billboard Global Excl. U.S., a week after it debuted at the summit of both surveys.
paras.zh: 泰特·麦克雷 (Tate McRae) 的《家庭主妇》连续第二周位居 Billboard Global 200 和 Billboard Global Excl 排行榜第一名。美国，在两项调查首次亮相一周后。

paras.en: The song remains the biggest hit in the world with 64.1 million streams (up 15%) and 3,000 sold (down 52%) globally Oct. 23-29, according to Luminate. It totaled 44.2 million streams (up 32%) outside the U.S.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，这首歌仍然是全球最热门歌曲，10 月 23 日至 29 日全球播放量为 6,410 万次（增长 15%），销量为 3,000 张（下降 52%）。美国以外地区的总播放量为 4,420 万次（增长 32%）

paras.en: “Housewife” became the Canadian singer-songwriter’s second leader on each chart, and her first to debut on top. “Greedy” ruled the Global 200 for two weeks and Global Excl. U.S. for five in 2023-24.
paras.zh: 《家庭主妇》成为这位加拿大创作型歌手在每张排行榜上的第二位领军者，也是她首次登顶榜首。 “Greedy”统治了全球 200 强两周，全球排除。 2023-24 年，美国将有 5 个。

paras.en: Elsewhere in the Global 200’s top five, Karol G, Judeline and rusowsky’s “BbY WOW” rebounds 3-2 after six weeks at No. 1 since September; ADÉLA’s “Nicole Kidman” rises 4-3, off its No. 2 best; Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan’s “Expectations” drops to No. 4 from its No. 2 peak; and Ashe’s “Stop the Wedding!” jumps 10-5 for a new high.
paras.zh: 在全球 200 强排行榜前五名中，Karol G、Judeline 和 rusowsky 的《BbY WOW》自 9 月份以来连续六周排名第一，之后以 3-2 的成绩反弹； ADÉLA 的《妮可·基德曼》以 4 比 3 的成绩上升，超越了第二名的最佳成绩；奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 和查普尔·罗恩 (Chappell Roan) 的《Expectations》从峰值的第二名跌至第四名；和艾什的《停止婚礼！》跃升10-5再创新高。

paras.en: The Global Excl. U.S. top five is rounded by “BbY WOW,” which holds at No. 2, likewise after six weeks at No. 1 since September; “Nicole Kidman,” up 5-3 after reaching No. 2; “Expectations,” which keeps at its No. 4 high; and A2O LITE’s “Neon,” down to No. 5 from its No. 3 peak.
paras.zh: 全球排除。美国前五名由“BbY WOW”进入，该歌曲自 9 月以来连续六周排名第一，目前排名第二； “妮可·基德曼”排名第二，以 5 比 3 领先； “预期”保持在第四位； A2O LITE 的《Neon》从最高的第 3 名跌至第 5 名。

paras.en: Jamie Miller earns his first top 10 on both the Global 200, where “Babydoll” bounds 37-10, and Global Excl. U.S., surging 31-9. The pop single by the Welsh artist, which he co-wrote, drew 19.8 million streams (up 36%) and sold 13,000 (up 55%) worldwide in the tracking week. It also notches a second week at No. 1 on the U.K.’s Official Singles Chart.
paras.zh: 杰米·米勒 (Jamie Miller) 在全球 200 强排行榜上首次跻身前 10 名，其中《Babydoll》 的成绩为 37-10，而《全球排除》则首次跻身前十。美国队以31-9飙升。这位威尔士艺术家与他人共同创作的这首流行单曲在追踪周内吸引了 1,980 万次播放（增长 36%），并在全球范围内售出 13,000 张（增长 55%）。它还连续第二周在英国官方单曲排行榜上排名第一。

paras.en: Plus, Felipe & Rodrigo, from Brazil, achieve their first Global Excl. U.S. top 10 as “Pos (Em Brasilia)” pushes 16-10 with 18.7 million streams (up 8%) outside the U.S.
paras.zh: 另外，来自巴西的 Felipe & Rodrigo 实现了他们的第一个全球排除赛。美国排名前 10 名的“Pos (Em Brasilia)”以 16-10 的成绩在美国以外地区以 1,870 万次播放量（增长 8%）挺进。

paras.en: The Billboard Global 200 and Global Excl. U.S. charts rank songs based on streaming and sales activity culled from more than 200 territories around the world, as compiled by Luminate. The Global 200 is inclusive of worldwide data and the Global Excl. U.S. chart comprises data from territories excluding the United States.
paras.zh: Billboard Global 200 和 Global Excl.美国排行榜根据 Luminate 编制的从全球 200 多个地区挑选的流媒体和销售活动对歌曲进行排名。全球 200 强包含全球数据和全球排除数据。美国图表包含美国以外地区的数据。

paras.en: Chart ranks are based on a weighted formula incorporating official-only streams on both subscription and ad-supported tiers of audio and video music services, as well as download sales, the latter of which reflect purchases from full-service digital music retailers from around the world, with sales from direct-to-consumer (D2C) sites excluded from the charts’ calculations.
paras.zh: 排行榜排名基于加权公式，其中包含音频和视频音乐服务的订阅层和广告支持层的官方流以及下载销售量，后者反映了来自世界各地的全方位服务数字音乐零售商的购买量，来自直接面向消费者 (D2C) 网站的销售量不包括在图表计算中。

paras.en: The latest charts, dated Nov. 7, 2026, will update on Billboard.com tomorrow, Nov. 3. For both tallies, the top 100 titles are available to all readers on Billboard.com, while the complete 200-title rankings are visible on Billboard Pro, Billboard’s subscription-based service. For all chart news, you can follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on both X, formerly known as Twitter, and Instagram.
paras.zh: 日期为 2026 年 11 月 7 日的最新排行榜将于明天（11 月 3 日）在 Billboard.com 上更新。对于这两个统计，Billboard.com 上的所有读者都可以看到前 100 部作品，而完整的 200 部作品排名可以在 Billboard 的订阅服务 Billboard Pro 上查看。对于所有排行榜新闻，您可以在 X（以前称为 Twitter）和 Instagram 上关注 @billboard 和 @billboardcharts。

paras.en: Luminate, the independent data provider to the Billboard charts, completes a thorough review of all data submissions used in compiling the weekly chart rankings. Luminate reviews and authenticates data. In partnership with Billboard, data deemed suspicious or unverifiable is removed, using established criteria, before final chart calculations are made and published.
paras.zh: Luminate 是 Billboard 排行榜的独立数据提供商，完成了对用于编制每周排行榜排名的所有数据提交的彻底审查。阐明评论并验证数据。与 Billboard 合作，在进行最终图表计算并发布之前，使用既定标准删除被视为可疑或无法验证的数据。

articles.title: Sharon Horgan Comedy ‘Youth’ Renewed for Second Season at HBO
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: HBO has picked up a second season of Sharon Horgan‘s comedy series Youth.
paras.zh: HBO 已播出莎朗·霍根 (Sharon Horgan) 的喜剧剧集《青春》第二季。

paras.en: The renewal comes a day after the show’s season finale, which saw Horgan’s character, Alex, at a crossroads both personally and professionally. There’s no word yet on when a second season might arrive.
paras.zh: 续订是在该剧季终集的第二天，霍根饰演的角色亚历克斯正处于个人和职业的十字路口。目前还没有关于第二季何时到来的消息。

paras.en: “I’m so happy to get another opportunity to live out my emotional and biological crises on HBO,” Horgan said in a statement. “I can’t think of a better platform to air my UTI problems on. The response to Youth has been beyond what I could have hoped for. I’m so grateful for the response and the chance to work with this incredible cast and creative team once more.”
paras.zh: 霍根在一份声明中表示：“我很高兴能再次有机会在 HBO 上度过我的情感和生理危机。” “我想不出更好的平台来表达我的尿路感染问题。《Youth》的反响超出了我的预期。我非常感谢大家的反响以及再次与这个令人难以置信的演员和创意团队合作的机会。”

paras.en: Youth follows Horgan’s Alex, a 50-year-old divorcee, as she tries to get her love life back on track, deals with a teenage son (Aran Murphy) having trouble adjusting to young adulthood and attempts to keep her career moving forward.
paras.zh: 《青春》讲述了霍根饰演的亚历克斯，一位 50 岁的离婚者，她试图让自己的爱情生活重回正轨，处理一个十几岁的儿子（阿兰·墨菲饰）在适应年轻成年时遇到的困难，并试图让她的事业继续前进。

paras.en: “In a way that only she can, Sharon has created a show that makes us howl with laughter and with tears — often in the same moment,” said Amy Gravitt, executive vp HBO Programming and head of comedy series for HBO and HBO Max. “Each performance in Youth is more delightful than the next. Along with our partners at Merman, we are so thrilled to have this brilliant ensemble back for another season.”
paras.zh: HBO 节目执行副总裁兼 HBO 和 HBO Max 喜剧系列主管艾米·格拉维特 (Amy Gravitt) 表示：“莎伦以她独有的方式创作了一部让我们又笑又泪的节目，而且常常是在同一时刻。” “《Youth》中的每一场表演都比下一场更令人愉快。与 Merman 的合作伙伴一起，我们非常高兴这个出色的乐团在另一个赛季再次回归。”

paras.en: The series also stars Rupert Friend, Sharlene Whyte and Robbie Gee. Horgan created Youth and writes and executive produces in addition to starring. Faye Dorn of Horgan’s Merman company, Jim Kleverweis, and Dawn Shadforth also exec produce. Shadforth directed four of the season’s eight episodes, while Jim O’Hanlon helmed the other four.
paras.zh: 该剧还由鲁珀特·弗兰德、莎琳·怀特和罗比·吉主演。霍根创作了《青春》，除了主演之外，还担任编剧和执行制片人。霍根 Merman 公司的 Faye Dorn、Jim Kleverweis 和 Dawn Shadforth 也担任执行制作。沙德福斯执导了本季八集中的四集，而吉姆·奥汉隆则执导了另外四集。

articles.title: Former ‘Ellen’ Executive Producer Matthew Wright Dies as Ellen DeGeneres Posts Tearful Video Calling Him “The Glue to Our Entire Family”
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: Former The Ellen DeGeneres Show executive producer Matthew Wright died Friday in what a GoFundMe campaign for his family calls an “unfathomable tragedy.” He was 52, according to reports.
paras.zh: 前《艾伦秀》执行制片人马修·赖特 (Matthew Wright) 于周五去世，GoFundMe 为他的家人发起的一项活动称，这是一场“深不可测的悲剧”。据报道，他今年 52 岁。

paras.en: Wright died while working remotely in Los Angeles, according to the GoFundMe, while his family is in New York. Both Wright and his husband were “laid off this summer,” the GoFundMe states.
paras.zh: 据 GoFundMe 报道，赖特在洛杉矶远程工作时去世，而他的家人则在纽约。 GoFundMe 称，赖特和他的丈夫“今年夏天都被解雇了”。

paras.en: DeGeneres posted a tearful video on Instagram Monday remembering Wright, who worked on her show from 2006 to its finale in 2022.
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯周一在 Instagram 上发布了一段泪流满面的视频，纪念赖特，赖特从 2006 年一直为她的节目工作，直到 2022 年大结局。

paras.en: “He was an amazing guy. He was funny. God, he made me laugh. He would surprise me with things that he did all the time. He was smart. He was kind. He was the part of our show that — I mean, everyone loved him. I loved him. And it’s just shocking — it’s shocking. We’re gonna miss him. He is and always will be the glue to our entire family at The Ellen Show.”
paras.zh: “他是一个了不起的人。他很有趣。上帝，他让我发笑。他总是用他所做的事情让我感到惊讶。他很聪明。他很友善。他是我们节目中的一部分 - 我的意思是，每个人都爱他。我爱他。这真是令人震惊 - 令人震惊。我们会想念他的。他现在是，也永远是艾伦秀上我们整个家庭的粘合剂。”

paras.en: DeGeneres also noted that Wright was close with former Ellen DJ Stephen “tWitch” Boss, who died in 2022, saying she believes the two are now reunited in the afterlife, “dancing and laughing.”
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯还指出，赖特与 2022 年去世的前艾伦 DJ 斯蒂芬“tWitch”Boss 关系密切，她说她相信两人现在在来世重聚，“又舞又笑”。

paras.en: DeGeneres ended her tribute with a compilation of some of Wright’s funniest moments on her show, including a video of him jokingly admonishing restaurants for bringing too many appetizers to the table at once in a segment called “Strong Opinions With Matt.”
paras.zh: 德杰尼勒斯以赖特在节目中一些最有趣时刻的汇编结束了她的致敬，其中包括一段视频，在一段名为“马特的强烈意见”的片段中，他开玩笑地警告餐馆一次性上桌的开胃菜太多。

paras.en: Fellow former Ellen executive producer Andy Lassner also took to Instagram to remember Wright, sharing photos of himself with Wright on the set of The Jennifer Hudson Show on Thursday, where Lassner now works as a executive producer, which Lassner said were taken “hours” before Wright died.
paras.zh: 前艾伦执行制片人安迪·拉斯纳也在 Instagram 上纪念赖特，周四分享了他与赖特在《詹妮弗·哈德森秀》片场的照片，拉斯纳现在担任执行制片人，拉斯纳说这些照片是在赖特去世前“几个小时”拍摄的。

paras.en: “We are all in shock. He was a brilliant producer and an even better human being,” Lassner wrote in the caption. “The way he looked after his mom, flying back and forth from Los Angeles to New York practically every weekend before she died, showed what an incredible son he was. He gave that same depth of love to his friendships. My heart breaks for his husband, Justin, his family, and all of us who loved him. I was so lucky to work beside Matt for so many years and to call him my friend. We should have had so much more time with him.”
paras.zh: “我们都感到震惊。他是一位出色的制片人，也是一个更好的人，”拉斯纳在标题中写道。 “在母亲去世前，他几乎每个周末都从洛杉矶飞往纽约，他照顾母亲的方式表明他是一个多么不可思议的儿子。他对友谊也给予了同样深的爱。我为他的丈夫贾斯汀、他的家人以及我们所有爱他的人感到心碎。我很幸运能在马特身边工作这么多年，并称他为我的朋友。我们应该有更多的时间和他在一起。”

paras.en: Former The Real co-host Loni Love also paid tribute to Wright, writing on Facebook that she was “devastated and heartbroken” to hear that he died.
paras.zh: 《The Real》前联合主持人洛妮·洛夫 (Loni Love) 也向赖特表示敬意，她在 Facebook 上写道，听到赖特去世的消息，她感到“震惊和心碎”。

paras.en: “He was such a talented, sweet man and always game for anything. I cannot believe he’s gone,” she wrote. “What a pleasure it was to have known him. Sending love and heartfelt condolences to his husband, family and all who loved him.”
paras.zh: “他是一个如此有才华、可爱的人，总是为任何事情而努力。我不敢相信他已经走了，”她写道。 “认识他真是太高兴了。向他的丈夫、家人和所有爱他的人致以爱和衷心的慰问。”

paras.en: The fundraising post, which sought to raise $50,000 for a funeral and memorial as well as a trust for his niece, had already surpassed its goal by Monday afternoon.
paras.zh: 该筹款帖旨在为他的侄女的葬礼和追悼会以及信托筹集 5 万美元，到周一下午已经超过了目标。

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Disney Night Rescheduled Ahead of Midterms: When and Where to Watch Online
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Fan-favorite DWTS Disney Night returns with guest judge Cynthia Erivo. Given Tuesday’s live election coverage, this week’s episode instead airs on Monday, Nov. 2 at 8 p.m. PT/ET on ABC, available to stream live via DirecTV (with a five-day free trial), Fubo (with a five-day free trial), Sling and Hulu + Live TV. It will also stream on Disney+, which doesn’t offer a free trial of its own, but is included in any of DirecTV’s Signature packages, which do offer the aforementioned free trial.
paras.zh: 深受粉丝喜爱的 DWTS 迪士尼之夜携客座评委辛西娅·埃里沃 (Cynthia Erivo) 回归。鉴于周二的现场选举报道，本周的剧集将于 11 月 2 日星期一晚上 8 点播出。 ABC 上的 PT/ET，可通过 DirecTV（免费试用五天）、Fubo（免费试用五天）、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV 进行直播。它还将在 Disney+ 上播放，Disney+ 本身不提供免费试用，但包含在 DirecTV 的任何 Signature 套餐中，后者确实提供上述免费试用。

paras.en: At a Glance: How to Watch Dancing With the Stars Season 35 Disney Night
paras.zh: 概览：如何观看与星共舞第 35 季迪士尼之夜

paras.en: - Air date/time: Monday, Nov. 2, 8 p.m. PT/ET
paras.zh: - 播出日期/时间：11 月 2 日星期一晚上 8 点时间/ET

paras.en: - Stream online: DirecTV, Fubo, Sling, Hulu + Live TV, Disney+ (also included in DirecTV Signature packages’ five-day free trial); available to stream next day on Hulu and on-demand via Disney+
paras.zh: - 在线流媒体：DirecTV、Fubo、Sling、Hulu + Live TV、Disney+（也包含在 DirecTV Signature 套餐的五天免费试用中）；第二天即可在 Hulu 上播放并通过 Disney+ 点播

paras.en: Where to Watch Dancing With the Stars Disney Night: Air Date, Time
paras.zh: 哪里可以观看《与星共舞迪士尼之夜》：播出日期、时间

paras.en: Disney Night 2026 airs live on Monday, Nov. 2 at 8 p.m. PT/ET on ABC (carried on live TV streamers like DirecTV, Fubo, Sling and Hulu + Live TV) and will be simulcast on Disney+.
paras.zh: 2026 年迪士尼之夜将于 11 月 2 日星期一晚上 8 点直播PT/ET 在 ABC 上播出（由 DirecTV、Fubo、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV 等直播电视流媒体直播），并将在 Disney+ 上同步播出。

paras.en: Where to Stream Dancing With the Stars Disney Night Online Free
paras.zh: 哪里可以免费在线观看《与星共舞迪士尼之夜》

paras.en: Since the competition show airs on ABC, it’s also available to watch live on any streaming service that carries said network, including DirecTV (with a five-day free trial), Fubo (also with a five-day free trial), Sling and Hulu + Live TV.
paras.zh: 由于比赛节目在 ABC 播出，因此还可以在任何支持该网络的流媒体服务上观看直播，包括 DirecTV（可免费试用五天）、Fubo（也可免费试用五天）、Sling 和 Hulu + Live TV。

articles.title: U.S. judge dismisses Trump administration's Harvard admissions probe case

paras.en: A federal judge dismissed on Monday a lawsuit by President Donald Trump's administration seeking to force Harvard University to turn over records for an investigation into whether it continues to consider race in its student admissions process.
paras.zh: 周一，一名联邦法官驳回了唐纳德·特朗普总统政府提起的诉讼，该诉讼旨在迫使哈佛大学交出记录，以调查其是否继续在学生招生过程中考虑种族因素。

paras.en: US District Judge Myong Joun in Boston rejected the US Department of Justice's lawsuit, which Harvard contends was filed as part of a broader campaign by the Republican president's administration against the Ivy League school.
paras.zh: 波士顿的美国地区法官 Myong Joun 驳回了美国司法部的诉讼，哈佛大学称该诉讼是共和党总统政府针对常春藤联盟学校发起的更广泛运动的一部分。

paras.en: The judge stressed that his decision rested on narrow, procedural grounds and did not resolve whether the Justice Department and US Department of Education could ultimately seek data on thousands of high school students who sought admission at Harvard.
paras.zh: 法官强调，他的决定基于狭隘的程序依据，并没有解决司法部和美国教育部最终是否可以获取数千名寻求哈佛入学的高中生的数据的问题。

paras.en: But Joun, an appointee of Democratic President Joe Biden, agreed with Harvard that the Justice Department sued without taking all legally required steps aimed at securing the university's voluntary compliance with its demands for applicant-level data.
paras.zh: 但民主党总统乔·拜登的任命人乔恩同意哈佛大学的观点，即司法部在没有采取旨在确保大学自愿遵守其对申请人级数据的要求的所有法律要求的步骤的情况下提起诉讼。

paras.en: "For example, the complaint does not allege that DOJ informed Harvard of the action it would take — namely, litigation — should Harvard fail to comply, nor does the complaint allege the specific failure identified," Joun wrote.
paras.zh: 乔恩写道：“例如，起诉书并没有声称司法部告知哈佛，如果哈佛不遵守规定，它将采取什么行动，即诉讼，也没有指控所确定的具体失败。”

paras.en: The Justice Department and Harvard did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 司法部和哈佛大学没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Harvard has been a top target of the administration's effort to leverage federal funding and government power to force changes at universities that Trump says are dominated by "radical left" ideologies.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学一直是政府利用联邦资金和政府权力迫使大学进行变革的首要目标，特朗普称这些大学被“激进左翼”意识形态主导。

paras.en: The Cambridge, Massachusetts-based university has already secured rulings from other judges rejecting the administration's efforts to terminate over $2 billion in grants, block the school from hosting international students and sue it for allegedly failing to protect Jewish and Israeli students from harassment.
paras.zh: 这所位于马萨诸塞州剑桥的大学已经获得其他法官的裁决，驳回政府终止超过 20 亿美元补助金、阻止学校招收国际学生的努力，并因涉嫌未能保护犹太和以色列学生免受骚扰而起诉该校。

paras.en: The Justice Department filed the case before Joun in February, arguing Harvard was not complying with investigations into whether it is following the US Supreme Court's 2023 ruling in a case involving the school rejecting race-conscious admissions programs used to boost enrollment of minority students.
paras.zh: 司法部于 2 月份向 Joun 提起诉讼，称哈佛没有接受调查，调查该校是否遵循美国最高法院 2023 年就一宗案件做出的裁决，该裁决涉及该校拒绝用于提高少数族裔学生入学率的具有种族意识的招生计划。

paras.en: The administration said it needed years of applicant-level admissions data to determine whether race remains a factor in Harvard's admissions decisions and if the university is complying with Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which bars racial discrimination in education programs.
paras.zh: 政府表示，需要多年的申请者招生数据来确定种族是否仍然是哈佛招生决策的一个因素，以及该大学是否遵守 1964 年《民权法案》第六章，该法案禁止教育项目中的种族歧视。

paras.en: Data released by Harvard last week showed Black undergraduate enrollment fell for a third straight year since the Supreme Court barred race-conscious admissions, dropping to 9.3% in the class of 2030 from 11.5% in the class of 2029.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学上周公布的数据显示，自最高法院禁止考虑种族因素的招生以来，黑人本科生入学率连续第三年下降，从 2029 届毕业生的 11.5% 降至 2030 届毕业生的 9.3%。

paras.en: The university's lawyers countered that the case was filed to retaliate against Harvard for refusing demands that it overhaul its governance, hiring and academic programs to align with the administration's agenda.
paras.zh: 该大学的律师反驳说，提起此案是为了报复哈佛大学拒绝彻底改革其治理、招聘和学术项目以符合政府议程的要求。

paras.en: They said the lawsuit was filed after Trump announced in early February that he was ending settlement talks and wanted $1 billion in damages from Harvard, which he said had "been, for a long time, behaving very badly."
paras.zh: 他们表示，这起诉讼是在特朗普于 2 月初宣布结束和解谈判并要求哈佛大学赔偿 10 亿美元后提起的，他称哈佛大学“长期以来表现非常糟糕”。

paras.en: Joun, in dismissing the case on Monday, stressed that he was not resolving whether Harvard has discriminated or if it may ultimately be required to provide data to the agencies. The Justice Department could try to pursue a similar case again if it takes additional administrative steps, he said.
paras.zh: 乔恩在周一驳回此案时强调，他并没有解决哈佛大学是否存在歧视，或者最终是否可能被要求向这些机构提供数据的问题。他说，如果采取额外的行政措施，司法部可能会尝试再次提起类似案件。

articles.title: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time

paras.en: Palantir beat Wall Street's third-quarter estimates after the bell on Monday, with U.S. commercial revenue topping government for the first time as businesses adopt more of the company's artificial intelligence tools.
paras.zh: Palantir 周一收盘后第三季度业绩超出了华尔街预期，随着企业更多地采用该公司的人工智能工具，美国商业收入首次超过政府收入。

paras.en: Here's how the company did compared to LSEG estimates:
paras.zh: 以下是该公司与伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 预估的比较结果：

paras.en: - Earnings per share: 44 cents adjusted vs. 41 cents expected
paras.zh: - 每股收益：调整后为 44 美分，预期为 41 美分

paras.en: - Revenue: $2.31 billion vs. $2.18 billion expected
paras.zh: - 收入：23.1 亿美元，预期为 21.8 亿美元

paras.en: Revenue nearly doubled from a year ago and blew past $2 billion for the first time ever, Palantir said. Net income more than doubled to $1.13 billion, or 44 cents per share, from about $476 million, or 18 cents per share.
paras.zh: Palantir 表示，收入比一年前几乎翻了一番，首次突破 20 亿美元。净利润从约 4.76 亿美元（即每股 18 美分）增加了一倍多，达到 11.3 亿美元（即每股 44 美分）。

paras.en: "I don't believe anyone's had consistent results like this in the history of software AI, ever," CEO Alex Karp told CNBC's Seema Mody in an interview, adding that the business is succeeding without salespeople.
paras.zh: 首席执行官亚历克斯·卡普 (Alex Karp) 在接受 CNBC 的 Seema Mody 采访时表示：“我相信，在软件人工智能的历史上，从来没有人能取得如此一致的结果。”他补充说，即使没有销售人员，公司也能取得成功。

paras.en: Palantir has long been known for its strength in the government sector, but its commercial segment caught up in Q3.
paras.zh: Palantir 长期以来以其在政府领域的实力而闻名，但其商业领域在第三季度迎头赶上。

paras.en: U.S. commercial revenue jumped 148% to $984 million, surpassing U.S. government revenue of $953 million, which was up 96%. The company's U.S. commercial revenue has more than quintupled over the last two years.
paras.zh: 美国商业收入跃升 148%，达到 9.84 亿美元，超过美国政府收入 9.53 亿美元，后者增长了 96%。过去两年，该公司在美国的商业收入增长了五倍多。

paras.en: Palantir lifted its guidance, saying it now expects U.S. commercial revenue "in excess of" $3.56 billion for the full year. Last quarter, the company boosted its forecast to $3.42 billion. The company projects about $2.65 billion in revenue for the fourth quarter and about $8.53 billion for full-year 2026.
paras.zh: Palantir 上调了预期，表示目前预计全年美国商业收入“超过”35.6 亿美元。上季度，该公司将其预测提高至 34.2 亿美元。该公司预计第四季度收入约为 26.5 亿美元，2026 年全年收入约为 85.3 亿美元。

paras.en: Karp has openly supported the use of open-weight models and criticized leading AI labs, which he told CNBC earlier this year are forcing businesses to sell their data sovereignty. Karp, on Monday, also reiterated recent calls to nationalize AI labs, calling it the "only realistic way" to manage liability.
paras.zh: 卡普公开支持使用开放权重模型，并批评领先的人工智能实验室，他在今年早些时候告诉 CNBC，这些实验室正在迫使企业出售其数据主权。卡普周一还重申了最近将人工智能实验室国有化的呼吁，称这是管理责任的“唯一现实的方式”。

paras.en: In September, Karp joined major tech CEOs at the White House as calls for regulation mounted following claims from AI researchers that the technology has a more than 10% of killing humanity.
paras.zh: 今年 9 月，随着人工智能研究人员声称该技术造成 10% 以上的人类死亡，要求监管的呼声越来越高，卡普加入了白宫各大科技公司首席执行官的行列。

paras.en: "My message to everybody is: Beware of thinking you can delay the future in AI," he told CNBC. "The future is here. The political ramifications of it are here."
paras.zh: 他对 CNBC 表示：“我向所有人传达的信息是：不要认为自己会推迟人工智能的未来。” “未来就在这里。它的政治影响就在这里。”

articles.title: Apple beats on quarterly revenue in CEO John Ternus' first earnings report: Live updates

paras.en: Apple reported better-than-expected revenue but came up short of estimates on iPad sales for the fiscal fourth quarter. The stock was little changed in extended trading on Monday.
paras.zh: 苹果公司公布的第四财季营收好于预期，但 iPad 销量未达到预期。该股在周一的延长交易中几乎没有变化。

paras.en: Here's how the company did compared to analysts' estimates, according to LSEG.
paras.zh: 根据伦敦证券交易所集团 (LSEG) 的数据，该公司的业绩与分析师的预期相比如下。

paras.en: - Revenue: $114.48 billion vs. $113.39 billion expected
Here's how Apple's most important product lines did:
paras.zh: 以下是苹果最重要的产品线的表现：

paras.en: - iPhone revenue: $57.58 billion vs. $56.54 billion estimated
paras.zh: - iPhone 收入：575.8 亿美元，预估为 565.4 亿美元

paras.en: - Mac revenue: $10.79 billion vs. $9.61 billion estimated
paras.zh: - Mac 收入：107.9 亿美元，预计为 96.1 亿美元

paras.en: - iPad revenue: $6.23 billion vs. $6.7 billion estimated
paras.zh: - iPad 收入：62.3 亿美元，预计为 67 亿美元

paras.en: - Other Products revenue: $8.3 billion vs. $9.06 billion estimated
paras.zh: - 其他产品收入：83 亿美元，预计为 90.6 亿美元

paras.en: - Wearables, Home and Accessories revenue: $31.57 billion vs. $31.58 billion estimated
paras.zh: - 可穿戴设备、家居及配件收入：315.7 亿美元，预计为 315.8 亿美元

paras.en: It's Apple's first earnings report since CEO John Ternus took the helm on Sept. 1, succeeding Tim Cook. CNBC isn't immediately comparing the earnings figure to LSEG's estimate of $1.99 per share. Apple said tariff refunds added 5 cents to earnings per share.
paras.zh: 这是苹果公司自 9 月 1 日接替蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 接任首席执行官约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 上任以来发布的第一份财报。 CNBC 并未立即将该盈利数据与 LSEG 每股 1.99 美元的预期进行比较。苹果表示，关税退款使每股收益增加了 5 美分。

paras.en: Apple will provide an outlook for the current quarter on a call with analysts as well as discuss memory supply .
paras.zh: 苹果将​​在与分析师的电话会议上提供当前季度的展望，并讨论内存供应问题。

paras.en: Revenue increased 12% from $102.5 billion a year earlier, Apple said in a statement on Monday. Apple's iPhone revenue in the quarter only included eight days of new Phone 18 Pro sales. And Apple's new flagship device, the iPhone Duo, didn't hit store shelves until the period was over.
paras.zh: 苹果公司周一在一份声明中表示，营收较上年同期的 1025 亿美元增长 12%。苹果本季度的 iPhone 收入仅包括新机 Phone 18 Pro 八天的销售。而苹果的新旗舰设备 iPhone Duo 直到该时期结束后才上架。

paras.en: Monday's report includes a full quarter of higher-priced Apple products, as the company raised prices across the board in June after it signaled challenges with memory supply and other parts. Apple increased prices on iPhones by $100.
paras.zh: 周一的报告包括整个季度的高价苹果产品，该公司在表示内存供应和其他零部件面临挑战后，于 6 月份全面提高了价格。 Apple 将 iPhone 的价格提高了 100 美元。

paras.en: The iPhone maker is reckoning with a global memory crunch and a rush for computer components. Apple said on Monday that its memory costs were higher this quarter than in the June period.
paras.zh: 这家 iPhone 制造商正在应对全球内存短缺和计算机零部件的抢购潮。苹果周一表示，本季度内存成本高于 6 月份。

paras.en: Still, Ternus said in a statement that Apple had just capped off its "best fiscal year ever." Ternus told CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos that Apple's growth came in spite of supply constraints and foreign exchange headwinds.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，特纳斯在一份声明中表示，苹果刚刚结束了“有史以来最好的财年”。 Ternus 告诉 CNBC 的 MacKenzie Sigalos，尽管存在供应限制和外汇不利因素，但苹果仍实现了增长。

paras.en: "I think at this point, with everything we've achieved, it just feels like we've never been more confident that the best is yet to come," Ternus said.
paras.zh: “我认为，在这一点上，随着我们所取得的一切成就，我们感觉我们从未如此有信心，最好的尚未到来，”特努斯说。

paras.en: Ternus said that Apple "reluctantly" raised prices, which helped it offset component increases.
paras.zh: Ternus 表示，苹果“不情愿”地提高了价格，这有助于其抵消零部件上涨的影响。

paras.en: Monday's earnings call, set to start at 5 p.m. ET, will be the first with Ternus as CEO. Investors want to hear from him about the company's plans in China after its AI software got approved, as well as the slew of recent product launches and how the company continues to grapple with global shortages of memory and flash storage.
paras.zh: 周一的财报电话会议定于下午 5 点开始。 ET 将是第一个由 Ternus 担任首席执行官的公司。投资者希望了解该公司在人工智能软件获得批准后在中国的计划，以及最近推出的一系列产品，以及该公司如何继续应对全球内存和闪存短缺问题。

articles.title: Ebola update, AI math scoop and permanent daylight saving time

paras.en: Happy Monday, listeners! And happy November. For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman. You’re listening to our weekly science news roundup.
paras.zh: Happy Monday, listeners! And happy November.我是《科学美国人》的《科学快报》的雷切尔·费尔特曼。您正在收听我们的每周科学新闻综述。

paras.en: We’ll start with an update on the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Last Tuesday, data from the country’s Ministry of Health confirmed more than 10,000 cases since May. And nearly half of those people have died.
paras.zh: 我们首先将介绍刚果民主共和国正在爆发的埃博拉疫情的最新情况。上周二，该国卫生部的数据证实自 5 月份以来已有超过 10,000 例病例。其中近一半的人已经死亡。

paras.en: This is the fastest known Ebola outbreak in history. For context, the deadliest outbreak on record, which occurred in West Africa between 2014 and 2016, resulted in 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. But that outbreak lasted more than two years, and the current outbreak in the DRC was declared less than 200 days ago. And the difference in their trajectories is striking. On day 187 of the current outbreak, the official case count was 10,060. On day 186 of the West Africa outbreak, just 544 cases had been recorded.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: There are a few factors making this outbreak tough to manage. The first is the actual species of Ebola-causing virus fueling the outbreak. Of the six known species in this genus, four cause the kind of severe hemorrhagic fever you probably think of when you hear the word “Ebola.” The West African epidemic was caused by one of those four viruses, which is somewhat confusingly now called the Ebola virus but used to be called the Zaire virus, and which has the highest fatality rate of the four. Fortunately, an extremely effective vaccine was developed and deployed to help end that epidemic.
paras.zh: 有几个因素导致这次疫情难以控制。第一个是导致埃博拉病毒爆发的实际物种。 Of the six known species in this genus, four cause the kind of severe hemorrhagic fever you probably think of when you hear the word “Ebola.” The West African epidemic was caused by one of those four viruses, which is somewhat confusingly now called the Ebola virus but used to be called the Zaire virus, and which has the highest fatality rate of the four.幸运的是，一种极其有效的疫苗被开发出来并被部署来帮助结束这种流行病。

paras.en: This latest outbreak is caused by a different species: the Bundibugyo virus. It’s much less common, having only caused two other known outbreaks in the past.
paras.zh: 这次最新的爆发是由不同的物种引起的：本迪布焦病毒。这种情况不太常见，过去只引起过另外两次已知的疫情爆发。

paras.en: Another factor in the outbreak’s breakneck growth is that the DRC is really struggling to track cases and administer care. The Associated Press reports that at least half of all deaths have been in people who were never admitted to treatment centers. And contact tracing isn’t going well, either. An outbreak is considered under control when 95% of all new cases come from contact with previously known and recorded cases. But at present, something like 80% of new cases are emerging from unknown sources.
paras.zh: 疫情爆发的另一个因素是刚果民主共和国在追踪病例和管理护理方面确实遇到了困难。美联社报道称，至少有一半的死亡病例是从未住进治疗中心的人。接触者追踪的进展也不顺利。当 95% 的新病例来自与先前已知和记录的病例接触时，就认为疫情已得到控制。但目前，大约 80% 的新病例都是来源不明的。

paras.en: In other words, there are still lots of people out transmitting the disease that haven’t yet been identified by contact tracers. Distrust of the government and, by extension, of health workers is also a huge issue, with many reportedly believing the outbreak is a hoax. Last month a nurse was killed and another health care worker was severely injured as they attempted to respond to reports of Ebola.
paras.zh: 换句话说，仍有很多人在传播尚未被接触追踪器识别出的疾病。对政府以及对卫生工作者的不信任也是一个大问题，据报道许多人认为这次疫情是一场骗局。上个月，一名护士在试图应对埃博拉病毒报告时被杀，另一名医护人员受重伤。

paras.en: However there is some good news, which is that clinical trials are ongoing to find a good vaccine candidate. Last Monday the first participant was vaccinated. The clinical trial is called Tumaini, which means “hope” in Swahili. The trial is made up of people who have recently been in close contact with individuals now confirmed to have the Bundibugyo virus. The first vaccine up for testing is the one tailored to prevent the Ebola virus, but several Bundibugyo-specific inoculations are currently in development and will be tested as well.
paras.zh: 然而，有一些好消息，即临床试验正在进行中，以寻找良好的候选疫苗。上周一，第一位参与者接种了疫苗。该临床试验名为“Tumaini”，在斯瓦希里语中意为“希望”。该试验由最近与现已确诊感染本迪布焦病毒的人有过密切接触的人组成。第一种用于测试的疫苗是专门用于预防埃博拉病毒的疫苗，但几种针对本迪布焦的疫苗目前正在开发中，也将进行测试。

paras.en: Now let’s get into some news about artificial intelligence. Just a few weeks after dropping hundreds of AI-generated math breakthroughs on a field that’s already in crisis, OpenAI is piling on more. Here to tell us more about this shake-up is artificial intelligence and technology reporter Peter Hall. He’s currently working as an editorial fellow at Scientific American. Thanks so much for coming on to chat, Peter.
paras.zh: 现在让我们来了解一些有关人工智能的新闻。就在几周前，OpenAI 在一个已经陷入危机的领域中放弃了数百项由人工智能产生的数学突破，而现在又在不断取得更多突破。人工智能和技术记者 Peter Hall 向我们介绍了有关这一变革的更多信息。他目前在《科学美国人》担任编辑研究员。非常感谢您接受我们的采访，彼得。

paras.en: Peter Hall: Good to meet you and good to talk with you.
paras.zh: 彼得·霍尔：很高兴见到你，也很高兴与你交谈。

paras.en: Feltman: So could you give our listeners a little bit of backstory for how this has been heating up?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：那么您能给我们的听众介绍一下事态如何升温的背景故事吗？

paras.en: Hall: Yeah. So over the past few months OpenAI and Anthropic, as well as other players, have really been trying to flex the ability of their models by, um, proving or disproving famous math conjectures.
paras.zh: 霍尔：是的。因此，在过去的几个月里，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 以及其他参与者一直在努力通过证明或反驳著名的数学猜想来展示其模型的能力。

paras.en: And last week OpenAI introduced these three results across math, physics and theoretical computer science that are quite big. And Anthropic also released the same result, almost at the same time on the same day.
paras.zh: 上周 OpenAI 介绍了这三项横跨数学、物理和理论计算机科学的重大成果。而Anthropic也几乎在同一天的同一时间发布了同样的结果。

paras.en: Feltman: And so, to give our listeners a little bit of context, what kinds of problems are we talking about and what does this process usually look like, you know, when human mathematicians are involved?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：所以，为了给我们的听众提供一些背景信息，我们正在谈论什么样的问题，以及当人类数学家参与时，这个过程通常是什么样子？

paras.en: Hall: So there’s a huge collection of problems that mathematicians have conjectured or guessed over decades of research. For the proofs from last week, these centered around problems related to Millennium Prize Problems, which are these group of seven problems that the Clay Mathematics Institute published in 2000 as a collection of problems that have existed across math and physics and computer science that are so noteworthy and so important and so difficult that they would get a million-dollar prize for a solution to them.
paras.zh: 霍尔：数学家在数十年的研究中猜想或猜测了大量的问题。上周的证明，主要围绕与千年奖问题相关的问题，这是克莱数学研究所于 2000 年发布的七个问题，作为数学、物理和计算机科学中存在的问题的集合，这些问题是如此值得注意、如此重要和如此困难，以至于他们将因解决这些问题而获得百万美元的奖金。

paras.en: Feltman: So is there any controversy about whether what OpenAI and Anthropic are presenting are actually solutions to these problems, that they’re solved?
paras.zh: Feltman：那么 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 所提出的内容是否实际上是这些问题的解决方案，是否已经解决，是否存在任何争议？

paras.en: Hall: Right. So that’s the other side of the coin is that, usually, you know, math research is published in journals or on preprint servers or in conferences. It’s discussed among mathematicians.
paras.zh: 霍尔：对。 So that’s the other side of the coin is that, usually, you know, math research is published in journals or on preprint servers or in conferences. It’s discussed among mathematicians.

paras.en: These don’t really follow the same blueprint there. These are just kind of, like, put in GitHub repos as just a collection of AI-generated text and programming that they claim not only shows that the result is true but also has verified it in a programming language called Lean, which is meant specifically for mathematics.
paras.zh: 这些并没有真正遵循相同的蓝图。 These are just kind of, like, put in GitHub repos as just a collection of AI-generated text and programming that they claim not only shows that the result is true but also has verified it in a programming language called Lean, which is meant specifically for mathematics.

paras.en: So definitely the aspect of, like, how intelligible these results are and what kind of insights people are gaining from them has been a huge point of controversy—and you know, who gets the credit when a model is just outputting a bunch of ideas that we don’t really know exactly what they’re building off of.
paras.zh: 因此，这些结果的可理解性以及人们从中获得什么样的见解肯定是一个巨大的争议点——而且你知道，当一个模型只是输出一堆我们并不真正知道它们是基于什么构建的想法时，谁会得到功劳。

paras.en: Feltman: It’s like when that monkey took a selfie, except I had more respect for both the monkey and the photographer than I unfortunately do for a lot of AI companies. Well, what are the potential benefits to the mathematics community of these proofs being out there? You know, are there any upsides?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：就像那只猴子自拍一样，只不过我对猴子和摄影师的尊重比对许多人工智能公司的尊重要多。 Well, what are the potential benefits to the mathematics community of these proofs being out there?你知道，有什么好处吗？

paras.en: Hall: You know with previous drops, there has been efforts from the communities to go through the proof, really, you know, with a very fine-tooth comb and turn it into something that is expository and something that we can look at the techniques for and really understand some sort of mathematical insight for it.
paras.zh: Hall：你知道，在之前的发布中，社区一直在努力仔细地梳理证明，并将其变成说明性的东西，我们可以研究其技术并真正理解其某种数学见解。

paras.en: You know, the hope is that solutions like these and the proof steps, even if they’re not written the best right now, can at some point down the line be turned into something that is useful. Like, you know, I can use the ideas from this to solve some other problem that I’ve seen elsewhere in my research.
paras.zh: 你知道，我们希望像这样的解决方案和证明步骤，即使它们现在写得不是最好的，也能在未来的某个时刻变成有用的东西。就像，你知道，我可以利用其中的想法来解决我在研究中其他地方看到的其他问题。

paras.en: Feltman: Well thank you so much for coming on to talk through this with us.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：非常感谢您接受我们的采访。

paras.en: Feltman: Now for some research on an extremely timely subject: daylight saving time. DST just ended for those of us in the United States—not counting several territories, including Puerto Rico, and the exempt states Hawaii and Arizona,minus the Navajo Nation, which does still observe DST. Complicated, right? And it’s not like “springing forward” and “falling back” are much fun to deal with, either. Research suggests that shifting our clocks back and forth by an hour takes a toll on the body and the mind.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：现在对一个非常及时的主题进行一些研究：夏令时。对于我们这些在美国的人来说，夏令时刚刚结束——不包括包括波多黎各在内的几个领土，以及豁免州夏威夷和亚利桑那州，不包括仍然遵守夏令时的纳瓦霍族保留地。 Complicated, right?而且“前进”和“后退”也不是很有趣。研究表明，将时钟来回调整一小时会对身体和精神造成损害。

paras.en: So it’s not surprising that this practice is pretty unpopular, and you might have celebrated when the House of Representatives passed the Sunshine Protection Act in July. That bill, which has yet to clear the Senate, would make DST permanent and therefore “preserve” an hour of afternoon sunlight as we head deeper into fall. Last week President Donald Trump blasted the Senate for failing to take a vote in time to implement permanent DST this year, claiming in a social media post that literally no one wanted to change their clocks. While that’s characteristically hyperbolic, recent survey data does suggest that almost half of U.S. adults are opposed to all the falling and springing.
paras.zh: 因此，这种做法非常不受欢迎也就不足为奇了，当众议院 7 月份通过《阳光保护法案》时，您可能会庆祝。该法案尚未获得参议院批准，该法案将使夏令时永久化，从而在我们进入深秋时“保留”一个小时的午后阳光。上周，唐纳德·特朗普总统抨击参议院今年未能及时投票实施永久性夏令时，并在社交媒体上发帖称，实际上没有人愿意改变自己的时钟。虽然这是典型的双曲线，但最近的调查数据确实表明，近一半的美国成年人反对所有的跌倒和反弹。

paras.en: But according to a new analysis published in Current Biology, making DST permanent could have serious, dangerous consequences for school-age children. Researchers at the University of Washington who study how school start times impact adolescent health decided to quantify exactly how many more trips to school would happen in darkness if we switched to year-round DST. They found that the Sunshine Protection Act would lead to more than two billion dark morning commutes for children. They also confirmed that fatal morning crashes involving kids aged five to 18 are more likely to occur if the sun has yet to rise. So those additional dark commutes really do pose a risk.
paras.zh: 但根据《当代生物学》发表的一项新分析，永久实行夏令时可能会给学龄儿童带来严重、危险的后果。华盛顿大学研究开学时间如何影响青少年健康的研究人员决定量化，如果我们改用全年夏令时，在黑暗中上学的次数将会增加。他们发现，阳光保护法案将导致超过 20 亿儿童在黑暗的早晨通勤。他们还证实，如果太阳尚未升起，涉及 5 至 18 岁儿童的致命早晨车祸更有可能发生。因此，这些额外的黑暗通勤确实会带来风险。

paras.en: The researchers aren’t arguing in favor of continuing to swap our clocks back and forth; in fact, they point out that while permanent DST would be the worst-case scenario for dark school commutes, our current system creates twice as many dark mornings as would occur under permanent standard time.
paras.zh: 研究人员并不赞成继续来回调换我们的时钟；而是赞成继续调换我们的时钟。事实上，他们指出，虽然永久夏令时将是黑暗学校通勤的最坏情况，但我们当前的系统造成的黑暗早晨是永久标准时间下的两倍。

paras.en: Listen: I’m as bummed out by an afternoon sunset as anyone else. But as long as we can get rid of the twice-a-year upheaval, I’m personally good with whatever. And keeping kids safe as they wait for the bus—or, even better, as they walk or bike to school, because we love a pedestrian-friendly commute—seems pretty worthwhile to me.
paras.zh: 听着：我和其他人一样对下午的日落感到沮丧。但只要我们能够摆脱每年两次的动荡，我个人就可以接受任何事情。在我看来，确保孩子们在等公交车时的安全——或者更好的是，在他们步行或骑自行车上学时，因为我们喜欢步行或骑自行车上学——对我来说似乎非常值得。

paras.en: That’s all for this week’s science news roundup. We’ll be back on Wednesday to talk about how soybeans quietly swept the nation and on Friday we’re going to talk about how AI swept everywhere.
paras.zh: 这就是本周科学新闻综述的全部内容。我们将在周三回来讨论大豆如何悄然席卷全国，周五我们将讨论人工智能如何席卷各地。

paras.en: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman. Have a great week!
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》的这位人物是雷切尔·费尔特曼 (Rachel Feltman)。祝你度过愉快的一周！

articles.title: How to tell if a voice recording is AI-generated

paras.en: I’ve long been intrigued by the technology needed to virtually clone my own voice. Just three years ago this effort involved multiple hours of recorded speech and a host of specialized tools to create a quick quote that sounded even remotely like me. Now I can do it with just a few seconds of audio and a couple of clicks—and it takes an expert to recognize that it’s fake.
paras.zh: 长期以来，我一直对虚拟克隆自己的声音所需的技术很感兴趣。就在三年前，这项工作涉及多个小时的录音语音和大量专用工具来创建听起来甚至与我有一点相似的快速引言。现在，我只需几秒钟的音频和几次点击就可以做到这一点，而且需要专家才能识别出它是假的。

paras.en: Why would I do this? I have a background in acoustic analysis, and as the technology has advanced, I’ve been curious to test it and track any tells that reveal the clone as a fake. So last week I again cloned my voice, this time using a free, open-source tool. If that sounds easy, it’s because it is, says Sarah Barrington, a doctoral candidate at the University of California, Berkeley, who studies artificial intelligence voice cloning. At most, a cloning service might ask the user to affirm their right to copy a voice.
paras.zh: 我为什么要这样做？ I have a background in acoustic analysis, and as the technology has advanced, I’ve been curious to test it and track any tells that reveal the clone as a fake.因此，上周我再次克隆了我的声音，这次使用的是免费的开源工具。 If that sounds easy, it’s because it is, says Sarah Barrington, a doctoral candidate at the University of California, Berkeley, who studies artificial intelligence voice cloning.克隆服务最多可能会要求用户确认他们复制声音的权利。

paras.en: “There are platforms online that will advertise as few as three seconds’ worth of someone’s voice to create a clone,” Barrington says. Voice cloning, she explains, went, “kind of overnight, from quite technical to immediately consumer-accessible.” In a demonstration in her lectures, for example, Barrington clones her own voice from a YouTube clip in a mere 90 seconds.
paras.zh: 巴林顿说：“有些在线平台会宣传某人的声音，只需三秒钟即可创建克隆。”她解释说，语音克隆“一夜之间就从技术性很强变成了消费者可以立即使用的技术”。例如，在她的讲座演示中，Barrington 仅用了 90 秒就从 YouTube 剪辑中克隆了自己的声音。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: This level of accessibility has drawn the attention of scammers. Reuters reported in September that someone posing as a lawyer and using a cloned voice persuaded a large Italian private bank to wire around €95 million (about $105 million) abroad.
paras.zh: 这种级别的可访问性引起了诈骗者的注意。路透社 9 月份报道称，有人冒充律师并使用克隆声音说服一家大型意大利私人银行向国外电汇约 9500 万欧元（约合 1.05 亿美元）。

paras.en: Our ears are, in general, bad at distinguishing between real and cloned voices. Barrington and her colleagues conducted a study where they played real and cloned voices of 220 different speakers to more than 600 listeners. About half of these listeners were asked to flag voices they thought were artificially generated, and they did so successfully 60 percent of the time. In a separate test, when the other half of listeners heard a clone and a real speaker side by side, they judged them to be the same person about 80 percent of the time.
paras.zh: 一般来说，我们的耳朵不擅长区分真实的声音和克隆的声音。 Barrington 和她的同事进行了一项研究，他们向 600 多名听众播放​​ 220 个不同说话者的真实声音和克隆声音。 About half of these listeners were asked to flag voices they thought were artificially generated, and they did so successfully 60 percent of the time. In a separate test, when the other half of listeners heard a clone and a real speaker side by side, they judged them to be the same person about 80 percent of the time.

paras.en: In the past, cloned voices could be discerned based on breaths, pauses and disfluencies such as “ums.” Essentially, the voices were too polished—too unnatural. This is no longer the case. Ums, ahs, breaths and other inflections are now added intentionally to better mask the clone. Researchers are instead training AI models to detect clones based on measurements associated with the sound wave itself, a process involving something called audio forensics.
paras.zh: 过去，克隆声音可以根据呼吸、停顿和“嗯”等不连贯的声音来识别。从本质上讲，声音太优美了——太不自然了。现在情况已不再如此。现在故意添加了嗯、啊、呼吸和其他变化，以更好地掩盖克隆。研究人员正在训练人工智能模型，根据与声波本身相关的测量结果来检测克隆，这一过程涉及到音频取证。

paras.en: By zooming in on the waveform of my own voice far enough, I can see each tiny vibration of my own vocal folds as a repetitive bump in signal. Tiny variations in the length of those cycles, known as jitter, and the height of their peaks, known as shimmer, are some of the many features that can be weighed together by a detection model to tell if a voice is AI-generated.
paras.zh: 通过将自己声音的波形放大得足够远，我可以将自己声带的每一个微小振动视为信号中的重复凸起。这些周期长度的微小变化（称为抖动）和峰值高度（称为闪烁）是检测模型可以权衡的众多特征中的一部分，以判断语音是否是人工智能生成的。

paras.en: Even the best detectors have blind spots, however. AI models can be tuned to detect the signatures of one cloning company’s tools or perhaps a few, but that ability “often does not transfer well to other providers,” Barrington says. For example, spectral analysis, which visualizes the change in audio frequencies over time, can reveal quirks of particular cloning tools, but there is no single measure that works across all of them.
paras.zh: 然而，即使是最好的探测器也有盲点。巴林顿说，可以调整人工智能模型来检测一个或几个克隆公司工具的签名，但这种能力“通常不能很好地转移到其他提供商”。例如，频谱分析可以可视化音频随时间的变化，可以揭示特定克隆工具的怪癖，但没有一种方法可以适用于所有这些工具。

paras.en: “You would expect to immediately see giveaways,” Barrington says. “That is absolutely not the case.” In other words, no single measurement can show that a recording is fake. You need a suite of tools. (To further complicate things, a phone call minimizes or degrades much of a voice’s key forensic detail, making clones even harder to spot.)
paras.zh: “You would expect to immediately see giveaways,” Barrington says. “绝对不是这样的。” In other words, no single measurement can show that a recording is fake.您需要一套工具。 (To further complicate things, a phone call minimizes or degrades much of a voice’s key forensic detail, making clones even harder to spot.)

paras.en: In my own testing, I compared two dozen sentences that I had spoken and the clone’s versions of the same sentences. Sentences recorded with a heater humming in the background showed that the clone’s jitter was statistically indistinguishable from mine, though its shimmer was steadier. In a quiet room, however, the clone came out measurably cleaner, with less noise under the tone in all 12 sentences, even after a simulated phone call.
paras.zh: 在我自己的测试中，我比较了我说过的两打句子和克隆人的相同句子的版本。在背景中加热器嗡嗡作响的情况下记录的句子表明，克隆人的抖动在统计上与我的没有区别，尽管它的闪光更稳定。然而，在安静的房间里，即使在模拟电话通话之后，克隆的声音也明显干净得多，所有 12 个句子的语气中的噪音都更少。

paras.en: For now, one of the most promising ways to distinguish AI-cloned voices from real ones may be embedded in the cloning technology itself. Some companies that make AI audio tools, such as Google, hide an inaudible watermark in the created audio. This watermark makes small changes throughout the sound that are too faint to hear but can be read by a detector later—and these changes go with the audio file wherever it is shared.
paras.zh: 目前，区分人工智能克隆声音和真实声音的最有前途的方法之一可能是嵌入克隆技术本身。一些制造人工智能音频工具的公司（例如谷歌）在创建的音频中隐藏了听不见的水印。此水印会在整个声音中产生微小的变化，这些变化太微弱而无法听到，但稍后可以被检测器读取 - 并且这些变化会随着音频文件的共享而变化。

paras.en: These watermarks are powerful, but they are not foolproof; someone might alter a recording enough to erase such a mark. And even when they are available, they may not be required: watermarks are optional on some open-source programs that offer them. Still, Barrington says that, like a locked door, a good watermark can “keep out 99 [percent] of the bad cases.” And for the rest—our audio forensics techniques will have to keep evolving as fast as the cloning tools are.
paras.zh: 这些水印功能强大，但并非万无一失；有人可能会改变录音足以删除这样的标记。即使它们可用，也可能不是必需的：在某些提供水印的开源程序中，水印是可选的。尽管如此，巴林顿表示，就像一扇锁着的门一样，好的水印可以“阻止 99% 的不良情况”。对于其余的，我们的音频取证技术必须与克隆工具一样快速发展。

articles.title: This bull and donkey show interspecies homosexual bonds can run deep

paras.en: Of all the things you might see on your lunch break, a bull having sex with a male donkey is likely low on the list. But ecologists “always have an eye on the horizon,” says André Beirão da Cruz. And when he and fellow Ph.D. candidate Martina Francesconi stopped for a bite during a field research trip in Ethiopia, that is exactly what they saw.
paras.zh: 在你午休时可能看到的所有事物中，一头公牛与一头公驴发生性关系可能排在最后。但生态学家“始终关注地平线”，安德烈·贝朗·达·克鲁斯 (André Beirão da Cruz) 说。当他和他的博士同事。候选人玛蒂娜·弗朗西斯科尼 (Martina Francesconi) 在埃塞俄比亚实地考察期间停下来吃了一口，这正是他们所看到的。

paras.en: “We were not sure if we had actually seen it or if it was some type of mirage,” says da Cruz, who’s completing his Ph.D. in ecology at the University of Pisa in Italy and the NOVA University of Lisbon in Portugal.
paras.zh: “我们不确定我们是否真的看到过它，或者它是否是某种海市蜃楼，”即将完成博士学位的达克鲁兹说。意大利比萨大学和葡萄牙里斯本 NOVA 大学生态学博士学位。

paras.en: This is the story of Achille and Patroclo, a domesticated bull and a male donkey, respectively, that live on an Ethiopian plateau and often graze together. In a new paper, da Cruz and his colleagues describe the deep bond between the two animals, who were named for the ancient Greek hero Achilles and his lover Patroclus. During the ecologists’ observations, Achille and Patroclo’s relationship involved dozens of sexual interactions and indicated a strong social connection.
paras.zh: 这是阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛的故事，阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛分别是一头家牛和一头公驴，生活在埃塞俄比亚高原上，经常一起吃草。在一篇新论文中，达克鲁兹和他的同事描述了这两种动物之间深厚的联系，它们以古希腊英雄阿喀琉斯和他的情人帕特罗克洛斯的名字命名。在生态学家的观察中，阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛的关系涉及数十次性互动，表明了强大的社会联系。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The case study, the researchers say, may offer a window into the complexities of animals’ same-sex behaviors.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，该案例研究可能为了解动物同性行为的复杂性提供了一个窗口。

paras.en: “Most of the time, people and researchers start with an idea in the field, and they are focused on that in a very strict and tight way,” says Elisabetta Palagi, senior author of the paper and an ecologist at the University of Pisa. “But this prevents people from looking around, and it is possible that this kind of interaction is much more frequent than has been reported.”
paras.zh: “大多数时候，人们和研究人员都是从该领域的一个想法开始，他们会以非常严格和严格的方式专注于这个想法，”该论文的资深作者、比萨大学的生态学家 Elisabetta Palagi 说。 “但这阻止了人们环顾四周，而且这种互动可能比报道的要频繁得多。”

paras.en: Achille and Patroclo have different owners but often graze in the same field; the researchers observed them for four days together and four days apart. In the four days together, Achille mounted Patroclo 51 times.
paras.zh: Achille 和 Patroclo 有不同的主人，但经常在同一块田地里吃草；研究人员对它们进行了四天的观察和四天的观察。在四天内，阿基尔骑乘帕特罗克洛 51 次。

paras.en: Same-sex sexual behavior among animals is well studied, but ecologists know far less about interspecies sexual behavior. The reciprocity in Achille and Patroclo’s behavior was most notable, Francesconi says: Patroclo was receptive when Achille mounted him but aggressive when any other bull was nearby. And the two animals’ interactions often went beyond just mounting, with the pair licking or rubbing against each other after sexual interactions. This suggests that sexual relationships between animals are far more complex than our current understanding, Francesconi adds.
paras.zh: 动物间的同性性行为已得到充分研究，但生态学家对物种间性行为的了解却少得多。弗朗西斯科尼说，阿基勒和帕特罗克洛的行为中的互惠性最为显着：当阿基勒骑上他时，帕特罗克洛很乐意接受，但当附近有任何其他公牛时，帕特罗克洛就会表现出攻击性。这两种动物的互动往往不仅仅是骑乘，它们在性交后还会互相舔舐或摩擦。弗朗西斯科尼补充道，这表明动物之间的性关系比我们目前的理解复杂得多。

paras.en: Vincent Savolainen, an ecologist at Imperial College London, who was not involved in the work, says the authors “show quite nicely that these two are not just a random dyad.”
paras.zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院的生态学家文森特·萨沃莱宁（Vincent Savolainen）没有参与这项工作，他说作者“很好地表明，这两者不仅仅是随机的二元组。”

paras.en: He adds, however, that Achille and Patroclo’s domestication may mean that their behavior does not reflect social traits or patterns among wild animals.
paras.zh: 然而，他补充说，阿奇勒和帕特罗克洛的驯化可能意味着它们的行为并不反映野生动物的社会特征或模式。

paras.en: “It’s important to publish and publicize this example just to show the diversity of what can happen, but it is obviously limited to two animals from two species that are domesticated,” Savolainen says. “If we want to make massive steps in the field of behavior ecology, you would want to study a larger group of wild animals.”
paras.zh: “发布和宣传这个例子很重要，只是为了展示可能发生的事情的多样性，但它显然仅限于两个驯化物种的两种动物，”萨沃莱宁说。 “如果我们想在行为生态学领域取得重大进展，你就需要研究更多的野生动物。”

paras.en: “What we know about interspecies sexual interactions is scarce,” Francesconi says. “And it’s mostly connected with a subject forcing the other or mistaken identity or something randomly going on by chance. But what’s not present in the literature is something recurrent, selective, and somehow voluntary and reciprocal.”
paras.zh: “我们对物种间性行为的了解很少，”弗朗西斯科尼说。 “这主要与一个主体强迫另一个人或错误的身份或偶然发生的事情有关。但文献中没有出现的是反复出现的、选择性的、某种程度上自愿和互惠的东西。”

paras.en: The research was published today in Current Biology.
paras.zh: 该研究今天发表在《当代生物学》上。

articles.title: Seabirds get jet lag, too — and it can throw them a bit off course
articles.author: Anirban Mukhopadhyay

paras.en: Jet lag isn’t just for travelers hurtling across time zones. Migratory birds may get it, too.
paras.zh: 时差不仅仅适用于跨越时区的旅客。候鸟也可能会感染。

paras.en: Manx shearwaters (Puffinus puffinus) fly fast enough to experience jet lag, researchers report October 29 in Science. Decades of tracking data from foraging flights revealed that rapid east-west journeys can throw the seabirds’ internal clocks out of sync with local time, causing them to misjudge the sun’s position and veer slightly off course.
paras.zh: 研究人员 10 月 29 日在《科学》杂志上报道称，马恩岛海鸥（Puffinus puffinus）飞得足够快，足以经历时差反应。数十年的觅食飞行跟踪数据显示，快速的东西向飞行会使海鸟的内部时钟与当地时间不同步，导致它们误判太阳的位置并稍微偏离航线。

paras.en: For animals crossing vast oceans, the sun can help them determine which direction to fly. But because the sun’s position in the sky changes throughout the day, these animals need an internal clock synchronized with natural local sun time to use it as a compass. This circadian rhythm helps them compensate for the sun’s apparent movement and stay on course.
paras.zh: 对于穿越浩瀚海洋的动物来说，太阳可以帮助它们确定飞行的方向。但由于太阳在天空中的位置全天都在变化，因此这些动物需要一个与当地自然太阳时间同步的内部时钟来将其用作指南针。这种昼夜节律有助于它们补偿太阳的明显运动并保持在轨道上。

paras.en: But when birds zip east or west, local time shifts faster than their internal clocks might adjust. Scientists have long predicted that this mismatch could confound the birds’ sun-based compasses, but testing the idea in the wild “has seemed impossible until now,” says Tim Guilford, a biologist at the University of Oxford.
paras.zh: 但是，当鸟类向东或向西飞翔时，当地时间的变化速度比它们的内部时钟调整的速度要快。科学家们早就预测，这种不匹配可能会干扰鸟类基于太阳的指南针，但牛津大学生物学家蒂姆·吉尔福德表示，在野外测试这一想法“到目前为止似乎是不可能的”。

paras.en: Over 20 years, Guilford and colleagues equipped 1,045 breeding Manx shearwaters with miniature GPS trackers. The trackers logged thousands of trips from United Kingdom breeding colonies to feeding grounds up to 1,000 kilometers away. The team focused on the return journeys, isolating 1,837 continuous homeward flights.
paras.zh: 20 多年来，Guilford 及其同事为 1,045 只正在繁殖的马恩岛海鸥配备了微型 GPS 跟踪器。追踪器记录了从英国繁殖地到最远 1000 公里外的觅食地的数千次行程。团队重点关注返程航班，隔离了1837个连续返航航班。

paras.en: Assuming the seabirds’ internal clocks were synchronized with local time at sunrise, the researchers calculated how flights should throw off their sun compass and compared those predictions with GPS tracking data. The birds veered as expected, by as much as 15 degrees from their intended direction.
paras.zh: 假设海鸟的内部时钟与当地时间日出时同步，研究人员计算了航班应如何摆脱太阳罗盘，并将这些预测与 GPS 跟踪数据进行比较。鸟儿按照预期转向，偏离预定方向多达 15 度。

paras.en: “But what really surprised us is that the small orientation errors … continue to be visible even when the birds were in sight of presumably familiar land,” Guilford says. While following a coastline, the birds should be able to use it as a guide to keep their course. But they either veered closer to shore or farther out to sea in line with their predicted sun compass errors. The pattern suggests that the birds use the sun compass alongside coastal cues, even when the two point in different directions.
paras.zh: “但真正令我们惊讶的是，即使这些鸟看到了可能熟悉的土地，微小的方向误差……仍然可见，”吉尔福德说。当沿着海岸线飞行时，鸟类应该能够利用它作为指南来保持航线。但根据预测的太阳罗盘误差，它们要么靠近海岸，要么远离海洋。该模式表明，鸟类使用太阳罗盘和沿海线索，即使两者指向不同的方向。

paras.en: The errors are small enough that they add only a few kilometers to the journey, not enough to prevent the Manx shearwaters from finding their way home.
paras.zh: 这些误差足够小，只增加了几公里的路程，不足以阻止马恩岛海鸥找到回家的路。

paras.en: This navigational tug-of-war excites Sangeeta Rani, a chronobiologist at the University of Lucknow in India. The findings, Rani says, hint at an ability that could serve these feathered fliers well as climate change and human activities alter familiar landscapes: The birds seem to process and integrate multiple navigational cues without relying blindly on any one of them.
paras.zh: 这场导航拔河比赛让印度勒克瑙大学的时间生物学家桑吉塔·拉尼 (Sangeeta Rani) 兴奋不已。拉尼说，这些发现暗示了一种可以为这些有羽毛的飞行者服务的能力，以及气候变化和人类活动改变熟悉的景观：鸟类似乎可以处理和整合多种导航线索，而不是盲目依赖其中任何一个。

paras.en: “After all, if I have marked a path for myself in the woods, my innate ability is not to mindlessly follow the markings,” Rani says. “It is to find out what’s missing and still find my way back.”
paras.zh: “毕竟，如果我在树林里为自己标出了一条道路，我与生俱来的能力就不会盲目地跟随这些标记，”拉尼说。 “我的目​​的是找出丢失的东西，同时还能找到回来的路。”

articles.title: Melting permafrost has birthed a new type of large landslide
articles.author: Nikk Ogasa

paras.en: In 2018, a strange and enormous landslide occurred in Canada’s Northwest Territories. A slab of earth roughly equivalent in volume to seven Great Pyramids of Giza suddenly began sliding downhill, leaving behind a barren scar in the forested landscape. But what puzzled scientists was that the slide had initiated in frozen ground that had been glued in place for years.
paras.zh: 2018年，加拿大西北地区发生了一场奇怪的巨大山体滑坡。一块体积大约相当于七座吉萨大金字塔的土板突然开始滑下山坡，在森林景观中留下了一道贫瘠的疤痕。但令科学家们感到困惑的是，滑坡是在多年来被粘在原地的冰冻地面上开始的。

paras.en: An analysis of the event reveals that it represents a new class of catastrophic landslides called permafrost detachment slides, researchers report in the Sept. 28 Geophysical Research Letters. The slides may be set in motion by wildfires that occurred decades earlier, destabilizing the ground and opening cracks through which water infiltrated deep underground. Over time, that water may have thawed the frozen layer from below, eventually unleashing the entire frozen layer in a catastrophic slide.
paras.zh: 研究人员在 9 月 28 日的《地球物理研究快报》中报告说，对这一事件的分析表明，它代表了一种新的灾难性山体滑坡，称为永久冻土分离滑坡。这些滑坡可能是由几十年前发生的野火引发的，破坏了地面的稳定并打开了裂缝，水通过裂缝渗透到地下深处。随着时间的推移，水可能会从下面融化冰冻层，最终导致整个冰冻层发生灾难性的滑坡。

paras.en: Large landslides don’t normally mobilize so much still-frozen material, and when they do begin in thawing layers they usually move slowly, says Dmitry Nicolsky, a geophysicist studying permafrost at the University of Alaska Fairbanks who was not involved in the study. But he says this new research suggests scientists need to better study what’s occurring beneath the surface in permafrost regions, because “we don’t know how [the ground] will move — it might go slowly or it might go catastrophically.”
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加大学费尔班克斯分校研究永久冻土的地球物理学家德米特里·尼科尔斯基（Dmitry Nicolsky）没有参与这项研究，他说，大型山体滑坡通常不会移动那么多仍然冻结的物质，当它们开始融化时，它们通常会缓慢移动。但他表示，这项新研究表明科学家需要更好地研究永久冻土地区地表以下发生的情况，因为“我们不知道[地面]将如何移动——它可能会缓慢移动，也可能会发生灾难性的后果。”

paras.en: The inspiration for the research manifested in 2019, when permafrost geologist Joseph Young, based at the University of Alberta in Edmonton, Canada, at the time, was helicoptering to a field site in the Northwest Territories to assist a colleague’s research. In some of the valleys out there, the slopes were “just collapsing with landslides everywhere,” says Young, who is now at an engineering firm in Edmonton. That was surprising because they were in an area where the permafrost — ground that has been frozen for at least two consecutive years — shouldn’t have been thawing much.
paras.zh: 这项研究的灵感体现在 2019 年，当时加拿大埃德蒙顿阿尔伯塔大学的永久冻土地质学家约瑟夫·杨 (Joseph Young) 乘直升机前往西北地区的一个现场，协助同事的研究。现在在埃德蒙顿一家工程公司工作的杨说，在一些山谷中，斜坡“正在崩塌，到处都是山体滑坡”。这是令人惊讶的，因为他们所在的地区永久冻土——至少连续两年被冻结的土地——不应该融化太多。

paras.en: Once on the ground, more puzzling details emerged. “Traditionally with permafrost, it melts from the top down, and that releases this slurry of muddy material,” Young says. But at some of the landslide sites, large blocks of still-frozen ground seemed to have been moved hundreds of meters, he says.
paras.zh: 一旦到达地面，更多令人费解的细节就出现了。 “传统上，永久冻土是从上到下融化的，从而释放出泥浆，”杨说。但他说，在一些山体滑坡地点，大块仍然冰冻的地面似乎已经移动了数百米。

paras.en: Young and his colleagues studied two of the largest slides in the region that had moved big chunks of permafrost. These were the 2018 slide, which mobilized 18 million cubic meters of earth and dammed the Redstone River, and another event in 2017 that moved 4.5 million cubic meters of material.
paras.zh: 杨和他的同事研究了该地区两个最大的滑坡，这些滑坡移动了大块永久冻土。其中包括 2018 年的滑坡事件，该事件移动了 1800 万立方米的土方并在红石河上筑坝，以及 2017 年的另一次滑坡事件，移动了 450 万立方米的材料。
