articles.title: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) lens review — how good is this budget lens for astrophotography?
articles.author: James Abbott

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) is an impressive lens for the price and certainly won’t break the bank. Image quality is impressive but imperfect, yet it's still an attractive lens.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) 是一款性价比令人印象深刻的镜头，而且肯定不会花太多钱。图像质量令人印象深刻，但并不完美，但它仍然是一个有吸引力的镜头。

paras.en: Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test and review products.
paras.zh: 我们的专家评审员花费大量时间测试和比较产品和服务，以便您可以选择最适合您的产品和服务。详细了解我们如何测试和审查产品。

paras.en: Budget primes can be, surprisingly, excellent choices for photographers shooting all subjects. It’s all too easy to get carried away with the best specs, such as a large maximum aperture and impressive optical design often seen in more expensive options. But affordable lenses like the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II FE (APO) have the potential to impress and delight in equal measure.
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的是，对于拍摄所有主题的摄影师来说，廉价定焦镜头可能是绝佳的选择。人们很容易被最好的规格所迷惑，例如大的最大光圈和令人印象深刻的光学设计，这些设计通常出现在更昂贵的选择中。但像 Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II FE (APO) 这样价格实惠的镜头也有可能给人留下深刻的印象并令人愉悦。

paras.en: The 35mm f/1.8 is a compact and lightweight lens offering a reasonably fast maximum aperture, making it a prime candidate for astrophotography. It’s also the same size and almost the same weight as the Viltrox AF 55mm f/1.8 FE (APO), another lens that could potentially grace your camera bag.
paras.zh: 35mm f/1.8 是一款紧凑轻便的镜头，提供相当快的最大光圈，使其成为天文摄影的主要候选者。它的尺寸和重量也与 Viltrox AF 55mm f/1.8 FE (APO) 相同，后者是另一款可以为您的相机包增光添彩的镜头。

paras.en: With a highly attractive price tag of just $399 / £385, and mount options for Nikon Z and Sony FE, many astrophotographers will be wondering if this is a lens worth considering. It features 13 elements in 10 groups, as well as featuring an apochromatic (APO) design for reducing chromatic aberration as much as possible. As much as possible is key here because not all lenses are as successful as the manufacturer claims, although that’s not a comment on the 35mm f/1.8. Read on to discover if this could be one of the best lenses for astrophotography.
paras.zh: 凭借仅为 399 美元/385 英镑的极具吸引力的价格标签，以及尼康 Z 和索尼 FE 的安装选项，许多天文摄影师会想知道这是否是一款值得考虑的镜头。它采用 10 组 13 片，并采用复消色差 (APO) 设计，尽可能减少色差。尽可能多是关键，因为并非所有镜头都像制造商声称的那样成功，尽管这不是针对 35mm f/1.8 的评论。请继续阅读，了解这是否是天文摄影的最佳镜头之一。

paras.en: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) lens review
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO) 镜头评测

paras.en: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Performance
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)：性能

paras.en: - Sweet spot at f/8-f/11, not ideal for astro
paras.zh: - 最佳对焦位置为 f/8-f/11，不适合 astro

paras.en: - Some astigmatism at the edges of the frame
paras.zh: - 镜框边缘有一些散光

paras.en: For a budget lens, the 35mm f/1.8 produces great, yet not perfect, image quality. On the plus side, images are nice and sharp, particularly in the centre, even when shooting wide open at f/1.8. At this aperture setting, though, there is some astigmatism at the left edges of the frame. This is where stars appear as crosses. This is a surprise since it’s an APO lens, and, equally surprising, it’s isolated, but it is something you have to consider.
paras.zh: 对于经济型镜头来说，35mm f/1.8 可以产生出色但并不完美的图像质量。从好的方面来说，即使在 f/1.8 全开拍摄时，图像也清晰锐利，尤其是在中心位置。不过，在此光圈设置下，画面左边缘存在一些散光。这是星星显示为十字的地方。这是一个惊喜，因为它是 APO 镜头，而且同样令人惊讶的是，它是孤立的，但这是你必须考虑的事情。

paras.en: You do have to zoom into the image to see it, so it may not be a dealbreaker. Photos shot at f/1.8 are sharpest in the centre, with some fall-off towards the edges, with the corners exhibiting the least sharpness. There’s also the strongest vignetting at f/1.8. At the time of writing, there’s no Adobe Lightroom lens profile for the lens, but you can manually remove the vignetting and even create a preset of your own.
paras.zh: 您必须放大图像才能看到它，所以它可能不会破坏交易。在 f/1.8 下拍摄的照片中心最清晰，边缘有一些衰减，角落的清晰度最低。 f/1.8 时暗角最强。在撰写本文时，该镜头还没有 Adob​​e Lightroom 镜头配置文件，但您可以手动消除渐晕，甚至创建自己的预设。

paras.en: The vignette disappears as soon as f/4, with a gradual increase in sharpness across the frame between f/2.8 and f/5.6. f/8 and f/11 appear identical in terms of sharpness and occupy the sweet spot, while diffraction is clearly at work when you stop down to f/16. In reality, it’s unlikely you’d shoot beyond f/11 with this lens, even if you were shooting landscapes.
paras.zh: 一旦 f/4，晕影就会消失，并且在 f/2.8 和 f/5.6 之间整个画面的清晰度逐渐增加。 f/8 和 f/11 在清晰度方面看起来相同，并且占据了最佳位置，而当您将光圈缩小到 f/16 时，衍射显然正在发挥作用。事实上，即使您拍摄风景，您也不太可能使用该镜头拍摄超过 f/11 的光圈。

paras.en: Overall, image quality is impressive despite not being perfect and stopping down to f/2.8 when shooting astro does provide greater clarity across the frame. This is, as you know, at the expense of having to shoot at a slightly higher ISO setting to compensate.
paras.zh: 总体而言，图像质量令人印象深刻，尽管并不完美，并且在拍摄 astro 时缩小到 f/2.8 确实可以提供更高的整个画面清晰度。如您所知，这是以必须以稍高的 ISO 设置进行拍摄来进行补偿为代价的。

paras.en: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Design
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)：设计

paras.en: While f/1.8 lenses may not have the speed and light-gathering capabilities of faster f/1.4 and f/1.2 lenses, they’re considerably smaller and lighter. The lens only has a 58mm filter thread, so if you use any night filters, they will be at the less expensive end of the price scale.
paras.zh: 虽然 f/1.8 镜头可能不具备更快的 f/1.4 和 f/1.2 镜头的速度和聚光能力，但它们要小得多、轻得多。该镜头只有 58 毫米滤镜螺纹，因此如果您使用任何夜间滤镜，它们将处于价格范围内较便宜的一端。

paras.en: For some photographers, the slight speed reduction of f/1.8 is a worthy compromise, and at 3.33 x 4.37 in / 69 x 76 mm with a weight of 12.52 oz / 355 g, the 35mm f/1.8 is beautifully compact and balances well with camera bodies.
paras.zh: 对于一些摄影师来说，稍微降低 f/1.8 的速度是值得的妥协，35mm f/1.8 的尺寸为 3.33 x 4.37 英寸/69 x 76 毫米，重量为 12.52 盎司/355 克，非常紧凑，与相机机身保持良好平衡。

paras.en: Build quality is excellent, and it’s fair to say the lens belies its budget price tag. The metal build alongside the manual aperture ring gives the 35mm f/1.8 a much more premium look and feel.
paras.zh: 做工质量非常好，而且可以公平地说，这款镜头的价格与其预算标签不符。手动光圈环旁边的金属结构赋予 35mm f/1.8 更优质的外观和感觉。

paras.en: The aperture ring can also be set to A for in-body aperture adjustments, as well as offering the ability to switch the aperture click on and off. The latter is most popular with videographers. There’s also a customizable Fn button on the side.
paras.zh: 光圈环还可以设置为 A 以进行体内光圈调整，并提供打开和关闭光圈咔嗒声的功能。后者最受摄像师欢迎。侧面还有一个可自定义的 Fn 按钮。

paras.en: The lens is weather-sealed against light rain and dust, with a rubber gasket on the lens mount. The front element also features a water and smudge-resistant coating, which is certainly useful for outdoor photography. Plus, there’s a minimum focusing distance of just 13.4 in / 34 cm, which is useful for daylight photography but of no consequence for astrophotography.
paras.zh: 镜头具有防风雨和防尘功能，镜头座上有橡胶垫圈。前元件还具有防水防污涂层，这对于户外摄影来说当然很有用。此外，最近对焦距离仅为 13.4 英寸/34 厘米，这对于日光摄影很有用，但对于天文摄影则没有影响。

paras.en: The 35mm f/1.8 is made up of 13 elements in 10 groups, and as previously mentioned, features an APO design, which is intended to eliminate chromatic aberration in high-contrast scenes.
paras.zh: 35mm f/1.8由10组13片组成，如前所述，采用APO设计，旨在消除高对比度场景中的色差。

paras.en: The elements include two extra-low dispersion (ED), three high refractive index (HR) and one ultra aspherical (UA). The UA lens is claimed to be Viltrox’s LAB Series quality, which matches the Viltrox flagship line-up.
paras.zh: 这些元件包括两枚超低色散 (ED)、三枚高折射率 (HR) 和一枚超非球面 (UA)。 UA 镜头据称具有 Viltrox 的 LAB 系列品质，与 Viltrox 旗舰产品阵容相匹配。

paras.en: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): Functionality
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)：功能

paras.en: When it comes to features, prime lenses are always pretty basic, with few features to shout about. The 35mm f/1.8 is certainly no exception, but its build quality and overall design hold up alongside its image quality and reasonably fast maximum aperture. It does, however, have a few points worth mentioning.
paras.zh: 说到功能，定焦镜头总是非常基本，没有什么值得夸耀的功能。 35mm f/1.8 当然也不例外，但其制造质量和整体设计与其图像质量和相当快的最大光圈保持一致。然而，它确实有几点值得一提。

paras.en: One feature that many Viltrox lenses have, including the 35mm f/1.8, is a USB-C Port on the lens mount. This allows you to use a smartphone app or a desktop app to quickly and easily update firmware. This is so much easier than having to download a file to your memory card and installing lens updates via the camera, which is how most native lenses have to be updated.
paras.zh: 许多 Viiltrox 镜头（包括 35mm f/1.8）所具有的一项功能是镜头卡口上的 USB-C 端口。这使您可以使用智能手机应用程序或桌面应用程序快速轻松地更新固件。这比将文件下载到存储卡并通过相机安装镜头更新要容易得多，这就是大多数本机镜头的更新方式。

paras.en: The manual aperture ring features click and clickless operation via a switch on the side, so you can easily see what aperture you’re using at a glance. The focusing ring is smooth and offers comfortable resistance, making manual focus a breeze. It’s also wide enough to rotate using gloves, although, being a compact lens, it’s narrower than what you’d expect on a larger and faster prime lens.
paras.zh: 手动光圈环通过侧面的开关进行点击和无点击操作，因此您可以一目了然地看到正在使用的光圈。对焦环光滑且阻力舒适，使手动对焦变得轻而易举。它也足够宽，可以戴着手套旋转，不过，作为一款紧凑型镜头，它比您期望的更大、更快的定焦镜头要窄。

paras.en: Autofocus (AF) is reasonably fast and silent, being powered by an stepping motor (STM). The AF performance seemed to improve after the firmware update that was installed via the desktop app before testing fully commenced.
paras.zh: 自动对焦 (AF) 速度相当快且安静，由步进电机 (STM) 提供动力。在测试完全开始之前，通过桌面应用程序安装固件更新后，自动对焦性能似乎有所改善。

paras.en: This functionality isn’t, of course, relevant to astrophotography, but it’s still a useful point to mention in case you intend to use the lens with autofocus in the day. Focusing is also internal, so the front element doesn’t rotate during focusing like cheap and cheerful kit lenses.
paras.zh: 当然，此功能与天文摄影无关，但如果您打算在白天使用具有自动对焦功能的镜头，它仍然是一个值得提及的有用点。对焦也是内部的，因此前部元件在对焦过程中不会像廉价而令人愉悦的套装镜头那样旋转。

paras.en: How we tested the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)
paras.zh: 我们如何测试 Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) was tested with the Sony A7R V, which offers an unforgivingly high resolution. The lens was tested at night with a focus on astrophotography, and in daylight to assess sharpness, distortion and general functionality for an all-round approach to testing.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) 使用索尼 A7R V 进行了测试，它提供了无与伦比的高分辨率。该镜头在夜间进行了测试，重点是天文摄影，并在白天进行了评估清晰度、畸变和一般功能，以进行全面的测试。

paras.en: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO): User reviews
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 II EVO FE (APO)：用户评论

paras.en: Online reviews echo one another, praising the AF 35mm f/1.8 for its sharpness and cost. Users appreciate that while it’s certainly not in the league of Sony’s premium G Master lenses, it represents great value for money. Some reviewers mention great build quality and looking good when paired with their Sony camera.
paras.zh: 网上评论纷纷称赞 AF 35mm f/1.8 的清晰度和成本。用户赞赏它虽然不属于索尼优质 G Master 镜头的范畴，但它代表着物超所值。一些评论家提到了出色的构建质量，并且与索尼相机搭配使用时看起来很棒。

paras.en: Should you buy the Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO)?
paras.zh: 您应该购买 Viiltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) 吗？

paras.en: ✅ You’re on a tight budget: The price of this lens is extremely attractive given the specs and performance.
paras.zh: ✅ 您的预算很紧张：考虑到规格和性能，这款镜头的价格非常有吸引力。

paras.en: ✅ You want portability: This is a compact and lightweight lens that's much less bulky than faster primes.
paras.zh: ✅ 您想要便携性：这是一款紧凑轻便的镜头，比速度更快的定焦镜头体积小得多。

paras.en: ❌ You want the best: This is a great little lens in many ways, but its image quality isn't the best that money can buy.
paras.zh: ❌您想要最好的：从很多方面来说，这都是一款很棒的小镜头，但它的图像质量并不是金钱所能买到的最好的。

paras.en: ❌ You shoot APS-C: Unless this is what you want, the equivalent focal length on a crop sensor is 52.5mm
paras.zh: ❌您拍摄 APS-C：除非这是您想要的，否则作物传感器上的等效焦距为 52.5mm

paras.en: Prime lenses can be expensive, especially if you’re looking at those with an f/1.4 or f/1.2 maximum aperture. The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) is a budget option in the Viltrox line-up, but with decent overall performance alongside impressive image quality for the price, this is a great 35mm lens for those on a budget. It’s also compact and lightweight, which could be useful if you often head out shooting with several lenses in your kit bag.
paras.zh: 定焦镜头可能很昂贵，特别是如果您正在寻找最大光圈为 f/1.4 或 f/1.2 的镜头。 Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.8 FE (APO) 是 Viltrox 系列中的一款预算选择，但凭借良好的整体性能以及令人印象深刻的图像质量，对于预算有限的人来说，这是一款出色的 35mm 镜头。它还结构紧凑、重量轻，如果您经常在套件包中携带多个镜头外出拍摄，这可能会很有用。

paras.en: Just going back to image quality, images are sharp, but when shooting astrophotography at f/1.8, there was some astigmatism at the left edges of the frame. This is where stars appear as crosses. You can only really see this when you zoom in to 100%, but it’s worth bearing in mind if you’re looking for the closest to optical perfection you can find.
paras.zh: 回到图像质量，图像很清晰，但在 f/1.8 拍摄天文摄影时，画面左边缘存在一些散光。这是星星显示为十字的地方。只有放大到 100% 时才能真正看到这一点，但如果您正在寻找最接近光学完美的效果，则值得记住这一点。

paras.en: When a weather-sealed prime lens with a manual aperture ring costs just $399 / £385, you can’t help but take notice. Build quality is excellent and the lens undoubtedly looks and feels like it would be more expensive than it is.
paras.zh: 当带有手动光圈环的防风雨定焦镜头售价仅为 399 美元/385 英镑时，您会情不自禁地注意到。做工质量非常好，而且镜头的外观和感觉无疑会比实际价格更贵。

paras.en: Considering all of this and the image quality, the lens is fairly priced and is still at the release price, so it could become more affordable in the future. Just like other Viltrox lenses, in the box you get the lens, a lens hood, front and rear lens caps and a soft lens case.
paras.zh: 考虑到所有这些和图像质量，该镜头的价格相当合理，并且仍处于发布价格，因此未来它可能会变得更加实惠。与其他 Viiltrox 镜头一样，包装盒中包含镜头、遮光罩、前后镜头盖以及软镜盒。

paras.en: The Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.2 LAB FE is part of Viltrox’s flagship lens series and offers a much faster maximum aperture, as the name suggests. It’s also more expensive, larger and heavier.
paras.zh: Viltrox AF 35mm f/1.2 LAB FE 是 Viltrox 旗舰镜头系列的一部分，顾名思义，它提供更快的最大光圈。它也更昂贵、更大、更重。

paras.en: If you’d like a wider lens, the Sony FE 20mm f/1.8 G is a fantastic option offering exceptional image quality alongside a compact build and light weight. A potential must-have for Sony users.
paras.zh: 如果您想要更宽的镜头，索尼 FE 20mm f/1.8 G 是一个绝佳的选择，可提供卓越的图像质量以及紧凑的结构和轻便的重量。索尼用户的潜在必备品。

paras.en: If you’d like to go wider still, the Sigma 14mm f/1.4 DG DN Art is an absolute beast of a lens, offering an ultra-wide light-gathering field of view alongside a fast f/1.4 maximum aperture.
paras.zh: 如果您想要更宽的范围，Sigma 14mm f/1.4 DG DN Art 绝对是一款野兽级镜头，它提供超宽的聚光视野以及快速的 f/1.4 最大光圈。

paras.en: James is an award-winning freelance landscape and portrait photographer, as well as a highly experienced photography journalist working with some of the best photography magazines and websites with a worldwide audience. He’s also the author of The Digital Darkroom: The Definitive Guide to Photo Editing. www.jamesaphoto.co.uk
paras.zh: 詹姆斯是一位屡获殊荣的自由风景和肖像摄影师，也是一位经验丰富的摄影记者，与一些拥有全球受众的最佳摄影杂志和网站合作。他还是《数字暗室：照片编辑权威指南》一书的作者。 www.jamesaphoto.co.uk

articles.title: New 'Star Trek: The Original Voyages' book traces the stellar legacy of the bold sci-fi brand
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: "Star Trek" celebrated its diamond anniversary last month, marking 60 years since it first aired on NBC on Sept. 8, 1966. There were a bunch of Trekkie-themed celebrations and news stories over September, including festive documentaries, special screenings, tributes, parade floats, interviews, and even a Galileo shuttle story.
paras.zh: 《星际迷航》上个月庆祝了它的钻石周年纪念日，纪念它自 1966 年 9 月 8 日在 NBC 首次播出以来的 60 周年。整个 9 月份有一系列以星际迷航为主题的庆祝活动和新闻报道，包括节日纪录片、特别放映、致敬、游行花车、采访，甚至还有伽利略号航天飞机的故事。

paras.en: Now, publishers Penguin Random House and Ten Speed Press are releasing "Star Trek: The Original Voyages: A Visual History" on Nov. 10, 2026.
paras.zh: 现在，出版商企鹅兰登书屋和十速出版社将于 2026 年 11 月 10 日发行《星际迷航：原始航程：视觉历史》。

paras.en: This coffee table book promises unprecedented exploration of the pioneering space fantasy television series and enduring pop culture property that bolstered the space race and ignited sci-fi audiences' imaginations by taking us to strange new worlds and civilizations in the final frontier.
paras.zh: 这本咖啡桌书承诺对开创性的太空奇幻电视连续剧和持久的流行文化财产进行前所未有的探索，这些财产通过带我们进入最后边疆的陌生新世界和文明，促进了太空竞赛并点燃了科幻观众的想象力。

paras.en: It's a striking 416-page hardback written by Kyle Newman and Jeff Bond, documenting all the classic characters and plotlines that are still inspiring artists, filmmakers, authors, and astronauts around the globe six decades later, and we’ve got our hands on a primo copy to show off.
paras.zh: 这是一本引人注目的 416 页精装本，由凯尔·纽曼 (Kyle Newman) 和杰夫·邦德 (Jeff Bond) 撰写，记录了所有经典人物和情节，六十年后仍然激励着全球各地的艺术家、电影制作人、作家和宇航员，我们手头有一本可以炫耀的初稿。

paras.en: "When the original 'Star Trek' series burst onto the screen in 1966, few could have anticipated the enduring legacy it would create," states the synopsis.
paras.zh: “当原版《星际迷航》系列于 1966 年出现在银幕上时，很少有人能预料到它会创造出不朽的遗产，”剧情简介说道。

paras.en: "Although it lasted just three seasons and 79 episodes, 'Star Trek' left an indelible mark on popular culture, and it soon spawned an animated television series, a blockbuster major motion picture franchise, and for its most dedicated fans, a way of life.
paras.zh: “尽管《星际迷航》只持续了三季和 79 集，但它在流行文化中留下了不可磨灭的印记，它很快催生了一部动画电视连续剧、一部轰动一时的大型电影系列，并为其最忠实的粉丝带来了一种生活方式。

paras.en: "The story of the U.S.S. Enterprise and her crew—James T. Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Leonard McCoy (DeForest Kelley), Montgomery Scott (James Doohan), Nyota Uhura (Nichelle Nichols), Pavel Chekov (Walter Koenig), and Hikaru Sulu (George Takei)—as well as the behind-the-scenes story of its creators, The Great Bird of the Galaxy Gene Roddenberry and his many collaborators, is extraordinary."
paras.zh: “企业号及其船员——詹姆斯·T·柯克（威廉·夏特纳）、斯波克（伦纳德·尼莫伊）、伦纳德·麦考伊（德福雷斯特·凯利）、蒙哥马利·斯科特（詹姆斯·杜汉）、尼奥塔·乌胡拉（尼切尔·尼科尔斯）、帕维尔·契诃夫（沃尔特·柯尼格）和光·苏鲁（乔治·竹井）——以及企业号的幕后故事它的创造者，银河大鸟吉恩·罗登伯里和他的许多合作者，都是非凡的。”

paras.en: Inside this classy collector's edition, which is the first volume of a two-book series gazing back at the complete history of "Star Trek," readers will behold a wealth of archival photos, costumes, storyboards, cast and creators' chats, behind-the-scenes ephemera, props, and filming models.
paras.zh: 在这本优雅的收藏版中，这是回顾《星际迷航》完整历史的两本书系列的第一卷，读者将看到大量的档案照片、服装、故事板、演员和创作者的聊天、幕后花絮、道具和拍摄模型。

paras.en: "Star Trek: The Original Voyages" chronicles not just the iconic TV show but also the short-lived animated series and all six of the big-screen "Star Trek" feature films up to the year 1991.
paras.zh: 《星际迷航：原始航程》不仅记录了标志性电视节目，还记录了短命的动画系列片以及截至 1991 年的所有六部大银幕“星际迷航”故事片。

paras.en: Above and beyond the dramatic cover emblazoned with reflective lettering, this beefy "Trek" book truly leaps into warp speed, covering all the licensed toys, comic books, convention memorabilia, media parodies, promotional roadshows, trading cards, and vintage magazine covers.
paras.zh: 除了印有反光字体的引人注目的封面之外，这本厚重的“迷航”书真正以惊人的速度飞跃，涵盖了所有授权玩具、漫画书、会议纪念品、媒体模仿、促销路演、交易卡和复古杂志封面。

paras.en: "Star Trek: The Original Voyages: A Visual History" lands on Nov. 10, 2026.
paras.zh: 《星际迷航：原始航程：视觉历史》将于 2026 年 11 月 10 日上映。

paras.en: Boldly celebrate 60 years of Star Trek with this official visual history of the original series, documenting how its iconic characters and storylines reshaped the science fiction genre.
paras.zh: 通过原系列的官方视觉历史，大胆庆祝《星际迷航》60 周年，记录其标志性人物和故事情节如何重塑科幻小说类型。

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Craft Prospect kicks off PERSEUS project to advance optical communications for space
articles.author: Craft Prospect

paras.en: Craft Prospect is working with Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics (Fraunhofer CAP) and Vector Photonics on a new project exploring the potential of next-generation laser technology for high-performance optical communications in space.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 正在与弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心 (Fraunhofer CAP) 和 Vector Photonics 合作开展一个新项目，探索下一代激光技术在太空高性能光通信中的潜力。

paras.en: PERSEUS (PCSEL Environmental and Radiation Sensitivity: Evaluation for Use in Space) will investigate whether a promising new laser technology called Photonic-Crystal Surface-Emitting Lasers (PCSELs) is suitable for operation in space and can offer a differentiated capability for both space-to-space and space/ground networks.
paras.zh: PERSEUS（PCSEL环境和辐射敏感性：太空使用评估）将研究一种有前途的新型激光技术，称为光子晶体表面发射激光器（PCSEL）是否适合在太空中运行，并可以为空对空和空/地网络提供差异化​​的功能。

paras.en: The project will evaluate the technology under conditions relevant to space deployment, demonstrate its compatibility with representative spacecraft hardware, and identify the next engineering steps required to move towards a commercial solution.
paras.zh: 该项目将在与太空部署相关的条件下评估该技术，展示其与代表性航天器硬件的兼容性，并确定迈向商业解决方案所需的下一步工程步骤。

paras.en: The project is funded through the Advanced Connectivity Technologies (ACT) programme, delivered by Innovate UK and funded by the Department for Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS). The ACT R&D Programme was announced by Minister Ian Murray during his speech at Connected Britain on 9 September 2026.
paras.zh: 该项目由先进连接技术 (ACT) 计划资助，该计划由创新英国组织实施，并由文化、媒体和体育部 (DCMS) 资助。 ACT 研发计划是由 Ian Murray 部长于 2026 年 9 月 9 日在 Connected Britain 上发表演讲时宣布的。

paras.en: Exploring a new approach to optical communications
paras.zh: 探索光通信新方法

paras.en: PCSEL technology offers the potential to address some of the limitations of existing optical and RF communications systems in space, supporting the move towards longer-range, higher-capacity, and more secure free-space optical links between ground stations, satellites, and potentially deeper-space assets.
paras.zh: PCSEL 技术有可能解决太空中现有光学和射频通信系统的一些局限性，支持地面站、卫星和潜在的深空资产之间建立更远距离、更高容量和更安全的自由空间光学链路。

paras.en: By bridging the gap between component and space system, PERSEUS will chart a course from disruptive technology to differentiated on-orbit capability for the fast-growing space market.
paras.zh: 通过弥合组件和太空系统之间的差距，PERSEUS 将为快速增长的太空市场制定从颠覆性技术到差异化在轨能力的路线。

paras.en: From device testing to spacecraft integration
paras.zh: 从设备测试到航天器集成

paras.en: The PERSEUS programme will subject PCSELs to a range of test campaigns expected of space qualified technologies, as well as carrying out long-range, high-bandwidth free-space demonstrations to showcase early performance.
paras.zh: PERSEUS 计划将使 PCSEL 接受一系列符合太空技术要求的测试活动，并进行远距离、高带宽自由空间演示，以展示早期性能。

paras.en: PCSEL devices will undergo characterisation and testing, including radiation, vibration, and thermal-vacuum campaigns, to better our understanding of how the technology fares in the launch and space environments.
paras.zh: PCSEL 设备将接受特性描述和测试，包括辐射、振动和热真空活动，以更好地了解该技术在发射和太空环境中的表现。

paras.en: Furthermore, the project will demonstrate early integration success with other flight-representative hardware for end-to-end data transmission, and develop mission concepts that harness the unique capabilities of PCSELs.
paras.zh: 此外，该项目还将展示与其他飞行代表硬件进行端到端数据传输的早期集成成功，并开发利用 PCSEL 独特功能的任务概念。

paras.en: The findings will feed into a future communications system design concept and help define the engineering roadmap required to progress PCSEL technology towards a differentiated space communications solution.
paras.zh: 研究结果将纳入未来的通信系统设计概念，并帮助定义将 PCSEL 技术发展为差异化空间通信解决方案所需的工程路线图。

paras.en: Bringing together photonics and space engineering expertise
paras.zh: 汇集光子学和空间工程专业知识

paras.en: At Craft Prospect, Head of Engineering Kevin Quillien is serving as Project Lead, supported by Chief Engineer Paul Yarr and Systems Engineers Lauryn Atkinson and Kairavi Pandit.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 的工程主管 Kevin Quillien 担任项目负责人，并由总工程师 Paul Yarr 以及系统工程师 Lauryn Atkinson 和 Kairav Pandit 提供支持。

paras.en: At Fraunhofer CAP, Dr Gerald Bonner is subcontract lead, while at Vector Photonics Dr Richard Taylor serves as subcontract lead and Dr Graham Goldberg as Project Manager.
paras.zh: 在 Fraunhofer CAP，Gerald Bonner 博士担任分包负责人，而在 Vector Photonics，Richard Taylor 博士担任分包负责人，Graham Goldberg 博士担任项目经理。

paras.en: The project also builds on Craft Prospect’s growing quantum-optical communications capability, including our work on OPS-SAT VOLT, where we are developing and testing space-to-ground free-space quantum and optical communications technologies as part of our wider mission to deliver Smart Secure Space.
paras.zh: 该项目还建立在 Craft Prospect 不断增长的量子光通信能力的基础上，包括我们在 OPS-SAT VOLT 上的工作，我们正在开发和测试空对地自由空间量子和光通信技术，作为我们提供智能安全空间的更广泛使命的一部分。

paras.en: Kevin Quillien, Project Lead and Head of Engineering Craft Prospect, said of the project:
paras.zh: 项目负责人兼 Engineering Craft Prospect 负责人 Kevin Quillien 谈到该项目时说道：

paras.en: ‘PERSEUS is an exciting opportunity to take a promising new photonics technology and understand the potential it has to offer the space industry.
paras.zh: “PERSEUS 是一个令人兴奋的机会，可以采用有前途的新型光子技术并了解它为航天工业带来的潜力。

paras.en: ‘By carrying out all the necessary early-stage work to test and characterise PCSELs for space, we will build a strong understanding of the potential that the technology offers in building the next generation of communication solutions. We’re looking forward to working with Fraunhofer CAP and Vector Photonics to explore where this roadmap will take us.’
paras.zh: “通过开展所有必要的早期工作来测试和表征太空 PCSEL，我们将深入了解该技术在构建下一代通信解决方案方面的潜力。我们期待与 Fraunhofer CAP 和 Vector Photonics 合作，探索该路线图将带我们走向何方。

paras.en: Craft Prospect is a Glasgow-based space engineering company advancing its vision of Smart Secure Space through onboard intelligence, quantum technologies, and satellite subsystem innovation. Learn more here.
paras.zh: Craft Prospect 是一家总部位于格拉斯哥的空间工程公司，通过机载智能、量子技术和卫星子系统创新推进其智能安全空间的愿景。在这里了解更多。

paras.en: About Fraunhofer Centre for Applied Photonics
paras.zh: 关于弗劳恩霍夫应用光子学中心

paras.en: Fraunhofer CAP is a not-for-profit research and technology organisation (RTO) offering industry a professional development capability in the fields of photonics, lasers and quantum technologies. Learn more about Fraunhofer CAP here.
paras.zh: Fraunhofer CAP 是一家非营利性研究和技术组织 (RTO)，为业界提供光子学、激光和量子技术领域的专业开发能力。点击此处了解有关弗劳恩霍夫 CAP 的更多信息。

paras.en: Vector Photonics Limited, based in Glasgow, is advancing its revolutionary, proprietary, PCSEL technology from proven R&D and commercial fab environments to high-volume manufacturing. Further information can be found here
paras.zh: Vector Photonics Limited 总部位于格拉斯哥，正在将其革命性的专有 PCSEL 技术从经过验证的研发和商业晶圆厂环境推进到大批量制造。更多信息可以在这里找到

articles.title: Advice for optimizing the space industry with Laura Crabtree
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, Mike Gruss speaks with Laura Crabtree, the CEO of Epsilon3, who is also a former SpaceX astronaut trainer. They talk about ways that space companies can organize themselves to increase speed, especially to remove roadblocks around testing and certification.
paras.zh: 在本集中，迈克·格鲁斯 (Mike Gruss) 与 Epsilon3 首席执行官劳拉·克拉布特里 (Laura Crabtree) 进行了交谈，劳拉·克拉布特里也是前 SpaceX 宇航员培训师。他们讨论了航天公司如何组织起来以提高速度，特别是消除测试和认证方面的障碍。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！

paras.zh: 注意：注册即表示您同意接收来自 SpaceNews 和我们合作伙伴的通信。

articles.title: How to Expand Reliable, Flexible Access to Space
articles.author: Exolaunch

paras.en: The space industry launched more rockets into orbit last year than ever before, yet satellite operators are confronting an unexpected problem: There still aren’t enough rides to go around.
paras.zh: 去年，航天工业向轨道发射的火箭数量比以往任何时候都要多，但卫星运营商却面临着一个意想不到的问题：仍然没有足够的运载火箭可供绕行。

paras.en: And increasingly, the shortage isn’t simply about the number of rockets.
paras.zh: 而且，短缺问题越来越不仅仅与火箭数量有关。

paras.en: Satellite companies want launches to more orbital destinations, with more regularity and aboard a wider range of vehicles. Instead, much of the industry has come to depend on a relatively small number of frequently launched rockets that often go to similar orbits. That’s left some companies and their spacecraft waiting months or years for a suitable ride.
paras.zh: 卫星公司希望以更多的规律性和更广泛的运载工具向更多的轨道目的地发射卫星。相反，该行业的大部分公司已经开始依赖数量相对较少、经常发射且通常进入相似轨道的火箭。这使得一些公司和他们的航天器需要等待数月或数年才能获得合适的飞行。

paras.en: “Demand is crazy,” said Robert Sproles, chief executive of Exolaunch, a Berlin-based broker of global launch services that has put 912 satellites into orbit during 51 separate launch events. “The demand curve is so much steeper than the supply curve.”
paras.zh: Exolaunch 首席执行官罗伯特·斯普罗尔斯 (Robert Sproles) 表示：“需求太疯狂了。”Exolaunch 是一家总部位于柏林的全球发射服务经纪商，在 51 次单独的发射活动中已将 912 颗卫星送入轨道。 “需求曲线比供给曲线陡峭得多。”

paras.en: The squeeze comes despite a historic expansion in launch activity. Data from the FAA shows the agency licensed 187 launches in fiscal year 2026. That’s up from less than 100 a decade earlier and governments are pushing for still more. The Trump administration has called for U.S. spaceports to support more than 1,000 launches and reentries annually by 2030.
paras.zh: 尽管发射活动出现了历史性的扩张，但这种挤压还是出现了。 FAA 的数据显示，该机构在 2026 财年批准了 187 次发射。这一数字高于十年前的不到 100 次，而且各国政府正在推动更多发射。特朗普政府呼吁美国太空港到 2030 年每年支持 1000 多次发射和重返大气层。

paras.en: But raw launch numbers obscure a problem that is becoming increasingly important as the space economy grows. A rocket going to the wrong orbit at the wrong time isn’t necessarily useful to a satellite operator.
paras.zh: 但原始发射数据掩盖了一个随着太空经济增长而变得越来越重要的问题。火箭在错误的时间进入错误的轨道对于卫星运营商来说不一定有用。

paras.en: All of that is turning choice, not just capacity, into one of the launch industry’s biggest constraints.
paras.zh: 所有这些都使选择（而不仅仅是容量）成为发射行业最大的限制之一。

paras.en: In order to truly close the gap between supply and demand, Sproles said, space transportation companies must also increase the diversity of available launches.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，为了真正缩小供需差距，航天运输公司还必须增加可用发射的多样性。

paras.en: “Yes, we need to meet demand. But we also need to make sure we’re putting that demand in the right places,” he said. “We need to recognize what types of launches are best for what types of missions, and we need to make sure those types of launches are available when the launch customer needs them.”
paras.zh: “是的，我们需要满足需求。但我们还需要确保将需求放在正确的地方，”他说。 “我们需要认识到哪种类型的发射最适合哪种类型的任务，并且我们需要确保在发射客户需要时可以使用这些类型的发射。”

paras.en: Market research firm Novaspace reports that the global space economy reached a valuation of $626 billion in 2025. Citing “consolidation, integration, and closer institutional alignment around security, resilience, and operational performance,” it forecasts annual growth of 5.5% through 2034 — at which point it predicts the global space economy will be worth over $1 trillion.
paras.zh: 市场研究公司 Novaspace 报告称，到 2025 年，全球太空经济估值将达到 6260 亿美元。该公司援引“围绕安全、弹性和运营绩效的整合、一体化和更紧密的机构协调”，预测到 2034 年年增长率将达到 5.5%，届时全球太空经济价值将超过 1 万亿美元。

paras.en: Markets that large are not monolithic, Sproles said, which means the industry needs multiple launch providers operating regularly across different orbital regimes.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯表示，这么大的市场并不是单一的，这意味着该行业需要多个发射提供商在不同的轨道制度上定期运营。

paras.en: “If you rewind to, say, 2016, there was more launch diversity in the market at that time than there is today. There was not more capacity, but there was a wider variety of vehicles that you could reliably gain access to,” Sproles said. The reasons for that decline in launch diversity includes changes in technology, geopolitics, and supply chains since the COVID-19 pandemic, all of which have led to the concentration of launch capacity in a small number of highly active launch providers.
paras.zh: “如果回溯到 2016 年，当时市场上的发射多样性比现在更多。运力并没有更多，但你可以可靠地获得更多种类的车辆，”斯普罗尔斯说。发射多样性下降的原因包括自COVID-19大流行以来技术、地缘政治和供应链的变化，所有这些都导致发射能力集中在少数高度活跃的发射提供商手中。

paras.en: But that variety is necessary, Sproles argues, because launch customers want to be able to optimize for when they can launch, where they need to go, and how much it will cost.
paras.zh: 但斯普罗尔斯认为，这种多样性是必要的，因为发布客户希望能够针对何时发布、需要去哪里以及需要花费多少进行优化。

paras.en: Consider the two most prolific launch providers today: SpaceX — whose Falcon 9 vehicle is optimized for large commercial constellations, human spaceflight, and heavy commercial rideshares — and Rocket Lab, whose Electron vehicle favors small satellites and CubeSats that require custom orbital planes.
paras.zh: 考虑一下当今最多产的两家发射提供商：SpaceX（其 Falcon 9 运载火箭针对大型商业星座、载人航天和重型商业共享出行进行了优化）和 Rocket Lab（其 Electron 运载火箭偏爱需要定制轨道飞机的小型卫星和立方体卫星）。

paras.en: “You could not come up with two more different vehicles both in terms of performance and commercial offerings, which just goes to show you that the industry is as hungry for choice as it is for capacity,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“在性能和商业产品方面，你无法再推出两种不同的车辆，这只会向你表明，该行业对选择的渴望与对容量的渴望一样。”

paras.en: In today’s launch market, rideshare services are a foundation of the space industry. “Rideshare is appropriate when your schedule is flexible enough to align with when a planned rideshare is launching, and when you have enough orbital wiggle room to go where the masses want to go,” Sproles said. “Basically, it makes sense when you have less rigid mission constraints.”
paras.zh: 在当今的发射市场中，拼车服务是航天工业的基础。斯普罗尔斯说：“当你的日程安排足够灵活，能够与计划的拼车服务启动时间保持一致，并且你有足够的轨道回旋空间去大众想去的地方时，拼车服务就是合适的。” “基本上，当你的任务限制不那么严格时，这是有意义的。”

paras.en: But as missions become more complex and bespoke, one size doesn’t fit all. Rideshare alternatives are needed, including shared launches — where launches are conceived from the outset with multiple customers in mind, instead of one customer’s mission piggybacking haphazardly onto another’s — and dedicated launches, wherein a customer procures an entire launch that’s customized to their unique schedule, destination, and payload, Sproles said
paras.zh: 但随着任务变得更加复杂和定制化，一种方法并不适合所有人。斯普罗尔斯表示，需要共享出行的替代方案，包括共享发射——从一开始就考虑到多个客户的情况来构思发射，而不是一个客户的任务随意地搭载在另一个客户的任务上——以及专用发射，其中客户购买根据其独特的时间表、目的地和有效载荷定制的整个发射。

paras.en: Exolaunch points to four planned missions that underscore the benefits of launch diversity:
paras.zh: Exolaunch 指出了四项计划任务，强调了发射多样性的好处：

paras.en: - In 2027, the company will conduct a mid-inclination rideshare mission aboard Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ H3 rocket. It will be the company’s first launch from Japan.
paras.zh: - 2027年，该公司将搭乘三菱重工的H3火箭执行中倾角拼车任务。这将是该公司首次在日本推出。

paras.en: - In late 2027 and 2028, respectively, Exolaunch will launch its Exo-1 and Exo-2 missions aboard two dedicated SpaceX Falcon 9 rockets procured exclusively for an anchor customer that in both instances will use approximately 40% of the launch vehicle; Exolaunch will sell the remaining 60% to other customers seeking a rideshare model.
paras.zh: - 分别于 2027 年末和 2028 年，Exolaunch 将利用专为主要客户采购的两枚专用 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射 Exo-1 和 Exo-2 任务，在这两种情况下，该客户将使用约 40% 的运载火箭； Exolaunch 将把剩余的 60% 出售给其他寻求拼车模式的客户。

paras.en: - In late 2028, Exolaunch will serve as the launch co-integrator for the Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment-Continuity (GRACE-C) mission that is a joint effort of the German Space Agency’s German Aerospace Center (DLR) and NASA. The company will provide a custom structure with which to secure the mission’s payload inside a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket that DLR and NASA had already secured for their launch; in return, DLR and NASA will allow it to provide the rocket’s unused capacity to other customers.
paras.zh: - 2028 年末，Exolaunch 将作为重力恢复和气候实验连续性 (GRACE-C) 任务的发射联合集成商，该任务是德国航天局德国航空航天中心 (DLR) 和 NASA 的共同努力。该公司将提供一种定制结构，用于将任务有效载荷固定在 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭内，DLR 和 NASA 已经为发射做好了准备；作为回报，德国航天中心和美国宇航局将允许其向其他客户提供火箭未使用的容量。

paras.en: The first eight launches for Exolaunch in 2026 took place across four different launch vehicles from three continents. By securing capacity across a diverse portfolio of launch vehicles, inclinations, and spaceports, Sproles said, Exolaunch gives launch customers not only more predictable access to orbit, but also increased flexibility with regard to cost, schedule, and orbital destination.
paras.zh: 2026 年 Exolaunch 的前八次发射是通过来自三大洲的四种不同的运载火箭进行的。 Sproles 表示，通过确保各种运载火箭、倾角和太空港的容量，Exolaunch 不仅为发射客户提供了更可预测的进入轨道的机会，而且还提高了成本、时间表和轨道目的地方面的灵活性。

paras.en: Sproles ultimately envisions a future where customers can launch at any time and to any orbit without ever having to consider available launch vehicles or schedules — just as manufacturers in other industries can ship their products knowing that there’s always a container ship, train, or truck available to transport them.
paras.zh: Sproles 最终设想的未来是，客户可以在任何时间、任何轨道发射火箭，而无需考虑可用的运载火箭或时间表，就像其他行业的制造商可以运送他们的产品一样，因为他们知道总有集装箱船、火车或卡车可以运输它们。

paras.en: “The ideal situation is that customers don’t have to think about what the vehicle is or when it’s going because there’s always an option to get to the desired orbit at the time when their satellite is manufactured,” Sproles said.
paras.zh: 斯普罗尔斯说：“理想的情况是，客户不必考虑车辆是什么或何时行驶，因为在制造卫星时总有一个选择可以到达所需的轨道。”

paras.en: That future is in the hands of launch companies.
paras.zh: 这个未来掌握在发射公司手中。

paras.en: “We have multiple launch providers who have shown they can launch rockets. Now, we need those launchers to launch. We need them operating reliably at cadence, and we need them going to multiple orbits. They can do it. We just need them to execute.”
paras.zh: “我们有多家发射提供商已经证明他们可以发射火箭。现在，我们需要这些发射器来发射。我们需要它们以节奏可靠地运行，我们需要它们进入多个轨道。他们可以做到。我们只需要他们执行。”

articles.title: Six in seven journalist murders go unpunished,  UNESCO reports

paras.en: Six in seven journalist murders go unpunished, UNESCO reports
paras.zh: 联合国教科文组织报告称，七分之六的记者谋杀案未受到惩罚

paras.en: Global impunity for journalist killings has risen for the first time in more than a decade, while the growing use of drones is an emerging threat for reporters in conflict zones, according to the latest report from UN cultural organization UNESCO.
paras.zh: 联合国文化组织教科文组织的最​​新报告显示，全球对杀害记者的有罪不罚现象十多年来首次上升，而无人机的日益使用对冲突地区的记者构成了新的威胁。

paras.en: “Journalists are increasingly paying with their lives for reporting from the frontlines of war and far too often those responsible for their killings are not held accountable,” said Director-General Khaled El-Enany.
paras.zh: “越来越多的记者为在战争前线进行报道而付出生命的代价，而那些对他们的杀戮负有责任的人往往没有被追究责任，”总干事哈立德·埃纳尼说。

paras.en: UNESCO first began measuring the proportion of journalist killings that go unpunished in 2012. The rate reached 86 per cent in 2024-2025, up one per cent from the previous two-year period.
paras.zh: 教科文组织于 2012 年首次开始衡量杀害记者而不受惩罚的比例。2024 年至 2025 年，这一比例达到 86%，比前两年上升了 1 个百分点。

paras.en: A confirmed total of 189 journalists and other media workers lost their lives in 2024-2025, or 20 per cent more than during the previous biennium and the highest number since 2014-2015.
paras.zh: 经确认，2024-2025 年共有 189 名记者和其他媒体工作者丧生，比上一个两年期增加了 20%，是 2014-2015 年以来的最高数字。

paras.en: More than two thirds, 127, were killed in conflict zones, accounting for 67 per cent of the death toll.
paras.zh: 超过三分之二的人，即 127 人，在冲突地区丧生，占死亡人数的 67%。

paras.en: The findings come in the Director-General’s Report on the Safety of Journalists and the Danger of Impunity, which is published every two years to mark the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists, observed on 2 November.
paras.zh: 这些调查结果发表在总干事关于记者安全和有罪不罚危险的报告中，该报告每两年发布一次，以纪念 11 月 2 日结束针对记者犯罪不受惩罚现象国际日。

paras.en: “Over the past year, at least 34 journalists paid the ultimate price. Six of every seven such killings go unpunished. In conflict settings, the rate of impunity is close to 100 per cent,” UN Secretary-General António Guterres said in his message for the Day.
paras.zh: “过去一年，至少有 34 名记者付出了最终的代价。每 7 起此类杀戮事件中就有 6 起未受到惩罚。在冲突环境中，有罪不罚率接近 100%，”联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在国际日致辞中表示。

paras.en: “This is a heinous affront to the victims and their loved ones, as well as all of us who depend on journalists to remain informed and engaged.”
paras.zh: “这对受害者及其亲人以及我们所有依赖记者保持知情和参与的人来说是令人发指的侮辱。”

paras.en: Killings were recorded across all regions of the world during the 2024-2025 biennium, representing “a global scourge”, the report said.
paras.zh: 报告称，2024-2025两年期内，世界所有地区都发生了杀戮事件，这是“全球性的祸害”。

paras.en: The highest number of verified cases were in the Arab States (97) followed by Latin American and the Caribbean (37), Asia-Pacific (34), Central and Eastern Europe (14), Africa (6) and Western Europe and North America (1).
paras.zh: 确诊病例数最多的是阿拉伯国家（97 例），其次是拉丁美洲和加勒比地区（37 例）、亚太地区（34 例）、中欧和东欧（14 例）、非洲（6 例）以及西欧和北美（1 例）。

paras.en: The State of Palestine had the highest number of killings in both years, at 30 and 32, respectively.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦国这两年的杀戮人数最多，分别为 30 人和 32 人。

paras.en: The report also identified what UNESCO called “a disturbing new threat” – the growing use of drones to kill journalists. During 2024-2025, drone strikes killed 50 journalists, or 40 per cent of all those killed in conflict zones.
paras.zh: 该报告还指出了联合国教科文组织所说的“令人不安的新威胁”——越来越多地使用无人机杀害记者。 2024 年至 2025 年间，无人机袭击导致 50 名记者死亡，占冲突地区遇难人数的 40%。

paras.en: It documented seven incidents in which several journalists were targeted and killed in a single attack, including strikes on media workplaces and temporary reporting centres. Fifteen journalists were reportedly killed while wearing press vests or in vehicles clearly marked ‘Press’.
paras.zh: 它记录了七起事件，其中几名记者在一次袭击中成为目标并被杀害，其中包括对媒体工作场所和临时报道中心的袭击。据报道，有 15 名记者在穿着新闻背心或乘坐明显标有“新闻”字样的车辆时被杀。

paras.en: “I reiterate my call for the respect of UN Security Council Resolution 2222 unanimously adopted in 2015 on the protection of journalists, media professionals and associated personnel as civilians in situations of conflict, a status reaffirmed in the Pact for the Future,” said Mr. El-Enany.
paras.zh: 埃纳尼先生表示：“我再次呼吁尊重联合国安理会 2015 年一致通过的第 2222 号决议，该决议涉及在冲突局势中保护作为平民的记者、媒体专业人员和相关人员，这一地位在《未来公约》中得到了重申。”

paras.en: The report also highlighted progress, as impunity in non-conflict countries has continued to decline. The rate has fallen from 94 per cent in 2012 to 77 per cent in 2026, or one percentage point per year.
paras.zh: 报告还强调了进展，非冲突国家的有罪不罚现象持续减少。这一比率已从 2012 年的 94% 下降到 2026 年的 77%，即每年下降一个百分点。

paras.en: The number of journalist killings in non-conflict zones, 85, is also the lowest in 18 years.
paras.zh: 非冲突地区记者遇害人数为 85 人，也是 18 年来最低的。

paras.en: “This demonstrates that when governments invest in investigations, prosecutions and protections for journalists, progress is possible,” UNESCO said.
paras.zh: 教科文组织表示：“这表明，当政府投资于调查、起诉和保护记者时，取得进展是可能的。”

paras.en: The agency noted, however, that women journalists continue to face particular risks, both in war zones and online. Thirteen out of the 14 women killed in 2024-2035 were in countries experiencing armed conflict.
paras.zh: 然而，该机构指出，无论是在战区还是在网上，女记者仍然面临着特殊的风险。 2024 年至 2035 年期间遇害的 14 名女性中有 13 名生活在经历武装冲突的国家。

paras.en: Furthermore, a 2025 study by UN Women and the International Center for Journalists found that 75 per cent of women journalists had experienced online or offline abuse and harassment. More than 40 per cent reported offline violence linked to online attacks, up from 20 per cent in a 2020 UNESCO survey.
paras.zh: 此外，联合国妇女署和国际记者中心 2025 年的一项研究发现，75% 的女记者曾遭受过线上或线下的虐待和骚扰。超过 40% 的人报告说，线下暴力与线上攻击有关，高于联合国教科文组织 2020 年调查的 20%。

paras.en: “Across the world, journalists continue to pay an outrageous price for telling the truth,” the UN Secretary-General said.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长表示：“在世界各地，记者继续为讲真话付出令人震惊的代价。”

paras.en: “On this International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists, we demand justice. When journalists are targeted and their reporting is extinguished, it makes victims of us all.”
paras.zh: “在这个结束针对记者犯罪有罪不罚现象国际日，我们要求伸张正义。当记者成为目标并且他们的报道被消灭时，我们所有人都成为受害者。”

articles.title: Ethiopia: Violence in the north is pushing health system to the brink, WHO chief warns

paras.en: Ethiopia: Violence in the north is pushing health system to the brink, WHO chief warns
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚：世卫组织负责人警告称，北部的暴力事件正在将卫生系统推向崩溃边缘

paras.en: “Reports of attacks on civilians in Ethiopia’s Amhara and Tigray regions are deeply disturbing,” Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus wrote in a post on social media.
paras.zh: “埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉和提格雷地区平民遭受袭击的报道令人深感不安，”总干事谭德塞在社交媒体上发帖写道。

paras.en: He said children, including a newborn, were among fatalities at a displacement camp in Amhara.
paras.zh: 他说，阿姆哈拉流离失所者营地的死亡人数包括儿童，包括一名新生儿。

paras.en: In a separate strike in the town of Rama in Tigray, several people were reportedly killed while trying to get food.
paras.zh: 据报道，在提格雷拉玛镇的另一次罢工中，有几人在试图获取食物时被杀。

paras.en: Fresh fighting between Ethiopian Government forces and rebel groups resumed in the two regions and another, Afar, in September nearly four years after a peace deal.
paras.zh: 和平协议签署近四年后，9月，埃塞俄比亚政府军与反叛组织在这两个地区和阿法尔地区重新爆发了新的战斗。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has warned of the risk of escalation and wider destabilization.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告局势升级和更广泛不稳定的风险。

paras.en: Last Friday, he said he was appalled by recent attacks on civilians – including health facilities.
paras.zh: 上周五，他表示，他对最近针对平民（包括医疗设施）的袭击感到震惊。

paras.en: “The Secretary-General calls on the parties to spare the civilian population and critical infrastructure and agree without delay to a cessation of hostilities as a first step towards ending this devastating conflict, said the statement issued by his Spokesperson.
paras.zh: 秘书长发言人发表声明说：“秘书长呼吁各方不要伤害平民和重要基础设施，并立即同意停止敌对行动，作为结束这场毁灭性冲突的第一步。”

paras.en: “He renews his urgent appeal to the parties to engage in good faith with mediation efforts.”
paras.zh: “他再次紧急呼吁各方真诚地进行调解努力。”

paras.en: While the deadly strikes marked the latest incidents, “drone attacks and civilian casualties have tragically become frequent across Ethiopia”, Tedros said.
paras.zh: 谭德塞表示，尽管致命袭击是最新事件的标志，但“埃塞俄比亚各地的无人机袭击和平民伤亡却悲惨地频繁发生”。

paras.en: “The violence in northern Ethiopia is pushing an already fragile health system closer to collapse,” he continued.
paras.zh: “埃塞俄比亚北部的暴力事件正在将本已脆弱的卫生系统推向崩溃，”他继续说道。

paras.en: “Hospitals face shortages of health workers, medicines, and equipment. Ambulance services are severely limited. Insecurity is obstructing the delivery of life-saving medical supplies to some areas.”
paras.zh: “医院面临卫生人员、药品和设备的短缺。救护车服务严重有限。不安全局势阻碍了向某些地区运送救生医疗用品。”

paras.en: He stressed that WHO and partners “are working around the clock to deliver additional much needed medical supplies to all the affected regions”.
paras.zh: 他强调，世卫组织和合作伙伴“正在夜以继日地工作，向所有受影响地区提供更多急需的医疗用品”。

paras.en: As fighting continues, he warned, more people are likely to lose access to essential healthcare. This includes emergency services, maternal and childcare as well as treatment for diseases.
paras.zh: 他警告说，随着战斗的继续，更多的人可能无法获得基本的医疗保健。这包括紧急服务、妇幼保健以及疾病治疗。

paras.en: “The most courageous choose peace,” he said. “The best medicine is peace.”
paras.zh: “最勇敢的人选择和平，”他说。 “最好的良药是和平。”

articles.title: Ukraine: WFP provides hot meals to Oleshky evacuees as UN pushes to restore power before winter

paras.en: Ukraine: WFP provides hot meals to Oleshky evacuees as UN pushes to restore power before winter
paras.zh: 乌克兰：联合国努力在冬季前恢复供电，粮食署为奥列什基撤离人员提供热餐

paras.en: The UN World Food Programme (WFP) is providing emergency food assistance to more than 400 people who were able to leave the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, in Ukraine’s Kherson region, during a brief local ceasefire.
paras.zh: 联合国世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 正在向 400 多人提供紧急粮食援助，这些人在当地短暂停火期间得以离开乌克兰赫尔松地区被俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市。

paras.en: Many arrived in worrying condition at medical facilities in Kyiv on 31 October after being trapped by fighting, enduring months of severe shortages of food, medical supplies and other basic necessities, the agency said late on Sunday.
paras.zh: 该机构周日晚表示，许多人因战斗而被困，并经历了数月的食品、医疗用品和其他基本必需品严重短缺的情况，于 10 月 31 日抵达基辅的医疗机构，情况令人担忧。

paras.en: Working with its national partner Iskra Dobra – a Ukrainian humanitarian NGO – WFP provided hot meals to evacuees as soon as they arrived and will continue to do so for an initial two weeks.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署与其国家合作伙伴 Iskra Dobra（乌克兰人道主义非政府组织）合作，在撤离人员抵达后立即向他们提供热餐，并将在最初两周内继续这样做。

paras.en: More evacuees are expected and the agency “stands ready to scale up its assistance”. The emergency food assistance is funded by the United States.
paras.zh: 预计会有更多的撤离人员，该机构“随时准备扩大援助规模”。紧急粮食援助由美国资助。

paras.en: “For people who have endured months of fear, isolation and deprivation, this humanitarian pause offers something very simple but incredibly important: a chance to reach safety and receive the help they need,” said WFP Executive Director Luke J. Lindberg.
paras.zh: 世界粮食计划署执行主任卢克·J·林德伯格表示：“对于经历了数月恐惧、孤立和匮乏的人们来说，这次人道主义暂停提供了一些非常简单但极其重要的东西：一个到达安全地带并获得所需帮助的机会。”

paras.en: He recognised the role of the US First Lady Melania Trump in helping to broker the ceasefire and expressed hope that it could open the door to sustained humanitarian access. WFP had previously tried to support people in Oleshky but had not been granted access.
paras.zh: 他承认美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普在帮助斡旋停火方面发挥的作用，并表示希望这能为持续的人道主义准入打开大门。粮食计划署此前曾试图为奥列什基的人们提供支持，但未获准进入。

paras.en: The UN’s Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher said that the evacuation window – which ended on Sunday – “shows what is possible when parties put civilians first.”
paras.zh: 联合国紧急救援协调员汤姆·弗莱彻表示，周日结束的疏散窗口“表明，当各方将平民放在第一位时，一切都是可能的。”

paras.en: He noted that aid had been delivered to Oleshky at last, describing it as “respite at last for so many. Thank you to First Lady Melania Trump and all involved. Now let's build on this opening and get aid to more people, wherever they are.”
paras.zh: 他指出，援助终于送到了奥列什基，并称其为“这么多人终于得到了喘息的机会。感谢第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普和所有参与者。现在让我们在此基础上再接再厉，为更多的人提供援助，无论他们身在何处。”

paras.en: The evacuation comes amid increasingly dangerous environment for civilians and humanitarian operations across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这次撤离是在乌克兰各地平民和人道主义行动面临日益危险的环境之际进行的。

paras.en: As of September, WFP recorded 134 security incidents affecting the agency and its partners since 2023, including 57 this year alone, affecting distribution points, vehicles, warehouses and staff.
paras.zh: 截至 9 月，粮食计划署记录了 2023 年以来影响该机构及其合作伙伴的 134 起安全事件，其中仅今年就有 57 起，影响了分发点、车辆、仓库和工作人员。

paras.en: Across the country, WFP reaches more than half a million people every month with food and cash assistance, focusing on communities near the front line.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署每月向全国超过 50 万人提供粮食和现金援助，重点关注前线附近的社区。

paras.en: Attacks over the weekend continued to kill and injure civilians while disrupting electricity and heating supplies as temperatures drop, with Dnipro and Donetsk regions among the hardest hit, the Secretary-General's Spokesperson said on Monday. Heat and power plants in Kyiv and Shostka were damaged, and more than 650 villages in the Zhytomr region experienced outages.
paras.zh: 秘书长发言人周一表示，周末的袭击事件继续造成平民伤亡，同时随着气温下降，电力和供暖供应中断，第聂伯罗和顿涅茨克地区受灾最严重。基辅和肖斯特卡的热电厂和发电厂遭到破坏，日托米尔地区 650 多个村庄出现停电。

paras.en: Meanwhile, UN Development Programme (UNDP) Goodwill Ambassador and actor Nikolaj Coster-Waldau has called for continued funding to help Ukrainian communities face another winter of war.
paras.zh: 与此同时，联合国开发计划署（UNDP）亲善大使兼演员尼古拉·科斯特-瓦尔道呼吁继续提供资金，帮助乌克兰社区应对另一个战争冬天。

paras.en: During a week-long visit, the Game of Thrones star met families in Kyiv living on a few rationed hours of electricity a day.
paras.zh: 在为期一周的访问中，这位《权力的游戏》明星会见了基辅每天靠几个小时的配给电力生活的家庭。

paras.en: “Statistics about damaged energy infrastructure can seem abstract, but the reality is deeply personal. It affects whether children can study, whether families can stay warm, or whether people can work and plan for tomorrow,” he said.
paras.zh: “有关受损能源基础设施的统计数据看似抽象，但现实是非常个人化的。它影响着孩子们是否可以学习，家庭是否可以取暖，或者人们是否可以工作并为明天做计划，”他说。

paras.en: “The encouraging thing is that support from partners around the world is already making a difference. Critical equipment is here. Now we need to make sure it is installed and working so communities have the power and services they need.”
paras.zh: “令人鼓舞的是，来自世界各地的合作伙伴的支持已经产生了影响。关键设备已经到位。现在我们需要确保它已安装并正常运行，以便社区拥有他们所需的电力和服务。”

paras.en: To speed this up, Ukraine’s Ministry of Energy and UNDP are appealing for $500 million through the newly launched Ukraine Energy Installation Facility, which will install and commission energy equipment already in the country. Last year, UNDP helped keep power, heat and water flowing for 6.6 million people.
paras.zh: 为了加快这一进程，乌克兰能源部和联合国开发计划署正在通过新启动的乌克兰能源安装设施筹集 5 亿美元，该设施将安装和调试该国已有的能源设备。去年，开发署帮助 660 万人保持电力、供暖和供水。

paras.en: Mr. Coster-Waldau also met veterans retraining as humanitarian deminers and visited Ukraine’s first dedicated underwater demining training centre, established by UNDP.
paras.zh: 科斯特-瓦尔道先生还会见了接受人道主义排雷人员再培训的退伍军人，并参观了由联合国开发计划署建立的乌克兰第一个专门的水下排雷培训中心。

paras.en: “There were air raids day and night, yet everywhere I met people who were determined to keep working, creating, and supporting one another,” he said. “Their resilience is inspiring, but resilience should never be taken for granted.”
paras.zh: “日夜都有空袭，但我到处都遇到了决心继续工作、创造和互相支持的人们，”他说。 “他们的韧性令人鼓舞，但绝不能认为韧性是理所当然的。”

articles.title: Australia's Maxwell announces retirement from international cricket

paras.en: Australia's Glenn Maxwell announces retirement from international cricket
paras.zh: 澳大利亚格伦·马克斯韦尔宣布从国际板球界退役

paras.en: Glenn Maxwell had already retired from one-day internationals and has now called time on his T20 international career as well; batting all-rounder's last appearance for his country came at 2026 T20 World Cup; Maxwell hit the fastest 50-over World Cup century, from 40 balls, in 2023
paras.zh: 格伦·马克斯韦尔 (Glenn Maxwell) 已经从一日国际比赛中退役，现在也结束了他的 T20 国际比赛生涯。这位全能击球手最后一次代表国家队出场是在 2026 年 T20 世界杯上；马克斯韦尔在 2023 年世界杯上以 40 个球打进 50 球以上的最快纪录

paras.en: Australia all-rounder Glenn Maxwell has announced his retirement from international cricket but will continue to play T20 for Melbourne Stars in the Big Bash League.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚全能选手格伦·马克斯韦尔宣布退出国际板球比赛，但将继续为墨尔本之星队在 Big Bash League 中打 T20 比赛。

paras.en: The 38-year-old's final appearance for his country came against Oman in the T20 World Cup earlier this year, when he recorded figures of 2-13 from three overs with his off-spin and was not required to bat.
paras.zh: 这位 38 岁的球员最后一次代表国家队出场是在今年早些时候的 T20 世界杯对阵阿曼的比赛中，当时他在三轮比赛中凭借低旋转取得了 2-13 的成绩，并且不需要击球。

paras.en: Maxwell scored five T20 international hundreds, a record he shares with India's Rohit Sharma, while he is one of only five Australian men, alongside Shane Watson, David Warner, Josh Inglis and Mitchell Marsh, to score a ton in all three international formats.
paras.zh: 马克斯韦尔在国际比赛中获得了 5 次 T20 百分，这一记录是他与印度选手罗希特·夏尔马 (Rohit Sharma) 共同创造的，而他是仅有的五名在所有三种国际赛事中都取得大量成绩的澳大利亚选手之一，其他五位分别是肖恩·沃森 (Shane Watson)、大卫·沃纳 (David Warner)、乔什·英格利斯 (Josh Inglis) 和米切尔·马什 (Mitchell Marsh)。

paras.en: Speaking on the Final Word podcast, Maxwell said: "I suppose [I had] a small hope that I might have been able to potentially get a send-off game at the MCG. But I can completely understand the direction they're going with this [T20] squad.
paras.zh: 麦克斯韦尔在 Final Word 播客中说道：“我想（我）有一个小小的希望，希望自己能够在 MCG 进行一场送别比赛。但我完全可以理解他们对这支 [T20] 球队的发展方向。

paras.en: "There's going to be a lot of change over the next 12 to 24 months with the Olympics coming up [in 2028], and they've got to make sure they get their eyeballs on a few young guys coming through, making sure they're getting exposed to international pressure."
paras.zh: “随着（2028 年）奥运会的临近，未来 12 到 24 个月将会发生很多变化，他们必须确保关注一些年轻人，确保他们能够承受国际压力。”

paras.en: Maxwell - who said he had considered trying to get ready for Australia's T20 series at home to England in late November, which includes a match in Melbourne - quit one-day international cricket in June of last year, the format in which he put in his most memorable performance during the 2023 World Cup.
paras.zh: 马克斯韦尔表示，他曾考虑为 11 月底在澳大利亚主场对阵英格兰的 T20 系列赛做好准备，其中包括在墨尔本举行的一场比赛。去年 6 月，他退出了一日国际板球比赛，这是他在 2023 年世界杯期间上演最令人难忘的表现的形式。

paras.en: He plundered a match-winning 201 not out from 128 balls against Afghanistan while battling injury as Australia recovered from 91-7 to reach a target of 292.
paras.zh: 在对阵阿富汗的比赛中，他在128球中打出201球制胜，同时还与伤病作斗争，而澳大利亚则从91胜7负的比分恢复到了292球的目标。

paras.en: Maxwell's 128-ball double hundred was the-then second-fastest in all ODIs, behind India star Ishan Kishan's 126-ball effort versus Bangladesh in 2022, but is now fourth.
paras.zh: 马克斯韦尔的 128 球双百成绩是当时所有 ODI 中第二快的，落后于印度球星伊尚·基尚 (Ishan Kishan) 2022 年对阵孟加拉国的 126 球，但现在排名第四。

paras.en: England white-ball captain Harry Brook smoked the quickest ODI double ton from 114 balls against Sri Lanka in October, after India's Shubman Gill had done so from 117 deliveries versus West Indies less than a month earlier.
paras.zh: 英格兰白球队长哈里·布鲁克在 10 月份对阵斯里兰卡的比赛中以 114 个球的成绩创造了最快的 ODI 双吨成绩，而不到一个月前，印度队的舒布曼·吉尔在对阵西印度群岛的比赛中以 117 个球的成绩创造了最快的 ODI 双吨成绩。

paras.en: Maxwell's heroics against Afghanistan three years ago came in a tournament in which he also hit the fastest 50-over World Cup century, from 40 deliveries against the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 马克斯韦尔在三年前对阵阿富汗的比赛中表现出色，当时他在对阵荷兰的比赛中打进了 40 球，创造了世界杯上最快的 50 球过百球纪录。

paras.en: The right-hander won the 2023 and 2015 50-over World Cups with Australia, while he also hit the winning runs as his nation claimed the T20 World Cup title in 2021.
paras.zh: 这位右投手随澳大利亚队赢得了 2023 年和 2015 年 50 杆以上世界杯冠军，同时他还在 2021 年帮助澳大利亚夺得 T20 世界杯冠军时打出了制胜分。

paras.en: Across 286 international matches (149 ODIs, 130 T20Is and seven Tests), Maxwell scored over 7,000 runs and took 136 wickets.
paras.zh: 在 286 场国际比赛中（149 场 ODI、130 场 T20Is 和 7 场测试），麦克斯韦尔得分超过 7,000 分，攻入 136 个三柱门。

paras.en: George Russell has posted a statement on social media to "speak from the heart" after his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday.
paras.zh: 在他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利周日夺得 F1 车手冠军后，乔治·拉塞尔在社交媒体上发表了一份“发自内心的言论”声明。

paras.en: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff revealed Russell was "distraught" in Mexico and went home after congratulating Antonelli on becoming world champion.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯老板托托·沃尔夫透露拉塞尔在墨西哥“心烦意乱”，并在祝贺安东内利成为世界冠军后回家了。

paras.en: The FIA gave Mercedes a €5,000 (£4,173) fine as Russell missed his mandatory media duties post-race, but the British driver has made his own first public comments on Monday.
paras.zh: 由于拉塞尔在赛后未能履行强制性媒体职责，国际汽联对梅赛德斯罚款 5,000 欧元（4,173 英镑），但这位英国车手在周一首次发表了公开评论。

paras.en: "Now feels like a pretty suitable moment to speak from the heart," he wrote on Instagram.
paras.zh: 他在 Instagram 上写道：“现在感觉是一个非常适合说出心声的时刻。”

paras.en: "This season started off exactly how I had hoped but it very quickly unravelled with tough luck and poor performances.
paras.zh: “这个赛季的开始正如我所希望的那样，但很快就因为运气不好和表现不佳而崩溃了。

paras.en: "It's been the first proper season of my career where I've had more bad days than good. Has it been tough to deal with? Yes, very. Has it been tough to pick myself up week in, week out? Yes, very. Confusion at times? Often. All I know is that I've given it my all and 2026 was not meant to be my year."
paras.zh: “这是我职业生涯第一个正常的赛季，糟糕的日子多于美好的日子。是不是很难应对？是的，非常困难。一周又一周让自己振作起来是不是很困难？是的，非常困难。有时会感到困惑？经常。我所知道的是，我已经全力以赴，而 2026 年并不适合我。”

paras.en: Russell began the season as the clear title favourite but has been comprehensively outperformed by Antonelli, who became F1's youngest ever world champion at the age of 20, with four rounds remaining.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔在本赛季开始时是明显的冠军热门，但在比赛还剩四轮比赛时，安东内利在 20 岁时成为 F1 有史以来最年轻的世界冠军，成为了 F1 历史上最年轻的世界冠军。

paras.en: Antonelli has won nine races compared to Russell's three and the latter has dropped to fourth in the Drivers' Championship after a power unit issue left him with sub-optimal power on the opening lap of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 安东内利赢得了九场比赛，而拉塞尔赢得了三场比赛，而后者在墨西哥城大奖赛第一圈的动力装置问题导致他的动力不佳，在车手锦标赛中跌至第四位。

paras.en: Russell continued: "I want to sincerely congratulate Kimi on what has been an absolutely incredible season. You truly deserve the Championship.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔继续说道：“我想真诚地祝贺基米度过了一个绝对令人难以置信的赛季。你确实值得获得冠军。

paras.en: "Thank you to the team for producing the best car and power unit this season; it's been inspiring to see everyone coming together over four tough years to bring Mercedes back to the top.
paras.zh: “感谢车队在本赛季生产出了最好的赛车和动力装置；看到每个人在艰难的四年里齐心协力，带领梅赛德斯重回巅峰，真是令人鼓舞。

paras.en: "Now, all I can promise is that for the rest of this season, and into the next one, I will be giving my absolute all to rediscover the performance I have been capable of producing for the majority of my career and fingers crossed a little bit of luck returns.
paras.zh: “现在，我能保证的是，在本赛季剩下的时间里，以及下一个赛季，我将尽我所能，重新发现我在职业生涯大部分时间里所能达到的表现，并祈祷能有一点运气回报。

articles.title: ‘Looks like Mars’: Toxic smog from Indonesia wildfires sparks health crisis, protests
articles.author: Tavleen Tarrant

paras.en: Almost every day for months, Indonesian schoolteacher Natanael Undas has gazed up at smoke-filled skies in apocalyptic shades of yellow and orange.
paras.zh: 几个月来，印度尼西亚教师纳塔内尔·乌达斯几乎每天都会抬头凝视充满烟雾的天空，呈现出末日般的黄色和橙色色调。

paras.en: “It looks like Mars, like we’re living on another planet,” said Undas, whose home in central Kalimantan province is at the heart of devastating wildfires generating toxic smog in Indonesia and across Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: “它看起来就像火星，就像我们生活在另一个星球上一样，”乌达斯说，他的家位于加里曼丹省中部，是印度尼西亚和东南亚各地产生有毒烟雾的毁灭性野火的中心。

paras.en: Although his family keeps the windows shut at all times, the noxious smoke penetrates the house anyway, sending Undas’ 2-year-old daughter into constant sneezing fits amid a spike in respiratory illnesses in haze-affected regions.
paras.zh: 尽管他的家人一直关着窗户，但有毒烟雾还是渗入了房子，导致乌达斯两岁的女儿在受雾霾影响的地区呼吸道疾病激增的情况下不断打喷嚏。

paras.en: Wildfires are nothing new in Indonesia, whose forests and peatlands are set ablaze each year as family and commercial farms clear land using traditional “slash and burn” methods. But the fires this year are far worse than usual, said Undas, who has been documenting Indonesia’s air quality on Instagram since 2014, as heat and drought aggravated by a “super” El Niño weather pattern make this the country’s worst fire season in over a decade.
paras.zh: 野火在印度尼西亚并不是什么新鲜事，由于家庭和商业农场使用传统的“刀耕火种”方法清理土地，该国的森林和泥炭地每年都会被点燃。但今年的火灾比往年严重得多，Undas 表示，自 2014 年以来，他一直在 Instagram 上记录印度尼西亚的空气质量，“超级”厄尔尼诺天气模式加剧了炎热和干旱，使今年成为该国十多年来最严重的火灾季节。

paras.en: The unrelenting haze from the fires has affected millions of people in the region since they started in July, closing schools in multiple countries and spurring arguments about who is to blame. Indonesian protesters have accused their government of insufficient action, while other countries are threatening prosecution.
paras.zh: 自7月份火灾开始以来，持续不断的烟雾影响了该地区数百万人，导致多个国家的学校关闭，并引发了关于谁应该受到指责的争论。印度尼西亚抗议者指责政府行动不足，而其他国家则威胁要起诉。

paras.en: On Wednesday, hundreds of Indonesian students and members of civil society groups protested in the capital, Jakarta, and other cities against the policies of President Prabowo Subianto, including his resistance to declaring the fires a national disaster.
paras.zh: 周三，数百名印度尼西亚学生和民间社会团体成员在首都雅加达和其他城市抗议总统普拉博沃·苏比安托的政策，包括他拒绝宣布火灾为国家灾难。

paras.en: “We want transparent and independent investigations about these wildfires,” protester Natasha Ruvantina told NBC News. “And also, we want a long-term prevention strategy.”
paras.zh: 抗议者 Natasha Ruvantina 告诉 NBC 新闻：“我们希望对这些野火进行透明和独立的调查。” “而且，我们需要一个长期的预防策略。”

paras.en: The Indonesian government said in a statement Wednesday that it recognized the students’ concerns, adding that it was prosecuting companies linked to the fires and sending aid to affected provinces.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚政府周三在一份声明中表示，它认识到学生们的担忧，并补充说，它正在起诉与火灾有关的公司，并向受影响的省份提供援助。

paras.en: The fires have also caused frustration in countries such as neighboring Singapore, where air pollution this month reached its highest level since 2015, when Indonesian wildfires were also intensified by El Niño. Singapore officials have threatened to prosecute companies seen as responsible for the devastation, and on Tuesday the foreign ministers of Singapore and Indonesia said they were considering a joint task force to combat illegal land burning.
paras.zh: 火灾还让邻国新加坡等国感到沮丧，本月新加坡的空气污染达到了2015年以来的最高水平，当时印度尼西亚的山火也因厄尔尼诺现象而加剧。新加坡官员威胁要起诉被认为对此次破坏负责的公司，新加坡和印度尼西亚外交部长周二表示，他们正在考虑成立联合工作组，打击非法烧毁土地的行为。

paras.en: “We will use the full force of the law to make sure those who profit from fire must answer for the fires,” Indonesian Foreign Minister Arrmanatha Nasir said.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚外交部长阿玛纳塔·纳西尔表示：“我们将充分利用法律的力量，确保那些从火灾中获利的人必须为火灾负责。”

paras.en: Indonesia’s neighbors and other countries have been accused of contributing to the problem.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚的邻国和其他国家被指责加剧了这一问题。

paras.en: In a report this month, the Indonesian environmental organization Walhi named 66 companies with links to Singapore and 27 companies with links to Malaysia that it said were associated with fire hot spots. On Thursday, the Indonesian government said police had identified 20 corporations suspected of being involved in the fires, including four from Singapore, Malaysia and South Korea.
paras.zh: 在本月的一份报告中，印度尼西亚环保组织 Walhi 点名了 66 家与新加坡有联系的公司和 27 家与马来西亚有联系的公司，称这些公司与火灾热点有关。周四，印度尼西亚政府表示，警方已确定 20 家涉嫌参与火灾的公司，其中 4 家来自新加坡、马来西亚和韩国。

paras.en: The Malaysian government has denied that any Malaysian companies are involved, while the government of Singapore did not respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 马来西亚政府否认有任何马来西亚公司参与其中，而新加坡政府则没有回应置评请求。

paras.en: Even as fingers are pointed across borders, the fires have been causing disruptions across the region, even threatening 67,000-year-old cave paintings on the Indonesian island of Sulawesi that are the oldest in the world.
paras.zh: 尽管人们的指责跨越国界，但大火仍在整个地区造成破坏，甚至威胁到印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛上拥有 67,000 年历史的洞穴壁画，这些壁画是世界上最古老的洞穴壁画。

paras.en: The haze also marred Singapore’s annual Formula One night race this month, obscuring the city’s iconic skyline during the globally watched event.
paras.zh: 本月的新加坡一年一度的一级方程式夜间比赛也受到雾霾影响，在这场全球瞩目的赛事期间，这座城市的标志性天际线变得模糊不清。

paras.en: “The biggest issue is a change in the quality of life,” Rajasekhar Balasubramanian, an engineering professor at the National University of Singapore, said of the haze.
paras.zh: “最大的问题是生活质量的变化，”新加坡国立大学工程学教授 Rajasekhar Balasubramanian 谈到雾霾时说道。

paras.en: “People who usually participate in outdoor activities, for example, doing some kind of physical exercise, cannot do it anymore,” he said.
paras.zh: “平时参加户外活动的人，比如做某种体育锻炼，现在已经做不到了，”他说。

paras.en: A Singapore-focused study published in September found that short-term increases in airborne fine particulate matter were associated with increased emergency department visits for asthma and other chronic respiratory illnesses. According to the study, spikes in such visits in 2016 and 2019 coincided with periods of haze caused by Indonesian wildfires.
paras.zh: 9月份发表的一项以新加坡为重点的研究发现，空气中细颗粒物的短期增加与哮喘和其他慢性呼吸道疾病急诊就诊的增加有关。研究显示，2016 年和 2019 年此类访问量的激增恰逢印度尼西亚野火造成的雾霾时期。

paras.en: In Indonesia, more than 283,000 cases of respiratory illness linked to the current fires had been reported in seven provinces as of Oct. 13, more than double the 113,000 cases reported as of Sept. 9, Reuters reported, citing Health Ministry data.
paras.zh: 据路透社援引卫生部数据报道，截至 10 月 13 日，印度尼西亚七个省报告了超过 283,000 例与当前火灾有关的呼吸道疾病病例，是截至 9 月 9 日报告的 113,000 例的两倍多。

paras.en: Adeline Tong, a civil engineer in Singapore, said that the recent haze had brought back her long-dormant asthma and that if she goes outside without an N95 mask, “I will feel like I need my inhaler.”
paras.zh: 新加坡土木工程师艾德琳·唐 (Adeline Tong) 表示，最近的雾霾让她休眠已久的哮喘又复发了，如果她不戴 N95 口罩就出门，“我会觉得我需要吸入器。”

paras.en: “Just two days ago, I could not even see the condo next to mine. It disappeared because the visibility was so bad,” she said in an interview on Oct. 21.
paras.zh: “就在两天前，我什至看不到我旁边的公寓。它消失了，因为能见度太差了，”她在10月21日接受采访时说。

paras.en: While Tong is able to work remotely, she said the haze has affected her social life, discouraging her from meeting friends at the outdoor food courts and hawker stalls that are ubiquitous in Singapore.
paras.zh: 虽然唐能够远程工作，但她说雾霾影响了她的社交生活，使她无法在新加坡随处可见的户外美食广场和小贩摊位与朋友见面。

paras.en: It has also affected her as a competitive ballroom dancer, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，这也影响了她作为一名竞技舞厅舞者的地位。

paras.en: “I usually would run outside to train, but now I can’t do that because the outside air will make me feel worse and the gyms are so crowded now because no one is outside,” she said.
paras.zh: “我通常会跑到外面训练，但现在我不能这样做，因为外面的空气会让我感觉更糟，而且健身房现在非常拥挤，因为外面没有人，”她说。

paras.en: For many others — including the scores of Indigenous tribes living in Borneo, an island divided among Indonesia, Malaysia and Brunei where the fires are concentrated — staying indoors isn’t an option.
paras.zh: 对于许多其他人来说，包括生活在婆罗洲的数十个土著部落，婆罗洲是一个分为印度尼西亚、马来西亚和文莱的岛屿，火灾集中在那里，呆在室内并不是一个选择。

paras.en: Molly Wang and Marianna Madun are Penans, a seminomadic, hunter-gatherer tribe indigenous to Sarawak, a Malaysian state in Borneo near the fires in Kalimantan, the Indonesian part of the island. They live in a village of around 150 people in Sarawak’s Baram region, where they weave baskets and bags for a living.
paras.zh: 莫莉·王（Molly Wang）和玛丽安娜·马敦（Marianna Madun）是本南人（Penans），这是一个半游牧、狩猎采集部落，原产于沙捞越州，沙捞越州是马来西亚婆罗洲的一个州，靠近印度尼西亚加里曼丹岛的大火。他们居住在砂拉越巴南地区一个约有 150 人的村庄，以编织篮子和袋子为生。

paras.en: Wang said the fires and smoke had sent animals running deeper into the jungle, making it harder for the community to hunt, while Madun said gathering food had been difficult because the smoke irritates her eyes.
paras.zh: 王说，火灾和烟雾使动物跑到丛林深处，使社区狩猎变得更加困难，而马顿说，收集食物很困难，因为烟雾刺激了她的眼睛。

paras.en: The community has also paused traditional slash-and-burn farming techniques to avoid adding more smoke to the air.
paras.zh: 该社区还暂停了传统的刀耕火种耕作技术，以避免向空气中添加更多烟雾。

paras.en: Wang said that while she doesn’t feel major health effects, older community members have been coughing and having trouble breathing; the closest clinic is an hour away by motorbike.
paras.zh: 王说，虽然她没有感受到重大的健康影响，但老年社区成员一直咳嗽和呼吸困难；最近的诊所距离摩托车一小时车程。

paras.en: Despite deploying thousands of personnel, Indonesia has struggled to quell the fires, which include vegetation fires above ground, as well as peat fires below.
paras.zh: 尽管部署了数千名人员，印度尼西亚仍在努力扑灭火灾，其中包括地上植被火灾以及地下泥炭火灾。

paras.en: Peat fires “are very difficult to put out and continue to smolder for ages,” Balasubramanian said. “So when you have ripe, dry conditions, a small little incident could ignite wildfires above the surface, and it’s very hard to control.”
paras.zh: 巴拉苏布拉马尼安说，泥炭火灾“很难扑灭，而且会持续闷烧很长时间”。 “因此，当条件成熟、干燥时，一个小小的事件就可能引发地表以上的野火，而且很难控制。”

paras.en: Though the fires are expected to continue into early November because of a delayed rainy season, smaller showers this week have brought some relief, with firefighters in Indonesia dancing in delight and residents across the region celebrating the first “blue sky” days in weeks.
paras.zh: 尽管由于雨季推迟，预计大火将持续到 11 月初，但本周较小的阵雨带来了一些缓解，印度尼西亚的消防队员高兴地跳舞，该地区的居民庆祝几周来的第一个“蓝天”。

articles.title: Fake alerts warn of nuclear danger as Ukraine and Russia report emergency app hacks
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Nuclear danger, radiation threat and street combat: Ukrainians received a wave of messages Sunday night that raised alarm with a series of grave — and baseless — warnings.
paras.zh: 核危险、辐射威胁和街头斗殴：周日晚上，乌克兰人收到了一波信息，其中包含一系列严重且毫无根据的警告，引发了警报。

paras.en: Authorities said the country’s emergency alert application had been targeted in a cyberattack, and hours later Russia said its own alert system had also been hacked. The dueling accusations came just as a rare humanitarian ceasefire between the two sides ended, raising fears of intensified fighting rather than a move toward broader peace.
paras.zh: 当局表示，该国的紧急警报应用程序已成为网络攻击的目标，几小时后，俄罗斯表示其自己的警报系统也遭到黑客攻击。这些相互对立的指控发生之际，双方之间罕见的人道主义停火刚刚结束，引发了人们对战斗加剧而不是走向更广泛和平的担忧。

paras.en: Residents in Ukraine have become used to the unsettling alerts that buzz their phones with news of incoming Russian missiles and drones — a service millions rely on to seek shelter before the attacks hit their cities. But the warnings Sunday night immediately stood out.
paras.zh: 乌克兰居民已经习惯了手机上传来的令人不安的警报，通报俄罗斯导弹和无人机来袭的消息——数百万人依靠这项服务在袭击袭击他们的城市之前寻求庇护。 But the warnings Sunday night immediately stood out.

paras.en: The messages, which began around 10:45 p.m. Kyiv time (3:45 p.m. ET), warned residents not to go outside because of radiation hazard, chemical threat and street fights.
paras.zh: 这些消息于晚上 10 点 45 分左右开始。基辅时间（美国东部时间下午 3:45），警告居民不要外出，因为存在辐射危害、化学威胁和街头斗殴。

paras.en: Another message professed, in Russian, that all of Ukraine was under nuclear alert. “Don’t worry,” it added. “Oreshnik is in action,” referring to Russia’s nuclear-capable hypersonic missile.
paras.zh: 另一条消息用俄语宣称，整个乌克兰都处于核戒备状态。 “别担心，”它补充道。 “奥列什尼克正在行动”，指的是俄罗斯的核弹头高超音速导弹。

paras.en: That message referenced a Telegram channel called Hitcorecorp. Major pro-Kremlin Telegram channel Mash said it spoke with the group and that it took responsibility for the hack. NBC News could not verify who the group is and whether it was responsible for the alerts.
paras.zh: 该消息引用了一个名为 Hitcorecorp 的 Telegram 频道。亲克里姆林宫的主要电报频道 Mash 表示已与该组织进行了交谈，并表示该组织对此次黑客攻击承担了责任。 NBC 新闻无法核实该组织是谁以及该组织是否对这些警报负责。

paras.en: Shortly after the alerts went out late Sunday, Ukraine’s air force said the country’s “Air Alert” app had likely been “compromised by the enemy,” confirming there was no “radiation threat” and urging calm.
paras.zh: 周日晚间警报发出后不久，乌克兰空军表示，该国的“空中警报”应用程序可能已“被敌人破坏”，确认不存在“辐射威胁”并敦促保持冷静。

paras.en: In separate statements, the app’s creators said “unauthorized third parties interfered with the operation of the app,” forcing them to temporarily suspend its operations. It later called the incident a “cyberattack,” saying it was gradually restoring the service. “The team is carrying out additional measures to protect the app in order to prevent similar situations in the future,” one of the statements said.
paras.zh: 该应用程序的创建者在另一份声明中表示，“未经授权的第三方干扰了该应用程序的运行”，迫使他们暂时中止其运行。该公司后来将该事件称为“网络攻击”，并表示正在逐步恢复服务。其中一份声明称：“该团队正在采取额外措施来保护该应用程序，以防止未来出现类似情况。”

paras.en: Ukrainian media reported that users across the country received the alert, and authorities in the western Lviv region reported that some of the public warning sirens and loudspeaker systems broadcast a “radiation hazard” signal.
paras.zh: 乌克兰媒体报道称，全国各地的用户都收到了警报，利沃夫西部地区当局报告称，一些公共警报器和扬声器系统广播了“辐射危险”信号。

paras.en: “I was outside with my dog when the first alert came,” said Olena Yermakova, 32, a researcher in Kyiv.
paras.zh: 基辅 32 岁的研究员奥莱娜·叶尔马科娃 (Olena Yermakova) 说：“第一个警报出现时，我正和我的狗在外面。”

paras.en: She picked up her dog and ran inside, she said, before checking the news to see what was happening.
paras.zh: 她说，她抱起狗跑了进去，然后查看新闻，看看发生了什么事。

paras.en: Because the message was in Russian, “I thought it was a hack by the Russians,” she said. “But the seconds before that were absolutely terrifying. I started running through a checklist in my head of what to do during a nuclear threat and whether I had all the supplies at home, and my hands started shaking.”
paras.zh: 因为这条信息是俄语的，“我认为这是俄罗斯人的黑客攻击，”她说。 “但在那之前的几秒钟绝对是可怕的。我开始在脑海中仔细检查核威胁期间该怎么做以及家里是否有所有补给品，然后我的手开始颤抖。”

paras.en: Still, many other Ukrainians did not appear unduly alarmed or panicked by the alerts. In fact, many shared memes online, poking fun at what they saw as a blatant fake, and the fact the warning was issued in Russian. “No one was particularly surprised,” one user wrote on X. “They might as well have thrown in a dinosaur attack, too.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，许多其他乌克兰人并没有对这些警报表现出过度的惊慌或惊慌。事实上，许多人在网上分享了表情包，嘲笑他们认为公然的假货，以及警告是用俄语发出的。 “没有人感到特别惊讶，”一位用户在 X 上写道，“他们也可能发起了恐龙袭击。”

paras.en: The state emergency service of Ukraine said Monday the national alert system was operating normally, and an NBC News producer in Kyiv did not experience any further issues with the “Air Alert” app.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家紧急服务部门周一表示，国家警报系统运行正常，基辅的 NBC 新闻制片人没有遇到“空中警报”应用程序出现任何进一步问题。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Russia’s emergencies ministry also said early Monday that its mobile application has suffered a “massive cyberattack,” resulting in what it said was “dissemination of fake information to the public.” The public alert system was restored and was operating normally, it said shortly after. It emphasized that the app was only “an additional, supplementary information service.”
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯紧急情况部周一早些时候还表示，其移动应用程序遭受了“大规模网络攻击”，导致“向公众传播虚假信息”。不久后，公共警报系统已恢复并正常运行。它强调该应用程序只是“一项额外的补充信息服务”。

paras.en: Screenshots shared by Russian media and some regional authorities suggested the alert, issued in Russian, warned of “nuclear warheads” launched at Russia. As with the Ukrainian alert, the wording was casual and did not appear official.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体和一些地区当局分享的屏幕截图显示，这一用俄语发出的警报警告称，有“核弹头”向俄罗斯发射。与乌克兰的警报一样，措辞很随意，看起来并不正式。

paras.en: Russian authorities did not say who was to blame for the alleged cyberattack, only saying “malicious actors” were behind it.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯当局没有透露谁应该为这起网络攻击负责，只是说幕后黑手是“恶意行为者”。

paras.en: It was not immediately clear whether the two incidents were linked.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这两起事件是否有关联。

paras.en: It came just hours after a temporary ceasefire between Kyiv and Moscow came to an end in the occupied southern Ukrainian region of Kherson.
paras.zh: 就在几小时前，基辅和莫斯科之间在被占领的乌克兰南部赫尔松地区的临时停火结束。

paras.en: The truce, brokered with involvement from first lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo XIV, held without violations from either side for six days, allowing the evacuation of hundreds of residents from the frontline town of Oleshky, which had been on the brink of a humanitarian catastrophe.
paras.zh: 在第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普和教皇利奥十四世的斡旋下，停火协议持续了六天，双方都没有违反协议，数百名居民得以从处于人道主义灾难边缘的前线城镇奥列什基撤离。

paras.en: The truce amounted to the biggest de-escalation between Kyiv and Moscow since the war started in early 2022.
paras.zh: 此次休战是基辅和莫斯科之间自 2022 年初战争爆发以来最大幅度的缓和局势。

paras.en: “On behalf of America, I commend Russia and Ukraine for their leadership and cooperation surrounding the Oleshky ceasefire,” Melania Trump said in a post on X on Sunday. “I hope Oleshky serves as a foundation for lasting peace between both nations.”
paras.zh: “我代表美国赞扬俄罗斯和乌克兰在奥列什基停火问题上的领导和合作，”梅拉尼娅·特朗普周日在 X 上发帖表示。 “我希望奥列什基成为两国之间持久和平的基础。”

paras.en: Ukraine’s ombudsman for human rights, Dmytro Lubinets, said he was exploring opportunities for “further humanitarian initiatives” with his Russian counterpart, Yana Lantratova, adding that it was “important to maintain this mechanism of cooperation.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰人权监察员德米特罗·鲁比内茨(Dmytro Lubinets)表示，他正在与俄罗斯人权监察员雅娜·兰特拉托娃(Yana Lantratova)探讨“进一步人道主义举措”的机会，并补充说“维持这种合作机制非常重要”。

paras.en: Before the truce took hold, the United Nations estimated that some 2,000 civilians remained in Oleshky, many experiencing hunger and unable to leave safely because of heavily mined roads.
paras.zh: 在停火协议生效之前，联合国估计约有 2,000 名平民仍留在奥列什基，其中许多人正在挨饿，而且由于道路布满地雷而无法安全离开。

paras.en: Neither side has disclosed the exact number of people evacuated, but the first lady said Sunday it was nearly 800. The evacuees could go into territory controlled by either Ukraine or Russia, or remain in the town, officials on both sides said.
paras.zh: 双方都没有透露撤离的确切人数，但第一夫人周日表示，撤离人数接近 800 人。双方官员均表示，撤离人员可能进入乌克兰或俄罗斯控制的地区，也可能留在该镇。

paras.en: Lantratova, the Russian human rights commissioner, said Monday that she had expected more people to evacuate from Oleshky, saying “quite a few empty buses” left the area. Many people chose to stay because they couldn’t leave elderly or sick loved ones, she said, or simply refused to leave their homes no matter what.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯人权专员兰特拉托娃周一表示，她预计会有更多人从奥列什基撤离，并称“相当多的空巴士”离开了该地区。她说，许多人选择留下来是因为他们无法离开年老或生病的亲人，或者干脆无论如何都拒绝离开自己的家。

paras.en: She said for those remaining, humanitarian aid deliveries would take place at least monthly, with the “coordination and mediation” of Melania Trump.
paras.zh: 她表示，对于剩下的人，人道主义援助将至少每月进行一次，并由梅拉尼娅·特朗普进行“协调和调解”。
