paras.en: Ukraine’s armed forces accused Russia on Monday of using the truce to rotate its units and fortify positions in the area. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said that Kyiv also could have used the ceasefire to regroup, calling it a “completely common practice in such situations.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰武装部队周一指责俄罗斯利用停战协议轮换部队并加固该地区的阵地。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，基辅也可以利用停火重新集结，称这是“在这种情况下完全常见的做法”。

articles.title: Supermarkets across Europe hit by new fridge cyberattacks
articles.author: Reuters

paras.en: Supermarkets across Europe were hit Monday by a new wave of apparent cyberattacks affecting fridges and freezers.
paras.zh: 周一，欧洲各地的超市遭受了新一波明显的网络攻击，影响了冰箱和冰柜。

paras.en: The incidents caused temperature spikes and spoiled food at stores in Sweden, the Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Luxembourg, and Estonia.
paras.zh: 这些事件导致瑞典、荷兰、比利时、爱尔兰、卢森堡和爱沙尼亚的商店温度升高和食品变质。

paras.en: It follows a cyberattack in France last month, in which police said hackers seized control of cooling units at hundreds of supermarkets, raising temperatures as high as 122 degrees Fahrenheit and causing fires and food losses.
paras.zh: 此前，法国上个月发生了一次网络攻击，警方表示，黑客控制了数百家超市的冷却装置，导致温度高达 122 华氏度，并造成火灾和食品损失。

paras.en: Authorities have not indicated who could have been behind the incidents. There were no claims of responsibility.
paras.zh: 当局尚未表明谁可能是这些事件的幕后黑手。没有人声称对此负责。

paras.en: The issues come as the continent confronts broader security fears stemming from Russia’s war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这些问题出现之际，欧洲大陆正面临俄罗斯乌克兰战争引发的更广泛的安全担忧。

paras.en: The new cyberattack highlights how digital threats can increasingly affect citizens’ everyday lives, the European Commission said Monday.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会周一表示，新的网络攻击凸显了数字威胁如何越来越多地影响公民的日常生活。

paras.en: The Ahold Delhaize supermarket chain in the Netherlands told NBC News on Monday that it was aware of an “IT incident” affecting the refrigeration systems in a number of its stores. “Our teams are working hard to fully assess the situation,” the company said in an email.
paras.zh: 荷兰 Ahold Delhaize 连锁超市周一告诉 NBC 新闻，该公司已获知发生了影响其多家商店制冷系统的“IT 事件”。该公司在一封电子邮件中表示：“我们的团队正在努力全面评估情况。”

paras.en: Stephan Moelans, the CEO of Belgian refrigeration company Sabcobel, which operates Delhaize’s systems, told the Belga news agency that the incident was a cyberattack, in which the units’ evaporators were switched to defrost mode.
paras.zh: 运营德尔海兹系统的比利时制冷公司 Sabcobel 的首席执行官斯蒂芬·莫兰斯 (Stephan Moelans) 告诉比利时通讯社，该事件是一次网络攻击，机组的蒸发器被切换到除霜模式。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Colruyt Group, which operates Spar stores in Belgium under a franchise system, said five shops had their fridge systems attacked. The Carrefour supermarket chain in the country said a “cyberattack targeting refrigeration installations only had an extremely limited impact,” affecting 15 of its more than 700 stores.
paras.zh: Colruyt 集团以特许经营方式在比利时经营 Spar 商店，其发言人表示，有 5 家商店的冰箱系统遭到攻击。该国连锁超市家乐福表示，“针对制冷装置的网络攻击影响极其有限”，影响了其 700 多家商店中的 15 家。

paras.en: Sweden’s grocery retailer chain ICA told NBC News its systems were not affected, but that it had been informed of “an incident at a small number of stores that use an external supplier and have their connectivity outside ICA’s central network.”
paras.zh: 瑞典杂货零售商连锁店 ICA 告诉 NBC 新闻，其系统没有受到影响，但已获悉“少数使用外部供应商且其连接位于 ICA 中央网络之外的商店发生了事件”。

paras.en: The incident has affected the stores’ refrigeration and freezer systems, the company said in an email. “ICA is currently supporting the affected stores in managing the incident,” it said.
paras.zh: 该公司在一封电子邮件中表示，该事件影响了商店的制冷和冷冻系统。 “ICA 目前正在支持受影响的商店处理这一事件，”它说。

paras.en: The ICA Kvantum branch in Sjöbo in southern Sweden wrote on its Facebook page that its fridges and freezers had been hacked and set to 122 degrees Fahrenheit. It said it was working to discard the affected items.
paras.zh: 瑞典南部 Sjöbo 的 ICA Kvantum 分公司在其 Facebook 页面上写道，其冰箱和冰柜遭到黑客攻击，温度被设置为 122 华氏度。该公司表示正在努力丢弃受影响的物品。

paras.en: Privately held grocery retail group Coop told Swedish daily Aftonbladet that six of its stores had been affected by similar incidents.
paras.zh: 私营杂货零售集团 Coop 告诉瑞典日报 Aftonbladet，其六家商店也受到类似事件的影响。

paras.en: In Ireland, food wholesaler Musgrave said that a cyber incident had affected refrigeration systems in 13 of its SuperValu stores, forcing it to remove some chilled and frozen products from sale.
paras.zh: 在爱尔兰，食品批发商 Musgrave 表示，一次网络事件影响了其 13 家 SuperValu 商店的制冷系统，迫使其下架了一些冷藏和冷冻产品。

paras.en: “Our monitoring systems alerted us to the issue and we took immediate action,” it said in a statement. “Our investigation is ongoing.” The company did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: 该公司在一份声明中表示：“我们的监控系统向我们发出了这个问题的警报，我们立即采取了行动。” “我们的调查正在进行中。”该公司没有立即回应 NBC 新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: In Estonia, a company that makes the affected technology said that one of its clients had been hit by a cyberattack in which attackers accessed a computer controlling refrigeration and also turned up the temperature to 122 degrees Fahrenheit, public broadcaster ERR reported.
paras.zh: 据公共广播公司 ERR 报道，在爱沙尼亚，一家生产受影响技术的公司表示，其一个客户遭到了网络攻击，攻击者访问了控制制冷的计算机，并将温度调至 122 华氏度。

paras.en: From refrigerators and heating systems to security cameras and alarm networks, an expanding range of devices can now be monitored and controlled remotely, creating new opportunities for cybercriminals.
paras.zh: 从冰箱和供暖系统到安全摄像头和报警网络，现在可以远程监控和控制越来越多的设备，为网络犯罪分子创造了新的机会。

paras.en: Sweden’s national cybersecurity center — which said it could not speculate on who was behind the attacks — is working on several incidents affecting grocery stores across the country, the head of the center, John Billow, said on Monday.
paras.zh: 瑞典国家网络安全中心负责人约翰·比洛 (John Billow) 周一表示，该中心正在调查影响全国杂货店的几起事件，该中心表示无法推测攻击的幕后黑手。

paras.en: “We have in recent weeks... identified that we have quite a lot of exposed operational technology devices in Sweden that we have been clear about the necessity to update or patch,” the cybersecurity center’s Billow said.
paras.zh: 网络安全中心的比洛表示：“最近几周，我们发现瑞典有相当多暴露的操作技术设备，我们已经明确需要更新或修补这些设备。”

articles.title: Rising costs approaching 'scary' levels for home owners
articles.author: Brianna Melville, Will Corbett, Amy Rossbach, and Rachel Jackson

paras.en: Staring down a likely Melbourne Cup Day interest rate rise, the rising cost of living is sitting front of mind for residents across regional Western Australia.
paras.zh: 考虑到墨尔本杯日利率可能上涨，生活成本的上升成为西澳大利亚地区居民最关心的问题。

paras.en: The Reserve Bank is expected to raise rates for the fifth time this year when it meets later today.
paras.zh: 预计储备银行将在今天晚些时候举行的会议上进行今年第五次加息。

paras.en: In Geraldton, 420 kilometres north of Perth, 27-year-old Liam Bristow bought a house six months ago and said his mortgage had already increased by $90 a fortnight.
paras.zh: 在珀斯以北 420 公里的杰拉尔顿 (Geraldton)，27 岁的利亚姆·布里斯托 (Liam Bristow) 六个月前买了一套房子，并表示他的抵押贷款每两周已经增加了 90 澳元。

paras.en: He says the added pressure has forced him to search for a housemate.
paras.zh: 他说，更大的压力迫使他寻找室友。

paras.en: Mr Bristow said he would be cutting some of the "fun stuff" from his spending, such as four-wheel driving and working on his car.
paras.zh: 布里斯托先生表示，他将从开支中削减一些“有趣的事情”，例如四轮驾驶和修车。

paras.en: "I can get by, but it is pay cheque to pay cheque," he said.
paras.zh: “我可以过得去，但这是工资支票到支票，”他说。

paras.en: "Since I've got the house, I haven't been able to put any savings away."
paras.zh: “自从有了房子，我就没办法存钱了。”

paras.en: Elsewhere in Geraldton, Roy Mckay is currently homeless and reliant on a $600 fortnightly payment from Centrelink.
paras.zh: 在杰拉尔顿的其他地方，罗伊·麦凯 (Roy Mckay) 目前无家可归，依靠 Centrelink 每两周发放的 600 美元生活费。

paras.en: "Fifty dollars is gone like that. You go and do some grocery shopping, you only get down half an isle and it's gone.
paras.zh: “50美元就这样消失了。你去买一些杂货，你只下了半个岛，它就消失了。

paras.en: "You just can't survive. You've got a car, you've got to pay for petrol, and that's gone up. Everything's just gone up."
paras.zh: “你就是无法生存。你有车，你必须支付汽油费，而汽油费却上涨了。一切都上涨了。”

paras.en: But the rate rises drew a different view from Laura and Gavin Anderson, who hope to move to Perth by the end of next year.
paras.zh: 但劳拉·安德森和加文·安德森对加息提出了不同的看法，他们希望在明年底搬到珀斯。

paras.en: "We don't own a house, so for us, we're actually quite happy that the interest rates are rising for now, but conscious that it's obviously not tenable," they said.
paras.zh: “我们没有房子，所以对我们来说，我们实际上很高兴目前利率上升，但意识到这显然是站不住脚的，”他们说。

paras.en: "We're also hoping that this interest rates actually pushes the price of property down, so that that puts us in a better position."
paras.zh: “我们还希望这种利率实际上会压低房地产价格，从而使我们处于更有利的地位。”

paras.en: Day to day spending has still been impacted for the couple who said they do not eat out at all and only go out for a coffee once a week.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇的日常支出仍然受到影响，他们说他们根本不出去吃饭，每周只出去喝一次咖啡。

paras.en: "When we first moved here two years ago, we'd come out for a coffee three times a week maybe," they said.
paras.zh: “两年前我们第一次搬到这里时，我们可能每周都会出去喝三次咖啡，”他们说。

paras.en: The further north in WA you go, the cost of everything rises, making any cost increase harder for locals to deal with.
paras.zh: 在西澳，越往北走，所有东西的成本都会上涨，这使得当地人更难以应对成本的增加。

paras.en: Connie and Aaron Curtis moved from Sydney with their young family to Wickham, about 1,550km north of Perth, two years ago.
paras.zh: 两年前，康妮·柯蒂斯 (Connie Curtis) 和亚伦·柯蒂斯 (Aaron Curtis) 带着他们年轻的家人从悉尼搬到了珀斯 (Perth) 以北约 1,550 公里处的威克姆 (Wickham)。

paras.en: Ms Curtis said they already felt the pressure of prices going up.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯女士表示，他们已经感受到了物价上涨的压力。

paras.en: "We feel as though we can't physically cut back on much else," she said.
paras.zh: “我们觉得好像我们无法在其他方面削减太多，”她说。

paras.en: "We cut our own hair, we cook everything from home."
paras.zh: “我们自己剪头发，我们在家做饭。”

paras.en: Ms Curtis said she does not expect the cost of living to improve any time soon.
paras.zh: 柯蒂斯女士表示，她预计生活成本不会很快改善。

paras.en: "I track our groceries every week and I notice when things go up even 50 cents an item, a dollar an item," she said.
paras.zh: “我每周都会跟踪我们的食品杂货，我注意到每件商品的价格甚至会上涨 50 美分，甚至每件商品 1 美元，”她说。

paras.en: Karratha retail worker Annie Duffy said she had a mortgage, so another rate rise was "scary".
paras.zh: 卡拉萨（Karratha）零售工人安妮·达菲（Annie Duffy）表示，她有抵押贷款，因此再次加息是“可怕的”。

paras.en: "It's not just the first time it's happened this year, it just keeps happening and happening."
paras.zh: “这不仅是今年第一次发生，而且还在不断发生。”

paras.en: Ms Duffy moved to the mining town from Tasmania earlier this year, and said the difference in cost between the two places was "astronomical".
paras.zh: 达菲女士今年早些时候从塔斯马尼亚搬到了这个矿业小镇，她表示两个地方的成本差异是“天文数字”。

paras.en: "They call it the Pilbara tax … everything is so much more expensive here."
paras.zh: “他们称之为皮尔巴拉税……这里的一切都贵得多。”

paras.en: Halimah Barnes works as a ranger in Broome, 2,000km north of Perth and has just turned 18.
paras.zh: 哈莉玛·巴恩斯 (Halimah Barnes) 在珀斯以北 2,000 公里处的布鲁姆 (Broome) 担任护林员，刚刚满 18 岁。

paras.en: She hopes to buy her own house in the future, but said affordable options in the tourist town were limited, and she was currently living with her parents to make ends meet.
paras.zh: 她希望将来能买自己的房子，但她表示，旅游小镇上负担得起的选择有限，她目前与父母住在一起以维持收支平衡。

paras.en: "I'm trying to work really hard just to save up, to be able to afford one," she said.
paras.zh: “我正在努力工作，只是为了存钱，以便能够买得起，”她说。

paras.en: "There's no way I'm going to be able to rent a house by myself."
paras.zh: “我一个人是不可能租到房子的。”

paras.en: At the opposite end of the state, Narrikup business owners Hayley and Dale Wyland said it felt like the goal of retirement keeps moving further away.
paras.zh: 在该州的另一端，Narrikup 企业主 Hayley 和 Dale Wyland 表示，感觉退休的目标越来越远。

paras.en: "We've just started a business three years ago and it's just harder and harder to make a living," Mr Wyland said.
paras.zh: “我们三年前刚刚开始创业，谋生越来越难，”怀兰先生说。

paras.en: "We aren't paying ourselves a wage because it's not doable. Getting a house, it's completely off the market for us. It's not going to happen."
paras.zh: “我们不给自己发工资，因为这是不可能的。买房子，对我们来说完全不在市场上。这不会发生。”

paras.en: Ms Wyland has little confidence in any relief.
paras.zh: 怀兰女士对任何缓解措施都没有信心。

paras.en: "It just feels like they [government] are moving the finish line," she said.
paras.zh: “感觉他们（政府）正在冲过终点线，”她说。

paras.en: "It's getting further and further away. It doesn't feel like it's going to happen."
paras.zh: “距离越来越远了，感觉不会发生了。”

articles.title: Trump describes midterms as 'most important in our lifetime'
articles.author: Riley Stuart and Kamin Gock

paras.en: Sitting US presidents have historically faced a backlash at the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 历史上，现任美国总统在中期选举中都面临过强烈反对。

paras.en: Donald Trump's approval ratings are particularly low right now.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普目前的支持率特别低。

paras.en: The elections will be held on Tuesday, local time.
paras.zh: 选举将于当地时间周二举行。

paras.en: Donald Trump has acknowledged his Republican Party is facing an uphill battle at the midterm elections this week, amid polling that suggests he could lose control of Congress.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普承认，他的共和党在本周的中期选举中面临着一场艰苦的战斗，民调显示他可能会失去对国会的控制权。

paras.en: In his final major campaign event before the elections, Mr Trump was quick to highlight the historical trend that the sitting president's party "doesn't win the midterms".
paras.zh: 在选举前的最后一次重大竞选活动中，特朗普很快强调了现任总统的政党“没有赢得中期选举”的历史趋势。

paras.en: "But we gave this a very strong shot," he said during a speech in Washington DC on Monday afternoon.
paras.zh: “但我们对此给予了很大的努力，”他周一下午在华盛顿特区的一次演讲中说道。

paras.en: He later described the votes that would take place on Tuesday, local time, as "the most important midterm, I believe, in our lifetime".
paras.zh: 他后来将当地时间周二举行的投票描述为“我相信，这是我们一生中最重要的中期选举”。

paras.en: "We have to keep our Congress strong and free," he said.
paras.zh: “我们必须保持我们的国会强大和自由，”他说。

paras.en: Analysts believe the GOP will be swamped in many House races, and while losing its Senate majority also remains a possibility, the contests in that chamber are considered more competitive.
paras.zh: 分析人士认为，共和党将在许多众议院竞选中陷入困境，尽管失去参议院多数席位的可能性仍然存在，但参议院的竞争被认为更具竞争力。

paras.en: Midterm elections are typically difficult for whichever party the president of the day represents.
paras.zh: 对于当天的总统代表哪个政党来说，中期选举通常都很困难。

paras.en: In all but three midterms since 1934, the president's party has lost House seats, although Senate trends are harder to predict.
paras.zh: 自 1934 年以来，除了三届中期选举外，总统所在的政党都失去了众议院席位，尽管参议院的趋势更难预测。

paras.en: Mr Trump's approval ratings have plummeted since he returned to the White House two years ago.
paras.zh: 自两年前重返白宫以来，特朗普的支持率直线下降。

paras.en: Polls suggest only about 37 per cent of Americans approve of Mr Trump, which would be the second-lowest rating heading into a midterm election of any US president since the end of World War II.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，只有约 37% 的美国人支持特朗普，这将是自二战结束以来美国中期选举中第二低的支持率。

paras.en: The Democrats need to retain all their Senate seats and flip four more if they are to seize control of the upper chamber of US politics on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 如果民主党想要在周二夺取美国政治上议院的控制权，他们就需要保留所有参议院席位，并再翻转四个席位。

paras.en: Mr Trump has spent the past few weeks trying to shore up support in states which he has typically been able to rely on for strong support over the past decade.
paras.zh: 过去几周，特朗普一直在努力巩固各州的支持，而在过去十年中，他通常能够依靠这些州获得强有力的支持。

paras.en: One of them is Texas, where the Democrats have not won a Senate seat for more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 其中之一是得克萨斯州，该州民主党已经 30 多年没有赢得参议院席位。

paras.en: However, many polls show the GOP candidate Ken Paxton trailing his Democrat rival James Talarico in the polls.
paras.zh: 然而，许多民意调查显示，共和党候选人肯·帕克斯顿(Ken Paxton)在民意调查中落后于他的民主党竞争对手詹姆斯·塔拉里科(James Talarico)。

paras.en: The city of San Antonio, in the state's south, normally leans blue, although those margins have been shrinking at recent elections.
paras.zh: 该州南部的圣安东尼奥市通常倾向于蓝色，尽管在最近的选举中这些优势一直在缩小。

paras.en: Local woman Debra Montelongo is planning to vote but has not decided who she will support.
paras.zh: 当地妇女黛布拉·蒙特隆戈计划投票，但尚未决定支持谁。

paras.en: "I've already done research. I've just pulled everything and printed it," she said.
paras.zh: “我已经做了研究。我刚刚把所有的东西都拿出来打印出来，”她说。

paras.en: "So today I'm going to go through and read through it all and then make my decision.
paras.zh: “所以今天我将仔细阅读并阅读所有内容，然后做出决定。

paras.en: "I think what is important is, of course, taxes and interest rates, gas. What's best for the people, not just what their platform is."
paras.zh: “我认为重要的是，当然，税收、利率、天然气。对人民来说最好的东西，而不仅仅是他们的平台是什么。”

paras.en: James Henson from the Texas Politics Project at the University of Texas has been following the trends closely. He described this Senate race as the most competitive statewide election in three decades.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学德克萨斯政治项目的詹姆斯·汉森一直在密切关注这一趋势。他将这次参议院竞选描述为三十年来竞争最激烈的全州选举。

paras.en: "The climate is very unusual," he said. "It's a climate in which Republicans are on their heels.
paras.zh: “气候非常不寻常，”他说。 “在这种氛围下，共和党人紧随其后。

paras.en: "And I don't think it makes sense to necessarily predict that the state is 'turning blue', as the phrase is here … but Republicans are having to put up much more of an active fight than they've had to in the past."
paras.zh: “我认为，正如这里所说的那样，预测该州正在‘变蓝’是没有意义的……但共和党人必须比过去更加积极地进行斗争。”

paras.en: Other tight Senate races are anticipated in Michigan, Alaska, Iowa, Kansas, Maine and Ohio. All but one of those seats are currently held by the Republicans.
paras.zh: 预计密歇根州、阿拉斯加州、爱荷华州、堪萨斯州、缅因州和俄亥俄州的参议院竞选也将激烈进行。目前，除了一个席位外，所有席位均由共和党占据。

articles.title: Supercells forecast for Queensland and NSW after overnight hail dump
articles.author: Ciara Jones

paras.en: Supercells forecast for Queensland and NSW after overnight hail dump
paras.zh: 夜间冰雹过后，昆士兰州和新南威尔士州出现超级单体预报

paras.en: A trough over southern inland Queensland has already triggered a line of severe storms.
paras.zh: 昆士兰南部内陆上空的低压槽已经引发了一系列严重风暴。

paras.en: The weather bureau says the atmosphere is still "highly unstable" after large hail hit parts of the Sunshine State overnight.
paras.zh: 气象局表示，大冰雹一夜之间袭击了阳光州部分地区，大气层仍然“高度不稳定”。

paras.en: Dangerous storms are forecast from south-east Queensland to north-east New South Wales.
paras.zh: 预计从昆士兰州东南部到新南威尔士州东北部将出现危险的风暴。

articles.title: Trump administration ramps up midterm battles, asks Supreme Court to intervene in California case

paras.en: Trump administration ramps up midterm battles, asks Supreme Court to intervene in California case
paras.zh: 特朗普政府加大中期斗争力度，要求最高法院介入加州案件

paras.en: Immigrants' rights group, data analysts say government's California list is riddled with errors
paras.zh: 移民权利组织、数据分析师称政府的加州名单充满错误

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump's Justice Department has shown a willingness to intervene directly in Tuesday's midterm elections before polls have closed, breaking with decades of practice meant to avoid the appearance that its law enforcement powers are being used in a partisan manner.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的司法部表示愿意在投票结束前直接干预周二的中期选举，这打破了数十年来旨在避免其执法权力被以党派方式使用的做法。

paras.en: In California, the Justice Department seeks to set aside mail-in ballots from about 20,000 voters it alleges are likely non-U.S. citizens ineligible to vote. The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court on Monday to temporarily block California from counting mail-in ballots from those voters.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，司法部试图搁置约 20,000 名选民的邮寄选票，据称这些选民可能是没有投票资格的非美国公民。特朗普政府周一要求最高法院暂时阻止加州清点这些选民邮寄的选票。

paras.en: It is one of two cases which underscore the department's willingness to intervene in election disputes before votes are counted. The cases have raised concerns among Democrats that, after polls close Tuesday, there will be an effort to sow doubt about the midterms, as Trump did with baseless claims of fraud following his 2020 election loss to Joe Biden, culminating in the Jan. 6, 2021 riot at the Capitol.
paras.zh: 这是强调该部门愿意在计票前干预选举争议的两个案例之一。这些案件引起了民主党人的担忧，他们担心，周二民意调查结束后，将会有人对中期选举产生怀疑，就像特朗普在 2020 年大选中输给乔·拜登后毫无根据地声称存在欺诈行为，最终导致 2021 年 1 月 6 日国会大厦骚乱一样。

paras.en: Voters enter the C. Blythe Andrews Jr. Public Library to cast their ballots on the final day of early voting for midterm elections in Tampa, Fla., on Sunday. (Octavio Jones/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周日，选民们进入小布莱斯·安德鲁斯公共图书馆，在佛罗里达州坦帕中期选举提前投票的最后一天投票。 （奥克塔维奥·琼斯/美联社）

paras.en: Outside groups aligned with Trump filed more than 60 lawsuits challenging his 2020 defeat, all of which were unsuccessful.
paras.zh: 与特朗普结盟的外部团体针对他 2020 年的失败提起了 60 多起诉讼，但均未成功。

paras.en: "The right-wing fringe outside groups are not going to have to do that this year because the [Justice Department] is clearly standing ready and willing to do it," said Elisabeth Frost, a voting rights lawyer with Elias Law Group, which frequently represents Democrats in court.
paras.zh: 经常在法庭上代表民主党人的埃利亚斯法律集团 (Elias Law Group) 的投票权律师伊丽莎白·弗罗斯特 (Elisabeth Frost) 表示：“外部右翼边缘团体今年不必这样做，因为[司法部]显然已做好准备并愿意这样做。”

paras.en: - Analysis Economic frustration set to boil over in midterm elections
paras.zh: - 分析 经济挫败感将在中期选举中爆发

paras.en: - Election denial has gone mainstream in the U.S. What does that mean for the midterms?
paras.zh: - 否认选举已成为美国主流。这对中期选举意味着什么？

paras.en: The House and Senate, which Republicans currently control by slim margins, could change hands if Democrats manage to pick up a net four seats in each chamber. All 435 House seats are up for election in the midterms, while only about one-third of the Senate's 100 seats are.
paras.zh: 目前共和党以微弱优势控制的参众两院，如果民主党能够在参众两院各净获得四个席位，那么众议院和参议院可能会易手。众议院全部 435 个席位都将在中期选举中进行选举，而参议院 100 个席位中只有大约三分之一进行选举。

paras.en: California, with 52 House of Representatives seats, can take weeks to count ballots and some of Tuesday's midterm races could be subjected to recounts and court challenges.
paras.zh: 拥有 52 个众议院席位的加州可能需要数周时间来计票，周二的部分中期选举可能会面临重新计票和法庭挑战。

paras.en: "Those within the recount or contest margin of error — the candidates, outside groups and the administration — will fight those tooth and nail," said Victoria Bassetti, senior adviser at States United Democracy Center, a non-profit group focused on protecting free, fair and secure elections.
paras.zh: 致力于保护自由、公平和安全选举的非营利组织美国联合民主中心的高级顾问维多利亚·巴塞蒂表示，“那些在重新计票或竞争误差范围内的人——候选人、外部团体和政府——将竭尽全力与之斗争。”

paras.en: Data analysts question government's list
paras.zh: 数据分析师质疑政府的清单

paras.en: The U.S. Constitution assigns the responsibility of administering elections to states, though the federal government has some oversight to protect against discriminatory and other illegal practices at the state and local level.
paras.zh: 美国宪法将管理选举的责任分配给各州，尽管联邦政府有一定的监督权，以防止州和地方层面的歧视和其他非法行为。

paras.en: In the California case, U.S. District Judge David Carter slammed the administration's efforts in denying its request on Oct. 28.
paras.zh: 在加州案件中，美国地区法官戴维·卡特 (David Carter) 猛烈抨击了政府 10 月 28 日拒绝其请求的做法。

paras.en: "Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the executive branch," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在美国历史上，联邦政府从未在选举前夕试图强迫州和地方政府放弃自己的宪法选举程序并屈服于行政部门的意愿。”

paras.en: The San Francisco-based 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals also refused on Friday to block the ballots.
paras.zh: 总部位于旧金山的美国第九巡回上诉法院周五也拒绝阻止投票。

paras.en: California has said that the state's safeguards against non-citizen voting are robust. As well, because the list originated from the Department of Homeland Security, state officials and immigrant rights groups fear it is being used as a pretext for contentious deportation efforts.
paras.zh: 加州表示，该州针对非公民投票的保障措施是强有力的。此外，由于该名单源自国土安全部，州官员和移民权利组织担心该名单被用作有争议的驱逐出境的借口。

paras.en: Multiple studies and state audits show that ineligible voting, including by non-citizens, is rare. When it occurs, it is disparate and not, to date, part of an organized effort that could sway a particular race.
paras.zh: 多项研究和国家审计表明，不合格投票（包括非公民投票）的情况很少见。当它发生时，它是不同的，而且到目前为止，还不是可能影响特定种族的有组织努力的一部分。

paras.en: An outside analysis of the list compiled by the Department of Justice has raised troubling questions. More than four in 10 names flagged as possible non-citizen voters in California by the Trump administration cannot be found on the state's voter rolls, said two data analysis members of UCLA's Voting Rights Project, who filed a lawsuit challenging it, along with the Los Angeles-based Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights (CHIRLA).
paras.zh: 对司法部编制的这份名单的外部分析提出了一些令人不安的问题。加州大学洛杉矶分校投票权项目的两名数据分析成员与总部位于洛杉矶的人道移民权利联盟 (CHIRLA) 一起提起诉讼对该项目提出质疑，他们表示，被特朗普政府标记为加州可能的非公民选民的名字中，超过十分之四的人无法在该州选民名册上找到。

paras.en: - Canadians caught up in Trump voter fraud crackdown as U.S. accuses Canada of election interference
paras.zh: - 美国指责加拿大干预选举，加拿大人陷入特朗普选民欺诈打击行动

paras.en: - 5 reasons why the Democrats might not take control of Congress in U.S. midterms
paras.zh: - 民主党可能无法在美国中期选举中控制国会的 5 个原因

paras.en: The research found that 8,880 of the names, representing 42 per cent of the entire list, do not correspond to anyone in California's current voter file.
paras.zh: 研究发现，其中 8,880 个名字（占整个名单的 42%）与加州当前选民档案中的任何人都不相符。

paras.en: "The expert analysis further makes clear that the mandated voter list endangers a significant number of eligible California voters," said the filing, which was cosigned by Xavier Becerra, the Democratic candidate for California governor and an adviser to the UCLA Voting Rights Project.
paras.zh: 该文件由加州州长民主党候选人、加州大学洛杉矶分校投票权项目顾问泽维尔·贝塞拉 (Xavier Becerra) 共同签署，文件称：“专家分析进一步表明，强制选民名单危及了大量合格的加州选民。”

paras.en: The analysis also found that thousands of U.S. citizens appear to be flagged as ineligible to vote on the government's list.
paras.zh: 分析还发现，数千名美国公民似乎被标记为没有资格在政府名单上投票。

paras.en: The administration has taken an increasingly aggressive approach toward how states run elections. The Justice Department has told election officials in all 50 states that they could face criminal prosecution if they knowingly allow non-citizens to remain on their rolls or cast ballots.
paras.zh: 政府对各州选举方式采取了越来越激进的态度。司法部已告诉所有 50 个州的选举官员，如果他们故意允许非公民留在名单上或投票，他们可能会面临刑事起诉。

paras.en: It has lost a series of lawsuits seeking to obtain voter rolls, including sensitive personal information, from dozens of states.
paras.zh: 它在一系列试图从数十个州获取选民名册（包括敏感个人信息）的诉讼中败诉。

paras.en: The Trump administration has also vowed to appeal a ruling in Alaska.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府还誓言将对阿拉斯加的裁决提出上诉。

paras.en: Alaska has become a particularly intense legal battleground after the New York Times reported that Democrat Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in recruiting retired teacher Daniel J. Sullivan to challenge Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉的竞选团队参与招募退休教师丹尼尔·J·沙利文来挑战共和党现任总统丹·沙利文后，阿拉斯加已成为一个特别激烈的法律战场。

paras.en: The Justice Department lawsuit, which Trump said he directed the department to file, asked a court to halt certification and order an investigation if the margin suggested voter confusion could have affected the outcome.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他指示司法部提起诉讼，如果比值表明选民的混乱可能影响了结果，则要求法院停止认证并下令进行调查。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Sharon Gleason, in Anchorage, dismissed the case on Sunday, finding Alaska could not conduct such a probe while preserving the secrecy of ballots.
paras.zh: 安克雷奇的美国地区法官莎伦·格里森周日驳回了此案，认为阿拉斯加无法在保持选票保密的同时进行此类调查。

paras.en: - Analysis Dirty tricks or much ado about nothing? Why Alaska, for once, is front and centre in midterms
paras.zh: - 分析 肮脏的伎俩还是无事生非？为什么阿拉斯加这一次在中期选举中名列前茅

paras.en: - Canada is in the U.S. midterm spotlight. Will the results be a blessing or a curse?
paras.zh: - 加拿大成为美国中期选举的焦点。结果是祝福还是诅咒？

paras.en: The lawsuit marks a rare federal intervention in the voting process and signalled a willingness by the administration to contest the election results in court.
paras.zh: 该诉讼标志着联邦对投票过程的罕见干预，并表明政府愿意在法庭上对选举结果提出质疑。

paras.en: Separate from the election result, the Justice Department has vowed to investigate whether any laws were broken in the effort that saw the politically inexperienced Dan Sullivan qualify for the ballot.
paras.zh: 除了选举结果之外，司法部还誓言要调查政治经验不足的丹·沙利文获得选举资格的努力是否违反了任何法律。

paras.en: The administration already sought to restrict voting by mail for this year's midterms — a mode of casting ballots used more often by Democratic-leaning voters — but the Supreme Court in September rebuffed that effort.
paras.zh: 政府已经试图限制今年中期选举的邮寄投票——这是倾向民主党的选民更常使用的一种投票方式——但最高法院在 9 月份拒绝了这一努力。

paras.en: According to an NBC News tracker, more than 24 million mail-in ballots have been cast so far, as of Monday.
paras.zh: 据 NBC 新闻跟踪报道，截至周一，迄今已投出超过 2400 万张邮寄选票。

paras.en: With files from CBC News and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自 CBC 新闻和美联社的文件

articles.title: U.S. records 1st human bird flu death since last year

paras.en: U.S. records 1st human bird flu death since last year
paras.zh: 美国记录去年以来首例人类禽流感死亡病例

paras.en: Washington state resident died after exposure related to infected dairy cattle
paras.zh: 华盛顿州居民因接触受感染的奶牛而死亡

paras.en: A person in Washington state has died from complications of the bird flu, the first such U.S. death in a year.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州一人死于禽流感并发症，这是美国一年内首例此类死亡病例。

paras.en: The Yakima County resident, who had previous health conditions, was exposed to avian influenza at a dairy with infected cattle and had been hospitalized, county health officials announced on Sunday.
paras.zh: 亚基马县卫生官员周日宣布，这名亚基马县居民此前曾有健康问题，在一家养有受感染牛的奶牛场接触了禽流感，现已住院治疗。

paras.en: Two other U.S. deaths have been tied to bird flu since it became a national public health concern in 2024. The first, announced in January 2025, was an elderly person in Louisiana who had a version of bird flu known as H5N1. The other, in Washington state, died in November 2025 from a rarer version called H5N5.
paras.zh: 自 2024 年禽流感成为全国公共卫生问题以来，美国另外两起死亡病例与禽流感有关。第一起死亡病例于 2025 年 1 月宣布，死亡病例是路易斯安那州的一名老人，他感染了一种名为 H5N1 的禽流感病毒。另一例位于华盛顿州，于 2025 年 11 月死于一种更为罕见的 H5N5 病毒。

paras.en: Yakima County officials did not release any additional details about the person who recently died. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) said the person was infected with H5N1.
paras.zh: 亚基马县官员没有透露有关最近死亡者的任何更多细节。美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 表示，该人感染了 H5N1 病毒。

paras.en: County officials have reported that 33 dairy herds have recently tested positive for H5N1.
paras.zh: 县官员报告称，最近有 33 个奶牛群的 H5N1 病毒检测结果呈阳性。

paras.en: They say three human infections have been linked to exposure at a dairy, and that the Yakima Health District is working with the state health department to find people who were in close contact with those people and monitor them for symptoms.
paras.zh: 他们表示，三起人类感染病例与一家乳品店的接触有关，亚基马卫生区正在与州卫生部门合作，寻找与这些人有密切接触的人，并监测他们的症状。

paras.en: - B.C. monitoring for avian flu amid rising reports of dying wild birds
paras.zh: - BC野生鸟类死亡报告不断增加，监测禽流感

paras.en: - Australia confirms first mass death of seabirds from H5N1 bird flu
paras.zh: - 澳大利亚确认首例海鸟因 H5N1 禽流感大规模死亡

paras.en: The H5N1 bird flu has been spreading widely among wild birds, poultry, cows and other animals for several years. Health concerns escalated in early 2024 when infections spread among U.S. livestock. Its presence in the environment increases the chances that people will be exposed and potentially catch it, officials have said.
paras.zh: 多年来，H5N1 禽流感已在野生鸟类、家禽、牛和其他动物中广泛传播。 2024 年初，当感染在美国牲畜中蔓延时，健康问题进一步升级。官员们表示，它在环境中的存在增加了人们接触和感染它的机会。

paras.en: More than 70 human infections have been reported in the U.S. since the beginning of 2024, according to the CDC. But there is no known person-to-person spread and the risk to the general public is low, the agency says.
paras.zh: 据 CDC 称，自 2024 年初以来，美国已报告了 70 多起人类感染病例。但该机构表示，目前尚无已知的人际传播情况，公众面临的风险很低。

paras.en: Officials continue to urge people who have contact with sick or dead birds to take precautions, including wearing respiratory and eye protection and gloves when handling poultry. People who work on farms are considered to be at higher risk.
paras.zh: 官员们继续敦促接触病禽或死禽的人们采取预防措施，包括在处理家禽时佩戴呼吸和眼睛防护装置以及手套。在农场工作的人被认为面临更高的风险。

articles.title: Snapchat reaches settlement in case after teens allege platform designed to be addictive

paras.en: Snapchat reaches settlement in case after teens allege platform designed to be addictive
paras.zh: 青少年指控 Snapchat 平台旨在让人上瘾后，Snapchat 达成和解

paras.en: Two teens brought forward lawsuit alleging addictive platform caused issues like depression
paras.zh: 两名青少年提起诉讼，指控成瘾平台导致抑郁等问题

paras.en: Snapchat parent Snap Inc. has reached a settlement during a trial over claims brought by two teenagers who say the company designed the platform to be addictive, causing their depression, anxiety and eating disorders, attorneys for the plaintiffs said on Monday.
paras.zh: 原告律师周一表示，Snapchat 母公司 Snap Inc. 在审判期间就两名青少年提出的索赔达成和解，两名青少年称该公司设计的平台会让人上瘾，导致他们抑郁、焦虑和饮食失调。

paras.en: Jury selection began last week for the trial, the second in Los Angeles state court over claims brought by young people who say they became addicted to social media after Snap, Meta Platforms, TikTok and Alphabet's YouTube designed their platforms to encourage compulsive use.
paras.zh: 该审判的陪审团遴选工作于上周开始，这是洛杉矶州法院针对年轻人提出的第二起诉讼，这些年轻人表示，在 Snap、Meta Platform、TikTok 和 Alphabet 旗下的 YouTube 设计了鼓励强迫使用的平台后，他们对社交媒体上瘾了。

paras.en: The plaintiffs had previously settled with Meta, TikTok and YouTube.
paras.zh: 原告此前已与 Meta、TikTok 和 YouTube 达成和解。

paras.en: "Our ultimate goal is to hold these social media companies accountable for how their actions have impacted millions of children across the country, and these settlements allow us to keep building toward that goal," John Morgan and Emily Jeffcott, trial attorneys for plaintiff K.D.B., said in a statement.
paras.zh: 原告 K.D.B. 的出庭律师约翰·摩根 (John Morgan) 和艾米丽·杰科特 (Emily Jeffcott) 在一份声明中表示：“我们的最终目标是让这些社交媒体公司对其行为影响全国数百万儿童负责，这些和解协议使我们能够继续朝着这一目标努力。”

paras.en: The trial was set to be the first for Snap in the sweeping litigation over social media's impact on teens, after the company settled the other cases that had been scheduled for trial. The company's chief executive, Evan Spiegel, had been expected to testify.
paras.zh: 在该公司解决了原定审判的其他案件之后，此次审判将是 Snap 在有关社交媒体对青少年影响的广泛诉讼中的首次审判。该公司首席执行官埃文·斯皮格尔预计将出庭作证。

paras.en: The case had been selected from thousands of pending lawsuits as a bellwether intended to test the claims against Snap and the other companies and potentially influence how similar cases are resolved. The next bellwether trials are scheduled to begin in March, according to the plaintiffs' lawyers.
paras.zh: 该案件是从数千起未决诉讼中选出的风向标，旨在检验针对 Snap 和其他公司的索赔，并可能影响类似案件的解决方式。据原告律师称，下一次领头羊审判定于三月开始。

paras.en: Companies like Snapchat have rejected claims that their platforms are designed to be addictive. The next bellweather trials over social media's impact on teens are expected to begin in March. (Dado Ruvic/Illustration/Reuters)
paras.zh: Snapchat 等公司否认了其平台旨在让人上瘾的说法。下一次关于社交媒体对青少年影响的风向标试验预计将于三月开始。 （达多·鲁维奇/图/路透社）

paras.en: A Snap spokesperson said in a statement that the company has built safeguards, launched safety tutorials and partnered with experts, and remains committed to "continually strengthening the safety, privacy, and well-being of our community."
paras.zh: Snap 发言人在一份声明中表示，该公司已经建立了保障措施，推出了安全教程并与专家合作，并将继续致力于“不断加强我们社区的安全、隐私和福祉”。

paras.en: Plaintiffs S.J., a 16-year-old girl from Illinois, and K.D.B., an 18-year-old from Mississippi, say they began using YouTube as early as age 3 and the other platforms around age 9, developing compulsive habits they blame on features such as autoplay and infinite scroll.
paras.zh: 原告 S.J.（来自伊利诺伊州的 16 岁女孩）和 K.D.B.（来自密西西比州的 18 岁女孩）表示，她们早在 3 岁时就开始使用 YouTube，并在 9 岁左右开始使用其他平台，养成了强迫性的习惯，她们将其归咎于自动播放和无限滚动等功能。

paras.en: The companies have rejected claims their platforms were designed to addict young people, and say they have taken action to make the apps safe places for young people to express themselves.
paras.zh: 这些公司否认了他们的平台旨在让年轻人上瘾的说法，并表示他们已采取行动，使这些应用程序成为年轻人表达自己的安全场所。

paras.en: Social media companies are facing thousands of lawsuits in federal and state courts brought by individuals, school districts, municipalities and other government entities alleging the companies knowingly sought to addict children to their platforms, contributing to a youth mental health crisis involving anxiety, depression and suicide.
paras.zh: 社交媒体公司面临着由个人、学区、市政府和其他政府实体向联邦和州法院提起的数千起诉讼，指控这些公司故意试图让儿童沉迷于其平台，从而导致青少年心理健康危机，包括焦虑、抑郁和自杀。

paras.en: Around 30 states have filed lawsuits against the companies, court records show.
paras.zh: 法庭记录显示，大约 30 个州已对这些公司提起诉讼。

paras.en: - TikTok settles landmark lawsuit over youth addiction claims
paras.zh: - TikTok 就青少年成瘾指控达成具有里程碑意义的诉讼

paras.en: - Kids and young adults are addicted to screens. New research argues it may be a public health concern
paras.zh: - 儿童和年轻人沉迷于屏幕。新研究认为这可能是一个公共卫生问题

paras.en: - How teen accounts on Instagram and Facebook are changing after Meta's $18B US settlement
paras.zh: - Meta 获得 18B 美元美国和解后，Instagram 和 Facebook 上的青少年账户发生了怎样的变化

paras.en: In the first case to go to trial, which ended in March, a Los Angeles jury found Meta and YouTube had been negligent and awarded a young woman $6 million US in damages.
paras.zh: 在 3 月份结束的第一起案件中，洛杉矶陪审团发现 Meta 和 YouTube 存在疏忽，并判给一名年轻女子 600 万美元的损害赔偿金。

paras.en: The next two teens whose cases were selected for trials either settled or dropped their claims against the companies.
paras.zh: 接下来的两名案件被选中进行审判的青少年要么达成和解，要么放弃对这些公司的索赔。

paras.en: The first school district chosen for trial settled with all of the companies.
paras.zh: 第一个试点的学区与所有公司达成了和解。

paras.en: Also in March, Meta lost both phases of a lawsuit brought by New Mexico, and was ordered to pay $375 million US after a jury found it had misled consumers about the safety of its platforms.
paras.zh: 同样是在 3 月份，Meta 在新墨西哥州提起的诉讼中败诉，并在陪审团发现 Meta 在其平台安全性方面误导消费者后被责令支付 3.75 亿美元。

paras.en: In August, Meta struck settlements worth up to $18 billion US with nearly every state and U.S. territory to resolve lawsuits brought by attorneys general over claims its platforms harmed teens and agreed to make changes to how Instagram and Facebook work for teens.
paras.zh: 8 月，Meta 与几乎所有州和美国领土达成了价值高达 180 亿美元的和解协议，以解决总检察长因其平台伤害青少年而提起的诉讼，并同意改变 Instagram 和 Facebook 对青少年的服务方式。

paras.en: The deal conditioned $5 billion US of the payout on the states reaching similar settlements with Snap, TikTok and YouTube.
paras.zh: 该协议的条件是各州必须与 Snap、TikTok 和 YouTube 达成类似的和解，才能支付 50 亿美元。

paras.en: Meta agreed for the next decade to restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to two hours a day, among other platform changes.
paras.zh: Meta 同意在未来十年内将青少年使用 Facebook 和 Instagram 的时间限制为每天两小时，以及其他平台变化。

paras.en: The lawsuits come amid a rise in legislation banning teenagers from using social media, such as an active ban in Australia and a proposed bill in Canada. Legal experts have raised red flags about this legislation, saying it may violate the Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
paras.zh: 这些诉讼发生之际，禁止青少年使用社交媒体的立法不断增多，例如澳大利亚的积极禁令和加拿大的一项拟议法案。法律专家对这项立法提出了警告，称其可能违反《权利和自由宪章》。

articles.title: Germany's chancellor called for Korean unity. Does Seoul want that?

paras.en: The story of South and North Korea — two nations that share history, language and much of their cultural heritage — sounds familiar to Germans.
paras.zh: 韩国和朝鲜这两个拥有共同历史、语言和大部分文化遗产的国家的故事对德国人来说听起来很熟悉。

paras.en: Their own country spent decades divided by opposing regimes until geopolitical winds shifted and allowed East and West Germany to reunite peacefully in 1991.
paras.zh: 他们自己的国家被对立政权分裂了数十年，直到地缘政治风向发生转变，东德和西德于 1991 年和平统一。

paras.en: Just two years later, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl visited the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) on the Korean Peninsula and expressed hope that South and North Korea would also be reunited by the end of the decade.
paras.zh: 仅仅两年后，德国总理赫尔穆特·科尔访问了朝鲜半岛的非军事区（DMZ），并表示希望韩国和朝鲜也能在本世纪末重新统一。

paras.en: That never materialized. Some 35 years since Germany achieved its dream of reunification, Seoul and Pyongyang are still bitterly divided by political systems, economy, and their geopolitical alliances.
paras.zh: 但这从未实现。德国实现统一梦想已有约 35 年，但首尔和平壤在政治制度、经济及其地缘政治联盟方面仍然存在严重分歧。

paras.en: Overlooking the DMZ, which separates the two Koreas, on Friday Chancellor Friedrich Merz could only repeat the hopes stated by Kohl in 1993.
paras.zh: 周五，俯瞰分隔朝韩两国的非军事区，德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨只能重复科尔在 1993 年提出的希望。

paras.en: "We Germans know how painful the division of a country is," Merz stated in a message shared on social media. "We also know that whoever stands firm in their values and has the courage for dialogue can tear down walls."
paras.zh: 默茨在社交媒体上分享的一条消息中表示：“我们德国人知道一个国家的分裂是多么痛苦。” “我们也知道，谁坚定自己的价值观，谁有勇气对话，谁就能推倒围墙。”

paras.en: "We wish the people in Korea unity in freedom," Merz said.
paras.zh: 默茨说：“我们希望韩国人民在自由中团结起来。”

paras.en: To analysts following the day-to-day inter-Korean politics, this sounds like a distant dream.
paras.zh: 对于关注日常朝韩政治的分析人士来说，这听起来像是一个遥远的梦想。

paras.en: Young Koreans ask 'why bother' with reunification
paras.zh: 韩国年轻人问“何必麻烦”统一

paras.en: As the Koreas continue to eye each other warily across the DMZ, their dramatic differences in wealth and political freedom are clearly on display.
paras.zh: 随着朝韩两国继续隔着非军事区警惕地注视着对方，他们在财富和政治自由方面的巨大差异清晰地展现出来。

paras.en: But the biggest single issue might be that neither side appears to want reunification.
paras.zh: 但最大的问题可能是双方似乎都不希望统一。

paras.en: "The feeling has changed in the last couple of decades," Choo Jae-woo, a professor of foreign policy at Kyung Hee University, told DW. "Younger South Koreans just see the North as another country that happens to be next to us, is poor and threatening, and they have no sentimental attachment to it, like older generations do."
paras.zh: 庆熙大学外交政策教授秋在宇 (Choo Jae-woo) 告诉德国之声：“这种感觉在过去几十年里发生了变化。” “年轻的韩国人只是将朝鲜视为恰好毗邻我们的另一个国家，贫穷且充满威胁，他们对朝鲜没有像老一辈人那样的感情依恋。”

paras.en: "More and more people are asking why they should bother about reunification," he said.
paras.zh: “越来越多的人在问为什么他们要为统一而烦恼，”他说。

paras.en: A study by Seoul National University's Institute for Peace and Unification Studies in September indicated that 39.1% of South Koreans believed reunification was impossible, the highest proportion since the survey was started some two decades ago.
paras.zh: 首尔国立大学和平与统一研究所9月份的一项研究表明，39.1%的韩国人认为统一是不可能的，这是自大约二十年前开始调查以来的最高比例。

paras.en: Many were concerned about the vast amounts of money that it would take to build the North's infrastructure, including roads, hospitals, schools and all other requirements for a modern functioning society.
paras.zh: 许多人担心建设朝鲜基础设施所需的巨额资金，包括道路、医院、学校以及现代社会运转所需的所有其他设施。

paras.en: Officially, South Korea's government has not abandoned reunification as a national objective. Its constitution still calls for peaceful union based on freedom and democracy, but Choo points out recent governments are promoting the idea far less frequently than in the past.
paras.zh: 韩国政府官方并未放弃统一这一国家目标。其宪法仍然呼吁建立基于自由和民主的和平联盟，但朱指出，最近几届政府推动这一想法的频率远低于过去。

paras.en: North Korea's clear signal against unity
paras.zh: 朝鲜明确发出反对团结的信号

paras.en: North Korea has not been nearly so reticent about where it stands on the matter.
paras.zh: 朝鲜在这个问题上的立场并没有那么沉默。

paras.en: "In December 2023, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un announced that the constitution was being changed and that peaceful reunification was no longer possible," Choo said. "Instead, South Korea would be seen as a hostile rival and that he no longer had any intention of bringing the two together."
paras.zh: “2023 年 12 月，朝鲜领导人金正恩宣布修改宪法，和平统一不再可能，”秋说。 “相反，韩国将被视为敌对对手，他不再有任何将两国结合在一起的意图。”

paras.en: The revised North Korean constitution was approved in March 2026 and Kim's regime has moved aggressively to scrub all references to reconciliation and national unity.
paras.zh: 修订后的朝鲜宪法于 2026 年 3 月获得批准，金氏政权已积极采取行动，删除所有有关和解与民族团结的内容。

paras.en: "I do not think the North can make it any clearer that it has no intention of getting any closer to South Korea," said Mason Richey, a professor of politics and international relations at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies in Seoul. He added that analysts, officials and ordinary Koreans in the South "roll their eyes" when the issue of Korean reunification crops up.
paras.zh: 首尔韩国外国语大学政治与国际关系教授梅森·里奇表示：“我认为朝鲜无法更明确地表明它无意与韩国走得更近。”他补充说，当朝鲜统一问题出现时，韩国的分析人士、官员和普通韩国人都会“翻白眼”。

paras.en: Beyond the lack of desire on both sides, there are a number of additional challenges that would need to be overcome, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，除了双方缺乏意愿之外，还需要克服许多额外的挑战。

paras.en: North Korea's regime wishes to protect its own power and prestige, which would inevitably be under threat if a democratic system were introduced for a unified nation.
paras.zh: 朝鲜政权希望保护自己的权力和威望，如果为一个统一的国家引入民主制度，其权力和威望将不可避免地受到威胁。

paras.en: Bridging the enormous gap in economic development would be a huge undertaking that would put immense pressure on the South, Richey said, even if outside assistance were forthcoming. And while a united Germany has been able to bring its regions to relatively comparable levels, it is worth noting that East Germany in 1990 was still substantially more developed than North Korea is today.
paras.zh: 里奇表示，缩小经济发展方面的巨大差距将是一项艰巨的任务，即使外部援助即将到来，也会给南方带来巨大压力。尽管统一的德国能够将其地区提升到相对可比较的水平，但值得注意的是，1990 年的东德仍然比今天的朝鲜发达得多。

paras.en: United Korea would pose major issues for US and China
paras.zh: 联合朝鲜将为美国和中国带来重大问题

paras.en: Professor Choo said reunification would not just be a domestic issue. The two nations have divided strategic and security loyalties, with the South allied to the US and the North tied to China and increasingly, Russia.
paras.zh: 朱教授表示，统一不仅仅是一个国内问题。两国在战略和安全忠诚度上存在分歧，南方与美国结盟，北方则与中国以及越来越多的俄罗斯结盟。

paras.en: "Those superpowers would not want to give up their ally for reunification as it would be a major strategic issue for them, as well," Choo said. "The US would not want a united Korea that leaned towards China, and Beijing would resist reunification if it meant the US could have its military on the Chinese border in what is presently North Korea. That's just impossible for either side to imagine."
paras.zh: “这些超级大国不想为了统一而放弃他们的盟友，因为这对他们来说也是一个重大战略问题，”朱说。 “美国不希望朝鲜出现一个偏向中国的统一，如果统一意味着美​​国可以在中国边境（即现在的朝鲜）部署军队，北京就会抵制统一。这对任何一方来说都是不可能想象的。”

paras.en: Ultimately, he said, the present status quo on the peninsula may be an imperfect solution, but it is the best way of preserving regional stability. A decade into the future, however, the economic, social and security situations may have radically altered — "and that is why we can never say never."
paras.zh: 他说，最终，半岛现状可能不是一个不完美的解决方案，但却是维护地区稳定的最佳途径。然而，未来十年，经济、社会和安全形势可能会发生根本性变化——“这就是为什么我们永远不能说永远”。

articles.title: What might Trump have planned for Iran following the midterm election?

paras.en: The US Republican Party is entering the midterm elections with Donald Trump's administration seemingly unable to either win or diplomatically resolve the Iran war. If the Republicans lose control of the US Congress, the administration will have to navigate an entirely different political landscape for the rest of Trump's second term, but the course of the war is not decided just in Washington — or in Tehran.
paras.zh: 美国共和党即将进入中期选举，唐纳德·特朗普政府似乎无法赢得伊朗战争，也无法通过外交手段解决伊朗战争。如果共和党失去对美国国会的控制，特朗普政府将不得不在特朗普第二任期的剩余时间内应对完全不同的政治格局，但战争的进程不仅仅由华盛顿或德黑兰决定。

paras.en: Seeking to identify key factors that could tip the balance towards war or peace in Iran, DW spoke with Omid Memarian of DAWN, a Washington-based think tank focused on reforming the US's Middle East policy; the Finland-based political scientist Leila Morovati; and Babak Rezaeedaryakenari, a professor of international relations at Leiden University in the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 为了找出可能使伊朗局势走向战争还是和平的关键因素，德国之声采访了 DAWN 的奥米德·梅马里安 (Omid Memarian)。DAWN 是一家总部位于华盛顿的智库，致力于改革美国的中东政策。芬兰政治学家莱拉·莫洛瓦蒂 (Leila Morovati)；以及荷兰莱顿大学国际关系学教授巴巴克·雷扎埃达亚肯纳里 (Babak Rezaeedaryakenari)。

paras.en: 1. US midterms: Is Trump set for more scrutiny?
paras.zh: 1. 美国中期选举：特朗普是否会受到更多审查？

paras.en: A Democratic victory would push Trump to focus more on domestic issues and would likely expose the financial costs of the war in the US Congress, Memarian told DW. However, Trump could continue limited strikes on Iran without formally declaring war.
paras.zh: 梅马里安告诉德国之声，民主党的胜利将促使特朗普更加关注国内问题，并可能在美国国会暴露战争的财务成本。然而，特朗普可以在不正式宣战的情况下继续对伊朗进行有限打击。

paras.en: Memarian said Trump would seek a way out that "saves face" after Tuesday's election.
paras.zh: 梅马里安表示，特朗普将在周二大选后寻求“保全面子”的出路。

paras.en: With Trump, Memarian said, Iran is engaged in a "big gamble with someone who does not behave like a conventional politician." This increases the risk of renewed attacks.
paras.zh: 梅马里安说，伊朗正在与特朗普进行一场“与一个行为方式不像传统政治家的人的豪赌”。这增加了再次遭受攻击的风险。

paras.en: Rezaeedaryakenari made a similar point: "The president has broad authority and freedom of action, especially in foreign policy and the conduct of military operations. A Republican defeat, even with increased pressure from Congress, doesn't necessarily stop new attacks."
paras.zh: 雷扎埃达亚肯纳里也提出了类似的观点：“总统拥有广泛的权力和行动自由，特别是在外交政策和军事行动方面。即使国会压力加大，共和党的失败也不一定会阻止新的袭击。”

paras.en: 2. Deadlock in Israel puts pressure on Netanyahu
paras.zh: 2、以色列僵局给内塔尼亚胡带来压力

paras.en: Israel's October 27 election ended in deadlock. Neither the coalition around incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, nor the camp supporting former IDF chief Gadi Eisenkot managed to secure an outright majority.
paras.zh: 以色列10月27日的选举陷入僵局。现任总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡周围的联盟和支持前以色列国防军司令加迪·艾森科特的阵营都未能获得绝对多数。

paras.en: Memarian said the political uncertainty could push Netanyahu to act on major decisions while he still wields power — making the transition period the "most fragile and dangerous" for renewed escalation.
paras.zh: 梅马里安表示，政治不确定性可能会促使内塔尼亚胡在仍掌握权力的情况下做出重大决定，从而使过渡期成为局势再次升级的“最脆弱和危险”的时期。

paras.en: A change of government in Israel would not fundamentally alter Israel's Iran policy, Memarian said. Netanyahu's main rival, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, "may be more deferential to America" and coordinate more closely with Washington. But ties with Trump are personal, and Eisenkot "certainly won't be like Netanyahu, who could sell any plan or scenario to Trump."
paras.zh: 梅马里安说，以色列政府的更迭不会从根本上改变以色列的伊朗政策。内塔尼亚胡的主要竞争对手、前军事首长加迪·艾森科特“可能会更加尊重美国”，并与华盛顿进行更密切的协调。但与特朗普的关系是私人的，艾森科特“当然不会像内塔尼亚胡那样，可以向特朗普兜售任何计划或方案”。

paras.en: Rezaeedaryakenari said Israel's security concerns about Iran "are not limited to Netanyahu himself." A new government could change the timing of a confrontation and coordination with Washington, but the security establishment and ruling coalition would also shape the risk of an attack, he said.
paras.zh: 雷扎伊达亚肯纳里表示，以色列对伊朗的安全担忧“不仅限于内塔尼亚胡本人”。他说，新政府可能会改变与华盛顿对抗和协调的时机，但安全机构和执政联盟也会影响袭击的风险。

paras.en: 3. Nuclear impasse: 'The ladder of tension'
paras.zh: 3. 核僵局：“紧张阶梯”

paras.en: Iran's nuclear program remains the biggest open issue between the governments, with the US rejecting the Iranian narrative that the program is meant only for civilian use.
paras.zh: 伊朗核计划仍然是两国政府之间最大的公开问题，美国拒绝接受伊朗关于该计划仅供民用的说法。

paras.en: But the two sides are also at odds on how the talks themselves should be set up, Memarian said.
paras.zh: 但梅马里安表示，双方在如何安排谈判方面也存在分歧。

paras.en: "The US wants negotiations to start not only with a focus on Iran's nuclear program, but with concessions right at the outset," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“美国希望谈判开始时不仅要关注伊朗核计划，而且要从一开始就做出让步。”

paras.en: Iran seeks the lifting of sanctions and the release of frozen assets before nuclear talks begin. If the sides don't move closer, Memarian warns, the odds of a renewed war rise.
paras.zh: 伊朗寻求在核谈判开始前解除制裁并释放冻结的资产。梅马里安警告说，如果双方不进一步靠近，重新爆发战争的可能性就会上升。

paras.en: Until the sides agree on an agenda, Memarian said, they are likely to keep "climbing the ladder of tension."
paras.zh: 梅马里安说，在双方就议程达成一致之前，他们可能会继续“攀登紧张局势”。

paras.en: Morovati, a Finland-based political analyst, said the nuclear program was "the crux" of the standoff. Iran's government sees it as a survival guarantee and bargaining chip, she said. In turn, Washington fears that a nuclear Iran would upend its security calculations and long-term strategy for the Middle East and beyond, which is why it insists on putting the issue on the table first.
paras.zh: 芬兰政治分析家莫洛瓦蒂表示，核计划是僵局的“症结所在”。她说，伊朗政府将其视为生存保障和讨价还价的筹码。反过来，华盛顿担心拥有核武器的伊朗会颠覆其在中东及​​其他地区的安全考虑和长期战略，这就是为什么它坚持首先将这个问题摆上桌面。

paras.en: 4. Strait of Hormuz: Is Iran's leverage also a risk factor?
paras.zh: 4、霍尔木兹海峡：伊朗的杠杆也是风险因素吗？

paras.en: Before the United States and Israel launched the war in late February, about 20% of the world's oil passed through the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has since drastically cut on the energy exports through the naval chokepoint, using at as leverage on US and Israel.
paras.zh: 在美国和以色列2月下旬发动战争之前，全球约20%的石油经过霍尔木兹海峡。此后，伊朗利用海军咽喉要道大幅削减能源出口，以此作为对美国和以色列的影响力。

paras.en: But, Memarian said, Iran's restrictions in the strait won't trigger escalation on their own.
paras.zh: 但是，梅马里安说，伊朗在该海峡的限制本身不会引发局势升级。

paras.en: Should US officials decide that a broader attack is needed to change Iran's calculations, any incident could serve as a pretext, Memarian said. If Washington considers the risks too high, it may opt for an economic blockade while keeping negotiations on the table. In that scenario, "even occasional tensions in the Strait of Hormuz won't pull America into war," according to the US-based analyst.
paras.zh: 梅马里安说，如果美国官员决定需要发动更广泛的袭击来改变伊朗的算计，任何事件都可以成为借口。如果华盛顿认为风险太高，它可能会选择经济封锁，同时保留谈判。这位驻美国的分析人士表示，在这种情况下，“即使霍尔木兹海峡偶尔出现紧张局势也不会将美国拖入战争”。

paras.en: 5. The Houthis in Yemen: Iran's allies, not subordinates
paras.zh: 5.也门胡塞武装：伊朗的盟友，而不是下属

paras.en: The Houthi rebels in Yemen have also been targeting energy exports on the Red Sea — including attacks on Saudi cities and infrastructure. But Memarian notes the Yemeni rebels' roots and struggle are "entirely domestic and organic" despite their ideological closeness to Tehran.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞叛乱分子还瞄准了红海的能源出口，包括对沙特城市和基础设施的袭击。但梅马里安指出，也门叛乱分子的根源和斗争“完全是国内的和有机的”，尽管他们在意识形态上与德黑兰很接近。

paras.en: Memarian said the Houthis made "pragmatic calculations" and their actions did not necessarily translate into an escalation between Iran and the United States.
paras.zh: 梅马里安表示，胡塞武装做出了“务实的计算”，他们的行动并不一定会导致伊朗和美国之间的局势升级。

paras.en: Still, the United States could use the rebels' action as a pretext to strike Iran again.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，美国仍可以利用叛军的行动作为再次打击伊朗的借口。

paras.en: Rezaeedaryakenari offered a slightly different assessment. Houthi attacks on shipping and on countries in the region, he says, "can both widen the war and accelerate coalition-building against the Islamic Republic." Countries that don't want war with Tehran "may turn to closer military cooperation to protect their trade and security." That doesn't necessarily mean entering the war directly, he adds, "but it could narrow the Islamic Republic's room for maneuver."
paras.zh: Rezaeedarakenar 的评估略有不同。他说，胡塞武装对航运和该地区国家的袭击“既可以扩大战争，也可以加速针对伊斯兰共和国的联盟建设”。不想与德黑兰发生战争的国家“可能会转向更密切的军事合作以保护其贸易和安全”。他补充道，这并不一定意味着直接参战，“但这可能会缩小伊斯兰共和国的回旋余地。”

paras.en: 6. Regional mediators: Four countries with a lot at stake
paras.zh: 6. 区域调解人：关系重大的四个国家

paras.en: With direct talks between the governments of Iran and the United States stalled, the world turned its attention to Qatar, Oman, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. While each nation plays a different role in the crisis, they all have a direct stake in ending the war.
paras.zh: 随着伊朗和美国政府之间的直接谈判陷入僵局，世界将注意力转向卡塔尔、阿曼、巴基斯坦和沙特阿拉伯。尽管每个国家在这场危机中扮演着不同的角色，但结束战争都与它们有着直接的利害关系。

paras.en: "They are close to the US, but also want to maintain ties with Iran and build regional alliances to prevent future conflicts," Memarian said.
paras.zh: 梅马里安说：“他们与美国关系密切，但也希望与伊朗保持关系并建立地区联盟，以防止未来发生冲突。”

paras.en: Morovati said the failure of the United States to support its Arab allies during the war could eventually push them to reconsider their policies and turn to the US's rivals.
paras.zh: 莫罗瓦蒂表示，美国在战争期间未能支持其阿拉伯盟友，最终可能会促使他们重新考虑政策并转向美国的竞争对手。

paras.en: 7. What will Trump administration do after the election?
paras.zh: 7. 大选后特朗普政府将做什么？

paras.en: During the campaign, Trump said he expected a deal with Iran soon after the midterm elections. Meanwhile, the Reuters news agency cited three senior Iranian officials and an additional source as saying that Tehran has deliberately prolonged talks to weaken Trump politically.
paras.zh: 特朗普在竞选期间表示，他预计中期选举后不久将与伊朗达成协议。与此同时，路透社援引三名伊朗高级官员和另一名消息人士的话说，德黑兰故意延长谈判，以在政治上削弱特朗普。

paras.en: Memarian said Iran's leaders believed that a Republican defeat would increase pressure on Trump to end the war. But Trump will remain the key foreign policy decision-maker, and congressional pressure is unlikely to play a deciding role.
paras.zh: 梅马里安表示，伊朗领导人认为共和党的失败将增加特朗普结束战争的压力。但特朗普仍将是关键的外交政策决策者，国会的压力不太可能发挥决定性作用。

paras.en: He said the present moment offers the "best opportunity" to end the standoff before Trump leaves office in January 2029.
paras.zh: 他表示，目前是在特朗普 2029 年 1 月卸任之前结束僵局的“最佳机会”。

paras.en: "Iran's leaders need to think about their endgame," Memarian said, warning that Trump could launch a massive attack, inflict serious damage and then declare victory.
paras.zh: 梅马里安说：“伊朗领导人需要考虑他们的结局。”他警告说，特朗普可能会发动大规模袭击，造成严重损害，然后宣布胜利。

paras.en: Rezaeedaryakenari said "escalatory factors" would have the upper hand in the coming months — and the likelihood of a military escalation is high.
paras.zh: 雷扎埃达亚肯纳里表示，“升级因素”将在未来几个月占据上风，而且军事升级的可能性很高。

paras.en: Iran's government can only avert a new round of war with a fundamental policy shift and concessions that the country's leaders would consider close to surrender. However, he said, such a retreat would also threaten the regime's survival by weakening its ideological justification and eroding support.
paras.zh: 伊朗政府只能通过根本性的政策转变和该国领导人认为接近投降的让步来避免新一轮战争。然而，他表示，这种撤退也会削弱政权的意识形态合理性并削弱支持，从而威胁到政权的生存。

paras.en: 8. Economic toll: Warring parties not at breaking point
paras.zh: 8. 经济损失：交战双方尚未达到崩溃边缘

paras.en: High oil prices, shipping risks and economic strain are putting pressure on all sides as the war enters its ninth month. Could that push Tehran, Washington and regional capitals toward compromise?
paras.zh: 随着战争进入第九个月，高油价、航运风险和经济压力给各方带来压力。这是否会促使德黑兰、华盛顿和地区首府达成妥协？

paras.en: "The economy is the Achilles' heel of every party to this war," Morovati said, "and that holds even for countries beyond the region."
paras.zh: 莫洛瓦蒂说：“经济是这场战争各方的致命弱点，甚至对于该地区以外的国家也是如此。”

paras.en: Energy prices as a source of pressure on the US government, Morovati said.
paras.zh: 莫洛瓦蒂表示，能源价格是美国政府面临的压力之一。

paras.en: "We've seen that energy supply and the expectations of the American public have been influential," Morovati said, "and this is one of the problems the Trump administration faces."
paras.zh: “我们已经看到能源供应和美国公众的期望具有影响力，”莫洛瓦蒂说，“这是特朗普政府面临的问题之一。”

paras.en: At the same time, Morovati said, Arab countries do not act as a united bloc toward Tehran.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫罗瓦蒂表示，阿拉伯国家在德黑兰问题上并不是一个统一的集团。

paras.en: "If they come under severe security and economic pressure, they may take joint action, but so far that hasn't happened in practice," Morovati said.
paras.zh: 莫洛瓦蒂说：“如果他们面临严峻的安全和经济压力，他们可能会采取联合行动，但到目前为止，这在实践中尚未发生。”

paras.en: Memarian also sees the economic costs as an incentive for a deal. But he also claims that each side believes that inflicting more pain on the other will strengthen its hand in future talks.
paras.zh: 梅玛丽安还将经济成本视为达成交易的动力。但他也声称，双方都认为给对方带来更多痛苦将在未来的谈判中增强自己的实力。

paras.en: "That can easily turn this into a war of attrition, and in recent months that has been the approach," Memarian said. Neither side has yet reached the point where it sees compromise as unavoidable.
paras.zh: 梅马里安说：“这很容易将其变成一场消耗战，最近几个月就是这种做法。”双方都还没有达到认为妥协不可避免的地步。

articles.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to block 20,000 California midterm ballots

paras.en: On the eve of the US midterm elections, the administration of President Donald Trump is making a last ditch attempt to sideline over 20,000 mail in ballots in California, claiming non-US citizens are attempting to vote.
paras.zh: 在美国中期选举前夕，唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府正在做出最后的努力，试图将加州超过 20,000 封的选票邮件搁置一边，声称非美国公民正在尝试投票。

paras.en: The US Justice Department (DoJ), which is run by Trump's former personal attorney Todd Blanche, claims to have a list documenting non-US citizens on California's voter rolls. In mid October, the federal government first filed a lawsuit based on the allegations.
paras.zh: 由特朗普前私人律师托德·布兰奇领导的美国司法部 (DoJ) 声称拥有一份记录加州选民名册上非美国公民的名单。 10月中旬，联邦政府首先根据这些指控提起诉讼。

paras.en: A district court judge rejected the DoJ request, warning that singling out ballots would "wreak havoc" on the election process and harm voters' trust in the democratic process.
paras.zh: 一名地区法院法官拒绝了司法部的请求，警告说单独选票会对选举过程“造成严重破坏”，并损害选民对民主进程的信任。

paras.en: "If the Executive can discount votes and threaten an ongoing election due to unproven allegations, then our democracy is in danger," wrote Los Angeles District Judge David Carter in rejecting the Trump administration's initial lawsuit in October.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶地区法官戴维·卡特 (David Carter) 在 10 月份驳回特朗普政府的初步诉讼时写道：“如果行政部门可以因未经证实的指控而打折选票并威胁正在进行的选举，那么我们的民主就处于危险之中。”

paras.en: In bringing its case to the Supreme Court on Monday, the DoJ asked for a "limited injunction" directing the state of California to "stop commingling suspected illegal ballots with legal ones" pending the verification of voters' status.
paras.zh: 在周一向最高法院提起诉讼时，美国司法部要求发布“有限禁令”，指示加利福尼亚州“在核实选民身份之前，停止将可疑的非法选票与合法选票混合在一起”。

paras.en: Early voting has been underway in California for several weeks, with hundreds of thousands of ballots already processed.
paras.zh: 加州的提前投票已经进行了几周，已有数十万张选票得到处理。

paras.en: It is unclear if the Supreme Court will respond in time for a ruling to have an effect on tomorrow's election.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚最高法院是否会及时做出回应，以使裁决对明天的选举产生影响。

paras.en: Analysis shows thousands of eligible voters on ballot blacklist
paras.zh: 分析显示数千名合格选民被列入选票黑名单

paras.en: The voter list had been compiled by the US Department of Homeland Security. In its response to the federal government's lawsuit, California defended its election integrity, and said the process used by the Trump administration to identify non-citizen voters was likely flawed and full of errors.
paras.zh: 选民名单由美国国土安全部编制。在对联邦政府诉讼的回应中，加州捍卫了其选举的公正性，并表示特朗普政府用于识别非公民选民的程序可能存在缺陷且充满错误。

paras.en: Last week, another federal judge ordered the DoJ to share its list with an immigrant rights group, and a voting rights watchdog based out of the University of California Los Angeles (UCLA).
paras.zh: 上周，另一位联邦法官命令司法部与移民权利组织和加州大学洛杉矶分校 (UCLA) 的投票权监管机构分享其名单。

paras.en: A legal filing of the analysis found that thousands of US citizens on the list appear to be inexplicably flagged as ineligible to vote. US District Judge Carter said people recently flagged as noncitizens on voter rolls in other states have repeatedly turned out to be naturalised US citizens.
paras.zh: 该分析的一份法律文件发现，名单上的数千名美国公民似乎被莫名其妙地标记为没有投票资格。美国地区法官卡特表示，最近在其他州的选民名册上被标记为非公民的人一再被证明是入籍的美国公民。

paras.en: Trump has made unfounded claims of election fraud for years, despite multiple investigations finding such malfeasance is exceedingly rare.
paras.zh: 特朗普多年来一直毫无根据地声称选举舞弊，尽管多项调查发现这种舞弊行为极为罕见。

paras.en: For the current midterm election cycle, Trump has zeroed in on claiming non US citizens are trying to vote, despite these claims being repeatedly debunked by research and investigation.
paras.zh: 在当前的中期选举周期中，特朗普将矛头指向非美国公民试图投票的说法，尽管这些说法一再被研究和调查揭穿。

paras.en: "Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the executive branch," US District Judge Carter wrote in October.
paras.zh: “在美国历史上，联邦政府从未在选举前夕试图强迫州和地方政府放弃自己的宪法选举程序并屈服于行政部门的意愿，”美国地区法官卡特在十月份写道。

paras.en: The most populous US state, California, leans heavily Democratic, and is not expected to be a competitive state for Trump's Republicans in the midterms.
paras.zh: 美国人口最多的州加利福尼亚州严重偏向民主党，预计在中期选举中不会成为特朗普领导的共和党的竞争州。

paras.en: California governor Gavin Newsom is an outspoken critic of Trump, and has warned the president's administration against trying to interfere in the state's voting process.
paras.zh: 加州州长加文·纽瑟姆直言不讳地批评特朗普，并警告总统政府不要试图干预该州的投票过程。

paras.en: Ahead of the midterm voting on Tuesday, Newsom announced the deployment of election law experts, poll observers and a help line for voters to report any attempts of intimidation or interference at the polls.
paras.zh: 在周二中期投票之前，纽瑟姆宣布部署选举法专家、民意调查观察员，并设立一条帮助热线，供选民举报任何恐吓或干扰投票的企图。

articles.title: US to suspend South Africa and Rwanda from duty-free trade access

paras.en: The United States has said it will suspend South Africa and Rwanda from duty-free trade benefits under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA), effective January 1, 2027.
paras.zh: 美国表示，将暂停南非和卢旺达根据《非洲增长与机会法案》(AGOA) 享受免税贸易优惠，该法案将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。

paras.en: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Monday that both countries had failed to meet AGOA’s eligibility criteria. South Africa has been the largest beneficiary of the programme, exporting about $1.7bn worth of goods to the US under AGOA in 2025.
paras.zh: 美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周一表示，两国均未能满足 AGOA 的资格标准。南非是该计划的最大受益者，到 2025 年根据 AGOA 向美国出口价值约 17 亿美元的商品。

paras.en: “President Trump found that the governments of Rwanda and South Africa are engaging in practices that are inconsistent with AGOA’s eligibility criteria,” Greer said in a statement.
paras.zh: 格里尔在一份声明中表示：“特朗普总统发现卢旺达和南非政府的做法不符合 AGOA 的资格标准。”

paras.en: There was no immediate response from either country.
paras.zh: 两国均未立即做出回应。

paras.en: AGOA beneficiaries are expected to meet eligibility requirements covering progress towards market-based economies, good governance and the elimination of barriers to US trade and investment, with Washington reviewing their eligibility annually.
paras.zh: AGOA 受益人预计将满足资格要求，包括市场经济进展、良好治理以及消除美国贸易和投资壁垒，华盛顿每年都会审查其资格。

paras.en: Washington highlighted trade barriers, rule of law and human rights as issues it is deeply concerned about in Rwanda, which was also suspended in 2018.
paras.zh: 华盛顿强调，卢旺达的贸易壁垒、法治和人权是其深切关注的问题，该项目也于 2018 年暂停。

paras.en: With regard to South Africa, Washington said it was concerned by barriers to US trade and investment, corruption and threats to US national security and foreign policy interests.
paras.zh: 关于南非，华盛顿表示对美国贸易和投资壁垒、腐败以及对美国国家安全和外交政策利益的威胁感到担忧。

paras.en: President Donald Trump’s administration has cracked down on South Africa for what Trump says is its persecution of white people. South Africa’s government says this is a falsehood spread by fringe groups.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府对南非进行了镇压，特朗普称南非迫害白人。南非政府表示，这是边缘团体散布的谎言。

paras.en: The US has also taken issue with South Africa’s foreign policy, in particular the genocide case it brought against Israel at the International Court of Justice. Israel denies genocide allegations.
paras.zh: 美国还对南非的外交政策提出了质疑，特别是南非向国际法院提起针对以色列的种族灭绝案件。以色列否认种族灭绝指控。

paras.en: South Africa’s Department of Trade, Industry and Competition said last week it was prepared for a negative outcome from the AGOA eligibility review and that it remained open to dialogue with the US. Exports under AGOA make up only about 10 percent of the country’s total exports to the US and 1 percent of its total global exports, it noted.
paras.zh: 南非贸易、工业和竞争部上周表示，已准备好应对 AGOA 资格审查的负面结果，并仍对与美国对话持开放态度。报告指出，AGOA 下的出口仅占该国对美国出口总额的 10% 左右，占全球出口总额的 1%。

paras.en: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa had also said in recent weeks that his country must prepare for being cut out of the programme, and that it was already seeking new markets and signing new trade deals with other partners such as China.
paras.zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨最近几周也表示，南非必须为被排除在该计划之外做好准备，并且已经在寻求新市场并与中国等其他伙伴签署新的贸易协议。

paras.en: South Africa’s main exports to the US include precious stones and metals, motor vehicles, iron and steel. Its exports under AGOA are mainly motor vehicles and parts, as well as farm products and wine.
paras.zh: 南非对美国的主要出口包括宝石和金属、汽车、钢铁。 AGOA下的出口主要是汽车和零部件，以及农产品和葡萄酒。

paras.en: Rwanda’s main exports to the United States include coffee, tea and minerals.
paras.zh: 卢旺达对美国的主要出口包括咖啡、茶叶和矿产。

articles.title: What’s the future of the Western Sahara conflict?

paras.en: The United Nations ends its peacekeeping mission in the disputed territory.
paras.zh: 联合国结束在争议领土的维和任务。

paras.en: It’s one of Africa’s longest-running conflicts.
paras.zh: 这是非洲持续时间最长的冲突之一。

paras.en: The dispute over the territory of Western Sahara started more than 50 years ago. It began with the end of Spanish colonial rule in the region.
paras.zh: 西撒哈拉领土争端始于50多年前。它始于西班牙对该地区殖民统治的结束。

paras.en: Since then, both Morocco and the Polisario Front have claimed the Western Sahara.
paras.zh: 此后，摩洛哥和波利萨里奥阵线都声称对西撒哈拉拥有主权。

paras.en: In the 1990s, the United Nations tried to reach a settlement, and deployed a peacekeeping mission to the region.
paras.zh: 20世纪90年代，联合国试图达成解决方案，并向该地区派遣了维和特派团。

paras.en: Last week, that effort ended when Russia and the United States blocked proposals to extend the mission’s mandate.
paras.zh: 上周，由于俄罗斯和美国阻止了延长任务授权的提议，这一努力结束了。

paras.en: So, could this development lead to renewed fighting?
paras.zh: 那么，这一事态发展是否会导致新一轮战斗？

paras.en: Samir Bennis – Political analyst and author of the book The Self-Determination Delusion: How Activist Scholars and Journalists Have Hijacked the Western Sahara Case
paras.zh: 萨米尔·本尼斯 (Samir Bennis) – 政治分析师和《自决错觉：活动学者和记者如何劫持西撒哈拉案件》一书的作者

paras.en: Irene Fernandez-Molina – Senior lecturer in International Relations at the University of Exeter in the United Kingdom and author of the book Moroccan Foreign Policy under Mohammed VI, 1999-2014
paras.zh: 艾琳·费尔南德斯-莫利纳 – 英国埃克塞特大学国际关系高级讲师，《穆罕默德六世领导下的摩洛哥外交政策》一书的作者，1999-2014 年

paras.en: Mahjoub Mleiha – Advocacy head of Collective of Sahrawi Human Rights Defenders (CODESA)
paras.zh: Mahjoub Mleiha – 撒哈拉人权捍卫者集体 (CODESA) 宣传负责人

articles.title: Mamdani’s progressive allies vie for seats in Congress

paras.en: In June, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani stood before a packed house of voters, rallying support for a new wave of candidates hoping to build on his progressive momentum by winning seats in Congress.
paras.zh: 6 月，纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 站在拥挤的选民面前，为新一波候选人争取支持，希望通过赢得国会席位来巩固他的进步势头。

paras.en: Inside Brooklyn’s historic Kings Theatre, the crowd answered chants of “Abolish ICE”, “Tax the rich” and “Free Palestine” with roaring applause, leaving little if any room for doubt about what the audience wanted from its politicians.
paras.zh: 在布鲁克林历史悠久的国王剧院内，人群以热烈的掌声回应“废除 ICE”、“向富人征税”和“自由巴勒斯坦”的口号，几乎没有任何余地怀疑观众对政客的期望。

paras.en: Within days, all three congressional hopefuls endorsed by Mamdani – Claire Valdez, Brad Lander and Darializa Avila Chevalier – had won their Democratic primaries, becoming the party’s candidates in the midterm election.
paras.zh: 几天之内，马姆达尼支持的三名国会候选人——克莱尔·瓦尔迪兹、布拉德·兰德和达里亚丽莎·阿维拉·谢瓦利埃——都赢得了民主党初选，成为该党中期选举的候选人。

paras.en: Lander, the former New York City comptroller, defeated Congressman Dan Goldman in a race in which Israel was the defining issue.
paras.zh: 前纽约市审计长兰德在一场以以色列为决定性问题的竞选中击败了国会议员丹·戈德曼。

paras.en: Avila Chevalier, a community organiser, unseated longtime Congressman Adriano Espaillat. Valdez, a lawmaker in the New York State Assembly and member of Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), won the contest to succeed retiring Congresswoman Nydia Velazquez.
paras.zh: 社区组织者阿维拉·谢瓦利埃 (Avila Chevalier) 罢免了长期担任国会议员的阿德里亚诺·埃斯佩拉 (Adriano Espaillat)。纽约州议会议员、美国民主社会主义者 (DSA) 成员瓦尔迪兹赢得了接替退休国会女议员尼迪亚·贝拉斯克斯 (Nydia Velazquez) 的竞选。

paras.en: Both Valdez and Avila Chevalier had the backing of New York City’s DSA chapter.
paras.zh: 瓦尔迪兹和阿维拉·谢瓦利埃都得到了纽约市 DSA 分会的支持。

paras.en: The candidates’ heavily Democratic districts mean they are likely to win congressional seats in Tuesday’s midterm elections. The June Democratic Party primaries effectively served as the main event for voters.
paras.zh: 候选人的民主党选区占多数，这意味着他们很可能在周二的中期选举中赢得国会席位。六月的民主党初选实际上是选民的主要活动。

paras.en: In the final hours before Tuesday’s midterm election, New York City – a place colloquially dubbed the city that never sleeps – is more politically sleepy, with canvassers a bit harder to find than they were in the final stretch before the primaries.
paras.zh: 在周二中期选举前的最后几个小时，纽约市（俗称不夜城）在政治上更加沉睡，拉票员比初选前的最后阶段更难找到。

paras.en: For the three progressive candidates, the past few months have been a test of how to turn bold campaign promises into policy they can actually deliver. The often slow minutiae of daily governance stand in stark contrast to buzzword-laden campaign slogans on the posters and signs galvanising their base of voters.
paras.zh: 对于三位进步候选人来说，过去几个月是对如何将大胆的竞选承诺转化为他们实际可以兑现的政策的考验。日常治理中往往缓慢的细节与海报和标语上充满流行语的竞选口号形成鲜明对比，以激励选民。

paras.en: The three congressional candidates’ platforms overlap on issues like abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), ending US military aid to Israel and establishing a public healthcare system dubbed Medicare for All. But their paths into progressive politics differ.
paras.zh: 三位国会候选人的政纲在废除移民和海关执法局（ICE）、结束美国对以色列的军事援助以及建立名为“全民医疗保险”的公共医疗体系等问题上有重叠。但他们进入进步政治的道路不同。

paras.en: Lander spent years in the New York City government, most recently as comptroller overseeing the city’s finances. After losing to Mamdani in the 2025 Democratic mayoral primary, he backed Mamdani in the election.
paras.zh: 兰德在纽约市政府工作了多年，最近担任审计长，负责监督该市的财务。在 2025 年民主党市长初选中输给马姆达尼后，他在选举中支持马姆达尼。

paras.en: But Lander’s congressional campaign against incumbent Goldman brought him national attention, with Israel and Palestine emerging as the defining issue in the race to lead a district with one of the largest Jewish populations in the United States.
paras.zh: 但兰德在国会针对现任高盛的竞选活动引起了全国的关注，以色列和巴勒斯坦问题成为领导这个美国犹太人口最多的地区之一的竞选的决定性问题。

paras.en: Lander has described Israel’s military campaign in Gaza as genocide and its occupation of Palestinian territory as apartheid. He also identifies as a Zionist who embraces pro-Palestinian activism, arguing that the positions are not mutually exclusive. Lander has long supported a two-state solution.
paras.zh: 兰德将以色列在加沙的军事行动描述为种族灭绝，将以色列对巴勒斯坦领土的占领描述为种族隔离。他还认为自己是一名拥护亲巴勒斯坦激进主义的犹太复国主义者，并认为这些立场并不相互排斥。兰德长期以来一直支持两国解决方案。

paras.en: “It’s straightforward that some approach to more shared safety for Israelis and Palestinians and for Jews and Muslims and everybody else here makes more sense,” Lander said. “I also want to be able to listen across those divides and have thoughtful policy debates.”
paras.zh: 兰德说：“很明显，为以色列人和巴勒斯坦人、犹太人和穆斯林以及这里的其他人提供更多共同安全的某种方法更有意义。” “我还希望能够跨越这些分歧倾听并进行深思熟虑的政策辩论。”

paras.en: Two weeks before Tuesday’s election, Israeli forces detained Lander in the occupied West Bank while he was volunteering to help with the olive harvest. Israeli authorities have since revoked his travel documents for a planned return visit.
paras.zh: 周二选举前两周，以色列军队在被占领的约旦河西岸拘留了兰德，当时他正在自愿帮助收获橄榄。此后，以色列当局吊销了他计划回访的旅行证件。

paras.en: “The main story I come home with is not the story of my detention or the revocation of my travel authorisation,” Lander said. “The main story that I come with is the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in the West Bank, which I just saw with my own eyes.”
paras.zh: “我回家时听到的主要故事不是我被拘留或旅行授权被撤销的故事，”兰德说。 “我带来的主要故事是西岸巴勒斯坦人的种族清洗，这是我亲眼所见的。”

paras.en: Lander has also long called for ICE to be abolished, including during President Donald Trump’s first term in office.
paras.zh: 兰德长期以来一直呼吁废除 ICE，包括在唐纳德·特朗普总统的第一个任期内。

paras.en: Avila Chevalier’s political rise was similarly shaped by immigration and Palestinian rights, though she has taken a more uncompromising approach.
paras.zh: 阿维拉·谢瓦利埃的政治崛起同样受到移民和巴勒斯坦权利的影响，尽管她采取了更加不妥协的态度。

paras.en: After interning at a youth organisation in Nablus in the occupied West Bank in 2014, she returned to the US and became an advocate for Palestinian communities.
paras.zh: 2014 年，她在被占领的约旦河西岸纳布卢斯的一个青年组织实习后，返回美国，成为巴勒斯坦社区的倡导者。

paras.en: Her “Babies Not Bombs” platform calls for redirecting military spending, including aid to Israel, towards domestic priorities such as childcare and healthcare.
paras.zh: 她的“婴儿不是炸弹”纲领呼吁重新调整军费开支，包括对以色列的援助，转向儿童保育和医疗保健等国内优先事项。

paras.en: “It’s important for us to see our budgets as moral documents,” Avila Chevalier told Al Jazeera. “Our resources should be going towards the things that make our lives dignified and make our communities thrive – not towards war, not towards ICE or things that are harming our communities.”
paras.zh: “对我们来说，将预算视为道德文件很重要，”阿维拉·谢瓦利埃告诉半岛电视台。 “我们的资源应该用于让我们的生活有尊严、让我们的社区繁荣发展的事情上——而不是战争、ICE 或伤害我们社区的事情。”

paras.en: Valdez, meanwhile, came to progressive politics through the labour movement. A former union-organiser-turned-state-assemblymember, she supports stronger labour protections, including federal legislation such as the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act to make union organising easier.
paras.zh: 与此同时，瓦尔迪兹通过劳工运动走向了进步政治。她曾是工会组织者，后来成为州议员，她支持加强劳工保护，包括《保护组织权 (PRO) 法案》等联邦立法，以使工会组织更容易。

paras.en: Valdez also backs national rent control and a government-run healthcare system to provide wider healthcare access than the country’s private-sector insurance model.
paras.zh: 瓦尔迪兹还支持国家租金管制和政府运营的医疗保健系统，以提供比该国私营部门保险模式更广泛的医疗保健服务。

paras.en: “Public programmes and entitlements have been under attack by the right,” Valdez told Al Jazeera as she exited a polling location in her district on the first day of early voting. “I think not just clawing those back but really advancing a vision for what those things should be will be top priorities.”
paras.zh: “公共计划和权利受到了右翼的攻击，”提前投票第一天，瓦尔迪兹离开所在地区的投票站时告诉半岛电视台。 “我认为，首要任务不仅是追回这些，而且真正推进这些事情应该是什么的愿景。”

paras.en: Abolishing ICE and ending military aid to Israel are lofty, ambitious goals, and neither is likely to be achieved without navigating competing interests in Congress and the White House. With the balance of congressional power potentially shifting towards Democrats in the midterms, the newcomers will have to decide which priorities to pursue first.
paras.zh: 废除 ICE 和终止对以色列的军事援助都是崇高而雄心勃勃的目标，如果不考虑国会和白宫的利益冲突，这两个目标都不可能实现。由于中期选举中国会权力的平衡可能会向民主党倾斜，新议员将必须决定首先追求哪些优先事项。

paras.en: That means looking for more immediate wins comparable to Mamdani’s move to fill 200,000 potholes when he took office as mayor, according to progressive political strategist Nomiki Konst.
paras.zh: 进步政治策略师诺米基·康斯特 (Nomiki Konst) 表示，这意味着要寻求更直接的胜利，就像马姆达尼就任市长时填补 20 万个坑洼的举措一样。

paras.en: “[Get] on the same page about an issue that we all agree on and leverage that in the Democratic Congress because there’s no better time than the beginning,” Konst told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 康斯特告诉半岛电视台：“在我们都同意的问题上达成共识，并在民主党国会中利用这一点，因为没有比开始更好的时机了。”

paras.en: For Lander, one such measure is banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks.
paras.zh: 对于兰德来说，其中一项措施是禁止国会议员交易个股。

paras.en: “Maybe that restores a little bit of trust,” Lander said. “People say that’s gross that members of Congress trade stocks. At least this new Congress is doing something, you know, to show me they’re not just all in it for themselves.”
paras.zh: “也许这会恢复一点信任，”兰德说。 “人们说国会议员交易股票是很恶心的。至少这届新国会正在做一些事情，你知道，向我表明他们不仅仅是为了自己。”

paras.en: Lander also sees an opportunity to restore enhanced government subsidies that expired at the end of 2025, raising premiums for many people who buy their private-sector insurance plans individually.
paras.zh: 兰德还看到了恢复 2025 年底到期的增强型政府补贴的机会，从而提高了许多单独购买私营部门保险计划的人的保费。

paras.en: “We can say we’re not going to pass a budget that doesn’t do that and force Republicans to vote one way or the other and see what Trump does,” Lander said.
paras.zh: 兰德说：“我们可以说，我们不会通过一项不这样做的预算，并迫使共和党人以一种或另一种方式投票，看看特朗普会做什么。”

paras.en: For Avila Chevalier, an early priority would be her “Babies Not Bombs” agenda, redirecting funding towards domestic needs. Valdez wants to pass the PRO Act.
paras.zh: 对于阿维拉·谢瓦利埃（Avila Chevalier）来说，早期的首要任务是她的“婴儿而不是炸弹”议程，将资金重新用于国内需求。瓦尔迪兹希望通过 PRO 法案。

paras.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez sets a precedent
paras.zh: 亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯开创先例

paras.en: The three would not be the first progressive New Yorkers to enter Congress promising major change.
paras.zh: 这三人并不是第一批进入国会承诺重大变革的进步纽约人。

paras.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez won her legislative seat in 2018 by defeating longtime incumbent Joe Crowley. Since then, she has occasionally worked with Republicans on shared priorities.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯 (Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez) 于 2018 年击败长期现任议员乔·克劳利 (Joe Crowley)，赢得了立法席位。从那时起，她偶尔会与共和党人就共同的优先事项进行合作。

paras.en: In 2025, Ocasio-Cortez introduced legislation with Republican Representative Anna Paulina Luna of Florida to cap credit card interest rates at 10 percent, echoing a proposal from Senator Bernie Sanders of Vermont and Republican Senator Josh Hawley of Missouri.
paras.zh: 2025 年，奥卡西奥-科尔特斯与佛罗里达州共和党众议员安娜·宝琳娜·卢纳 (Anna Paulina Luna) 共同提出立法，将信用卡利率上限限制在 10%，这与佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯 (Bernie Sanders) 和密苏里州共和党参议员乔什·霍利 (Josh Hawley) 的提议相呼应。

paras.en: The question, Konst says, is whether Mamdani’s endorsed candidates can turn ideological commitments into legislative results. Doing so will require compromise, including setting aside some priorities to advance others.
paras.zh: 康斯特说，问题在于马姆达尼认可的候选人能否将意识形态承诺转化为立法结果。这样做需要妥协，包括搁置一些优先事项来推进其他事项。
