paras.en: Avila Chevalier is under the microscope after calling for New York City Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch to resign over a man being shot in his car by ICE while his child was in the backseat. Avila Chevalier said she was later shoved to the ground by New York City police officers during protests following the shooting.
paras.zh: 阿维拉·切瓦利埃 (Avila Chevalier) 呼吁纽约市警察局长杰西卡·蒂施 (Jessica Tisch) 辞职，原因是一名男子在车内被 ICE 枪击，而他的孩子就坐在后座上。阿维拉·谢瓦利埃 (Avila Chevalier) 表示，在枪击事件发生后的抗议活动中，她后来被纽约市警察推倒在地。

paras.en: Mamdani reportedly appointed Tisch on the recommendation of Governor Kathy Hochul, whose support was important to Mamdani’s mayoral campaign. An Atlantic magazine report suggested that her endorsement of Mamdani, whose more progressive platform included universal childcare and government-operated grocery stores, hinged on Tisch’s appointment.
paras.zh: 据报道，马姆达尼在州长凯西·霍赫尔的推荐下任命了蒂施，后者的支持对马姆达尼的市长竞选非常重要。 《大西洋》杂志的一篇报道表明，她对马姆达尼的支持取决于蒂施的任命，马姆达尼的更进步的平台包括全民儿童保育和政府经营的杂货店。

paras.en: “Everybody wants to have their agenda passed, right? I think being really thoughtful about when to hold fire, when to fire, when to be bold, when to hold back, and when to say what you feel so you’ll get the most support,” Konst said.
paras.zh: “每个人都希望自己的议程获得通过，对吧？我认为，要认真考虑何时停火、何时开火、何时大胆、何时克制以及何时说出你的感受，这样你才能获得最大的支持，”康斯特说。

paras.en: But Avila Chevalier said she is willing to work with anyone to advance her priorities.
paras.zh: 但阿维拉·谢瓦利埃表示，她愿意与任何人合作，以推进她的优先事项。

paras.en: “There is always something that two people can agree on. And that’s where I plan on starting because I think organising is about meeting people where they’re at,” Avila Chevalier said.
paras.zh: “总有一些事情是两个人可以达成一致的。这就是我计划开始的地方，因为我认为组织就是在人们所处的位置与他们会面，”阿维拉·谢瓦利埃说。

paras.en: “There are so many folks who really want to see healthcare transformed in this country, who really want to see a moratorium on data [centres]. That is a bipartisan issue for so many.”
paras.zh: “有很多人真的希望看到这个国家的医疗保健发生转变，他们真的希望看到数据[中心]的暂停。对很多人来说，这是一个两党共同的问题。”

articles.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
paras.zh: 联合国在有争议的西撒哈拉的维和任务结束35年后

paras.en: CASABLANCA, Morocco — The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years, as a result of a U.S.-Russia standoff at U.N. headquarters over the territory's future.
paras.zh: 摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡——由于美俄在联合国总部围绕该领土的未来陷入对峙，联合国在有争议的西撒哈拉地区执行的长期维和任务在执行了 35 年后于周日停止行动。

paras.en: The end of the mission raises concerns about stability in the region. Rich in minerals and fisheries, Western Sahara is a vast desert territory roughly the size of Colorado along Africa's northwestern Atlantic coast. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.
paras.zh: 任务的结束引发了对该地区稳定的担忧。西撒哈拉拥有丰富的矿产和渔业资源，是非洲西北大西洋沿岸一片广阔的沙漠地区，面积大约相当于科罗拉多州的大小。曾经由西班牙统治，摩洛哥和支持独立的波利萨里奥阵线均声称拥有主权。

paras.en: "This 1 November 2026 marks the start of the liquidation period," Stéphane Dujarric, spokesperson for the U.N. secretary general, said in a statement. "A smaller team reporting to the United Nations' Department of Operational Support will oversee the orderly transportation of assets belonging to troop-contributing countries to their respective nations, and the appropriate disposal of equipment belonging to the United Nations.''
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长发言人斯特凡·杜雅里克 (Stéphane Dujarric) 在一份声明中表示：“2026 年 11 月 1 日标志着清理期的开始。” “向联合国行动支持部报告的一个较小的团队将监督部队派遣国的资产有序运输到各自国家，以及联合国设备的适当处置。”

paras.en: The mission had been repeatedly extended since it was established in 1991. In the U.N. Security Council on Friday, Russia vetoed a draft U.S. resolution that would have supported Morocco's demand for sovereignty over Western Sahara and ended the peacekeeping mission next year.
paras.zh: 自1991年成立以来，该任务已多次延长。周五，俄罗斯在联合国安理会否决了美国一项支持摩洛哥对西撒哈拉主权要求的决议草案，并于明年结束了维和任务。

paras.en: Then a rival Russian resolution to extend the mission was voted down. The disagreement led to an abrupt end of the force's mandate.
paras.zh: 随后，俄罗斯一项延长任务期限的竞争对手决议被否决。这一分歧导致该部队的任务突然终止。

paras.en: Morocco's royal palace welcomed the non-renewal of the mission. It called it an "instrument to internationalize the dispute.''
paras.zh: 摩洛哥王宫对不再延长任务期限表示欢迎。它称其为“使争端国际化的工具。”

paras.en: The Polisario Front, backed by Algeria, called it "an unacceptable decision.'' The Algerian foreign ministry said it profoundly regrets the non-renewal of the mandate and criticized what it called the ''excessive bias'' of the U.S. draft resolution.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚支持的波利萨里奥阵线称这是“一个不可接受的决定”。阿尔及利亚外交部表示，对不延长授权深感遗憾，并批评美国决议草案“过度偏见”。

paras.en: Western Sahara is Africa's longest territorial dispute
paras.zh: 西撒哈拉是非洲最长的领土争端

paras.en: The U.N. classifies Western Sahara as a "non-self-governing territory," while critics of Morocco's control describe it as Africa's last colony. Morocco administers nearly all of the disputed territory, except for a narrow strip known as the "free zone" that lies east of a Moroccan-built sand wall.
paras.zh: 联合国将西撒哈拉列为“非自治领土”，而摩洛哥控制的批评者则将其描述为非洲最后的殖民地。摩洛哥管理着几乎所有有争议的领土，除了位于摩洛哥建造的沙墙以东的一条被称为“自由区”的狭长地带。

paras.en: After Morocco annexed it in 1975, the dispute escalated into an armed conflict that lasted more than 15 years and claimed more than 16,000 lives on both sides, according to the French Senate.
paras.zh: 据法国参议院称，摩洛哥于 1975 年吞并该国后，争端升级为武装冲突，持续了 15 年多，并夺走了双方 16,000 多人的生命。

paras.en: Bringing Western Sahara under its full sovereignty has been a central objective of Morocco's foreign policy for decades. Rabat, which has secured the backing of a growing number of Western capitals, including Washington, Paris and London, refers to the territory as its southern provinces. The dispute has become a defining feature of Morocco's diplomacy, with the kingdom often measuring its relations with other countries by their position on the issue.
paras.zh: 几十年来，将西撒哈拉置于其完全主权之下一直是摩洛哥外交政策的核心目标。拉巴特已经获得了越来越多西方国家首都的支持，包括华盛顿、巴黎和伦敦，该地区将其称为南部省份。这一争端已成为摩洛哥外交的一个决定性特征，该王国经常根据其他国家在该问题上的立场来衡量其与其他国家的关系。

paras.en: The Polisario Front seeks independence for the territory, which it considers the homeland of the Indigenous Sahrawi people. Operating from refugee camps in the Algerian city of Tindouf, the movement aims to establish an independent Sahrawi Republic. Mainly backed by Algeria, Russia and South Africa, the Polisario has seen its international support dwindle in recent years.
paras.zh: 波利萨里奥阵线寻求该地区的独立，它认为该地区是撒哈拉原住民的家园。该运动在阿尔及利亚廷杜夫市的难民营开展活动，旨在建立一个独立的撒哈拉共和国。波利萨里奥主要得到阿尔及利亚、俄罗斯和南非的支持，近年来其国际支持不断减少。

paras.en: The expired mission was established to monitor a referendum
paras.zh: 已过期的特派团是为了监测公投而设立的

paras.en: A U.N.-brokered cease-fire took effect in 1991. The agreement also paved the way for the creation of the U.N. Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara, known as MINURSO.
paras.zh: 联合国斡旋的停火于 1991 年生效。该协议还为创建联合国西撒哈拉全民投票特派团（即 MINURSO）铺平了道路。

paras.en: The settlement plan provided for a referendum on self-determination, with independence among the options. But the vote never materialized. Morocco wanted the voter list to include Sahrawis living in the territory it controls, while the Polisario objected, arguing that their inclusion would tilt the outcome toward integration with Morocco. The movement insisted on using Spain's colonial census to determine voter eligibility.
paras.zh: 解决计划规定就自决进行全民公投，其中包括独立性选项。但投票从未实现。摩洛哥希望选民名单中包括居住在其控制领土上的撒哈拉人，而波利萨里奥党则表示反对，认为将他们纳入选民名单将使结果倾向于与摩洛哥一体化。该运动坚持利用西班牙殖民地人口普查来确定选民资格。

paras.en: Twenty MINURSO personnel lost their lives in the mission. The U.N. force was authorized to have 534 personnel, and its 2026-2027 budget was more than $62 million. The top military contributors to the force were Egypt, Ghana and Pakistan.
paras.zh: 20 名西撒特派团人员在任务中丧生。联合国部队被授权拥有 534 名人员，2026-2027 年预算超过 6200 万美元。该部队的最大军事派遣国是埃及、加纳和巴基斯坦。

paras.en: As the mission ends, the U.N. secretary-general ''calls upon all parties to respect and promote the rights of the people of Western Sahara,'' Dujarric said, and "remains concerned about the security situation throughout the Territory and the risk of escalation of hostilities. He calls on all concerned to exercise maximum restraint."
paras.zh: 杜贾里克表示，访问结束后，联合国秘书长“呼吁各方尊重和促进西撒哈拉人民的权利”，并“仍然关注整个领土的安全局势和敌对行动升级的风险。他呼吁所有有关各方保持最大限度的克制。”

paras.en: The Polisario withdrew from the ceasefire in 2020 after clashes and the territory has since remained the scene of tensions and low-intensity hostilities, the U.N. said last month.
paras.zh: 联合国上个月表示，波利萨里奥党在冲突后于 2020 年退出停火，此后该地区一直处于紧张局势和低强度敌对行动。

paras.en: Western Sahara is the major flashpoint in the rivalry between regional heavyweights Morocco and Algeria. Algiers, which arms, funds and hosts the Polisario Front, sees full Moroccan sovereignty over the territory as a major diplomatic defeat. The two countries severed diplomatic relations in 2021, and the end of the mission risks further straining ties and fueling an arms race.
paras.zh: 西撒哈拉是地区大国摩洛哥和阿尔及利亚之间竞争的主要爆发点。阿尔及尔为波利萨里奥阵线提供武器、资金和东道国，该国认为摩洛哥对该领土的完全主权是一次重大的外交失败。两国于 2021 年断绝外交关系，任务的结束可能会导致关系进一步紧张并加剧军备竞赛。

articles.title: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
articles.author: Joanna Kakissis

paras.en: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰临时停火期间数百人撤离城市

paras.en: The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市的停火已经结束。停火持续了几天，数百名居民得以撤离。

paras.en: A ceasefire brokered by Pope Leo and Melania Trump in a corner of southern Ukraine has ended. The truce enabled the evacuation of hundreds of residents in a Russian-occupied town, and across the river in the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, the truce also allowed residents to walk the streets without being targeted by Russian drones. NPR's Joanna Kakissis traveled there this weekend and is on the line from Kyiv. Good morning, Joanna.
paras.zh: 由教皇利奥和梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋在乌克兰南部一角达成的停火协议已经结束。停战协议使俄罗斯占领的一个城镇的数百名居民得以疏散，而在河对岸的乌克兰控制的赫尔松市，停战协议还允许居民在街道上行走而不会成为俄罗斯无人机的目标。 NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 本周末从基辅前往那里。早上好，乔安娜。

paras.en: JOANNA KAKISSIS, BYLINE: Good morning, Leila.
paras.zh: 乔安娜·卡基西斯连线：早上好，莱拉。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Well, Leila, tunnels of heavy-duty nets cover nearly every street and many of the buildings in Kherson, if you can imagine that. These nets help protect residents from drones because for the last couple of years, Russian soldiers have used FPV, or first-person view drones strapped with explosives, to actually hunt and kill civilians in Kherson. So Russian troops are also about a mile away across a river. They also drop a lot of guided air bombs into the city.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：好吧，莱拉，重型网的隧道几乎覆盖了赫尔松的每条街道和许多建筑物，如果你能想象的话。这些网有助于保护居民免受无人机袭击，因为在过去的几年里，俄罗斯士兵使用 FPV（第一人称视角无人机）绑着炸药，在赫尔松实际猎杀平民。因此，俄罗斯军队也在大约一英里外的河对岸。他们还向城市投掷了大量制导炸弹。

paras.en: Now, this is a city I first visited in late 2022, right after Ukrainian forces freed Kherson from Russian occupation. Last time I was there was about a year ago. It's a lovely city filled with parks, but, you know, Russian forces have destroyed so many buildings there, and people never left their homes while I was there last time without drone detectors and sometimes even body armor.
paras.zh: 现在，这是我在 2022 年底首次访问的城市，当时乌克兰军队将赫尔松从俄罗斯占领下解放出来。我上次去那里是大约一年前。这是一个充满公园的可爱城市，但是，你知道，俄罗斯军队摧毁了那里的许多建筑物，当我上次在那里时，人们从未离开过自己的家，没有无人机探测器，有时甚至没有防弹衣。

paras.en: FADEL: So how much has changed since you were last there, especially given there was a ceasefire this weekend?
paras.zh: FADEL：那么，自您上次访问以来发生了多少变化，特别是考虑到本周末停火了？

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Well, Leila, the locals were not wearing body armor this time, and the city did show signs of normal life.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：嗯，莱拉，这次当地人没有穿防弹衣，这座城市确实表现出了正常生活的迹象。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: We saw people strolling outside with their kids, stocking up on groceries, having coffee in the sun. And at one very busy cafe, we met two best friends, Anna Hersomenko (ph) and Olena Soboleva (ph). They are 21 years old, and here's Olena.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：我们看到人们带着孩子在外面散步，购买杂货，在阳光下喝咖啡。在一家非常繁忙的咖啡馆，我们遇到了两位最好的朋友，安娜·赫索缅科（Anna Hersomenko）（博士）和奥莱娜·索博列娃（Olena Soboleva）（博士）。他们今年 21 岁，这是奥琳娜。

paras.en: OLENA SOBOLEVA: There is no drones. There is no explosions. It is like a feeling that no one wants to kill you.
paras.zh: 奥琳娜·索博列娃：没有无人机。没有爆炸。这就像一种没有人想杀你的感觉。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: And Anna told us she took the opportunity to walk to a salon.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：安娜告诉我们她借此机会步行去了一家沙龙。

paras.en: ANNA HERSOMENKO: Last two days, I did my nails. Paint my nail. Yeah.
paras.zh: 安娜·赫索门科：过去两天，我做了指甲。画我的指甲。是的。

paras.en: HERSOMENKO: Yes. Thank you a million. Really, it's definitely a lot of people now walking around. A lot of cars.
paras.zh: 赫尔索门科：是的。谢谢你一百万。确实，现在肯定有很多人在四处走动。很多车。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Now, these two friends, Leila, live on the same street, but they only see each other in person about once a month because it's usually so dangerous to walk outside.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：现在，莱拉这两个朋友住在同一条街上，但他们大约每月只见面一次，因为外面走路通常很危险。

paras.en: FADEL: Wow. So a little bit of a respite for them. So Kherson relaxed a little during the ceasefire, as you pointed out. This truce, though, was negotiated to help a town across the river. What happened there?
paras.zh: 法德尔：哇。所以给他们一点喘息的机会。正如你所指出的，赫尔松在停火期间放松了一些。不过，这次休战是为了帮助河对岸的一个城镇而谈判的。那里发生了什么？

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Well, yeah, Russia and Ukraine agreed to the ceasefire to help the town of Oleshky. This town is occupied by Russian forces, which mined the land around it. Trucks delivering food and medicine could not get in for several months. Some residents in Oleshky were eating boiled weeds to survive. Now, during the ceasefire, hundreds of residents were evacuated from the town, and many went to northern Ukraine to meet their families.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：嗯，是的，俄罗斯和乌克兰同意停火以帮助奥列什基镇。这个城镇被俄罗斯军队占领，并在其周围的土地上埋设了地雷。运送食品和药品的卡车几个月都无法进入。奥列什基的一些居民靠吃煮熟的杂草来生存。现在，在停火期间，数百名居民从该镇撤离，许多人前往乌克兰北部与家人团聚。

paras.en: FADEL: Now, the truce ended Sunday night. So does that mean back to war for everyone?
paras.zh: 法德尔：现在，停战协议于周日晚上结束。那么这是否意味着每个人都会回到战争呢？

paras.en: KAKISSIS: Well, I should note that this was a successful truce because it lasted several days and no violations were reported. But, you know, everyone we spoke to in Kherson was already really nervous as the deadline for the truce's end approached.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：嗯，我应该指出，这是一次成功的休战，因为它持续了几天，并且没有任何违规行为的报道。但是，你知道，随着休战结束最后期限的临近，我们在赫尔松采访的每个人都已经非常紧张。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED MUSICAL ARTIST: (Playing accordion).
paras.zh: 身份不明的音乐艺术家：（演奏手风琴）。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: We met oncology nurse Olena Yehorova (ph) at a bus stop. What you're hearing is a gray-haired musician playing the accordion at that bus stop. Olena kept looking up at the sky for drones while we were talking.
paras.zh: KAKISSIS：我们在公交车站遇到了肿瘤科护士 Olena Yehorova（博士）。你听到的是一位白发音乐家在那个公共汽车站拉手风琴。当我们谈话时，奥莱娜一直抬头仰望天空，寻找无人机。

paras.en: KAKISSIS: And she's saying, "I'm so anxious because I just cannot trust the Russians." And she also said that she is bracing herself for new attacks now that the truce is over.
paras.zh: 卡基西斯：她说，“我很焦虑，因为我无法相信俄罗斯人。”她还表示，休战结束后，她正在为新的袭击做好准备。

paras.en: FADEL: That's NPR's Joanna Kakissis in Kyiv. Thank you so much for your reporting.
paras.zh: FADEL：这是基辅 NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis)。非常感谢您的报告。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
paras.zh: 海莉·史蒂文斯支持迈克·罗杰斯。而且，海湾国家准备应对对伊朗的潜在袭击

paras.en: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens stunned the political landscape by endorsing GOP Michigan Senate candidate Mike Rogers for Michigan's open Senate seat, breaking with her party less than 48 hours before Election Day. The surprise defection followed weeks of deteriorating relations with her former primary opponent, Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed. In her endorsement of Rogers, Stevens cited El-Sayed's ties to political streamer Hasan Piker, whose remarks concerning Jewish people and Israel sparked backlash in August. El-Sayed sought to distance himself from the controversy, but Stevens has criticized him for not doing enough to reassure Black and Jewish voters who backed her in the primary.
paras.zh: 民主党众议员海莉·史蒂文斯 (Haley Stevens) 支持共和党密歇根州参议院候选人迈克·罗杰斯 (Mike Rogers) 竞选密歇根州的空缺参议院席位，震惊了政治格局，但在距离选举日不到 48 小时时，她与该党决裂。这次意外叛逃是在她与前主要对手、民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德的关系持续恶化数周之后发生的。在支持罗杰斯时，史蒂文斯提到了埃尔赛义德与政治流媒体哈桑·皮克的关系，后者有关犹太人和以色列的言论在八月份引发了强烈反对。埃尔-赛义德试图与这场争议保持距离，但史蒂文斯批评他没有采取足够措施安抚在初选中支持她的黑人和犹太选民。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Sam Gringlas tells Up First that he has met Democrats who didn't support El-Sayed in the primary and are struggling with their votes this fall. The latest drama may not sway late deciders, but it's not the discussion the El-Sayed campaign wanted. Many Democrats are angry and now rallying behind El-Sayed. Stevens' longtime chief of staff and many other staff members have quit, and the Michigan Democratic Party chair announced that Stevens is no longer a member. This turmoil exposes deepening fault lines within the party, not just over Israel but also regarding its future identity, Gringlas says. Even if Democrats reclaim one or both chambers of Congress on Tuesday, questions about the party's future are expected to linger, especially as they prepare to choose a presidential nominee in 2028.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的萨姆·格林格拉斯 (Sam Gringlas) 告诉 Up First，他遇到了一些在初选时不支持埃尔赛义德的民主党人，他们在今年秋天的选票上遇到了困难。最新的戏剧性事件可能不会影响迟到的决策者，但这并不是赛义德竞选团队想要的讨论。许多民主党人感到愤怒，现在团结起来支持埃尔赛义德。史蒂文斯长期担任的幕僚长和许多其他幕僚已经辞职，密歇根民主党主席宣布史蒂文斯不再是党员。格林格拉斯说，这场动荡暴露了党内日益加深的分歧，不仅在以色列问题上，而且在其未来身份问题上也存在分歧。即使民主党周二夺回国会两院或两院席位，有关该党未来的疑问预计仍将持续存在，尤其是在他们准备选出 2028 年总统候选人的时候。

paras.en: - 🎧 Voters are unhappy, NPR's Tamara Keith says, which has shifted a favorable election landscape for Republicans into a challenging position for President Trump and his party. Democrats are urging voters to give them a chance to drive change. Meanwhile, the GOP — as summed up by House Speaker Mike Johnson — has framed the midterms as a "contrast election between common sense and crazy." Keith says midterms typically serve as a referendum on the sitting president and his party, rather than a contrast.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的塔玛拉·基思 (Tamara Keith) 表示，选民们并不高兴，这使得共和党有利的选举格局变成了对特朗普总统及其政党充满挑战的局面。民主党人敦促选民给他们推动变革的机会。与此同时，正如众议院议长迈克·约翰逊所总结的那样，共和党将中期选举描述为“常识与疯狂之间的对比选举”。基思表示，中期选举通常是对现任总统及其政党的公投，而不是对比。

paras.en: - ➡️ Here are six things to watch for on election night to see who will end up controlling Congress. NPR has a guide on when polls close and where to watch the results come in.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在选举之夜需要注意以下六件事，看看谁最终将控制国会。 NPR 提供了有关民意调查何时结束以及在哪里观看结果的指南。

paras.en: - ➡️ Ahead of Election Day, NPR political correspondents answer listeners' biggest questions about the midterms' potential outcomes and what it's like to cover the excitement of politics.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在选举日之前，NPR 政治记者回答了听众关于中期选举的潜在结果以及如何报道令人兴奋的政治的最大问题。

paras.en: - ➡️ In every election, a key group of voters influences which candidates prevail. NPR's Politics team shares five insights from a year of engaging with voters who supported former President Joe Biden in 2020 and then switched to Trump in 2024.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在每次选举中，一群关键选民都会影响哪些候选人获胜。 NPR 政治团队分享了与 2020 年支持前总统乔·拜登、然后在 2024 年转向特朗普的选民接触的一年中的五点见解。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: After tomorrow's elections, Trump may choose to bomb Iran again — an option he has discussed with Israel. The U.S.' partners in the Gulf are on edge and bracing for potential conflict. Qatar has been actively leading negotiations with Iran over the past 72 hours to prevent further fighting.
paras.zh: 明天的选举后，特朗普可能会选择再次轰炸伊朗——他已经与以色列讨论过这一选择。美国’海湾合作伙伴处于紧张状态，准备应对潜在的冲突。卡塔尔在过去72小时内一直积极主导与伊朗的谈判，以防止进一步的战斗。

paras.en: - 🎧 Qatar has been tight-lipped about the negotiations, but Iran says there's a two-day plan to stop attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz and resume talks with the U.S., depending on the U.S. response. Trump said that the U.S. has neutralized key components of Iran's military but has a couple of targets left, according to NPR's Aya Batrawy. Gulf states worry that further attacks will destabilize the region and disrupt global energy supplies.
paras.zh: - 🎧 卡塔尔对谈判守口如瓶，但伊朗表示，有一个为期两天的计划，以停止对霍尔木兹海峡船只的袭击，并恢复与美国的谈判，具体取决于美国的反应。据美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的阿亚·巴特威 (Aya Batrawy) 报道，特朗普表示，美国已经消灭了伊朗军队的关键组成部分，但还剩下几个目标。海湾国家担心进一步的袭击将破坏该地区的稳定并扰乱全球能源供应。

paras.en: The Supreme Court will hear arguments tomorrow in a case between the Catholic Church and Colorado's taxpayer-funded pre-K programs. The case questions whether religious schools can refuse admission to children of gay and trans parents, which would violate a state law against discrimination. For decades, the Supreme Court upheld the separation of church and state. But in the past 10 years, the court's conservative majority has increasingly shifted focus to the First Amendment's protection of religious freedom. This shift complicates Colorado's inclusive pre-K initiative aimed at ensuring that virtually all 4-year-olds in the state get a pre-K education. To meet its goal, the state included religious schools in its program, as long as they comply with state laws prohibiting discrimination on the basis of race, religion, sexual orientation or gender identity.
paras.zh: 最高法院将于明天就天主教会和科罗拉多州纳税人资助的学前教育项目之间的案件进行辩论。该案质疑宗教学校是否可以拒绝同性恋和跨性别父母的孩子入学，这违反了州反歧视法律。几十年来，最高法院一直维持政教分离。但在过去的十年里，最高法院的保守派多数逐渐将焦点转向第一修正案对宗教自由的保护。这一转变使科罗拉多州的包容性学前教育计划变得更加复杂，该计划旨在确保该州几乎所有 4 岁儿童都能接受学前教育。为了实现其目标，该州将宗教学校纳入其计划，只要它们遵守禁止基于种族、宗教、性取向或性别认同的歧视的州法律。

paras.en: "Your Turn" is a special series from NPR's Allison Aubrey, exploring how to navigate your way through midlife.
paras.zh: 《轮到你了》是 NPR 的艾莉森·奥布里 (Allison Aubrey) 制作的特别系列节目，探讨如何度过中年。

paras.en: Burnout can be a challenge during midlife. As work and home obligations take up more of your focus, burnout can slowly sap your sense of joy and wonder in everyday life. Psychiatrist Judith Joseph says there's a term for this: anhedonia. It's the inability or reduced capacity to experience pleasure from things that are normally enjoyable. Joseph says it can accompany what she calls "high-functioning depression," and she describes it as depression's "silent sister." Here's what the research shows about high-functioning depression:
paras.zh: 倦怠可能是中年时期的一个挑战。随着工作和家庭义务占据您更多的注意力，倦怠会慢慢削弱您日常生活中的快乐和惊奇感。精神病学家朱迪思·约瑟夫说，有一个术语可以形容这种情况：快感缺失。这是无法或能力降低从通常令人愉快的事物中体验快乐的能力。约瑟夫说，它可能伴随着她所说的“高功能抑郁症”，她将其描述为抑郁症的“沉默的姐妹”。以下是有关高功能抑郁症的研究结果：

paras.en: - ➡️ Research published in the journal Cureus confirmed the hypothesis that people with high-functioning depression have increased levels of anhedonia and trauma. Parents and caregivers had the highest high-functioning depression scores.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 发表在《Cureus》杂志上的研究证实了这样的假设：患有高功能抑郁症的人的快感缺失和创伤程度会增加。父母和照顾者的高功能抑郁评分最高。

paras.en: - ➡️ High-functioning depression is not an official diagnosis in the DSM-5. People who keep functioning may not recognize their symptoms or seek treatment until they're burned out.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 高功能抑郁症并不是 DSM-5 中的官方诊断。保持正常运转的人可能直到精疲力竭才意识到自己的症状或寻求治疗。

paras.en: - ➡️ Joseph has developed an anhedonia quiz. While it's not a diagnostic tool, it can be helpful to take stock of the obstacles preventing you from living a more joyful life.
paras.zh: - ➡️约瑟夫开发了一个快感缺乏测验。虽然它不是诊断工具，但它可以帮助您评估阻碍您过上更快乐生活的障碍。

paras.en: - ➡️ Joseph also developed a framework to combat anhedonia, called the Five V's: Validation, Venting, Values, Vision and Vitals.
paras.zh: - ➡️ Joseph 还开发了一个对抗快感缺失的框架，称为“五个 V”：验证、发泄、价值观、愿景和活力。

paras.en: by Tamara Keith, senior political correspondent
paras.zh: 作者：Tamara Keith，高级政治记者

paras.en: At this stage in the midterms, all that's left is the voting and the waiting. On election night, I'll be in Studio 31 at NPR headquarters with browser tabs full of spreadsheets, watching the results roll in and sharing context with NPR listeners.
paras.zh: 到了中期选举的这个阶段，剩下的就是投票和等待了。在选举之夜，我将在 NPR 总部的 31 工作室，浏览器选项卡上充满电子表格，观看结果滚动并与 NPR 听众分享背景信息。

paras.en: One of those spreadsheets lists all the congressional districts that have been redrawn since 2024 as part of a mid-decade redistricting push by President Trump. Facing down the historical precedent that the president's party usually loses seats in the midterms, the president pressured Republican-led states to create more sure-thing GOP districts.
paras.zh: 其中一份电子表格列出了自 2024 年以来重新划定的所有国会选区，这是特朗普总统十年中期重新划分选区计划的一部分。面对总统所在政党通常在中期选举中失去席位的历史先例，总统向共和党领导的州施压，要求他们创建更有把握的共和党选区。

paras.en: But headed into voting, the results in two-thirds of those districts are very much up in the air. In some cases, Democrats are favored. These are places Trump would have won by 10 points just two years ago.
paras.zh: 但在投票前，三分之二选区的结果仍悬而未决。在某些情况下，民主党人会受到青睐。就在两年前，特朗普还能以 10 个百分点的优势赢得这些席位。

paras.en: Last month, I saw that the president had a campaign rally scheduled in Greenville, N.C. But national Republicans essentially stopped running ads for Michael Whatley — Trump's handpicked nominee — and diverted resources to states with more competitive races. So, why was the president holding another rally? I reached out to a few sources in the state.
paras.zh: 上个月，我看到总统计划在北卡罗来纳州格林维尔举行竞选集会。但全国共和党人基本上停止了为特朗普精心挑选的提名人迈克尔·沃特利投放广告，并将资源转移到竞争更激烈的州。那么，总统为什么要再次举行集会呢？我联系了该州的一些消息来源。

paras.en: What I learned is that the real reason for the president's trip was almost certainly to help the Republican candidate in eastern North Carolina's first congressional district. It is now one of the most hotly contested and expensive House races in the country, despite new district lines that should have made it an easy Republican pick-up.
paras.zh: 据我所知，总统此行的真正原因几乎可以肯定是为了帮助北卡罗来纳州东部第一国会选区的共和党候选人。它现在是美国竞争最激烈、成本最高的众议院竞选之一，尽管新的选区划分应该会让共和党轻松获胜。

paras.en: Two days of driving through this very large district, one Trump rally, two bags of gummy candy and a lot of coffee later, I was back in the office digging into my spreadsheet of congressional districts. NC-01 isn't an isolated case. A majority of districts redrawn to be a firewall for a Republican majority have turned out to be far more competitive than expected.
paras.zh: 两天开车穿过这个非常大的选区，参加了一场特朗普集会，带了两袋软糖和很多咖啡，之后我回到办公室，仔细研究国会选区的电子表格。 NC-01 并不是一个孤立的案例。事实证明，大多数选区被重新划定为共和党多数派的防火墙，其竞争力远远超出预期。

paras.en: - Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., 53, has been hospitalized after experiencing a stroke. His office reports that he is expected to make a full recovery.
paras.zh: - 康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲 (Chris Murphy)，53 岁，中风后住院治疗。他的办公室报告称，他有望完全康复。

paras.en: - Hackers stole more than $6 billion from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. The FBI concluded that North Korea carried out the attack.
paras.zh: - 黑客从全球最大的加密货币交易所币安窃取了超过 60 亿美元。联邦调查局得出结论，朝鲜实施了这次袭击。

paras.en: - Oil companies reported huge profits in the quarter that just ended. Together, ExxonMobil, Shell and Chevron earned more than $36 billion as the war in Iran drives up gas prices.
paras.zh: - 石油公司在刚刚结束的季度报告了巨额利润。由于伊朗战争推高了天然气价格，埃克森美孚、壳牌和雪佛龙总共赚取了超过 360 亿美元。

articles.title: Kirby Smart clarifies comments after taking shot at how much college football players are making

paras.en: Several years into the name, image, and likeness era, college football fans are now familiar with most of the resulting changes happening across the sport.
paras.zh: 进入名称、形象和肖像时代几年后，大学橄榄球迷现在已经熟悉了这项运动所发生的大部分变化。

paras.en: Parity within the major conferences is rapidly increasing, with the gaps between teams dropping dramatically. Players who used to commit to sit on the bench at Alabama under Nick Saban or Ohio State under Ryan Day are now bringing in bigger paydays to start at smaller schools. For good reason.
paras.zh: 主要会议中的平等正在迅速增加，球队之间的差距急剧缩小。那些曾经承诺在尼克·萨班（Nick Saban）领导下的阿拉巴马州或瑞安·戴（Ryan Day）领导下的俄亥俄州立大学（Ohio State）担任替补的球员现在开始在规模较小的学校开始获得更大的薪水。有充分的理由。

paras.en: The combination of NIL and the transfer portal has made rebuilding a program overnight more realistic than it's ever been. Curt Cignetti turned the Indiana Hoosiers from an also-ran into an undefeated, National Championship-winning behemoth in just two seasons. Bob Chesney came to UCLA from James Madison and overnight, made the Bruins into a legitimate College Football Playoff contender, sitting at No. 5 in the latest Associated Press Top 25 poll late into the season.
paras.zh: NIL 和传输门户的结合使得在一夜之间重建程序比以往任何时候都更加现实。科特·西格内蒂在短短两个赛季内将印第安纳州印第安纳州印第安纳州队从一支落败球队变成了一支不败的、赢得全国冠军的庞然大物。鲍勃·切斯尼 (Bob Chesney) 从詹姆斯·麦迪逊 (James Madison) 来到加州大学洛杉矶分校 (UCLA)，一夜之间，棕熊队 (Bruins) 成为了大学橄榄球季后赛的有力竞争者，在美联社最新的赛季末 25 强排名中排名第五。

paras.en: But Georgia Bulldogs head coach Kirby Smart may have tacitly admitted to another result from the NIL era: a lack of motivation and aggression for the week-in, week-out grind of major conference college football.
paras.zh: 但佐治亚斗牛犬队主教练柯比·斯马特可能已经默认了 NIL 时代的另一个结果：在重大联盟大学橄榄球比赛中，人们缺乏动力和侵略性。

paras.en: After the Bulldogs easily handled the Florida Gators 27-8, Smart was asked about the number of injuries his team is dealing with, and whether playing a tough SEC schedule could contribute to it. And his answer was revealing about the state of modern college football, particularly with the amount of money that's now floating around it.
paras.zh: 在斗牛犬队以 27-8 轻松击败佛罗里达短吻鳄队后，斯玛特被问及他的球队正在处理的伤病人数，以及在 SEC 的艰难赛程中是否会造成这种情况。他的回答揭示了现代大学橄榄球的现状，特别是现在围绕它流动的资金数额。

paras.en: "Everybody is practicing less, but everybody’s getting injured more," he said.
paras.zh: “每个人的训练都减少了，但每个人都受伤了，”他说。

paras.en: "I think about the teams we had in ’21 and ’22, and how physical they were and how they practiced. We can’t even get close to that now," Smart added. "If it’s a different culture that guys don’t want to as much, I don’t know. They were definitely hungrier, because there was a motivation to make it. A lot of these guys, honestly, they make more than I did until I was 40. It’s just a different day and age."
paras.zh: “我想到了我们21年和22年的球队，以及他们的身体素质和训练方式。我们现在甚至无法接近这一点，”斯玛特补充道。 “如果这是一种不同的文化，人们不太想要，我不知道。他们肯定更饥饿，因为有动力去做。老实说，他们中的很多人在我 40 岁之前赚的钱都比我多。这只是一个不同的日子和年龄。”

paras.en: It's an important insight that may have been obvious, but is frequently unsaid. Players may not feel the need to improve as much as they used to, because they're not fighting for the NFL payday down the road, they're already making significant money. It's human nature, and likely true, but it's one of the perhaps unexpected ancillary outcomes of players now being able to earn money for their contributions.
paras.zh: 这是一个可能显而易见但经常未被提及的重要见解。球员们可能不会像以前那样觉得需要提高，因为他们不再为未来的 NFL 发薪日而奋斗，他们已经赚了很多钱。这是人性，而且可能是真的，但这可能是玩家现在能够通过贡献赚钱的意想不到的附带结果之一。

paras.en: Still, Smart's comments received some blowback, with some adding that Smart's doing pretty well financially, and that coaches have frequently displayed a financially-motivated lack of loyalty or commitment to stick with their teams. If they can benefit from the money being generated by college football, why shouldn't the players putting themselves on the line benefit as well?
paras.zh: 尽管如此，斯玛特的言论还是遭到了一些反驳，一些人补充说，斯玛特的财务状况相当不错，而且教练们经常表现出出于经济动机缺乏忠诚度或对球队的忠诚度或承诺。如果他们可以从大学橄榄球所产生的金钱中受益，为什么那些冒着风险的球员也不能受益呢？

paras.en: Unsurprisingly, he clarified those comments on Monday, saying he thinks it's "awesome" that young athletes are able to earn money in college sports now.
paras.zh: 不出所料，他周一澄清了这些评论，并表示他认为年轻运动员现在能够在大学体育运动中赚钱“太棒了”。

paras.en: "I don’t want to come across as whining," he explained. "I think it’s awesome that players are getting paid. I wish they were being paid when I played because then maybe I wouldn’t have had to get a $5,000 job for the summer trying to work. But that is none of my concern. It is more long-term effect of earning power, what is the value of a dollar, do I actually know how hard it is to go out in the real world, and gotta go work for $60,000? That outlook can be tough on guys. But the earning power they have while they’re here, more power to them."
paras.zh: “我不想给人留下爱发牢骚的印象，”他解释道。 “我认为球员们能得到报酬真是太棒了。我希望他们在我打球的时候得到报酬，因为那样的话我可能就不必在夏天找一份 5,000 美元的工作来努力工作。但这不是我关心的。这是赚钱能力的更长期影响，一美元的价值是多少，我真的知道在现实世界中出去有多难，而且必须去工作 60,000 美元吗？这种前景对男人来说可能很艰难。但是他们在这里拥有赚钱的能力，对他们来说有更多的权力。”

paras.en: Again, it's an obvious fact that 18-year-olds now able to make that much money, or far, far, more is going to have some other side effects. Motivation being one of them. But like all jobs and careers, if they fail to live up to expectations, because of a lack of motivation, it can all change in the blink of an eye.
paras.zh: 再说一次，18 岁的年轻人现在能够赚那么多钱，或者多得多，这是一个明显的事实，这将会产生一些其他副作用。动机就是其中之一。但就像所有的工作和职业一样，如果由于缺乏动力而未能达到期望，那么一切都可能在眨眼之间发生变化。

paras.en: Smart added that it's now even more important to evaluate how a player will respond to making that kind of money, and whether it'll impact their ability to contribute moving forward.
paras.zh: 斯玛特补充说，现在更重要的是评估球员对赚到这么多钱有何反应，以及这是否会影响他们继续前进的能力。

paras.en: "That still is an art in recruiting and decision-making: Are you recruiting the right kinds of kids that will not be affected by that," Smart said. "We used to deal with that all the time when I was at Alabama, when you’d have an (NFL) scout come in and say, ‘Well, is him being a first-round pick or second-round pick going to change him?’ That’s your job to decide that, not mine.
paras.zh: 斯玛特说：“这仍然是招募和决策的一门艺术：你是否招募了合适的、不会受到影响的孩子。” “当我在阿拉巴马州时，我们一直在处理这个问题，当时你会有一个（NFL）球探进来问，‘好吧，他是第一轮选秀还是第二轮选秀会改变他？’这是你的工作来决定，而不是我的。

paras.en: "Well, now it’s our job to decide as coaches. Do you have the right kind of people in your program who will be motivated for the team, and the culture of the program?"
paras.zh: “好吧，现在我们作为教练的工作就是做出决定。你的项目中是否有合适的人选，他们会为球队和项目文化带来动力？”

paras.en: The broader point, he added, was about the change in roster limits also impacting the ability to practice with more physicality. When the 2025 House settlement limited rosters to 105 players instead of effectively unlimited, coaches were less willing to go all out in practice and risk injuries. That, Smart believes, is part of the change to college football.
paras.zh: 他补充说，更广泛的一点是，名单限制的变化也会影响更多身体训练的能力。当 2025 年众议院和解协议将球员名单限制为 105 名而不是实际上无限时，教练们不太愿意冒着受伤的风险在训练中全力以赴。斯玛特认为，这是大学橄榄球变革的一部分。

paras.en: Maybe it's both. Maybe it's none of it, and it's just random variance. It's hard to know, in the modern era, with how many changes there are seemingly week-to-week. Given the chaos this season has brought already, at least the increase in parity has made for more exciting television.
paras.zh: 也许两者都是。也许都不是，而只是随机方差。很难知道，在现代，每周都会发生多少变化。考虑到本季已经带来的混乱，至少平价的增加让电视节目变得更加令人兴奋。

articles.title: Battleground Dem touts bipartisan record, but can’t name single issue she’d work with Trump on

paras.en: A Democratic Senate candidate in Minnesota touted her bipartisan record Sunday but could not name a single issue she would work with President Donald Trump on, instead accusing his administration of "continued grift."
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州的一位民主党参议员候选人周日吹捧了她的两党合作记录，但无法说出她将与唐纳德·特朗普总统合作的任何问题，而是指责他的政府“持续欺诈”。

paras.en: The exchange came as Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan, Minnesota’s Democratic Senate nominee, campaigns against Republican Michele Tafoya in a race Republicans see as a rare opportunity to flip a traditionally blue state. Flanagan’s answer underscored the sharply partisan nature of the Minnesota race, where she has cast Tafoya as a rubber stamp for Trump and pledged to oppose the administration at nearly every turn.
paras.zh: 此次交锋发生之际，明尼苏达州民主党参议员候选人、副州长佩吉·弗拉纳根(Peggy Flanagan)正在竞选对手共和党人米歇尔·塔福亚(Michele Tafoya)，共和党人认为这场竞选是颠覆传统蓝州的难得机会。弗拉纳根的回答凸显了明尼苏达州竞选的尖锐党派性质，她将塔福亚视为特朗普的橡皮图章，并承诺几乎在每一个环节都反对政府。

paras.en: "I just want to be really clear that I’ve got a long track record of working with folks on the other side of the aisle," Flanagan told Fox News' Bill Melugin when asked if there were any policies she could see herself working with Trump on. Flanagan pointed to her work at the Children’s Defense Fund–Minnesota and her time in the Minnesota Legislature, where she served alongside a Republican majority and helped pass bipartisan legislation, as evidence of her ability to work across the aisle.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否有任何政策可以与特朗普合作时，弗拉纳根告诉福克斯新闻的比尔梅鲁金：“我只是想明确表示，我在与两党人士合作方面有着长期的记录。”弗拉纳根指出，她在明尼苏达州儿童保护基金会的工作以及在明尼苏达州立法机构的工作经历，与共和党多数派一起工作，并帮助通过了两党立法，作为她跨党派工作能力的证据。

paras.en: "I think that, you know, that proves that I have the ability to work with folks," she continued.
paras.zh: “我认为，你知道，这证明了我有能力与人们合作，”她继续说道。

paras.en: Flanagan’s bipartisan pitch comes against the backdrop of a campaign built around opposing Trump’s agenda. She has called for dismantling ICE, passing Medicare for All and reversing the administration’s Medicaid and SNAP cuts, while accusing Trump of using the presidency to enrich himself.
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根的两党合作是在一场围绕反对特朗普议程的竞选活动的背景下进行的。她呼吁废除 ICE、通过全民医疗保险并扭转政府对医疗补助和 SNAP 的削减，同时指责特朗普利用总统职位为自己谋取利益。

paras.en: "Right now, I’m deeply concerned about the Trump administration, the continued grift, making money hand over fist directly from the Oval Office," she continued in her response to Melugin on whether she would work with Trump on anything.
paras.zh: “现在，我对特朗普政府深感担忧，持续的欺诈行为，直接从椭圆形办公室赚钱，”她在回答梅鲁金是否会在任何事情上与特朗普合作时继续说道。

paras.en: The Democratic Senate candidate went on to tell Melugin that what she has been "hearing" on the campaign trail is that voters want someone who will be a "check" on Trump, not his ally.
paras.zh: 这位民主党参议院候选人接着告诉梅鲁金，她在竞选过程中“听到”的是，选民想要的是一个能够“制衡”特朗普的人，而不是他的盟友。

paras.en: "They’re interested in whether people are going to be a check on this guy, and roll back some of the devastating cuts and impacts on Minnesota," Flanagan concluded in her answer about working with Trump. "That’s the place I’m going to start."
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根在关于与特朗普合作的回答中总结道：“他们感兴趣的是人们是否会对这个人进行检查，并减少对明尼苏达州的一些毁灭性削减和影响。” “这就是我要开始的地方。”

paras.en: Flanagan is facing Republican Michele Tafoya, a former NFL sideline reporter who has turned the race into a referendum on the massive fraud scandal that unfolded under the Walz administration. Tafoya has argued that Flanagan, who served as Walz’s No. 2 as lieutenant governor, should share responsibility for the scandal, while also tying her opponent to progressive positions including Medicare for All and dismantling ICE.
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根的对手是共和党人米歇尔·塔福亚（Michele Tafoya），他是一名前美国国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）场外记者，他将这场竞选变成了对沃尔兹政府时期发生的大规模欺诈丑闻的公投。塔福亚认为，曾担任沃尔兹二号副州长的弗拉纳根应该对这起丑闻承担责任，同时也将她的对手与包括全民医疗保险和解散 ICE 在内的进步立场联系在一起。

paras.en: The race has become unexpectedly competitive after Tafoya narrowed the gap in Minnesota, prompting Fox News to shift its rating from "Likely Democrat" to "Lean Democrat."
paras.zh: 在塔福亚缩小了明尼苏达州的差距后，这场竞选变得出乎意料地激烈，促使福克斯新闻将其评级从“可能是民主党人”转变为“倾向于民主党人”。

paras.en: "The more that Minnesotans learn about me and my opponent and see what my opponent has failed to do over the last eight years alongside [Democratic Gov.] Tim Walz, they're understanding Minnesota needs change. We need fresh ideas, we need an independent thinker and they're jumping on board," Tafoya said in a Fox News Digital interview.
paras.zh: “明尼苏达人对我和我的对手了解得越多，看到我的对手在过去八年里与民主党州长蒂姆·沃尔兹一起未能做到的事情，他们就越了解明尼苏达州需要改变。我们需要新的想法，我们需要一个独立的思想家，他们正在加入，”塔福亚在福克斯新闻数字采访中说。

paras.en: Flanagan has repeatedly tied Tafoya to President Donald Trump, whose approval ratings are well underwater in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 弗拉纳根多次将塔福亚与唐纳德·特朗普总统联系在一起，后者在明尼苏达州的支持率远远低于预期。

paras.en: "Michele Tafoya is all in for Donald Trump — and he's all in for her," Flanagan said last month in a social media post.
paras.zh: “米歇尔·塔福亚全力支持唐纳德·特朗普，而他也全力支持她，”弗拉纳根上个月在社交媒体帖子中表示。

paras.en: But Tafoya appears to be putting some daylight between herself and Trump, as she highlights her support for abortion rights.
paras.zh: 但塔福亚似乎在疏远自己和特朗普之间的关系，因为她强调了自己对堕胎权的支持。

paras.en: "I’m a pro-choice Republican not afraid to stand up to my party," Tafoya says in a new campaign commercial. "When Trump is right, I will work with him. When he is wrong, I will stand up for Minnesota."
paras.zh: 塔福亚在新的竞选广告中表示：“我是一名支持堕胎的共和党人，不怕与我的政党对抗。” “当特朗普是对的时候，我会与他合作。当他错了时，我会支持明尼苏达州。”

paras.en: While the ad drew opposition from some Republicans, including Mercedes Schlapp, a senior fellow at the Conservative Political Action Conference, Trump subsequently signaled support for Tafoya at an Ohio rally he headlined.
paras.zh: 虽然这则广告引起了一些共和党人的反对，其中包括保守党政治行动会议高级研究员梅赛德斯·施拉普(Mercedes Schlapp)，但特朗普随后在他主持的俄亥俄州集会上表示支持塔福亚。

paras.en: "You have to vote for Michele Tafoya, who’s a very respected person," the president said.
paras.zh: 总统说：“你必须投票给米歇尔·塔福亚，他是一位非常受人尊敬的人。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Paul Steinhauser contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的保罗·斯坦豪瑟 (Paul Steinhauser) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: 'The View' host Sara Haines lauds Haley Stevens' 'brave' endorsement of Mike Rogers

paras.en: "The View" co-host Sara Haines defended Rep. Haley Stevens, D-Mich., during a discussion on Monday about the Democrat's decision to endorse Michigan Republican U.S. Senate candidate Mike Rogers over Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed, pushing back against critics who called the endorsement a betrayal.
paras.zh: 《观点》联合主持人萨拉·海恩斯在周一讨论民主党决定支持密歇根州共和党参议员候选人迈克·罗杰斯而不是民主党候选人阿卜杜勒·赛义德时，为密歇根州民主党众议员海莉·史蒂文斯辩护，驳斥了批评者称这一支持是背叛的言论。

paras.en: Co-hosts Sunny Hostin and Ana Navarro both argued that Stevens endorsed Rogers for the wrong reasons, with Hostin saying, "Shame on her," if the move was motivated by a bruised ego. Stevens said during an interview on Sunday that it was El-Sayed's "anger" and "lack of kindness" that led her to endorse Rogers.
paras.zh: 联合主持人桑尼·霍斯汀（Sunny Hostin）和安娜·纳瓦罗（Ana Navarro）都认为史蒂文斯支持罗杰斯的理由是错误的，霍斯汀说，“她感到羞耻”，如果此举是出于自尊心受伤的话。史蒂文斯在周日接受采访时表示，正是埃尔赛义德的“愤怒”和“缺乏善意”导致她支持罗杰斯。

paras.en: "I disagree. And I actually think that, although there’s a lot of Islamophobia here that are muddying the waters, there are deep concerns about his beliefs," Haines said. "Campaigning with Hasan Piker, you could not put enough room between me and that man. And we went after the Republicans for going around with Nick Fuentes, also problematic."
paras.zh: 海恩斯说：“我不同意。事实上，我认为，尽管这里有很多仇视伊斯兰教的情绪，使水变得浑浊，但人们对他的信仰深感担忧。” “在与哈桑·派克一起竞选时，你无法在我和那个人之间留出足够的空间。我们还因为共和党人和尼克·富恩特斯的关系而追究共和党的责任，这也是有问题的。”

paras.en: "We have got to know when we denounce someone," she continued. "And if crossing party lines can be an act of conscience for Liz Cheney, I don’t know why the automatic response was that this was betrayal somehow."
paras.zh: “当我们谴责某人时，我们必须知道，”她继续说道。 “如果跨越党派界限对于利兹·切尼来说是一种良心行​​为，我不知道为什么人们会自动反应这是某种背叛。”

paras.en: Haines, a registered independent, said Stevens' decision was "brave."
paras.zh: 注册独立人士海恩斯表示，史蒂文斯的决定是“勇敢的”。

paras.en: "Integrity is not just backing your party when you support your party," the co-host added. "The real test is backing them when it costs you something. I keep hearing, 'Donald Trump is so dangerous,' and that is true, but that can’t end every conversation we have about what we’re willing to accept on our own sides."
paras.zh: “诚信不仅仅是在你支持你的政党时支持你的政党，”共同主持人补充道。 “真正的考验是在你付出代价时支持他们。我不断听到，‘唐纳德·特朗普太危险了’，这是事实，但这并不能结束我们关于我们自己愿意接受什么的每一次对话。”

paras.en: "Honestly, the hateful rhetoric and demeaning language, I don’t have to agree with a candidate on everything at all, and compromise is absolutely necessary, but you cannot loan your loyalty and support out to a party," Haines continued. "They must earn it every single time. And that’s why this was actually a very brave thing for her to do."
paras.zh: “老实说，仇恨言论和侮辱性语言，我不必在所有事情上都同意候选人，妥协是绝对必要的，但你不能把你的忠诚和支持借给一个政党，”海恩斯继续说道。 “他们每次都必须赢得它。这就是为什么这对她来说实际上是一件非常勇敢的事情。”

paras.en: Democratic strategist Kaivan Shroff told Fox News Digital in a statement, "Haines’s defense is hard to square with the facts. I was one of the early Democrats who said El-Sayed needed to put real distance between himself and Hasan Piker. And he did. He said Piker did not speak for his campaign, stopped campaigning with him, and reportedly even called him directly to say his rhetoric was hurting the campaign and counterproductive. That all happened well before Haley Stevens’s last-minute endorsement."
paras.zh: 民主党策略师凯万·史洛夫在一份声明中告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，“海恩斯的辩护很难与事实相符。我是早期认为埃尔·赛义德需要在自己和哈桑·派克之间保持真正距离的民主党人之一。他确实做到了。他说派克没有为他的竞选活动发言，停止与他一起竞选，据报道甚至直接打电话给他说他的言论损害了竞选活动并适得其反。这一切都发生在海莉·史蒂文斯之前。最后一刻的认可。”

paras.en: "So Haines is using an issue El-Sayed already addressed to excuse this wild switch-up, while openly acknowledging the Islamophobia on the other side and then instantly brushing past it," he added.
paras.zh: “因此，海恩斯正在利用埃尔-赛义德已经解决过的一个问题来为这种疯狂的转变开脱，同时公开承认另一方的伊斯兰恐惧症，然后立即忽略它，”他补充道。

paras.en: Shroff argued that Haines was treating hate from one side as disqualifying, but not the other, and said, "That is not principled, balanced, or reasonable. It is just a glaring double standard."
paras.zh: 史洛夫辩称，海恩斯将一方的仇恨视为不合格，而不是另一方，并表示，“这没有原则、平衡或合理。这只是一种明显的双重标准。”

paras.en: Co-host Whoopi Goldberg brought up the timing of the endorsement as Haines argued that El-Sayed had also told Stevens he did not want her to campaign with him.
paras.zh: 联合主持人乌比·戈德堡提出了支持的时机，海恩斯辩称，埃尔·赛义德也告诉史蒂文斯，他不希望她与他一起竞选。

paras.en: Navarro reiterated that she believed Stevens' decision was motivated by El-Sayed's reluctance to have her at the event.
paras.zh: 纳瓦罗重申，她相信史蒂文斯的决定是由于埃尔赛义德不愿让她参加活动。

paras.en: Fellow co-host Alyssa Farah Griffin said that Stevens had raised "real issues" about antisemitism.
paras.zh: 共同主持人艾莉莎·法拉·格里芬表示，史蒂文斯提出了有关反犹太主义的“真正问题”。

paras.en: Griffin also compared Stevens endorsing Rogers with Liz Cheney endorsing former Vice President Kamala Harris earlier in the segment.
paras.zh: 格里芬还将史蒂文斯支持罗杰斯与利兹·切尼在该部分早些时候支持前副总统卡马拉·哈里斯进行了比较。

paras.en: "We shouldn’t just praise independents when Liz Cheney breaks with Republicans, because she thinks that’s the principled position. If this woman feels this is the principled position for her, she has every right to do that," Griffin said.
paras.zh: “当利兹·切尼与共和党决裂时，我们不应该仅仅赞扬独立人士，因为她认为这是原则立场。如果这位女士认为这对她来说是原则立场，她完全有权这样做，”格里芬说。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to the El-Sayed and Rogers campaigns for comment but did not immediately receive a response.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了埃尔赛义德和罗杰斯的竞选团队请其置评，但没有立即收到回复。

paras.en: Shroff argued the Cheney comparison did not hold up, telling Fox News Digital, "Cheney crossed party lines because of Trump’s conduct and her stated concerns about democracy. Stevens, by contrast, says she is crossing party lines because she cannot tolerate hate, yet she is endorsing Mike Rogers in a race where anti-Muslim hate has been Rogers’s central campaign strategy."
paras.zh: 史洛夫认为切尼的比较并不成立，她告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，“切尼因为特朗普的行为和她对民主的担忧而跨越了党派界限。相比之下，史蒂文斯说她跨越党派界限是因为她不能容忍仇恨，但她在一场反穆斯林仇恨一直是罗杰斯核心竞选策略的竞选中支持迈克·罗杰斯。”

paras.en: "Moreover, Haley still maintains that Republicans — folks like Mike Rogers — are allowing Trump to act as a ‘dictator.’ It just doesn’t add up any way you try," he said.
paras.zh: “此外，黑利仍然坚持认为共和党人——像迈克·罗杰斯这样的人——正在允许特朗普充当‘独裁者’。无论你怎么尝试，这都是行不通的，”他说。

articles.title: Oil price falls amid hope of a breakthrough to end Iran war
articles.author: Graeme Wearden

paras.en: The oil price has fallen to its lowest level in more two weeks amid new hopes of a breakthrough to end the Iran war.
paras.zh: 由于结束伊朗战争取得突破的新希望，油价已跌至两周多以来的最低水平。

paras.en: Brent crude, the international benchmark, dropped by more than 6.5% to as low as $105.55 a barrel on Monday, the lowest since 16 October, sending shares in airline companies higher and pushing down government borrowing costs.
paras.zh: 国际基准布伦特原油周一下跌逾 6.5%，跌至每桶 105.55 美元，为 10 月 16 日以来的最低水平，导致航空公司股价走高，并压低政府借贷成本。

paras.en: Oil prices fell after Tehran revealed that contacts between Iran and the US to end their eight-month war were continuing.
paras.zh: 在德黑兰透露伊朗和美国之间为结束八个月战争而进行的接触仍在继续后，油价下跌。

paras.en: “Consultations through mediators are very intensive. We have presented our conditions and proposals and everything depends on the political rationality of Washington,” the Iranian foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, said, according to the state media outlet IRNA.
paras.zh: 据官方媒体伊朗伊斯兰共和国通讯社报道，伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，“通过调解人进行的磋商非常密集。我们已经提出了我们的条件和建议，一切都取决于华盛顿的政治理性。”

paras.en: Over the weekend, Qatari officials tried to negotiate the release of more than $6bn (£4.5bn) in Iranian assets, so that Tehran might allow the strait of Hormuz to reopen.
paras.zh: 周末，卡塔尔官员试图通过谈判释放超过 60 亿美元（45 亿英镑）的伊朗资产，以便德黑兰允许霍尔​​木兹海峡重新开放。

paras.en: Donald Trump had earlier taken a belligerent tone, telling voters in Iowa on Sunday that Iran would receive “the hammer” unless there was progress.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普早些时候采取了好战的语气，周日告诉爱荷华州选民，除非取得进展，否则伊朗将受到“锤子”。

paras.en: “The only reason why I’m not finished with Iran is I want to be nice. I want to try and save all those lives if I can ... But at some point we’re going to have to give them the hammer,” he said during a campaign rally in the run-up to the US midterm elections.
paras.zh: “我在伊朗问题上没有结束的唯一原因是我想表现得友善。如果可以的话，我想尽力拯救所有这些人的生命……但在某些时候，我们将不得不向他们下手，”他在美国中期选举前夕的一次竞选集会上说道。

paras.en: But investors were cheered by reports on Monday that Iran’s supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, had granted “powers” to his government in its talks with the US seeking to end the Middle East war.
paras.zh: 但周一有报道称，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊在与美国寻求结束中东战争的谈判中授予其政府“权力”，令投资者感到振奋。

paras.en: Chris Beauchamp, the chief market analyst at the investing and trading platform IG, said: “The news is manna from heaven for stock markets, which have felt increasingly pressured by oil’s rise, but of course there is still a risk that Trump will try one last throw of the iron dice after the midterms.”
paras.zh: 投资和交易平台IG首席市场分析师克里斯·博尚(Chris Beauchamp)表示：“这个消息对股市来说简直是天赐甘露，股市因油价上涨而感受到越来越大的压力，但当然，特朗普在中期选举后尝试最后一掷的风险仍然存在。”

paras.en: The drop in the oil price sparked hopes of a break in the inflationary pressures gripping the global economy. Government borrowing costs dropped, with the yield – or interest rate – on 10-year UK bonds down 10 basis points, or 0.1 of a percentage point, to the lowest since 22 September.
paras.zh: 油价下跌引发了全球经济通胀压力得到缓解的希望。政府借贷成本下降，英国 10 年期债券收益率（或利率）下降 10 个基点，即 0.1 个百分点，降至 9 月 22 日以来的最低水平。

paras.en: Shares in British Airways’ parent company, IAG, rose by 4.2% in London, while United Airlines jumped 7% in New York.
paras.zh: 英国航空母公司 IAG 的股价在伦敦上涨 4.2%，联合航空在纽约的股价上涨 7%。

articles.title: French pupils resume school blockades as country braces for more protests
articles.author: Angelique Chrisafis in Paris

paras.en: Dozens of high schools across France were blockaded again on Monday as the government braced for another tense week of protests over school conditions and the high cost of living.
paras.zh: 周一，法国各地数十所高中再次被封锁，政府准备迎接又一周因学校条件和高昂生活成本而引发的紧张抗议活动。

paras.en: The protests come amid warnings that weeks without lessons are putting some pupils’ school year and final exams at risk.
paras.zh: 抗议活动发生之际，有人警告称，数周停课将使一些学生的学年和期末考试面临风险。

paras.en: As children returned after the two-week school holiday, students’ unions ignored Emmanuel Macron’s call to end the lycée blockades, which have been running since September and have prompted one of the biggest protest movements and social crises of his presidency.
paras.zh: 两周的学校假期结束后，学生们纷纷返校，学生会无视马克龙关于结束中学封锁的呼吁。封锁自去年 9 月以来一直持续，并引发了马克龙总统任期内最大规模的抗议运动和社会危机之一。

paras.en: From early morning in Paris and its suburbs, as well as in cities including Lille, Toulouse and Marseille, schoolchildren demanding more replacement teachers and repairs to buildings barricaded school entrances with wheelie bins. Police officers outside some schools attempted to drag the bins away and made arrests.
paras.zh: 从清晨起，在巴黎及其郊区，以及里尔、图卢兹和马赛等城市，学童们就用带轮垃圾箱封锁了学校入口，要求更换更多教师并修缮建筑物。一些学校外的警察试图将垃圾箱拖走并进行逮捕。

paras.en: University students’ unions were planning additional barricades at faculties on Tuesday. Trade unions have called for a large-scale strike on Thursday, with rail workers, teachers and private-sector employees planning to join demonstrations in cities across France to support schoolchildren’s demands for better conditions and protest against the rising cost of living and low salaries.
paras.zh: 大学生工会计划周二在各院系设置更多路障。工会呼吁周四举行大规模罢工，铁路工人、教师和私营部门雇员计划参加法国各地城市的示威活动，支持学童对更好条件的要求，并抗议生活成本上涨和工资过低。

paras.en: Nathanaël Combary from the school students’ union Renouveau Lycéen, who is also a member of Macron’s centrist party Renaissance, said schoolchildren must keep going in their “battle of strength” with the government to push for more funding, better access to higher education and repairs to decrepit schools.
paras.zh: 来自学生会Renouveau Lycéen的纳撒纳尔·康巴里(Nathanaël Combary)也是马克龙中间派复兴党的成员，他表示，学童必须继续与政府进行“力量之战”，以推动更多资金、更好的接受高等教育的机会以及修复破旧的学校。

paras.en: He said measures offered by the government last week to cap some class sizes and review the university applications platform were inadequate. Combary told BFMTV that protests were the only way for schoolchildren to push a government response. He said: “Democratically speaking it’s a bit scandalous that we have to reach this type of situation to be heard but it’s the only solution we have.”
paras.zh: 他表示，政府上周提出的限制班级规模和审查大学申请平台的措施是不够的。 Combary 告诉 BFMTV，抗议是学童推动政府做出反应的唯一途径。他说：“从民主角度来说，我们必须达到这种情况才能被听到，这有点可耻，但这是我们唯一的解决方案。”

paras.en: The education minister, Édouard Geffray, said he feared the school year was now “at risk” for many students in their final years who had missed weeks of classes because of the blockades and would be unable to complete coursework or catch up on the curriculum for exams.
paras.zh: 教育部长爱德华·杰弗雷 (Édouard Geffray) 表示，他担心对于许多最后几年的学生来说，本学年现在“面临风险”，他们因封锁而缺课数周，无法完成课程作业或赶上考试课程。

paras.en: He said: “We have pupils who are sitting their baccalauréat at the end of the year who for hundreds of thousands of them have had no classes for four or five weeks if you include holidays, and for whom the school year is now at risk. And that’s something that we can’t allow.”
paras.zh: 他说：“我们有一些学生在年底参加中学毕业考试，如果算上假期的话，数十万学生已经有四五周没有上课了，他们的学年现在面临着风险。这是我们不能允许的事情。”

paras.en: Geffray said the school blockades were “illegal” and his priority was for children to return to class.
paras.zh: 杰弗雷表示，封锁学校是“非法的”，他的首要任务是让孩子们重返课堂。

paras.en: In Montpellier, the Socialist senator Hussein Bourgi accused the government of “misconduct” and “provocation” after video footage showed a 53-year-old school nurse saying something to police near a school barricade before being forced face-down to the ground, handcuffed and taken into police custody. The local prefect, in charge of police operations, defended the arrest, saying the woman had insulted officers and resisted police.
paras.zh: 在蒙彼利埃，社会党参议员侯赛因·布尔吉 (Hussein Bourgi) 指责政府“行为不当”和“挑衅”，因为视频显示一名 53 岁的学校护士在学校路障附近对警察说了些什么，然后被迫面朝下倒在地上，戴上手铐并被警方拘留。负责警方行动的当地长官为逮捕行为进行了辩护，称该女子侮辱了警察并反抗警察。

paras.en: The education ministry said 41 high schools were blocked across France – around 1% of the nationwide total. Students’ unions put the figure at 150.
paras.zh: 教育部表示，法国全国有 41 所高中被封锁，约占全国总数的 1%。学生会称这一数字为 150 人。

paras.en: Nicolas Bonnet, of the headteachers’ union SNPDEN-UNSA, said: “It’s time for us to return to our job: teaching and supporting pupils.” He warned that coursework, final-year exams and university applications were at risk.
paras.zh: 校长工会 SNPDEN-UNSA 的尼古拉斯·博内特 (Nicolas Bonnet) 表示：“现在是我们回归工作的时候了：教学和支持学生。”他警告说，课程作业、期末考试和大学申请都面临风险。

paras.en: He said he understood why high-school students felt the government had not offered enough to fix problems in schools, but urged more dialogue between the government and pupils.
paras.zh: 他说，他理解为什么高中生认为政府没有提供足够的资金来解决学校的问题，但他敦促政府和学生之间进行更多对话。

paras.en: The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, said he would meet school students’ unions again next week.
paras.zh: 总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努表示，他将于下周再次与学校学生会会面。

articles.title: Fossilised red blood cells found in 115m-year-old dinosaur’s bone, say scientists
articles.author: Ian Sample Science editor

paras.en: It could be the opening of a Jurassic Park rip-off: scientists examining ancient dinosaur bones find what appear to be fossilised red blood cells, and traces of the molecule that gives the beast’s blood its distinctive crimson hue.
paras.zh: 这可能是侏罗纪公园盗版的开始：科学家们在检查古代恐龙骨骼时发现了似乎是化石的红细胞，以及赋予恐龙血液独特深红色调的分子痕迹。

paras.en: But that is what researchers are claiming to have discovered after analysing the hind leg bones of a small, meat-eating dinosaur called an Aratasaurus that lived and died in what is now north-eastern Brazil 115m years ago.
paras.zh: 但这是研究人员声称在分析一种名为阿拉塔龙的小型食肉恐龙的后腿骨后发现的，这种恐龙于 1.15 亿年前生活和死亡于现在的巴西东北部。

paras.en: Electron microscope images of the dinosaur bones revealed small, round structures that resemble red blood cells in fine channels where blood vessels once ran, while chemical tests identified the presence of heme, the organic compound that allows haemoglobin in blood to carry oxygen around the body.
paras.zh: 恐龙骨骼的电子显微镜图像显示出微小的圆形结构，类似于血管曾经运行的细通道中的红细胞，而化学测试发现了血红素的存在，血红素是一种允许血液中的血红蛋白将氧气携带到全身的有机化合物。

paras.en: Such claims are controversial because biological tissues and molecules can break down fast, leaving little or no trace in ancient fossils. But if confirmed, it would open up entirely new avenues for scientists, allowing them to investigate dinosaur blood, metabolism and even their activity levels.
paras.zh: 这种说法是有争议的，因为生物组织和分子可以快速分解，在古代化石中留下很少或根本没有痕迹。但如果得到证实，它将为科学家开辟全新的途径，使他们能够研究恐龙的血液、新陈代谢甚至活动水平。

paras.en: “We are seeing a mineral and molecular echo of the dinosaur’s original biology,” said Prof Kliti Grice at Curtin University in Western Australia who led the research team. “Fossilised red blood cells with distinct chemistry related to heme have never been found in situ in any fossil, let alone a dinosaur. This is a world first.”
paras.zh: “我们看到了恐龙原始生物学的矿物和分子回声，”领导该研究小组的西澳大利亚科廷大学克利蒂·格赖斯教授说。 “从未在任何化石中原位发现过具有与血红素相关的独特化学成分的红细胞化石，更不用说恐龙了。这是世界首例。”

paras.en: The fossilised remnants of the Aratasaurus were discovered in a mine in 2008 and have since been held in the National Museum of Brazil, where researchers continue to study them. While analysing the dinosaur’s hind leg bones, Grice spotted the structures that resembled red blood cells.
paras.zh: 阿拉塔龙的化石残骸于 2008 年在一个矿井中被发现，此后一直保存在巴西国家博物馆，研究人员继续在那里研究它们。在分析恐龙的后腿骨骼时，格赖斯发现了类似于红细胞的结构。

paras.en: The scientists’ suspicions that they were looking at red blood cells were bolstered when chemical tests came back positive for heme and its breakdown products. Tests also found traces of the amino acid building blocks for collagen, a key protein in connective and other tissues.
paras.zh: 当化学测试结果显示血红素及其分解产物呈阳性时，科学家们更加怀疑他们正在观察红细胞。测试还发现了胶原蛋白的氨基酸组成部分的痕迹，胶原蛋白是结缔组织和其他组织中的关键蛋白质。

paras.en: If the structures really are fossilised red blood cells, as the researchers contend, it raises the question of how they were preserved. According to Grice, a manganese compound called hausmannite, which formed in and around the blood cells, may have lent a helping hand by stabilising them prior to fossilisation. The same process might have helped preserve the amino acids, she added. The study appears in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
paras.zh: 如果这些结构确实是红细胞化石，正如研究人员所说，这就提出了它们如何保存的问题。格赖斯表示，一种叫做黑锰矿的锰化合物形成于血细胞内部和周围，可能在血细胞石化之前稳定它们，从而起到了帮助作用。她补充说，同样的过程可能有助于保存氨基酸。该研究发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上。

paras.en: The work is already stoking debate. Prof Mary Schweitzer at North Carolina State University in the US, who has discovered remnants of blood vessels and soft tissues in dinosaur fossils, is not convinced Grice and her colleagues have found red blood cells. One reason for her doubt is that the dinosaur’s red blood cells should have a “nuclear bulge” making them appear dome-like on both sides. The structures Grice found are concave, suggesting they might be something else.
paras.zh: 这项工作已经引发了争论。美国北卡罗来纳州立大学的玛丽·施韦策教授在恐龙化石中发现了血管和软组织的残留物，但她并不相信格赖斯和她的同事们已经发现了红细胞。她怀疑的原因之一是恐龙的红细胞应该有一个“核凸起”，使它们的两侧看起来像圆顶。格赖斯发现的结构是凹面的，这表明它们可能是别的东西。

paras.en: Schweitzer was more persuaded by the discovery of heme and collagen amino acids in the bone and said there was so much more to learn from exceptionally well-preserved fossils. Schweitzer added: “The conventional wisdom in palaeontology that all endogenous organics would disappear in a million years or less is being routinely challenged, and will continue to be as technological approaches to palaeontological specimens are more routinely applied.”
paras.zh: 施韦策对骨骼中血红素和胶原氨基酸的发现更加信服，并表示从保存完好的化石中可以学到更多东西。施韦策补充道：“古生物学中的传统观点认为，所有内源有机物都会在一百万年或更短的时间内消失，这种观点经常受到挑战，而且随着古生物学标本的技术方法得到更广泛的应用，这种挑战将继续存在。”

paras.en: Another question the research raises is what other biological material might lurk in fossils collections around the world. On this, Grice urges extreme caution, adding that her work does not imply that large biological molecules such as proteins or DNA live on in ancient fossils. “Any extraordinary claim needs extraordinary analytical evidence,” she said. “The aim isn’t to find Jurassic Park DNA, it’s to determine how much genuine molecular information deep time can preserve.”
paras.zh: 该研究提出的另一个问题是世界各地的化石收藏中可能潜藏着哪些其他生物材料。对此，格赖斯敦促要极其谨慎，并补充说，她的研究并不意味着蛋白质或 DNA 等大型生物分子存在于古代化石中。 “任何非凡的主张都需要非凡的分析证据，”她说。 “我们的目的不是寻找侏罗纪公园的 DNA，而是确定深层时间可以保存多少真实的分子信息。”

paras.en: “The really exciting implication is that extraordinary molecular information may already be sitting in museum collections around the world, waiting for us to ask new questions of old fossils,” she added.
paras.zh: “真正令人兴奋的暗示是，非凡的分子信息可能已经存在于世界各地的博物馆藏品中，等待我们对古老化石提出新的问题，”她补充道。

articles.title: Copilot in deadly Florida jet crash identified in reports as 20-year-old

paras.en: A 20-year-old copilot was among nine people killed when a small jet crashed and exploded in Florida on Sunday, according to US media.
paras.zh: 据美国媒体报道，周日一架小型飞机在佛罗里达州坠毁并爆炸，九人遇难，其中包括一名 20 岁的副驾驶。

paras.en: Nathalia Filgueiras, who earned her pilot's licence when she was 17, is reported to have been one of two crew members aboard the Learjet 60 from Austin, Texas, to the Bahamas when it crashed near West Palm Beach.
paras.zh: 娜塔莉亚·菲尔盖拉斯 (Nathalia Filgueiras) 在 17 岁时获得了飞行员执照，据报道，她是从德克萨斯州奥斯汀飞往巴哈马的里尔 60 型飞机上的两名机组人员之一，该飞机在西棕榈滩附近坠毁。

paras.en: The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) said it would investigate to what extent ice and turbulence may have contributed to the crash, and whether human error played a role.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）表示，将调查冰和湍流在多大程度上导致了坠机，以及人为错误是否起了作用。

paras.en: One man on the ground sustained a leg injury when the aircraft nosedived on to a street near Cresthaven, nine miles (14 km) from President Donald Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort.
paras.zh: 飞机急速俯冲到克雷斯特哈文附近的一条街道上，距离唐纳德·特朗普总统的海湖庄园度假村 9 英里（14 公里），地面上一名男子腿部受伤。

paras.en: Images from the scene show a large fiery crater in the middle of a residential suburban street.
paras.zh: 现场图像显示，郊区住宅街道中央有一个巨大的火坑。

paras.en: The debris was scattered across sports fields, businesses and homes in the area, officials told a news conference on Monday, possible evidence that the plane broke up before it hit the ground.
paras.zh: 官员们在周一的新闻发布会上表示，碎片散落在该地区的运动场、企业和住宅中，这可能证明飞机在落地前就解体了。

paras.en: The NTSB confirmed that after the jet took off from Austin, the crew transmitted to air traffic control that they were encountering ice and moderate turbulence.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会证实，飞机从奥斯汀起飞后，机组人员向空中交通管制中心报告称，他们遇到了结冰和中度湍流。

paras.en: "We are picking up precipitation, requesting to climb to 37,000 feet if able," the crew said.
paras.zh: “我们正在收集降水，如果可能的话，我们请求爬升到 37,000 英尺，”机组人员说。

paras.en: NTSB member Tom Chapman said that less than 30 seconds later, the plane began to descend and the crew issued a mayday call.
paras.zh: NTSB成员汤姆·查普曼表示，不到30秒后，飞机开始下降，机组人员发出求救信号。

paras.en: The transmission then became "unintelligible", he said, adding that: "Sadly, all aboard were lost."
paras.zh: 他说，传输信息随后变得“难以理解”，并补充道：“可悲的是，船上所有人都失踪了。”

paras.en: Flight analysis indicates the jet was plummeting hundreds of feet per second before crashing.
paras.zh: 飞行分析表明，这架飞机在坠毁前以每秒数百英尺的速度垂直下降。

paras.en: In air traffic control audio, a crew member can be heard declaring an emergency, shouting "we are in an overspeed condition descending 20,000ft per minute", before saying, "we are going to crash into the ground".
paras.zh: 在空中交通管制音频中，可以听到一名机组人员宣布紧急情况，大喊“我们处于每分钟下降 20,000 英尺的超速状态”，然后又说“我们将坠落到地面”。

paras.en: About 35 seconds after the initial mayday announcement, the last remark from the cockpit appears to be "we're out of time".
paras.zh: 在最初的求救消息发布后大约 35 秒，驾驶舱内的最后一句话似乎是“我们没时间了”。

paras.en: Filgueiras's mother, Camila Corteleti, confirmed to US media that her daughter had died in the fireball.
paras.zh: 菲尔盖拉斯的母亲卡米拉·科尔特莱蒂向美国媒体证实，她的女儿在火球中丧生。

paras.en: Corteleti told the New York Times: "She loved the freedom. It was completely different seeing the world from the top."
paras.zh: 科特莱蒂告诉《纽约时报》：“她热爱自由。从高处看世界是完全不同的。”

paras.en: In a 2023 interview with a local news affiliate of CBS News, Filgueiras spoke proudly of receiving her pilot's licence while still a senior in high school.
paras.zh: 2023 年，菲尔盖拉斯在接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻的当地新闻附属机构采访时，自豪地谈到自己在高中四年级时就获得了飞行员执照。

paras.en: "I like being different than everyone," she said. "Some people think that it's weird that I can fly planes, but I can't drive a car, I mean I can but, a lot of people think it's funny."
paras.zh: “我喜欢与每个人不同，”她说。 “有些人认为我可以开飞机，但我不能开车，这很奇怪，我的意思是我可以，但是，很多人认为这很有趣。”

paras.en: None of the other eight people on board has been identified.
paras.zh: 机上其他八人的身份尚未确定。

paras.en: The NTSB said that ice and turbulence were factors in the crash.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，冰和湍流是导致坠机的因素。

paras.en: Officials are also trying to find out whether a cockpit voice recorder was on board at the time of the crash and if it can be recovered.
paras.zh: 官员们还在试图查明坠机时机上是否有驾驶舱录音机以及是否可以恢复。

paras.en: The NTSB said determining the probable cause of the crash will be a "lengthy investigatory process".
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，确定坠机的可能原因将是一个“漫长的调查过程”。

paras.en: As part of the investigation, the NTSB is working with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), representatives from Learjet as well as meteorologists and air traffic control experts.
paras.zh: 作为调查的一部分，国家运输安全委员会正在与美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA)、里尔喷气机公司的代表以及气象学家和空中交通管制专家合作。

paras.en: Recovering the wreckage from the crater on the roadway will be a "daunting challenge", said Timothy Monville, an air safety investigator with the NTSB.
paras.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 航空安全调查员蒂莫西·蒙维尔 (Timothy Monville) 表示，从道路上的弹坑中打捞残骸将是一项“艰巨的挑战”。

paras.en: He added that an individual who was in a vehicle near the crash site sustained a leg injury.
paras.zh: 他补充说，事故现场附近一辆汽车内的一名人员腿部受伤。

paras.en: Unverified footage posted on social media shows what appears to be a dash-camera recording of the moment of the crash.
paras.zh: 社交媒体上发布的未经证实的视频显示，行车记录仪似乎记录了事故发生的瞬间。

paras.en: "When you see that video, it's a jarring thing," Florida Governor Ron DeSantis told reporters at a news conference on Sunday. "It's like a missile coming down, and a massive explosion, debris going everywhere."
paras.zh: “当你看到这段视频时，这是一件令人震惊的事情，”佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯在周日的新闻发布会上告诉记者。 “这就像一枚导弹坠落，然后发生大规模爆炸，碎片散得到处都是。”

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described the crash as a "horrific tragedy".
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲称这次事故是一场“可怕的悲剧”。

paras.en: The Palm Beach County Sheriff's Office said the crash happened on Military Trail, a six-lane road lined with businesses and restaurants.
paras.zh: 棕榈滩县治安官办公室表示，事故发生在军事步道上，这是一条六车道的道路，两旁都是企业和餐馆。

paras.en: Thunderstorms had been reported in the area at the time of the crash.
paras.zh: 据报道坠机时该地区有雷暴。

paras.en: Trump was at Mar-a-Lago on Sunday morning, and departed from an airport nearby on Air Force One about an hour before the crash.
paras.zh: 周日早上，特朗普在海湖庄园，并在坠机事件发生前大约一小时乘坐空军一号从附近的机场出发。

articles.title: Man guilty of stealing cash from farm owned by South African president

paras.en: A court in South Africa has found a man guilty of stealing more than $500,000 (Â£372,822) in cash from a farm owned by South African president Cyril Ramaphosa, in a case that mired the head of state in an impeachment saga.
paras.zh: 南非一家法院判定一名男子从南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨 (Cyril Ramaphosa) 拥有的农场盗窃了超过 50 万美元（合 372,822 英镑）的现金，此案使国家元首陷入弹劾传奇。

paras.en: Imanuwela David was found guilty of theft on Monday, as well as conspiracy to commit housebreaking with intent to steal at Phala Phala farm in the Limpopo province in 2020.
paras.zh: 周一，伊马努韦拉·大卫 (Imanuwela David) 被判犯有盗窃罪，并于 2020 年在林波波省的 Phala Phala 农场合谋入室盗窃。

paras.en: Froliana Joseph, a cleaner at the property, was also found guilty of conspiracy to commit housebreaking with intent to steal.
paras.zh: 该物业的清洁工弗洛丽安娜·约瑟夫 (Froliana Joseph) 也被判犯有串谋入室盗窃罪。

paras.en: Her brother, Ndilinasho Joseph, was acquitted on all charges.
paras.zh: 她的兄弟恩迪利纳肖·约瑟夫 (Ndilinasho Joseph) 所有指控均被无罪释放。

paras.en: David was accused of breaking into the cattle farm in February 2020 and taking $580,000 (Â£432,000) in cash from a sofa on the property. David then went on a spending spree, buying a range of cars including three Mercedes - among them one for his girlfriend - a Porsche, two Volkswagens as well as diamond-encrusted Rolex watches and a house.
paras.zh: 大卫被指控于 2020 年 2 月闯入养牛场，并从农场的沙发上拿走了 58 万美元（43.2 万英镑）现金。随后，大卫开始疯狂消费，购买了一系列汽车，包括三辆奔驰（其中一辆是给他女朋友的）、一辆保时捷、两辆大众汽车以及镶钻劳力士手表和一栋房子。

paras.en: David told the court he had made the money through businesses including diamonds and Bitcoin, claims the court rejected. The court also found that David was the only one of the two convicted who had any of the stolen cash in his bank account.
paras.zh: 大卫告诉法庭，他是通过钻石和比特币等业务赚到钱的，但法庭驳回了这一说法。法院还发现，大卫是两名被定罪者中唯一一个在银行账户中存有被盗现金的人。

paras.en: Pre-sentencing will take place on 13 November.
paras.zh: 预判将于 11 月 13 日进行。

paras.en: There have been many twists and turns in what is known as the Farmgate scandal.
paras.zh: 所谓的“农场门”丑闻经历了许多曲折。

paras.en: The theft was largely unknown until 2022 when it was brought to light by Arthur Fraser, South Africa's former intelligence chief and an ally for the former president Jacob Zuma, when he claimed that Ramaphosa hid the theft from the police and tax authorities.
paras.zh: 这起盗窃案直到 2022 年才被南非前情报局长、前总统雅各布·祖马的盟友阿瑟·弗雷泽曝光，当时他声称拉马福萨向警方和税务机关隐瞒了这起盗窃案。

paras.en: Ramaphosa admitted the theft took place but denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 拉马福萨承认发生了盗窃事件，但否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: An independent panel that same year found Ramaphosa could have questions to answer over the burglary. MPs voted against establishing an impeachment inquiry.
paras.zh: 同年，一个独立小组发现拉马福萨可能对入室盗窃案有疑问需要回答。议员们投票反对建立弹劾调查。

paras.en: In May this year, the constitutional court ruled that parliament had acted unlawfully by shelving the panel's report, and in July Ramaphosa blocked the parliamentary inquiry through a provincial court.
paras.zh: 今年5月，宪法法院裁定议会搁置该小组报告的行为非法，7月拉马福萨通过省法院阻止了议会调查。

articles.title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says

paras.en: At least 26 people were killed after Russian bombs hit an aid distribution centre, in an attack that Ukraine's leader has called "utterly horrific".
paras.zh: 俄罗斯炸弹袭击了一个援助物资分发中心，造成至少 26 人死亡，乌克兰领导人称这次袭击“极其可怕”。

paras.en: Five people were injured and 27 initially reported missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit the village of Komyshuvakha in the southern Zaporizhzhia region, regional head Mykhailo Semikin said.
paras.zh: 地区负责人米哈伊洛·塞米金 (Mykhailo Semikin) 表示，至少 9 枚 3000 公斤重的空投炸弹袭击了扎波罗热州南部地区的 Komyshuvakha 村，造成 5 人受伤，27 人初步报告失踪。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that after the first strike on the local school "used for humanitarian needs", there was a second attack on the place where people were sheltering.
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，在当地“用于人道主义需求”的学校遭受第一次袭击之后，人们避难的地方又发生了第二次袭击。

paras.en: He posted a video showing a huge crater left after Monday's attack, and rescuer teams searching through the rubble.
paras.zh: 他发布了一段视频，显示周一袭击后留下一个巨大的弹坑，救援人员正在废墟中搜寻。

paras.en: The Russian military has not publicly commented.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军方尚未公开发表评论。

paras.en: Zelensky initially put the death toll at 18, but Ukraine's state emergencies service DSNS later said 24 people, including two rescuers and four police officers, were confirmed to have been killed.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基最初称死亡人数为18人，但乌克兰国家紧急服务机构DSNS后来表示，确认有24人死亡，其中包括两名救援人员和四名警察。

paras.en: In his video address late on Monday, Zelensky said 26 people were now known to have died.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在周一晚间的视频讲话中表示，目前已知有 26 人死亡。

paras.en: He earlier said that "the Russians could not have been unaware that the local residents who remained in Komyshuvakha received humanitarian aid there every week" on Monday.
paras.zh: 他早些时候表示，“俄罗斯人不可能不知道，留在科梅舒瓦哈的当地居民每周都会在那里接受人道主义援助”。

paras.en: "This is yet another proof that Russia does not want any de-escalation."
paras.zh: “这再次证明俄罗斯不希望局势缓和。”

paras.en: He said that after a recent successful joint Russian-Ukrainian operation to evacuate civilians from the Russia-occupied southern city of Oleshky during a temporary ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump, "there was a moment when the next steps could show that peace is possible".
paras.zh: 他说，在美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的临时停火期间，俄罗斯和乌克兰最近成功从俄罗斯占领的南部城市奥列什基撤离平民，“有那么一刻，下一步行动可能表明和平是可能的”。

paras.en: "With such killings, Russia is sending the exact opposite signal - Russia is counting on further killings," Zelensky said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基说：“通过此类杀戮，俄罗斯发出了完全相反的信号——俄罗斯指望进一步杀戮。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Semikin described the Russian attack as a "terrible tragedy" for the village, confirming that "people are still under the rubble".
paras.zh: 与此同时，塞米金将俄罗斯的袭击描述为该村庄的一场“可怕的悲剧”，并证实“人们仍然在废墟下”。

paras.en: He said rescue teams were working at the scene, but they had been forced to halt their operation a number of times because of Russian drone attacks in the area.
paras.zh: 他说，救援队正在现场开展工作，但由于俄罗斯无人机袭击该地区，他们多次被迫停止行动。

paras.en: A day of mourning has been declared for Tuesday across the entire Zaporizhzhia region.
paras.zh: 整个扎波罗热地区宣布周二为哀悼日。

paras.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京于2022年2月对乌克兰发动全面入侵。

paras.en: Teams from Ukraine, Russia and the US are due to resume peace talks in the next few days after negotiations were suspended in February, with Moscow stepping up attacks as Kyiv virtually ran out of Western-supplied interceptors to defend against missiles.
paras.zh: 乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国的谈判在二月份暂停后，预计将在未来几天内恢复和平谈判，莫斯科加大了攻击力度，因为基辅几乎耗尽了西方提供的拦截导弹。

paras.en: However, no major breakthrough is expected at the talks that are likely to be held in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 然而，预计在阿联酋阿布扎比举行的会谈不会取得重大突破。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将出现在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible.
