articles.title: FORVIA Partners With Raiqon to Advance AI Engineering
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: FORVIA, a global automotive supplier, and Raiqon GmbH have formed a strategic partnership to advance artificial intelligence in automotive engineering. Raiqon specializes in scalable AI solutions for regulated engineering environments.
paras.zh: 全球汽车供应商 FORVIA 和 Raiqon GmbH 建立了战略合作伙伴关系，以推进汽车工程领域的人工智能。 Raiqon 专注于为受监管的工程环境提供可扩展的人工智能解决方案。

paras.en: The partnership focuses on applying artificial intelligence (AI) to requirements engineering, a critical step in product development. This process involves defining, analyzing and managing technical requirements. Depending on product complexity, development projects can involve up to 15,000 individual requirements.
paras.zh: 此次合作的重点是将人工智能 (AI) 应用到需求工程中，这是产品开发的关键一步。此过程涉及定义、分析和管理技术要求。根据产品的复杂程度，开发项目可能涉及多达 15,000 个单独的需求。

paras.en: FORVIA Integrates AI Into Engineering Processes
paras.zh: FORVIA 将人工智能集成到工程流程中

paras.en: FORVIA will deploy the solution within its secure IT environment using Raiqon’s multi-agent AI platform. The platform integrates data from multiple engineering applications. The companies are adapting the solution to the specific needs of FORVIA HELLA and Faurecia Clarion Electronics.
paras.zh: FORVIA 将使用 Raiqon 的多代理人工智能平台在其安全 IT 环境中部署该解决方案。该平台集成了来自多个工程应用程序的数据。两家公司正在调整该解决方案以满足 FORVIA HELLA 和佛吉亚歌乐电子的特定需求。

paras.en: The platform automates key activities across the development process, including requirement analysis, identification of similarities and reuse of previous assessments. It also detects inconsistencies and automatically creates missing links.
paras.zh: 该平台自动执行整个开发过程中的关键活动，包括需求分析、相似性识别和先前评估的重用。它还可以检测不一致并自动创建缺失的链接。

paras.en: By reducing manual effort, the solution allows engineers to focus on new requirements while increasing productivity.
paras.zh: 通过减少手动工作，该解决方案使工程师能够专注于新的需求，同时提高生产力。

paras.en: “Artificial Intelligence is becoming a key enabler of innovation and competitiveness in the automotive industry,” said Martin Fischer, CEO of FORVIA. “Through our partnership with Raiqon, and as part of our IGNITE transformation journey, we are accelerating the digital transformation of our engineering processes, empowering our teams to work more efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety and compliance. This collaboration demonstrates FORVIA’s commitment to leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver faster innovation and greater value to our customers.”
paras.zh: FORVIA 首席执行官 Martin Fischer 表示：“人工智能正在成为汽车行业创新和竞争力的关键推动者。” “通过与 Raiqon 的合作，作为 IGNITE 转型之旅的一部分，我们正在加速工程流程的数字化转型，使我们的团队能够更高效地工作，同时保持最高的质量、安全和合规标准。此次合作表明了 FORVIA 致力于利用尖端技术为客户提供更快的创新和更大的价值。”

paras.en: Partnership Targets Engineering Efficiency
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系以工程效率为目标

paras.en: “AI-based automation of requirements engineering is a key element in becoming faster and more efficient, and thereby further enhancing our competitiveness,” said Joerg Weisgerber, managing director of electronics at FORVIA HELLA. “Together with Raiqon, we have built a solution tailored to our needs that integrates directly into our existing IBM DOORS environment and enables our teams to handle a significantly higher volume of requirements.”
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 电子部总经理 Joerg Weisgerber 表示：“基于人工智能的需求工程自动化是变得更快、更高效的关键要素，从而进一步增强我们的竞争力。” “我们与 Raiqon 一起构建了一个根据我们的需求量身定制的解决方案，该解决方案直接集成到我们现有的 IBM DOORS 环境中，并使我们的团队能够处理数量显着增加的需求。”

paras.en: “The automotive industry is facing increasing international pressure to accelerate development cycles, improve economic efficiency and manage growing complexity at the same time,” said Szabi Koppany, CEO of Raiqon. “The rapid and effective introduction of AI into engineering processes is one of the key levers for remaining competitive in the future. Our shared goal is to sustainably improve the efficiency and quality of engineering processes and support FORVIA in strengthening its leadership position in the automotive industry.”
paras.zh: Raiqon 首席执行官 Szabi Koppany 表示：“汽车行业面临着越来越大的国际压力，要求加快开发周期、提高经济效益并同时管理日益增长的复杂性。” “将人工智能快速有效地引入工程流程是未来保持竞争力的关键杠杆之一。我们的共同目标是持续提高工程流程的效率和质量，并支持 FORVIA 巩固其在汽车行业的领导地位。”

articles.title: Autel Ushers in New Era of HVAC Diagnostics
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Autel U.S. is hosting a full day of advanced automotive HVAC and thermal-management training today at the Hilton Garden Inn Roslyn in Port Washington, New York. Led by Autel U.S. founder and MaxiHVAC AC909 developer Gary DeLuca and Gary Machiros, owner of Applied Automotive Technology and ASE Master Technician and instructor, the program brings together a full room of automotive technicians and educators from across the country to learn more about the company’s MaxiHVAC AC909 Advanced A/C Diagnostic System and its disruptive approach to diagnosing increasingly complex vehicle HVAC and thermal-management systems.
paras.zh: Autel 美国公司今天在纽约华盛顿港罗斯林希尔顿花园酒店举办一整天的高级汽车 HVAC 和热管理培训。该项目由 Autel 美国创始人兼 MaxiHVAC AC909 开发人员 Gary DeLuca 和 Applied Automotive Technology 所有者兼 ASE 主技师兼讲师 Gary Machiros 领导，汇集了来自全国各地的汽车技术人员和教育工作者，详细了解该公司的 MaxiHVAC AC909 高级空调诊断系统及其诊断日益复杂的车辆 HVAC 和热管理系统的颠覆性方法。

paras.en: “On the side of your chairs, there should be seat belts because we’re going to go 110 miles an hour. We’ll lock in there and go. All I’m doing is giving out the information that I’ve learned and put into the tool to make you a better tech,” DeLuca said. The ultimate goal, he explained, is to help technicians diagnose and repair HVAC and thermal-management systems more effectively, positioning independent repair businesses to address the increasingly sophisticated service requirements of today’s vehicle fleet.
paras.zh: “你的椅子旁边应该有安全带，因为我们的时速要达到 110 英里。我们会锁定在那里然后继续前进。我所做的就是给出我学到的信息，并将其放入工具中，让你成为更好的技术人员，”德卢卡说。他解释说，最终目标是帮助技术人员更有效地诊断和维修 HVAC 和热管理系统，定位独立维修业务，以满足当今车队日益复杂的服务需求。

paras.en: The introduction of the AC909 comes as vehicle thermal-management technology continues to evolve beyond traditional passenger cabin cooling. Modern systems, particularly those found in hybrid and electric vehicles, incorporate electric compressors, multiple evaporators, electronic expansion valves, heat exchangers and sophisticated electronic controls. These advancements are creating new diagnostic challenges for technicians while increasing the need for equipment capable of evaluating the interaction between mechanical, electrical and refrigerant systems.
paras.zh: AC909 的推出正值车辆热管理技术不断发展超越传统客舱冷却之际。现代系统，特别是混合动力和电动汽车中的系统，包含电动压缩机、多个蒸发器、电子膨胀阀、热交换器和复杂的电子控制装置。这些进步给技术人员带来了新的诊断挑战，同时增加了对能够评估机械、电气和制冷系统之间相互作用的设备的需求。

paras.en: Tom Lech, a fourth-generation technician and owner of Lech Auto Air Conditioning in San Francisco, California, emphasized how automotive A/C technology is increasingly adopting principles and components long used in commercial refrigeration and HVAC applications. Drawing on decades of experience in both industries, Lech explained that traditional pressure-based diagnostic methods are no longer sufficient for evaluating today’s electronically controlled systems. Instead, technicians must understand refrigerant saturation, superheat, subcooling and the electronic controls that regulate system operation.
paras.zh: Tom Lech 是第四代技术人员，也是加利福尼亚州旧金山 Lech 汽车空调公司的所有者，他强调了汽车空调技术如何越来越多地采用商业制冷和 HVAC 应用中长期使用的原理和组件。凭借在这两个行业数十年的经验，莱赫解释说，传统的基于压力的诊断方法已不足以评估当今的电子控制系统。相反，技术人员必须了解制冷剂饱和度、过热度、过冷度以及调节系统运行的电子控制装置。

paras.en: Lech noted that commercial HVAC technicians have already transitioned toward digital diagnostic platforms that integrate physical measurements with software-based analysis. He sees the AC909 as bringing those established diagnostic practices into the automotive service environment. As vehicles incorporate increasingly sophisticated thermal-management circuits, particularly in hybrid and electric applications, technicians need a more comprehensive understanding of how refrigerant flows, temperatures and electronic controls interact to deliver heating and cooling performance.
paras.zh: Lech 指出，商业暖通空调技术人员已经转向将物理测量与基于软件的分析集成在一起的数字诊断平台。他认为 AC909 将这些既定的诊断实践引入了汽车服务环境。随着车辆采用越来越复杂的热管理电路，特别是在混合动力和电动应用中，技术人员需要更全面地了解制冷剂流动、温度和电子控制如何相互作用以提供加热和冷却性能。

paras.en: The MaxiHVAC AC909 is designed to bring that diagnostic capability into the service bay. The system integrates refrigerant pressures, temperatures, humidity measurements and supported vehicle diagnostic data into a single graphical interface, allowing technicians to evaluate system performance rather than relying on individual gauge readings. Guided procedures and component testing capabilities help technicians isolate faults, identify underlying causes and verify repairs, potentially reducing unnecessary parts replacement and repeat labor.
paras.zh: MaxiHVAC AC909 旨在将诊断功能带入服务区。该系统将制冷剂压力、温度、湿度测量和支持的车辆诊断数据集成到单个图形界面中，使技术人员能够评估系统性能，而不是依赖单个仪表读数。引导程序和组件测试功能可帮助技术人员隔离故障、识别根本原因并验证维修，从而可能减少不必要的零件更换和重复劳动。

paras.en: DeLuca, who helped engineer the AC909, said the concept had been under consideration for approximately a decade, but earlier computing and connectivity limitations prevented its development. Advances in processing capabilities and Bluetooth connectivity now make it possible to integrate multiple diagnostic devices and measurements into a unified platform. He emphasized that input from experienced technicians and HVAC specialists was instrumental in bringing the technology to market.
paras.zh: 帮助设计 AC909 的 DeLuca 表示，这个概念已经被考虑了大约十年，但早期的计算和连接限制阻碍了它的发展。处理能力和蓝牙连接的进步现在使得将多个诊断设备和测量集成到一个统一的平台中成为可能。他强调，经验丰富的技术人员和暖通空调专家的意见有助于将该技术推向市场。

paras.en: Another important focus is leak detection, an ongoing challenge for automotive A/C service providers. DeLuca emphasized the need for technicians to understand both the capabilities and limitations of conventional refrigerant recovery, recycling and recharging equipment. The AC909’s broader diagnostic approach, along with advanced vacuum measurement and leak-testing capabilities available in the AC909D package, is intended to help shops identify problems more precisely, improve repair verification and minimize costly comebacks. For aftermarket service providers, these capabilities represent an opportunity to improve productivity, manage refrigerant use and retain more complex repair work in-house.
paras.zh: 另一个重要的焦点是泄漏检测，这对汽车空调服务提供商来说是一个持续的挑战。 DeLuca 强调技术人员需要了解传统制冷剂回收、再循环和再充装设备的功能和局限性。 AC909 更广泛的诊断方法以及 AC909D 套件中提供的先进真空测量和泄漏测试功能旨在帮助商店更准确地识别问题，改进维修验证并最大限度地减少成本高昂的返工。对于售后服务提供商来说，这些功能代表了提高生产力、管理制冷剂使用以及保留更复杂的内部维修工作的机会。

paras.en: Beyond the equipment itself, DeLuca stressed that technician education and industry collaboration are essential to advancing automotive HVAC service. He encouraged attendees to share their experiences and ideas for improving the system as vehicle technology continues to evolve.
paras.zh: 除了设备本身之外，德卢卡强调技术人员教育和行业合作对于推进汽车暖通空调服务也至关重要。他鼓励与会者分享随着车辆技术不断发展改进系统的经验和想法。

articles.title: ZF Expands ProVia Commercial Vehicle Parts Range
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Ten years after its launch, ZF Aftermarket is expanding its ProVia brand’s commercial vehicle spare parts portfolio. The brand offers cost-effective repair solutions for workshops, distributors, fleet operators and truck drivers. The expansion supports vehicle uptime while addressing the needs of aging vehicle fleets.
paras.zh: 推出十年后，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 正在扩大其 ProVia 品牌的商用车备件产品组合。该品牌为车间、经销商、车队运营商和卡车司机提供经济高效的维修解决方案。此次扩建可延长车辆的正常运行时间，同时满足老化车队的需求。

paras.en: ZF Plans to Triple ProVia Parts Range by 2027
paras.zh: ZF 计划到 2027 年将 ProVia 零件范围增加两倍

paras.en: The anniversary year marks a new phase in the development of the ProVia brand. The company recently added transmission spare parts to its established portfolio. Existing product ranges include air braking, air processing, ECAS, driveline control and trailer products. The expansion continues, with clutches and air compressors set to follow.
paras.zh: 周年纪念标志着 ProVia 品牌发展的新阶段。该公司最近在其现有产品组合中添加了变速箱备件。现有产品范围包括空气制动、空气处理、ECAS、传动系统控制和拖车产品。扩张仍在继续，离合器和空气压缩机也将紧随其后。

paras.en: By 2027, ZF Aftermarket plans to triple its ProVia range, adding more than 830 part numbers. The expansion will focus primarily on pneumatics and driveline-related products, prioritizing compressors, clutches and further extensions to the transmission portfolio. The company will initially launch the program across Europe, IMEA and APAC in 2026, followed by North and South America.
paras.zh: 到 2027 年，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 计划将其 ProVia 系列扩大两倍，增加 830 多个零件号。此次扩张将主要关注气动和传动系统相关产品，优先考虑压缩机、离合器以及变速箱产品组合的进一步扩展。该公司将于 2026 年首先在欧洲、IMEA 和亚太地区推出该计划，随后在北美和南美推出。

paras.en: ProVia Offers Repair Options for Aging Commercial Vehicles
paras.zh: ProVia 为老化商用车提供维修选项

paras.en: Commercial vehicle operators increasingly need cost-effective repair options that extend vehicle life while maintaining quality, safety and reliability. ProVia addresses this need with aftermarket spare parts that combine cost efficiency with dependable performance.
paras.zh: 商用车运营商越来越需要经济高效的维修方案，以延长车辆使用寿命，同时保持质量、安全性和可靠性。 ProVia 通过将成本效益与可靠性能相结合的售后备件满足了这一需求。

paras.en: ZF Aftermarket develops ProVia parts according to original equipment (OE) production quality standards and dedicated ProVia aftermarket specifications. The company bases these specifications on original equipment manufacturer (OEM) requirements and benchmark testing.
paras.zh: ZF Aftermarket 根据原始设备 (OE) 生产质量标准和专用 ProVia 售后市场规范开发 ProVia 零件。该公司根据原始设备制造商 (OEM) 的要求和基准测试制定了这些规范。

paras.en: The quality approach includes advanced supplier qualification, repeatable and approved production processes and 100% end-of-line testing before packaging. The company also conducts in-house validation tests to confirm performance and longevity. ZF Aftermarket applies certifications such as ISO, TÜV, SAE or ECE where required.
paras.zh: 质量方法包括先进的供应商资格、可重复且经过批准的生产流程以及包装前 100% 的下线测试。该公司还进行内部验证测试以确认性能和寿命。采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket) 根据需要采用 ISO、TÜV、SAE 或 ECE 等认证。

paras.en: This approach supports the expansion into additional product categories, giving customers more options to maintain commercial vehicles efficiently and cost-effectively.
paras.zh: 这种方法支持扩展到其他产品类别，为客户提供更多选择，以高效且经济高效地维护商用车。

paras.en: “Over the past ten years, ProVia has helped customers keep commercial vehicles on the road with reliable, cost-efficient spare parts. As the market continues to demand practical solutions for aging fleets, we are expanding the range in the areas that matter most to workshops, distributors, fleet operators and the truck drivers who depend on vehicle uptime every day – from transmission parts to clutches and air compressors. This is how ProVia delivers trusted value while supporting vehicle uptime,” says Aleksander Rabinovitch, head of Business Line Commercial Vehicles, ZF Aftermarket.
paras.zh: “过去十年来，ProVia 帮助客户通过可靠、经济高效的备件确保商用车继续行驶。随着市场不断需要针对老化车队的实用解决方案，我们正在扩大对车间、经销商、车队运营商和每天依赖车辆正常运行的卡车司机最重要的领域的产品范围，从变速箱部件到离合器和空气压缩机。这就是 ProVia 在支持车辆正常运行时间的同时提供值得信赖的价值的方式。”商业业务线主管 Aleksander Rabinovitch 说道车辆，采埃孚售后 (ZF Aftermarket)。

paras.en: Expanded Portfolio Supports Commercial Vehicle Repairs
paras.zh: 扩展的产品组合支持商用车维修

paras.en: The addition of transmission spare parts gives customers more options to maintain vehicle performance while managing lifecycle costs. ProVia parts serve as direct replacement solutions, with fit and function that support efficient repairs in demanding workshop environments.
paras.zh: 变速箱备件的添加为客户提供了更多选择，以保持车辆性能，同时管理生命周期成本。 ProVia 零件可作为直接替换解决方案，其配合和功能可支持在要求苛刻的车间环境中进行高效维修。

paras.en: The growing ProVia portfolio gives distributors additional competitively priced spare parts that combine quality with affordability. Workshops gain components that support straightforward installation and efficient repair processes.
paras.zh: 不断增长的 ProVia 产品组合为分销商提供了更多具有价格竞争力的备件，这些备件将质量与价格相结合。车间获得支持简单安装和高效维修过程的组件。

paras.en: Fleet operators and independent truck drivers gain access to cost-efficient repair solutions that help reduce maintenance costs. These components also support vehicle uptime and help keep vehicles operational longer.
paras.zh: 车队运营商和独立卡车司机可以获得经济高效的维修解决方案，有助于降低维护成本。这些组件还支持车辆的正常运行时间，并有助于延长车辆的运行时间。

paras.en: The expanded ProVia range addresses commercial vehicle aftermarket needs, including parts reliability, availability, safety and cost.
paras.zh: 扩展后的 ProVia 系列可满足商用车售后市场的需求，包括零件可靠性、可用性、安全性和成本。

articles.title: Parts Authority Names Danielle Rickerson to Senior VP Role
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Parts Authority, national distributor of automotive replacement parts, tools, and equipment, announced the promotion of Danielle Rickerson to senior vice president of marketing & communications. In this expanded role, Rickerson will provide executive oversight of the company’s marketing and communications functions, with a focus on strengthening the Parts Authority brand and aligning marketing initiatives with the company’s broader commercial and growth objectives, the company said.
paras.zh: 汽车更换零件、工具和设备的全国分销商 Parts Authority 宣布晋升 Danielle Rickerson 为营销与传播高级副总裁。该公司表示，在这一扩大的职位上，里克森将对公司的营销和传播职能进行行政监督，重点是加强 Parts Authority 品牌，并使营销举措与公司更广泛的商业和增长目标保持一致。

paras.en: Rickerson brings more than two decades of experience in the automotive aftermarket, with leadership experience spanning sales, marketing, communications, and commercial strategy. Throughout her career, she has built a strong track record of driving growth, developing teams, and connecting strategic marketing initiatives to measurable business results.
paras.zh: 里克森在汽车售后市场拥有二十多年的经验，在销售、营销、传播和商业战略方面拥有领导经验。在她的整个职业生涯中，她在推动增长、发展团队以及将战略营销计划与可衡量的业务成果联系起来方面建立了良好的记录。

paras.en: Prior to joining Parts Authority, Rickerson held executive leadership at NPW, where she served as vice president of sales & marketing. Her experience across both sales and marketing provides a unique perspective on the aftermarket and the evolving needs of customers, suppliers, and the independent automotive repair community, Parts Authority said.
paras.zh: 在加入 Parts Authority 之前，Rickerson 在 NPW 担任行政领导职务，担任销售和营销副总裁。 Parts Authority 表示，她在销售和营销方面的经验为售后市场以及客户、供应商和独立汽车维修社区不断变化的需求提供了独特的视角。

paras.en: As part of the expanded leadership structure, Jacqueline Rodriguez will continue in her role as vice president of marketing, working closely with Rickerson and the broader commercial organization to advance Parts Authority’s marketing strategy and initiatives.
paras.zh: 作为扩大的领导结构的一部分，杰奎琳·罗德里格斯将继续担任营销副总裁，与里克森和更广泛的商业组织密切合作，以推进 Parts Authority 的营销战略和举措。

paras.en: “Danielle’s depth of industry experience and her ability to connect marketing strategy with commercial performance make her a tremendous asset to our leadership team,” said Eric Schwartz, chief commercial officer. “She understands this industry from multiple perspectives and brings a strong focus on growth, collaboration, and results. We are excited to have her provide executive leadership across marketing and communications while continuing to build on the strong talent and capabilities already within the organization.”
paras.zh: 首席商务官埃里克·施瓦茨 (Eric Sc​​hwartz) 表示：“丹妮尔丰富的行业经验以及将营销策略与商业绩效联系起来的能力使她成为我们领导团队的巨大财富。” “她从多个角度了解这个行业，并高度重视增长、协作和结果。我们很高兴让她在营销和传播方面提供行政领导，同时继续利用组织内现有的强大人才和能力。”

paras.en: Rickerson’s promotion reflects Parts Authority’s continued investment in leadership and its commitment to building a strong, unified commercial organization positioned for long-term growth, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，里克森的晋升反映了 Parts Authority 对领导力的持续投资，以及对建立一个强大、统一的商业组织以实现长期增长的承诺。

articles.title: Choosing Between Wax and Ceramic Coatings
articles.author: Counterman Staff

paras.en: Traditional car wax, particularly carnauba-based products, creates a protective barrier on a vehicle’s paint. However, UV exposure and water gradually degrade that protection, requiring regular reapplication. Ceramic coatings offer longer-lasting protection by bonding with the surface.
paras.zh: 传统的车蜡，特别是巴西棕榈蜡产品，可以在车辆的油漆上形成保护屏障。然而，紫外线照射和水会逐渐降低这种保护作用，需要定期重新涂抹。陶瓷涂层通过与表面粘合提供更持久的保护。

paras.en: It’s important to emphasize proper surface preparation, including removing dirt and contaminants with clay bars or specialized cleaning mitts before application.
paras.zh: 重要的是要强调适当的表面准备，包括在施工前用粘土棒或专门的清洁手​​套去除污垢和污染物。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: PRT to Showcase Expanded Product Lines at AAPEX
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: PRT, a brand of ADD USA Group, will showcase its product lines and latest applications at AAPEX 2026. The company will exhibit at the Venetian Expo in booth F14600. PRT manufactures shocks, struts and complete strut assemblies. A key highlight will be its new light commercial vehicle (LCV) line, which expands coverage in the segment.
paras.zh: ADD USA集团旗下品牌PRT将在AAPEX 2026上展示其产品线和最新应用。该公司将在威尼斯博览会F14600展位展出。 PRT 生产减震器、前减震器和完整的前减震器组件。一个主要亮点将是其新的轻型商用车（LCV）产品线，该产品线扩大了该细分市场的覆盖范围。

paras.en: PRT Expands Light Commercial Vehicle Coverage
paras.zh: PRT 扩大轻型商用车覆盖范围

paras.en: The company also will present its air shocks, top mounts and motor mounts product lines. Its heavy-duty portfolio includes applications for trucks, trailers, buses, commercial vehicles, cement mixers and motorhomes. Attendees can visit the booth to learn about promotional offers available to eligible customers during the show.
paras.zh: 该公司还将展示其空气减震器、顶部安装件和电机安装件产品线。其重型产品组合包括卡车、拖车、公共汽车、商用车、水泥搅拌机和房车的应用。与会者可以参观展位，了解展会期间向符合条件的客户提供的促销优惠。

paras.en: “We’re more than happy to introduce our new LCV line and showcase our multiple product lines at AAPEX 2026,” said Bruno Bello of PRT. “Our ongoing investments in manufacturing technology and OE-quality engineering support the continued development of solutions for the North American Aftermarket.”
paras.zh: PRT 的 Bruno Bello 表示：“我们非常高兴在 AAPEX 2026 上推出我们新的轻型商用车系列并展示我们的多个产品线。” “我们对制造技术和原厂质量工程的持续投资支持北美售后市场解决方案的持续开发。”

paras.en: Customers can obtain additional product information by calling PRT at 770-238-1611 or visiting www.prtautoparts.com. The company also provides updates through its social media channels at @prtautoparts.
paras.zh: 客户可以致电 PRT 770-238-1611 或访问 www.prtautoparts.com 获取更多产品信息。该公司还通过其社交媒体渠道@prtautoparts 提供更新信息。

articles.title: 'It isn't under control at all': Live Science readers respond to whether AI is making them lazy
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: While people use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help with tasks like learning new skills or answering questions, a new study suggests that these benefits may come with a downside.
paras.zh: 虽然人们使用人工智能 (AI) 工具来帮助完成学习新技能或回答问题等任务，但一项新研究表明，这些好处可能也有缺点。

paras.en: The findings, presented at the 2026 Conference on Language Modeling in San Francisco earlier this month, revealed that people who used AI assistance for reading comprehension or math problems were more likely to struggle or give up when the AI assistance was removed. The results suggest that relying too much on AI could lower people's motivations to overcome challenging situations.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候在旧金山举行的 2026 年语言建模会议上公布的研究结果显示，当人工智能辅助被取消时，使用人工智能辅助来解决阅读理解或数学问题的人更有可能陷入困境或放弃。结果表明，过度依赖人工智能可能会降低人们克服挑战性情况的动力。

paras.en: In the wake of this study, Live Science recently polled its readers on whether they felt AI was making them less motivated after using it.
paras.zh: 这项研究之后，《Live Science》最近对读者进行了民意调查，询问他们是否认为人工智能在使用人工智能后降低了他们的积极性。

paras.en: More than 140 readers voted in the poll, with 30% of voters picking "No, I don't use AI at all, so this situation doesn't apply to me."
paras.zh: 超过 140 名读者参与了投票，其中 30% 的选民选择“不，我根本不使用人工智能，所以这种情况不适用于我。”

paras.en: "If AI were only a tool, controlled by those who use it I might give it a try," said one commenter in response. "But it isn't under control at all. It gets into your bank accounts and moves money without authorization. It encourages suicide and self-harm. It is addictive and makes people lazy. I know someone who uses it to answer questions and while it is detailed, it makes her lazier, asking one question and getting the answer without her searching for it. AI Is a danger. It should not be allowed."
paras.zh: “如果人工智能只是一种工具，由使用它的人控制，我可能会尝试一下，”一位评论者回应道。 “但它根本不受控制。它进入你的银行账户，未经授权转移资金。它鼓励自杀和自残。它会让人上瘾，让人变得懒惰。我认识一个用它来回答问题的人，虽然它很详细，但它让她变得更懒，问一个问题，不去寻找答案就得到答案。人工智能是一种危险。它不应该被允许。”

paras.en: - Can AI detect cognitive decline better than a doctor? New study reveals surprising accuracy
paras.zh: - 人工智能能否比医生更好地检测认知能力下降？新研究揭示了惊人的准确性

paras.en: - Doctors say AI model can predict 'biological age' from a selfie — and want to use it to guide cancer treatment
paras.zh: - 医生表示人工智能模型可以通过自拍照预测“生物年龄”，并希望用它来指导癌症治疗

paras.en: - 'There's a sense that these algorithms are objective and they get to know you': How social media warps our understanding of healthcare
paras.zh: - “有一种感觉，这些算法是客观的，它们会了解你”：社交媒体如何扭曲我们对医疗保健的理解

paras.en: Other comments reflected this sentiment, with one reader writing, "Use of all automatic aids decrease[s] attention and retention. I see it in the use of navigation devices where drivers ought to recognize routes after a couple of times. AI helps research and cuts down lengthy searches, but over use of summaries weakens critical faculties."
paras.zh: 其他评论也反映了这种观点，一位读者写道：“使用所有自动辅助设备会降低注意力和记忆力。我在导航设备的使用中看到了这一点，驾驶员应该在几次后识别路线。人工智能有助于研究并减少冗长的搜索，但过度使用摘要会削弱关键能力。”

paras.en: Other commenters questioned whether AI is the problem, or if people are just inclined to take the easy option, asking "Would you get the same results if the answers to all but a few problems were provided on separate sheet of paper?" and another writing, "I think researchers should also investigate whether shovels decrease motivation to dig holes with one's hands. AI, like a shovel, is only a tool."
paras.zh: 其他评论者质疑人工智能是否是​​问题所在，或者人们是否只是倾向于采取简单的选择，并询问“如果除了少数问题之外的所有问题的答案都在单独的纸上提供，你会得到相同的结果吗？”另一篇文章写道，“我认为研究人员还应该调查铲子是否会降低用手挖洞的动力。人工智能就像铲子一样，只是一种工具。”

paras.en: Do you agree with these readers? Let us know in the comments!
paras.zh: 您同意这些读者的观点吗？请在评论中告诉我们！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune could destroy each other sooner than we thought, simulations hint
articles.author: Abha Jain

paras.en: When the sun inevitably dies, not even the outer solar system will be safe from the resulting chaos, new research hints.Scientists have long thought the outer solar system — which comprises the four giant planets Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune — would mostly retain its present-day appearance for hundreds of billions of years to come. But a new study suggests that the outer giants may develop weirdly shaped orbits as the sun runs out of fuel, causing the planets to cross paths and destroy themselves through collisions within three billion years of the sun's transformation into a red giant.
paras.zh: 新的研究提示，当太阳不可避免地死亡时，即使是外太阳系也无法幸免于由此产生的混乱。科学家们长期以来一直认为，由木星、土星、天王星和海王星四颗巨行星组成的外太阳系将在未来数千亿年里基本保持其现在的面貌。但一项新的研究表明，当太阳耗尽燃料时，外巨星可能会形成形状怪异的轨道，导致行星交叉路径并在太阳转变为红巨星后的三十亿年内通过碰撞自我毁灭。

paras.en: The findings, published Sept. 21 in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, could change our understanding of what kinds of exoplanets orbit certain stars.
paras.zh: 该研究结果于 9 月 21 日发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上，可能会改变我们对哪些类型的系外行星围绕某些恒星运行的理解。

paras.en: In about 5 billion years, the sun will balloon outward as a red giant after exhausting all of the hydrogen in its core. During this red giant phase, our star will swell to 100 times its present-day size, gobbling up Mercury, Venus and possibly even Earth in the process, Nathan Kaib, a planetary scientist at the University of Oklahoma who wasn't involved in the new research, told Live Science in an email. Following this violent swelling, the sun will crumple into a collapsed core called a white dwarf.
paras.zh: 大约50亿年后，太阳在耗尽其核心的所有氢后，将以红巨星的形式向外膨胀。在这个红巨星阶段，我们的恒星将膨胀到目前大小的 100 倍，在此过程中吞噬水星、金星，甚至可能吞噬地球，未参与这项新研究的俄克拉荷马大学行星科学家内森·凯布 (Nathan Kaib) 在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。在这种剧烈的膨胀之后，太阳将塌陷成一个塌陷的核心，称为白矮星。

paras.en: Until now, scientists thought the four outer planets would escape this phase relatively unscathed. A 1998 simulation-based study suggested that the gas the sun spews from its outer layers will push this planetary quartet outward, doubling the radius of each planet's orbit. Only the gravitational impact of a runaway star could destabilize this new order, and such events are thought to occur only once every billion billion years.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，科学家们认为四颗外行星将相对毫发无伤地逃脱这一阶段。 1998 年的一项基于模拟的研究表明，太阳从其外层喷出的气体会将这四颗行星向外推，使每颗行星的轨道半径加倍。只有失控恒星的引力影响才能破坏这种新秩序的稳定，而此类事件被认为每十亿年才会发生一次。

paras.en: These predictions hinged on the assumption that the sun will eject its outer layers smoothly. However, recent observations of stars suggest a jerkier loss of mass, with gas clouds lofted by plumes of plasma in the sun — as though our star were spitting out mass blobs. "They're kind of like coronal mass ejections, except much larger," Jim Fuller, a professor of theoretical astrophysics at Caltech and co-author of the new study, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 这些预测取决于太阳将顺利弹出其外层的假设。然而，最近对恒星的观测表明，质量急剧损失，太阳中的等离子体羽流使气体云升起——就好像我们的恒星正在吐出质量斑点一样。加州理工学院理论天体物理学教授、这项新研究的合著者吉姆·富勒在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“它们有点像日冕物质抛射，只不过规模要大得多。”

paras.en: Each "blob" pushes the star backward, similar to how a fired bullet causes a gun to recoil. Although every push is small, moving the sun just a few feet per second, many pushes can, over time, impart the equivalent of an enormous kick that alters the sun's speed by several hundred feet per second. In fact, astronomers have already seen white dwarfs suffer such kicks in other star systems.
paras.zh: 每个“斑点”都会向后推动恒星，类似于发射的子弹如何导致枪后坐力。尽管每次推力都很小，仅每秒移动太阳几英尺，但随着时间的推移，许多推力可以产生相当于一个巨大的踢力，使太阳的速度每秒改变数百英尺。事实上，天文学家已经在其他恒星系统中看到白矮星遭受过这样的打击。

paras.en: When Fuller, who studied these kicks, described them to Konstantin Batygin, a professor of planetary science at Caltech and the study's first author, Batygin "realized this would have important consequences for the evolution of our own solar system," Fuller said. That's because the kicks change the sun's gravitational pulls on everything around it.
paras.zh: 当研究这些踢击的富勒向加州理工学院行星科学教授、该研究的第一作者康斯坦丁·巴蒂金描述它们时，巴蒂金“意识到这将对我们太阳系的演化产生重要影响，”富勒说。那是因为踢动改变了太阳对周围一切物体的引力。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: To determine how the sun's mass loss would influence the giant planets, Batygin created computer-based simulations of the sun and the outer planets. The researchers considered three scenarios: if the sun lost its mass smoothly, if it spit out distinct mass blobs during its entire time evolving as a red giant, and if the sun spewed the blobs only during its last stages. The researchers also varied each ejected blob's mass.
paras.zh: 为了确定太阳的质量损失将如何影响巨行星，巴特金创建了基于计算机的太阳和外行星模拟。研究人员考虑了三种情况：如果太阳顺利失去质量，如果它在整个红巨星演化过程中喷出明显的质量斑点，如果太阳只在最后阶段喷出这些斑点。研究人员还改变了每个喷射团块的质量。

paras.en: The first scenario produced results similar to those of previous studies, with the outer solar system retaining almost all of its features for billions of years. In contrast, the other two cases had drastically different results. Using 672 simulations, the researchers found that if the sun lost mass in blobs, the giant planets would be thrown into chaos, switching places, developing weirdly oval-shaped orbits, and even getting ejected out of the solar system entirely. Most dramatically, in 96% of the simulations with the heaviest ejected mass packets, the planets get destroyed as they crashed into each other.
paras.zh: 第一种情况产生的结果与之前的研究相似，外太阳系在数十亿年的时间里保留了几乎所有的特征。相比之下，另外两个案例的结果却截然不同。通过 672 次模拟，研究人员发现，如果太阳失去了质量，巨行星就会陷入混乱，改变位置，形成奇怪的椭圆形轨道，甚至完全被弹出太阳系。最引人注目的是，在 96% 的具有最重喷射质量包的模拟中，行星在相互碰撞时被摧毁。

paras.en: These developments also happened much more rapidly — less than a few hundred million years after the sun transformed into a white dwarf, or even during the red giant phase, in the most extreme scenarios.
paras.zh: 这些发展也发生得更快——在太阳转变为白矮星后不到几亿年，甚至在最极端的情况下，甚至在红巨星阶段。

paras.en: The study's findings hint that analogues of the present-day outer solar system around white dwarf stars are less likely to exist than previously thought. Kaib noted that the study's results suggest that planets with oval-shaped orbits should dominate instead. It's thought that habitable planets could exist around white dwarfs, but this study's findings show that our understanding of those distant star systems may be incomplete, and that such worlds may, in reality, be unstable.
paras.zh: 这项研究的发现暗示，白矮星周围类似当今外太阳系的类似物存在的可能性比以前认为的要小。凯布指出，该研究结果表明，椭圆形轨道的行星应该占主导地位。人们认为白矮星周围可能存在宜居行星，但这项研究的发现表明，我们对这些遥远恒星系统的理解可能不完整，而且实际上，这样的世界可能是不稳定的。

paras.en: Batygin, K., Fuller, J., & Adams, F. C. (2026). Terminal instability of the solar system triggered by stochastic solar mass loss. The Astrophysical Journal Letters, 1009(2), L22. https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aea290
paras.zh: Batygin, K.、Fuller, J. 和 Adams, F.C. (2026)。由随机太阳质量损失引发的太阳系的最终不稳定性。天体物理学杂志快报，1009(2)，L22。 https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aea290

paras.en: See how well you know our planetary neighborhood with our solar system quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的太阳系测验来看看您对我们的行星邻居有多了解！

paras.en: Abha Jain is a freelance science writer. She did a masters degree in biology, specializing in neuroscience, from the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, India, and is almost through with a bachelor's degree in archaeology from the University of Leicester, UK. She's also a self-taught space enthusiast, and so loves writing about topics in astronomy, archaeology and neuroscience.
paras.zh: 艾卜哈·贾恩 (Abha Jain) 是一位自由科学作家。她在印度班加罗尔的印度科学研究所获得了生物学硕士学位，专攻神经科学，并且即将获得英国莱斯特大学的考古学学士学位。她也是一位自学成才的太空爱好者，因此喜欢撰写有关天文学、考古学和神经科学主题的文章。

articles.title: Neuroscientists reveal method to train people to have lucid dreams — and it involves virtual reality and meditation
articles.author: Kamal Nahas

paras.en: Lucid dreaming — in which the dreamer is aware that they are dreaming and can sometimes influence the dream's trajectory — is a skill that can be honed, a new study finds. And the researchers found that doing this is surprisingly easy, after training participants to do exactly that using virtual reality (VR) twice a week for just one month.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，清醒梦——做梦者意识到自己正在做梦，并且有时可以影响梦的轨迹——是一种可以磨练的技能。研究人员发现，在训练参与者使用虚拟现实 (VR) 每周两次、持续一个月后，做到这一点出奇地容易。

paras.en: The study's results could have practical benefits, said Daniel Morris, a cognitive neuroscientist at Northwestern University who studies dreams and was not involved with the work. "Lucid dreaming can benefit people with nightmares by allowing them to transform their nightmares into positive dreams and feel greater agency in their dreams," Morris told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 西北大学认知神经科学家丹尼尔·莫里斯（Daniel Morris）研究梦，但并未参与这项工作，他说，这项研究的结果可能会带来实际好处。莫里斯在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》：“清醒梦可以让做噩梦的人受益，让他们将噩梦转化为积极的梦，并在梦中感受到更大的能动性。”

paras.en: Before this study, published Sept. 28 in the journal Frontiers in Psychology, neuroscientists tried to induce lucid dreaming with various methods. These included meditation exercises and so-called reality checks, in which participants ask themselves while awake whether unusual phenomena they encounter — such as people wearing odd Halloween costumes — are real or if they're dreaming. The idea is that they will ask themselves the same question in their sleep during bizarre dreams.
paras.zh: 这项研究于 9 月 28 日发表在《心理学前沿》杂志上，在此之前，神经科学家尝试用各种方法诱导清醒梦。其中包括冥想练习和所谓的现实检查，参与者在清醒时问自己遇到的不寻常现象（例如穿着奇怪的万圣节服装的人）是真实的还是在做梦。这个想法是，他们会在睡梦中做奇怪的梦时问自己同样的问题。

paras.en: However, "for most people, our day-to-day lives may not feel 'dream-like,'" Morris said, explaining why reality checks have had mixed results and don't reliably trigger lucid dreaming.
paras.zh: 然而，“对于大多数人来说，我们的日常生活可能并不像‘梦一样’，”莫里斯说，并解释了为什么现实检查的结果好坏参半，并且不能可靠地引发清醒梦。

paras.en: Since dream-like scenarios are rare in waking life, the neuroscientists behind the new study used VR simulations of bizarre situations to complement reality-check exercises.
paras.zh: 由于梦境般的场景在现实生活中很少见，因此这项新研究的神经科学家使用了对奇异情况的 VR 模拟来补充现实检查练习。

paras.en: The team, based at the University of Trento in Italy, recruited university students and asked them to meditate and then perform the VR training. The meditation was intended to increase students' awareness of what they were thinking about in a given moment. Each time they encountered bizarre happenings in the VR environment, such as objects or people violating laws of physics or rapid switches from one scene to another, they performed reality checks.
paras.zh: 该团队位于意大利特伦托大学，招募了大学生，要求他们进行冥想，然后进行 VR 训练。冥想的目的是提高学生对他们在特定时刻所想的事情的认识。每当他们在 VR 环境中遇到奇怪的事件时，例如违反物理定律的物体或人，或者从一个场景快速切换到另一个场景，他们都会进行现实检查。

paras.en: After the training, participants went home and were asked to keep a dream diary that they wrote in every morning. They also filled out daily questionnaires, citing the number of dreams they recalled and how many they remembered being lucid.
paras.zh: 培训结束后，参与者回家后被要求记下每天早上写的梦想日记。他们还填写了每日调查问卷，列出了他们回忆起的梦的数量以及他们记得清醒的梦的数量。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The participants experienced lucid dreams four times more often than participants did in a second group that did reality checks without performing any meditation or VR training. The study also included another comparison group, in which participants carried out reality checks during realistic rather than dream-like VR simulations; these participants were over eight times less likely to report lucid dreams. This latter comparison ensured that the results were not caused solely by the use of VR, the researchers said.
paras.zh: 参与者经历清醒梦的频率是第二组参与者的四倍，第二组在没有进行任何冥想或 VR 训练的情况下进行现实检查。该研究还包括另一个对照组，参与者在现实而不是梦幻般的 VR 模拟中进行现实检查；这些参与者报告清醒梦的可能性要低八倍多。研究人员表示，后一种比较确保了结果不仅仅是由 VR 的使用造成的。

paras.en: It was particularly surprising to find that such little training with the dream-like VR simulations was needed to develop lucid dreaming as a skill, said study co-author Nicola De Pisapia, a neuroscientist at the University of Trento. His team ran the experiment for only a month because any longer would have been too demanding for the participants, De Pisapia noted.
paras.zh: 研究报告的合著者、特伦托大学的神经科学家尼古拉·德·皮萨皮亚 (Nicola De Pisapia) 表示，特别令人惊讶的是，我们发现只需进行如此少量的梦幻般 VR 模拟训练就可以培养清醒梦这项技能。德皮萨皮亚指出，他的团队只进行了一个月的实验，因为更长的时间对参与者来说要求太高了。

paras.en: Study co-author Andrea Signorelli, a doctoral student in De Pisapia's lab, thinks the VR intervention is at the heart of why the approach worked. People often don't realize that they're dreaming because the dreams "fool" your senses and feel realistic in the moment, he explained.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、De Pisapia 实验室的博士生 Andrea Signorelli 认为 VR 干预是该方法有效的核心。他解释说，人们常常没有意识到自己在做梦，因为梦“欺骗”了你的感官，让你感觉很现实。

paras.en: "Virtual reality is the technology to fool you on stereoscopic vision and auditory information," he said. The term "stereoscopic" refers to techniques that create 3D illusions from 2D images by mimicking how human eyes see.
paras.zh: “虚拟现实是一种在立体视觉和听觉信息上欺骗你的技术，”他说。 “立体”一词是指通过模仿人眼的视觉方式从 2D 图像创建 3D 幻觉的技术。

paras.en: "It's basically the most immersive technology that we have at the moment," making it a good intervention for reality check exercises, Signorelli said.
paras.zh: 西诺雷利说，“这基本上是我们目前拥有的最具沉浸感的技术”，使其成为现实检查练习的良好干预措施。

paras.en: The team also compared the number of lucid dreams participants reported against their total number of recalled dreams, which revealed an interesting pattern. On average, participants in each group recalled more dreams after starting the experiment than they did beforehand. However, the dream-simulating VR group recalled the fewest dreams overall after entering the experiment, even though they had the highest number of lucid dreams.
paras.zh: 研究小组还将参与者报告的清醒梦的数量与他们回忆起的梦的总数进行了比较，这揭示了一个有趣的模式。平均而言，每组参与者在开始实验后回忆起的梦都比之前多。然而，模拟梦境的 VR 组在进入实验后回忆起的梦总体最少，尽管他们的清醒梦数量最多。

paras.en: Signorelli speculated that perhaps it takes a lot of energy to have lucid dreams, which could divert resources away from recalling other dreams. Morris argued that, alternatively, participants in the lucid-dream VR group "may have been less motivated to report non-lucid dreams than the control groups." So there may have been some bias in the reporting.
paras.zh: 西诺雷利推测，也许做清醒梦需要大量的精力，这可能会转移用于回忆其他梦的资源。莫里斯认为，另一方面，清醒梦 VR 组的参与者“可能比对照组更不愿意报告非清醒梦”。因此，报道中可能存在一些偏见。

paras.en: The study had some limitations, such as its small sample size of 38 participants. Plus, neither of the two control groups were asked to meditate, so it is impossible to say whether the meditations or the dreamlike VR sessions had more influence over lucid dreaming in the test group.
paras.zh: 该研究有一些局限性，例如样本量较小，只有 38 名参与者。另外，两个对照组都没有被要求冥想，因此不可能说冥想或梦幻般的 VR 课程是否对测试组的清醒梦有更大的影响。

paras.en: The team is now doing a follow-up study in which the meditation part has been removed, Signorelli said, to reveal whether the VR dream scenarios are the critical factor, as suspected.
paras.zh: Signorelli 表示，该团队目前正在进行一项后续研究，其中冥想部分已被删除，以揭示 VR 梦境场景是否如怀疑的那样是关键因素。

paras.en: Signorelli said that he would like to see lucid-dream training tailored for each individual. For example, the VR simulations could be personalized to simulate a recurrent nightmare that a given person experiences, training them to recognize triggers specific to that dream, he said.
paras.zh: 西诺雷利表示，他希望看到针对每个人量身定制的清醒梦训练。例如，VR 模拟可以个性化，以模拟特定人经历的反复出现的噩梦，训练他们识别特定于该梦的触发因素，他说。

paras.en: "Other future research could explore the potential therapeutic benefits of this intervention for people with nightmares, anxiety, or PTSD [post-traumatic stress disorder]," Morris suggested.
paras.zh: 莫里斯建议：“未来的其他研究可能会探索这种干预措施对噩梦、焦虑或 PTSD（创伤后应激障碍）患者的潜在治疗益处。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Kamal Nahas is a freelance contributor based in Oxford, U.K. His work has appeared in New Scientist, Science and The Scientist, among other outlets, and he mainly covers research on evolution, health and technology. He holds a PhD in pathology from the University of Cambridge and a master's degree in immunology from the University of Oxford. He currently works as a microscopist at the Diamond Light Source, the U.K.'s synchrotron. When he's not writing, you can find him hunting for fossils on the Jurassic Coast.
paras.zh: Kamal Nahas 是英国牛津的自由撰稿人。他的作品曾发表在《新科学家》、《科学》和《科学家》等媒体上，主要涵盖进化、健康和技术方面的研究。他拥有剑桥大学病理学博士学位和牛津大学免疫学硕士学位。他目前在英国同步加速器钻石光源公司担任显微镜师。当他不写作时，你会发现他在侏罗纪海岸寻找化石。

articles.title: Crows Can Make Decisions Based on Visual Information at Lightning Speed—Roughly Twice as Fast as Humans Can, Study Suggests

paras.en: Crows are famously intelligent animals; they use tools, host funerals and remember people’s faces. Past research hints they can even count to four and understand basic geometry.
paras.zh: 乌鸦是出了名的聪明动物。他们使用工具、举办葬礼并记住人们的面孔。过去的研究表明，他们甚至可以数到四并理解基本的几何形状。

paras.en: Now, a new study suggests the jet-black birds can make decisions based on visual information incredibly fast—possibly at twice the speed of humans. The findings, described in the journal Science on October 22, can provide insights into crows’ evolutionary history.
paras.zh: 现在，一项新的研究表明，乌黑的鸟类可以根据视觉信息做出决策，速度非常快——可能是人类速度的两倍。 10 月 22 日《科学》杂志上描述的这一发现可以为了解乌鸦的进化史提供见解。

paras.en: Crow brains certainly move “in the fast lane,” study co-author Andreas Nieder, an animal physiologist at the University of Tübingen in Germany, tells the Transmitter’s Sarah Thau.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、德国图宾根大学的动物生理学家安德烈亚斯·尼德尔 (Andreas Nieder) 告诉《发射器》杂志的莎拉·托 (Sarah Thau)，乌鸦的大脑确实在“快车道上”移动。

paras.en: In the study, Nieder and Philipp Schmidbauer, a neuroscientist also at the University of Tübingen, worked with two carrion crows named Iggy and Lemmy. Each would sit in front of a touchscreen showing a cluster of dots in the center. Some dots started moving in one direction—either left or right—while the others shifted randomly as distractors. When the movement began, the birds tapped the left or right side of the screen as fast as possible to indicate which way the associated dots were traveling. Getting the answer right earned them a tasty treat: a mealworm, Pien Huang reports for NPR’s “All Things Considered.”
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，尼德和蒂宾根大学的神经科学家菲利普·施米德鲍尔（Philipp Schmidbauer）对两只名叫伊基（Iggy）和莱米（Lemmy）的食腐乌鸦进行了研究。每个人都坐在触摸屏前，触摸屏的中心显示一簇点。一些点开始向一个方向移动（向左或向右），而其他点则作为干扰物随机移动。当运动开始时，鸟儿尽可能快地敲击屏幕的左侧或右侧，以指示相关点的移动方向。黄片在美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的“综合考虑”节目中报道称，正确答案为他们赢得了美味佳肴：黄粉虫。

paras.en: The birds performed the task thousands of times. In some trials, nearly all the dots moved in concert. Other times, just a tiny fraction did, making it tough for the birds to choose the correct side.
paras.zh: 这些鸟执行了这个任务数千次。在一些试验中，几乎所有的点都一致移动。其他时候，只有一小部分人这样做，这使得鸟类很难选择正确的一方。

paras.en: The crows took an average of 235 milliseconds to indicate their correct decision, which is about a fifth of a second. That’s roughly twice as fast as monkeys and humans can do similar tasks without sacrificing accuracy, according to past research.
paras.zh: 乌鸦平均需要 235 毫秒才能做出正确的决定，大约是五分之一秒。根据过去的研究，这大约是猴子和人类在不牺牲准确性的情况下完成类似任务的速度的两倍。

paras.en: What’s more, “even when the patterns of motion were hard to recognize, the crows’ decisions were still better than random choices,” Schmidbauer says in a statement. “And with clear signals, they achieved an accuracy of nearly 100 percent.”
paras.zh: 更重要的是，“即使运动模式难以识别，乌鸦的决定仍然比随机选择更好，”施米德鲍尔在一份声明中说。 “凭借清晰的信号，他们的准确率接近 100%。”

paras.en: As the crows made their lightning-speed decisions, the Nieder and Schmidbauer also recorded activity in the animals’ brains. They specifically monitored nerve cell, or neuronal, activity in the nidopallium caudolaterale, a region similar to the primate prefrontal cortex, which is important for higher-order thinking and decision-making.
paras.zh: 当乌鸦以闪电般的速度做出决定时，尼德和施米德鲍尔还记录了动物大脑的活动。他们专门监测了尾外侧巢穴中的神经细胞或神经元的活动，该区域类似于灵长类动物的前额皮质，对于高阶思维和决策非常重要。

paras.en: The team found that neurons in the birds’ brain area were firing signals as soon as 70 milliseconds after the crows viewed the visual stimulus. Neuronal activity increased as a crow’s decision took shape, until reaching a “decision threshold,” after which the animal tapped the screen to indicate its choice. Past research suggests that primates’ brains follow the same pattern, hinting that the two distinct types of animals rely on a similar neuronal process.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，在乌鸦看到视觉刺激后 70 毫秒，鸟类大脑区域的神经元就会发出信号。随着乌鸦决策的形成，神经元活动增加，直到达到“决策阈值”，之后动物点击屏幕来表明它的选择。过去的研究表明灵长类动物的大脑遵循相同的模式，这暗示这两种不同类型的动物依赖于相似的神经元过程。

paras.en: “The bigger implication is that a brain does not need a mammalian neocortex to perform sophisticated computations,” Nieder tells Live Science’s Kenna Hughes-Castleberry.
paras.zh: “更大的含义是，大脑不需要哺乳动物的新皮质来执行复杂的计算，”尼德告诉《生活科学》的肯纳·休斯-卡斯尔伯里。

paras.en: Neuroscientist Mike Colombo, of the University of Otago in New Zealand, agrees. The findings show “it’s not about the architecture; it’s the circuitry that matters, and [crows and primates] the same circuitry,” says Colombo, who wasn’t involved in the study, to NPR.
paras.zh: 新西兰奥塔哥大学的神经科学家迈克·科伦坡对此表示同意。研究结果表明，“重要的不是结构，而是电路，而且[乌鸦和灵长类动物]具有相同的电路”，科伦坡（未参与这项研究）对 NPR 表示。

paras.en: So why is the same neuronal circuitry making crows faster? It might have something to do with the demands of a bird’s lifestyle. Their vision is essential for the navigational complexities of flight, rapid beak movement and predator detection, for example. In other words, avians may have been forced to evolve rapid visual processing and motor responses.
paras.zh: 那么为什么相同的神经元回路会让乌鸦跑得更快呢？这可能与鸟类生活方式的要求有关。例如，它们的视力对于飞行、快速喙运动和捕食者检测等导航复杂性至关重要。换句话说，鸟类可能被迫进化出快速的视觉处理和运动反应。

paras.en: Still, researchers don’t know how widespread this speedy trait might be among birds, says Aaron Blaisdell, a neuroscientist at the University of California, Los Angeles who also did not participate in the study, to the Transmitter. Is it “something that’s avian versus mammal, or is it something about crows specifically?”
paras.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的神经科学家亚伦·布莱斯德尔（Aaron Blaisdell）也没有参与这项研究，他对《发射器》表示，研究人员仍然不知道这种快速特征在鸟类中有多普遍。这是“鸟类与哺乳动物之间的区别，还是乌鸦特有的区别？”

articles.title: Three in Four Former NFL Players Who Died From 2008 Through 2023 May Have Had CTE, a Brain Disease Caused by Repeated Head Injuries

paras.en: American football is famously a dangerous sport. In August, a study found that at least one in four recently deceased former NFL players had a brain disease called chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, forcing a conversation around safety in the sport.
paras.zh: 众所周知，美式橄榄球是一项危险的运动。八月份的一项研究发现，最近去世的前 NFL 球员中至少有四分之一患有一种称为慢性创伤性脑病 (CTE) 的脑部疾病，迫使人们围绕这项运动的安全展开讨论。

paras.en: The actual image might be even starker. New work by some of the same researchers suggests that three in four of the retired professional athletes who died from 2008 through 2023 likely had CTE. The findings were published in the journal JAMA Network Open on October 28.
paras.zh: 实际的图像可能更加鲜明。一些研究人员的新研究表明，从 2008 年到 2023 年去世的退役职业运动员中，四分之三的人可能患有 CTE。研究结果发表在 10 月 28 日的《JAMA Network Open》杂志上。

paras.en: “More than 20 million men alive today in the U.S. have played football, so understanding how many of them have CTE is an important public health question,” says study co-author Yorghos Tripodis, a biostatistician at Boston University, to Youri Benadjaoud and Betsy-Ann Assoumou at ABC News.
paras.zh: “如今，美国有超过 2000 万男性踢足球，因此了解其中有多少人患有 CTE 是一个重要的公共卫生问题，”该研究的合著者、波士顿大学生物统计学家 Yorghos Tripodis 向美国广播公司新闻频道的 Youri Benadjaoud 和 Betsy-Ann Assoumou 说道。

paras.en: CTE is a progressive brain disease likely caused by repeated head injuries. Symptoms are thought to include mood swings, memory loss, depression and dementia, but CTE can only be diagnosed after death. That’s because one definitive sign is the buildup of the protein tau, also implicated in Alzheimer’s disease, which causes the brain to atrophy. The autopsy-dependent diagnosis has long skewed CTE research, given that families are more likely to donate brains of former athletes who showed symptoms of the disease.
paras.zh: CTE 是一种进行性脑部疾病，可能由反复头部受伤引起。人们认为症状包括情绪波动、记忆丧失、抑郁和痴呆，但 CTE 只能在死后才能诊断出来。这是因为一个明确的迹象是 tau 蛋白的积聚，它也与阿尔茨海默病有关，这种病会导致大脑萎缩。长期以来，依赖尸检的诊断扭曲了 CTE 研究，因为家属更有可能捐献表现出该疾病症状的前运动员的大脑。

paras.en: Tripodis and colleagues tried to adjust for selection bias. They analyzed the medical records of 2,362 former NFL players—in the league for an average of five years—who died between January 2008 and December 2023. Most of them were not brain donors. But by looking for documentation of dementia or other cognitive issues, the scientists found that those showing potential behavioral signs of CTE were around five times more likely to have their brains donated for research.
paras.zh: Tripodis 和同事试图调整选择偏差。他们分析了 2,362 名前 NFL 球员（平均在联盟效力五年）的医疗记录，这些球员在 2008 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间去世。他们中的大多数人都不是大脑捐赠者。但通过寻找痴呆症或其他认知问题的记录，科学家们发现，那些表现出潜在 CTE 行为迹象的人捐献大脑用于研究的可能性大约是其他人的五倍。

paras.en: Then, the researchers found that out of 387 brain donors, nearly 94 percent had CTE. Adjusting that percentage for the donation bias yielded the estimate that 74.5 percent of former NFL players in the cohort died with CTE. For comparison, less than 1 percent of brains from members of the general population in research banks show signs of CTE, Tripodis tells Jackie Flynn Mogensen at Scientific American.
paras.zh: 然后，研究人员发现，在 387 名大脑捐赠者中，近 94% 的人患有 CTE。根据捐赠偏差调整该百分比得出的估计是，该队列中 74.5% 的前 NFL 球员死于 CTE。 Tripodis 告诉《科学美国人》的 Jackie Flynn Mogensen，相比之下，研究银行中只有不到 1% 的普通人群大脑显示出 CTE 的迹象。

paras.en: What’s more, roughly one in four ex-football players had dementia, the team calculates, a figure that is likely an underestimate.
paras.zh: 此外，该团队计算出，大约四分之一的前足球运动员患有痴呆症，这个数字可能被低估了。

paras.en: Zachary Binney, an epidemiologist at Emory University who wasn’t involved in the study, tells Carolyn Y. Johnson and John Branch at the New York Times that the research was “pretty rigorous, and the methods seem reasonable and valid.”
paras.zh: 没有参与这项研究的埃默里大学流行病学家扎卡里·宾尼 (Zachary Binney) 告诉《纽约时报》的卡罗琳·Y·约翰逊 (Carolyn Y. Johnson) 和约翰·布兰奇 (John Branch)，这项研究“相当严格，而且方法似乎合理有效”。

paras.en: “It is higher than I would have guessed previously,” he adds. “But this paper has a larger data set and applies stronger methods than previous work.”
paras.zh: “这个数字比我之前的预期要高，”他​​补充道。 “但这篇论文比以前的工作有更大的数据集和更强的方法。”

paras.en: When asked about the findings, the NFL pointed to its response to the August study, report Diana Anos and Nadia Kounang at CNN. “The NFL continuously strives to make the game of football safer, including by implementing strategies to reduce concussions and head impacts,” the organization said.
paras.zh: CNN 的戴安娜·阿诺斯 (Diana Anos) 和纳迪亚·库南 (Nadia Kounang) 报道称，当被问及调查结果时，NFL 指出了其对 8 月份研究的回应。 “NFL 不断努力让橄榄球比赛更加安全，包括实施减少脑震荡和头部撞击的策略，”该组织表示。

paras.en: Julie Stamm, a neuroscientist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison, tells CNN that the NFL could do more to protect players, such as banning tackles during practice. “If the NFL says that, the youth levels, the younger levels, they’ll listen, and that will go a long way in decreasing the overall number of impacts over a lifetime that these individuals sustain, which is what we’ve seen increases the risk for CTE,” says Stamm, who wasn’t involved in the study.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的神经科学家朱莉·斯塔姆告诉 CNN，NFL 可以采取更多措施来保护球员，例如在训练期间禁止铲球。 “如果 NFL 这么说，那么年轻人、更年轻的人​​就会听从，这将大大减少这些人一生中所承受的影响总数，而我们所看到的影响会增加 CTE 的风险，”未参与这项研究的斯塔姆说。

paras.en: Still, studying CTE remains difficult. Researchers can’t know how many living football players are walking around with the undiagnosed brain disease. But Tripodis hopes the latest study will increase investment in its research, as well as inform families and players about the risks involved in football.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究 CTE 仍然很困难。研究人员无法知道有多少活着的足球运动员患有未确诊的脑部疾病。但特里波迪斯希望最新的研究能够增加对其研究的投资，并让家庭和球员了解足球所涉及的风险。

paras.en: “CTE is a preventable disease. We find, in study after study, that the more blows to the head over your lifetime, the higher the risk of CTE,” Tripodis tells Scientific American. “If you reduce exposure to repetitive head impacts, then you reduce the risk of CTE.”
paras.zh: “CTE 是一种可预防的疾病。我们在一项又一项的研究中发现，一生中头部受到的打击越多，患 CTE 的风险就越高，”Tripodis 告诉《科学美国人》。 “如果你减少重复头部撞击的机会，那么你就可以降低 CTE 的风险。”

articles.title: Where Is England's Oldest Pub? An Archaeologist Drilled Into 600-Year-Old Timbers to Answer the Contentious Question

paras.en: Across England, dozens of historic taverns claim to have poured pints longer than any of their competitors. Yet according to a recent forensic investigation, nearly all those ancient founding dates are myths brewed by shrewd landlords rather than historical reality.
paras.zh: 在英格兰各地，有数十家历史悠久的小酒馆声称倒酒的时间比任何竞争对手都长。然而，根据最近的一项法医调查，几乎所有这些古代的建国日期都是精明的地主编造的神话，而不是历史事实。

paras.en: The findings follow a comprehensive architectural survey by James Wright, a buildings archaeologist working with Historic England. By analyzing surviving medieval timbers and cross-referencing historic documents, Wright tested the validity of more than two dozen establishments that claim the mantle of England’s oldest pub.
paras.zh: 这些发现是在与历史英格兰合作的建筑考古学家詹姆斯·赖特 (James Wright) 进行的全面建筑调查之后得出的。通过分析幸存的中世纪木材和交叉引用历史文献，赖特测试了两打以上声称拥有英格兰最古老酒吧称号的场所的有效性。

paras.en: “Not one of the claimants to be the oldest pub (and there are over two dozen of them) are even vaguely close to being so in reality,” Wright tells the Guardian’s Helena Horton.
paras.zh: 赖特告诉《卫报》的海伦娜·霍顿：“声称是最古老酒吧的人（有超过两打）没有一家比现实中的最古老酒吧更接近。”

paras.en: To separate legend from architectural fact, Wright relied on dendrochronology, the science of dating through the growth rings of wooden timbers. He believes he has identified the true titleholder of England’s earliest surviving purpose-built inn: the George Inn in Norton St. Philip, Somerset.
paras.zh: 为了将传说与建筑事实区分开来，赖特依靠树木年代学，即通过木材的年轮来测定年代的科学。他相信他已经确定了英格兰现存最早的专门建造的旅馆的真正所有权人：位于萨默塞特郡诺顿圣菲利普的乔治旅馆。

paras.en: “The architectural history of the George Inn’s stone and timber suggests that this building has been in continuous service for over 600 years,” he tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: “乔治旅馆的石头和木材的建筑历史表明，这座建筑已经连续使用了 600 多年，”他告诉卫报。

paras.en: “Because we know medieval carpenters didn’t muck around at all, that they would fell the timber when it was green and they would build almost immediately afterwards, the actual date of felling gives us the near-date of construction,” Wright explains in a video for Historic England. “We’re not guessing at its age … Now that’s the difference between a local legend and a national treasure.”
paras.zh: “因为我们知道中世纪的木匠根本不会乱搞，他们会在木材还绿的时候砍伐木材，然后几乎立即建造，所以实际砍伐日期为我们提供了近期的施工日期，”赖特在历史英格兰的视频中解释道。 “我们不会猜测它的年龄……这就是当地传说和国宝之间的区别。”

paras.en: Charo Havermans, a pub historian, echoes the importance of this method. “The strongest claims are when the history meets the science,” she tells the BBC’s Chris Lockyer and Pippa Rifka.
paras.zh: 酒吧历史学家查罗·哈弗曼斯 (Charo Havermans) 也认同这种方法的重要性。 “当历史与科学相遇时，才是最有力的主张，”她告诉 BBC 的克里斯·洛克耶 (Chris Lockyer) 和皮帕·里夫卡 (Pippa Rifka)。

paras.en: The analysis determined that the George Inn’s lower stone walls were constructed in the late 14th century by Carthusian monks from the nearby Hinton Priory. The monks expanded the inn during the early 15th century, adding an imposing timber-framed facade and roof framed with oak cut down between 1430 and 1432.
paras.zh: 分析确定，乔治旅馆较低的石墙是由附近欣顿修道院的卡尔特会修道士于 14 世纪末建造的。僧侣们在 15 世纪初扩建了旅馆，增加了雄伟的木结构外墙和屋顶，屋顶采用了 1430 年至 1432 年间砍伐的橡木。

paras.en: During the Middle Ages, inns differed from everyday alehouses, which sold ale, and taverns, which served wine, per the Telegraph. Purpose-built inns were substantial commercial hubs designed to provide beds, food and stables for traveling merchants.
paras.zh: 据《电讯报》报道，在中世纪，旅馆不同于出售麦芽酒的日常啤酒屋和供应葡萄酒的小酒馆。专门建造的旅馆是大型商业中心，旨在为旅行商人提供床铺、食物和马厩。

paras.en: The George Inn served as a central storehouse for the priory’s wool trade and hosted merchants attending regional wool fairs, generating vital lodging fees, storage dues and sales tolls for the monks.
paras.zh: 乔治旅馆是修道院羊毛贸易的中央仓库，接待参加地区羊毛交易会的商人，为僧侣们产生重​​要的住宿费、仓储费和销售费。

paras.en: - In 1668, diarist Samuel Pepys stayed overnight at the George Inn, noting that it was already “a very old house.”
paras.zh: - 1668 年，日记作家塞缪尔·佩皮斯 (Samuel Pepys) 在乔治旅馆 (George Inn) 过夜，他指出这里已经是“一座非常古老的房子”。

paras.en: - In 1685, the Duke of Monmouth, the illegitimate son of Charles II, commandeered the inn as his headquarters during his ill-fated rebellion.
paras.zh: - 1685 年，查理二世的私生子蒙茅斯公爵在其不幸的叛乱中占领了这家旅馆作为他的总部。

paras.en: - Following Monmouth’s defeat, the inn’s dining hall served as a courtroom for George Jeffreys, the infamous “Hanging Judge,” who sentenced local rebels during the Bloody Assizes.
paras.zh: - 蒙茅斯战败后，旅馆的餐厅成为臭名昭著的“绞刑法官”乔治·杰弗里斯的法庭，他在血腥巡回审判中对当地叛乱分子进行了宣判。

paras.en: In crowning the George Inn, Wright debunked several famous long-standing contenders. Ye Olde Fighting Cocks in St. Albans, Hertfordshire, has frequently claimed an origin year of 793. However, archival research reveals that the octagonal timber structure was originally built as a monastic dovecote around 1400 and was not licensed as an alehouse until roughly 1807; its early medieval date appeared on a 20th-century tourist postcard.
paras.zh: 在为乔治酒店加冕的过程中，赖特揭穿了几位著名的长期竞争者的谎言。位于赫特福德郡圣奥尔本斯的 Ye Olde Fighting Cocks 经常声称其起源年份为 793 年。然而，档案研究表明，这座八角形木结构建筑最初是在 1400 年左右建造的，作为修道院的鸽舍，直到大约 1807 年才获得许可作为啤酒屋；它的中世纪早期出现在一张 20 世纪的旅游明信片上。

paras.en: Similarly, the Bingley Arms near Leeds claims a founding date of 953 and an entry in the Domesday Book of 1086. Yet its structure dates to the 18th century.
paras.zh: 同样，利兹附近的 Bingley Arms 声称其成立日期为 953 年，《末日审判书》中的条目为 1086 年。但其结构可追溯到 18 世纪。

paras.en: “There are no pubs mentioned—at all—in the Domesday Book, so any pub claiming to be in it is having you on,” Wright tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 赖特告诉《卫报》：“《末日审判书中》根本没有提到任何酒吧，所以任何声称在其中的酒吧都是在吸引你。”

paras.en: Even Nottingham’s Ye Olde Trip to Jerusalem, which advertises an 1189 crusade-era pedigree, only first appears in licensing records (under the name “the Pilgrim”) in 1751.
paras.zh: 即便是诺丁汉的《耶奥尔德耶路撒冷之旅》，宣传 1189 年十字军东征时期的血统，也只是在 1751 年才首次出现在许可记录中（以“朝圣者”的名义）。

paras.en: Pinpointing the definitive champion has proven so fraught that Guinness Book of World Records retired its entry for England’s oldest pub in 2000, conceding that tracking unbroken historical hospitality across centuries had become impossible to adjudicate, per the BBC.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司 (BBC) 报道，要找出最终的冠军实在令人担忧，以至于《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》于 2000 年撤销了英格兰最古老酒吧的条目，并承认追踪几个世纪以来不间断的热情好客历史已经变得不可能裁决。

paras.en: Nevertheless, for surviving buildings specifically constructed as inns that have continuously served travelers, Wright found that only about a dozen medieval structures survive across England. Alongside early rivals like the King’s Head in Shrewsbury and the New Inn in Gloucester, the George Inn stands alone at the front of the line, its 600-year-old timbers anchoring it firmly as a living artifact of English history.
paras.zh: 然而，赖特发现，对于专门建造的持续为旅行者提供服务的旅馆的幸存建筑，英格兰各地只有大约十几座中世纪建筑幸存下来。与什鲁斯伯里的 King’s Head 和格洛斯特的 New Inn 等早期竞争对手相比，George Inn 独领风骚，其拥有 600 年历史的木材使其成为英国历史上活生生的文物。

articles.title: What Democrats Can Learn From New York’s Data Center Moratorium
articles.author: Molly Taft

paras.en: Welcome back to Power Play! Each week, senior writer Molly Taft tackles a topic around this midterm season’s biggest issue: data centers. If you’ve got a question or thought for the column, feel free to shoot Molly an email at [email protected] or reach them securely on Signal at mollytaft.76.
paras.zh: 欢迎回到 Power Play！每周，资深作家莫莉·塔夫脱都会围绕本期中最大的问题讨论一个话题：数据中心。如果您对本专栏有疑问或想法，请随时通过 [email protected] 向 Molly 发送电子邮件，或通过 Signal 安全地联系他们：mollytaft.76。

paras.en: When New York became the first state in the country to enact a moratorium on data center development, Adrienne Yocina was excited. For the past two years, the mom of three has been organizing in western Genesee County to stop a 600-megawatt data center from coming to a site close to the Tonawanda Seneca Nation’s reservation and a federal wildlife refuge.
paras.zh: 当纽约成为美国第一个暂停数据中心开发的州时，Adrienne Yocina 感到很兴奋。在过去的两年里，这位三个孩子的母亲一直在杰纳西县西部组织起来，阻止一座 600 兆瓦的数据中心落户托纳旺达塞内卡国家保留地和联邦野生动物保护区附近的一个地点。

paras.en: But almost four months after the one-year moratorium began, Yocina tells me that she’s “getting nervous.” She’s worried that Democratic governor Kathy Hochul won’t sign a stronger bill to impose a stricter moratorium, and is concerned that the state Department of Environmental Conservation is not adequately involved in the process of evaluating data centers in New York.
paras.zh: 但在一年的暂停期开始近四个月后，约西娜告诉我她“变得紧张”。她担心民主党州长凯西·霍赫尔（Kathy Hochul）不会签署更强有力的法案来实施更严格的暂停令，并担心州环境保护部没有充分参与评估纽约数据中心的过程。

paras.en: “I feel like she’s just trying to shut us up,” she says of Hochul.
paras.zh: “我觉得她只是想让我们闭嘴，”她谈到霍赫尔时说道。

paras.en: Data centers are at the center of midterm races across the country, with politicians of both parties making promises to enact regulations or moratoriums on development. After next week comes the tough part: Newly elected officials must either break their word or follow through on those promises as they weigh large infrastructure projects coming to their states and residents who say they’ll reject data centers no matter what.
paras.zh: 数据中心是全国中期选举的中心，两党政客都承诺制定法规或暂停开发。下周之后是最艰难的部分：新当选的官员必须要么食言，要么兑现这些承诺，因为他们正在权衡进入本州的大型基础设施项目，而居民则表示无论如何都会拒绝数据中心。

paras.en: How will those compromises go—and will they appease voters? New York’s moratorium, and the continued opposition from some groups, may offer clues.
paras.zh: 这些妥协将如何进行——它们会安抚选民吗？纽约的暂停以及一些团体的持续反对可能会提供线索。

paras.en: In July, just two months after dismissing the idea of a data center moratorium, Hochul signed the nation’s first executive order to put a pause on development. Her order was a compromise. Just weeks prior, the state legislature had passed an omnibus bill that would have implemented a one-year moratorium throughout New York. The bill contained several provisions that made it more aggressive than Hochul’s moratorium, including stricter limits on the size of data centers and a mandate that the Department of Environmental Conservation conduct a thorough environmental impact review of data center operations. Rather than sign the bill, Hochul issued her own order. (The governor has until the end of the year to sign that bill, and her office says they are still looking at it.)
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，就在驳回暂停数据中心的想法两个月后，Hochul 签署了美国第一个暂停开发的行政命令。她的命令是一个妥协。就在几周前，州立法机关通过了一项综合法案，该法案将在整个纽约实施为期一年的暂停。该法案包含的几项条款比 Hochul 的暂停令更为激进，包括对数据中心规模的更严格限制，以及要求环境保护部对数据中心运营进行彻底的环境影响审查。霍楚尔没有签署该法案，而是发布了自己的命令。 （州长必须在今年年底之前签署该法案，她的办公室表示他们仍在考虑该法案。）

paras.en: One of the bill’s State Senate sponsors, Democrat Kristen Gonzalez, has been publicly supportive of Hochul’s moratorium. The governor’s office, Gonzalez says, proactively reached out to her after her bill passed to help design the moratorium for more immediate relief for New Yorkers.
paras.zh: 该法案的州参议院发起人之一、民主党人克里斯汀·冈萨雷斯(Kristen Gonzalez)一直公开支持霍赫尔的暂停令。冈萨雷斯说，在她的法案通过后，州长办公室主动与她联系，帮助设计暂停令，以便为纽约人提供更直接的救济。

paras.en: Gonzalez went on a data center tour of New York at the end of the summer, talking to residents around the state about their concerns. She told me that the people she talked to overwhelmingly wanted Hochul to go further and implement more aggressive measures to protect communities from data centers.
paras.zh: 夏末，冈萨雷斯参观了纽约的数据中心，与该州各地的居民谈论了他们的担忧。她告诉我，与她交谈的人绝大多数希望 Hochul 进一步采取更积极的措施来保护社区免受数据中心的影响。

paras.en: “There are local communities statewide that are living near existing data centers, dealing with significant air pollution and noise pollution, who are struggling with rising utility bills and rising water bills,” she told me. “We see the moratorium as a first step, but it can’t be the last.”
paras.zh: “全州范围内的一些当地社区居住在现有数据中心附近，面临着严重的空气污染和噪音污染，他们正在努力应对不断上涨的水电费和水电费，”她告诉我。 “我们认为暂停是第一步，但它不可能是最后一步。”

paras.en: Hochul has a comfortable lead over Republican challenger Bruce Blakeman ahead of Tuesday’s election—something that may have been helped by the moratorium’s passing. In a recent Quinnipiac poll of New York voters, 53 percent of respondents said they trusted Hochul to do a better job in handling AI and data centers, compared to just 31 percent trusting Blakeman. Blakeman, who has voiced support for data centers, called Hochul’s moratorium “crazy” when it was passed in July. His campaign didn’t immediately respond to WIRED’s request for comment.
paras.zh: 在周二的选举之前，霍赫尔轻松领先于共和党挑战者布鲁斯·布莱克曼——这可能是由于暂停令的通过而有所帮助。在昆尼皮亚克大学最近对纽约选民进行的一项民意调查中，53% 的受访者表示，他们相信 Hochul 在处理人工智能和数据中心方面做得更好，而只有 31% 的受访者相信 Blakeman。曾表示支持数据中心的布莱克曼称 Hochul 的暂停令在 7 月份通过时“疯狂”。他的竞选团队没有立即回应《连线》杂志的置评请求。

paras.en: Hochul has also touted her tough-on-data-center bona fides on the campaign trail. Early last month, she hosted a roundtable discussion on data centers with agricultural, environmental, and business leaders at a farm in the Hudson Valley. There, she told reporters that she wanted to work with the state legislature to implement more aggressive protections, including banning tax breaks for data centers. At the event, Hochul was flanked by Gonzalez and Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, one of Washington’s most prominent data center critics.
paras.zh: Hochul 还在竞选活动中宣扬了她对数据中心强硬的诚意。上月初，她在哈德逊河谷的一个农场与农业、环境和商业领袖主持了一场关于数据中心的圆桌讨论。在那里，她告诉记者，她希望与州立法机构合作实施更积极的保护措施，包括禁止数据中心的税收减免。在活动中，霍赫尔的两侧是冈萨雷斯和众议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯（Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez），后者是华盛顿最著名的数据中心批评者之一。

paras.en: I asked Hochul at the event how she anticipates handling continued opposition after her moratorium ends. How does New York balance economic development with community opposition if some people don’t want data centers in their backyards under any circumstances, even with the assurances from the state that Hochul’s office is working to create?
paras.zh: 我在活动中问 Hochul，她预计在暂停期结束后如何应对持续的反对声音。如果有些人在任何情况下都不希望在自家后院建立数据中心，即使霍赫尔办公室正在努力创建州政府的保证，那么纽约如何平衡经济发展与社区反对呢？

paras.en: The purpose of her pause, she said, was that communities should be able to choose. “This is democracy in action,” she said. “If you want it, it should come with all kinds of guardrails and restraints, but if you don’t want it, it doesn’t come.”
paras.zh: 她说，她暂停的目的是社区应该能够选择。 “这是行动中的民主，”她说。 “如果你想要它，它就应该有各种护栏和束缚，但如果你不想要它，它就不会来。”

paras.en: More New Yorkers may end up choosing the latter option. A Siena poll from September found that 63 percent of New Yorkers would oppose data centers being built in their area even after Hochul’s moratorium expires. (It’s even higher for New York Democrats, with 75 percent saying they’d remain opposed to data center development post-moratorium.)
paras.zh: 更多的纽约人最终可能会选择后一种选择。锡耶纳 9 月份的一项民意调查发现，即使在 Hochul 的禁令到期后，63% 的纽约人仍会反对在他们所在地区建设数据中心。 （纽约民主党人的比例甚至更高，75% 的人表示他们在暂停后仍反对数据中心开发。）

paras.en: Many newly elected (or reelected) governors will face a similar dynamic: At least 20 gubernatorial candidates have promised a data center moratorium or pause, according to research compiled by government relations company MultiState. Even more have promised to regulate the industry more tightly. Formerly data-center-friendly incumbents like Texas’s Greg Abbott and Pennsylvania’s Josh Shapiro have also made pledges to be stricter on their development.
paras.zh: 许多新当选（或连任）的州长将面临类似的情况：根据政府关系公司 MultiState 编制的研究，至少 20 名州长候选人承诺暂停或暂停数据中心。更多人承诺更严格地监管该行业。德克萨斯州的格雷格·阿博特（Greg Abbott）和宾夕法尼亚州的乔什·夏皮罗（Josh Shapiro）等以前对数据中心友好的现任者也承诺对数据中心的发展更加严格。

paras.en: Come January, new governors will face highly engaged constituents who are finding a political home for the first time in the fight against data centers. That includes Yocina, who says she had never voted in a local election before.
paras.zh: 一月份，新任州长将面对高度参与的选民，他们在反对数据中心的斗争中首次找到了政治归宿。其中包括约西娜，她说她以前从未在地方选举中投票过。

paras.en: She says she understands the need for industries and jobs in upstate New York: Her youngest son decided to join the Army after a fruitless job search and is about to be deployed. Now, her organizing group is moving from focusing on just stopping the data center to brainstorming new ideas for the site.
paras.zh: 她说，她了解纽约州北部对工业和就业的需求：她的小儿子在求职无果后决定参军，即将被部署。现在，她的组织小组正从专注于停止数据中心转向集思广益地讨论该网站的新想法。

paras.en: “We’re trying to figure out what we can say yes to that’s not a data center,” she says.
paras.zh: “我们正在努力弄清楚我们可以接受什么，这不是数据中心，”她说。

paras.en: Buried in Anthropic’s IPO documents filed last week was a startling admission. The tech giant’s plan to develop its own data centers exposes it to financial risk, thanks to its projected reliance on natural gas. Of course, Anthropic isn’t alone in its reliance on gas, and the filing acknowledges that’s a real problem. The heavy demand could “drive up the price of natural gas” and make it harder to purchase. I took a look at Anthropic’s plans for data centers and the brewing competition between data centers over natural gas supply in the US.
paras.zh: Anthropic 上周提交的 IPO 文件中隐藏着令人震惊的承认。由于预计对天然气的依赖，这家科技巨头开发自己的数据中心的计划使其面临财务风险。当然，Anthropic 并不是唯一一家依赖天然气的公司，该文件承认这是一个真正的问题。旺盛的需求可能会“推高天然气价格”并使购买变得更加困难。我了解了 Anthropic 的数据中心计划，以及美国数据中心之间正在酝酿的天然气供应竞争。

paras.en: - The Verge’s Gaby Del Valle takes readers out west for a deep dive on data centers’ water woes in Arizona—and why a massive and thirsty chip manufacturing plant seems to have escaped the public’s ire.
paras.zh: - The Verge 的 Gaby Del Valle 带领读者前往西部，深入探讨亚利桑那州数据中心的用水问题，以及为什么一座庞大而缺水的芯片制造工厂似乎逃脱了公众的愤怒。

paras.en: - New findings from Pew Research Center show that advertisers spent $12 million on political ads mentioning data centers in a 90-day period leading up to the midterms.
paras.zh: - 皮尤研究中心的最新调查结果显示，在中期选举前的 90 天内，广告商在提及数据中心的政治广告上花费了 1200 万美元。

paras.en: - Two professors who study real estate and urban economics write in The Conversation about their most recent research on data centers and job creation. Their findings: Data centers lead to modest job growth in certain sectors like transportation and warehousing, but not in local services like restaurants and retail.
paras.zh: - 两位研究房地产和城市经济学的教授在《对话》中撰写了他们关于数据中心和创造就业机会的最新研究。他们的发现：数据中心导致运输和仓储等某些行业的就业增长适度，但餐馆和零售等本地服务业的就业增长却没有。

articles.title: 8 Best Space Heaters (2026): Tested, Measured, and Mistreated
articles.author: Matthew Korfhage, Kat Merck

paras.en: The Best space heaters are winter’s rear guard, the last line of defense against goose bumps and cold feet. Though not a great way to heat a whole home, space heaters can be indispensable for a late-evening movie night, a workbench in a chilly garage, or the home’s odd corners that refuse to stay warm. And if you live in an apartment building where you don’t control the heat, they may be your only way to feel OK in January.
paras.zh: 最好的小型取暖器是冬季的后卫，是抵御鸡皮疙瘩和脚冷的最后一道防线。虽然小型取暖器并不是为整个房屋供暖的好方法，但它对于深夜电影之夜、寒冷车库中的工作台或家里那些难以保持温暖的奇怪角落来说是不可或缺的。如果您住在无法控制热量的公寓楼中，它们可能是您在一月份感觉良好的唯一方法。

paras.en: Even so, these little machines do bring about serious safety and reliability concerns, along with a need to be able to parse dodgy and opaque marketing claims. (For example, no matter what the marketing specifies, large space heaters usually aren’t more powerful or more effective than small ones.) So we turned down the thermostat and tested dozens of space heaters to find the ones that’ll warm you up as quickly, quietly, and safely as possible.
paras.zh: 即便如此，这些小型机器确实带来了严重的安全性和可靠性问题，并且需要能够解析狡猾和不透明的营销主张。 （例如，无论市场营销如何规定，大型空间取暖器通常并不比小型取暖器更强大或更有效。）因此，我们调低了恒温器并测试了数十个空间取暖器，以找到能够尽可能快速、安静和安全地为您取暖的产品。

paras.en: Alongside naming the top pick overall—the blessedly balanced and quiet Dreo Whole Room Heater 714—we also pinpointed which heaters are best poised to suit specific needs, from the best bathroom heater and a space heater that doubles as an air purifier to an option that’ll warm your towels. For those on a tight budget, the bare-bones Honeywell 360 Surround often goes on sale.
paras.zh: 除了列出总体首选——平衡且安静的 Dreo Whole Room Heater 714 之外，我们还确定了哪些加热器最适合满足特定需求，从最好的浴室加热器和兼作空气净化器的空间加热器到可以加热毛巾的选项。对于预算紧张的人来说，简陋的 Honeywell 360 Surround 经常打折。

paras.en: Looking for more ways to tailor your air? Check out our guide to all things that improve your indoor air quality, as well as our specialized guides to the Best Air Purifiers, Best Humidifiers, Best Fans, and Best Dehumidifiers.
paras.zh: 正在寻找更多方法来定制您的空气吗？查看我们关于改善室内空气质量的所有事项的指南，以及关于最佳空气净化器、最佳加湿器、最佳风扇和最佳除湿器的专业指南。

paras.en: Updated November 2026: We’ve added a new Honeywell model (HHF365) as a pick, heaters from Lasko and Amazon Basics to Honorable Mentions, and information about a Dreo recall. We’ve also updated links and prices.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月更新：我们添加了新的霍尼韦尔型号 (HHF365) 作为选择，将 Lasko 和 Amazon Basics 的加热器添加到荣誉奖中，以及有关 Dreo 召回的信息。我们还更新了链接和价格。

paras.en: Are Large Space Heaters More Powerful Than Smaller Ones?
paras.zh: 大型空间加热器比小型空间加热器更强大吗？

paras.en: Nope! It may seem counterintuitive, but large space heaters don’t necessarily heat any better than smaller options. In fact, most space heaters in the US and Canada deliver about the same amount of heat, regardless of size. Space heaters top out at 1,500 watts, which is the highest safe operating load for a 15-amp household circuit. And aside from some low-power personal heaters here and there, most space heaters available are capable of 1,500 watts.
paras.zh: 没有！这似乎有悖常理，但大型空间加热器的加热效果并不一定比小型加热器好。事实上，美国和加拿大的大多数小型取暖器无论尺寸如何，都能提供大致相同的热量。空间加热器的最高功率为 1,500 瓦，这是 15 安培家用电路的最高安全工作负载。除了随处可见的一些低功率个人取暖器外，大多数空间取暖器的功率均为 1,500 瓦。

paras.en: What’s more, electric space heaters are all pretty much 100 percent efficient at converting that electricity to heat. Whether directly or indirectly, nearly all of that energy eventually becomes heat.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，电动空间加热器将电能转化为热能的效率几乎都是 100%。无论是直接还是间接，几乎所有能量最终都会变成热量。

paras.en: So if space heaters share basically the same power and efficiency capacity, why are some 1,500-watt heaters advertised for small rooms and others for large rooms? This likely has as much to do with marketing as science. Pretty much every ceramic, electric-coil, and positive-temperature-coefficient (PTC) heater has about the same amount of juice and, thus, the same ability to heat a room … at least eventually.
paras.zh: 因此，如果小型取暖器具有基本相同的功率和效率能力，为什么一些 1,500 瓦的取暖器在广告中宣传用于小房间，而另一些则用于大房间呢？这可能既与科学有关，也与营销有关。几乎每个陶瓷、电线圈和正温度系数 (PTC) 加热器都具有大致相同的电量，因此具有相同的房间供暖能力……至少最终是这样。

paras.en: What differs among heaters is how and where the heat gets distributed and how quickly. All other things being equal, a heater's efficiency mostly focuses on whether it puts the heat where you want it to go.
paras.zh: 加热器之间的不同之处在于热量的分布方式、位置以及速度。在其他条件相同的情况下，加热器的效率主要取决于它是否将热量传递到您想要的地方。

paras.en: What Are the Different Types of Space Heaters?
paras.zh: 空间加热器有哪些不同类型？

paras.en: All electric space heaters essentially do the same thing: They take electricity off the grid, usually 1,500 watts of it, if you're in the United States, and turn that power into heat.
paras.zh: 所有电空间加热器本质上都做同样的事情：它们从电网获取电力，通常为 1,500 瓦（如果您在美国），然后将电力转化为热量。

paras.en: The vast majority of space heaters, including ceramic heaters and PTC heaters, are electric-resistance heaters. This means they run an electrical current through something that creates resistance: maybe an electric coil or maybe a specially designed ceramic. This quickly turns electricity into heat.
paras.zh: 绝大多数空间加热器，包括陶瓷加热器和 PTC 加热器，都是电阻加热器。这意味着它们使电流流经产生电阻的物体：可能是电线圈，也可能是专门设计的陶瓷。这很快将电能转化为热量。

paras.en: Most space heaters use a fan to disperse this heat out into the world, where we all live. These forced-air convection heaters tend to be the fastest at quickly raising the temperature of the surrounding air. The air then heats you. While this variety heats quickly, it can take quite a bit of electricity to warm an entire room.
paras.zh: 大多数空间加热器使用风扇将热量散发到我们所有人居住的世界中。这些强制空气对流加热器往往能够最快地快速升高周围空气的温度。然后空气会加热你。虽然这种类型的加热速度很快，但需要相当多的电力才能使整个房间变暖。

paras.en: Oil-filled radiators, in contrast, heat oil that circulates inside the device, which then emits heat to the surrounding room. These tend to heat up more slowly than electric-resistance heaters, but they offer even, lasting heat and are very quiet. These radiators operate on the same principle as steam radiators in buildings with a boiler room. And just like steam radiators, they can get hot to the touch.
paras.zh: 相比之下，充油散热器会加热设备内部循环的油，然后将热量散发到周围的房间。它们的加热速度往往比电阻加热器慢，但它们提供均匀、持久的热量，而且非常安静。这些散热器的工作原理与带有锅炉房的建筑物中的蒸汽散热器相同。就像蒸汽散热器一样，它们摸起来会很热。

paras.en: Radiant heaters, such as infrared heaters, operate much like the sun or a campfire: Rather than heat the air, they directly heat objects or people by radiating energy in their direction. Infrared devices heat the air only indirectly, via the objects they heat. The glow is immediately palpable as warmth, but you’ll need to be in the path of the radiation to feel it, much like the feeling of being in direct sunlight versus the shade. Likewise, the thermometer might not immediately register the warmth you perceive. Infrared heaters tend to be superior for providing warmth without expending much energy, making this type common in large, lofty spaces or outside on a patio.
paras.zh: 辐射加热器（例如红外线加热器）的工作原理与太阳或篝火非常相似：它们不是加热空气，而是通过向物体或人的方向辐射能量来直接加热物体或人。红外线设备仅通过其加热的物体间接加热空气。光芒会立即让人感受到温暖，但你需要处于辐射路径中才能感受到它，就像在阳光直射和阴影下的感觉一样。同样，温度计可能不会立即记录您感受到的温暖。红外线加热器往往能够在不消耗太多能量的情况下提供温暖，因此这种类型在大而高的空间或户外露台上很常见。

paras.en: Though they deliver heat differently, both infrared and oil-filled heaters are subject to the same wattage limitations as electrical-resistance heaters and share efficiencies.
paras.zh: 尽管红外加热器和充油加热器的传热方式不同，但它们都受到与电阻加热器相同的瓦数限制，并且效率相同。

paras.en: The same is not true of heat pumps, a newer technology that’s expected to provide the next generation of household heat. Heat pumps don’t use energy to create heat. Instead, they move heat energy from one place to another. Accordingly, they require far less energy than other space heater types. But household systems are costly to install, and while more affordable window and portable heat pumps are ramping up, they’re not yet broadly available.
paras.zh: 热泵的情况并非如此，这是一种有望提供下一代家庭供暖的新技术。热泵不使用能量来产生热量。相反，它们将热能从一个地方转移到另一个地方。因此，它们比其他空间加热器类型需要的能量少得多。但家用系统的安装成本高昂，虽然更实惠的窗式热泵和便携式热泵正在兴起，但它们尚未广泛使用。

paras.en: Space heaters are much safer than they used to be. Modern space heaters are heavily regulated, especially regarding exposed heating elements and automatic shutoff switches to prevent overheating.
