paras.en: "Hearts, far from this valley, will ache with yours. Tears, from those who remember and those who at the time were not yet born, will be shed with yours."
paras.zh: “远离这个山谷的心将与你的心一起疼痛。那些记得的人和那些当时尚未出生的人的眼泪将与你一起流下。”

paras.en: — King Charles, in a speech to mark the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster, when slurry from a collapsed colliery spoil tip slid down a mountain slope and engulfed a school and houses in the Welsh mining village of Aberfan, killing 116 children and 26 adults.
paras.zh: — 查尔斯国王在纪念阿伯凡灾难 60 周年的演讲中，当时倒塌的煤矿弃土尖的泥浆从山坡上滑落，吞没了威尔士阿伯凡矿村的一所学校和房屋，造成 116 名儿童和 26 名成人死亡。

paras.en: Queen Camilla, third from left, lays flowers at Aberfan Memorial Garden as King Charles, second from left, and Mair Morgan, left, the last surviving teacher from Pantglas Junior School, look on during a commemoration event to mark the 60th anniversary of the Aberfan disaster on Oct. 21 in Merthyr Tydfil, Wales. On Oct. 21, 1966, a mountain of liquefied coal waste slid into a valley, engulfing Pantglas Junior School and several surrounding houses. (Aaron Chown/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10月21日，在威尔士梅瑟蒂德菲尔举行的阿伯凡灾难60周年纪念活动中，卡米拉王后（左三）在阿伯凡纪念花园献花，查尔斯国王（左二）和潘格拉斯小学最后一位幸存教师梅尔·摩根（左）在旁观礼。 1966 年 10 月 21 日，一座液化煤废料山滑入山谷，吞没了潘特格拉斯小学和周围的几栋房屋。 （亚伦·乔恩/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Detectives in Scotland are investigating Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell's stay at Balmoral castle as reported guests of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor amid allegations that women were trafficked from the royal estate. [The Guardian]
paras.zh: 苏格兰的侦探正在调查杰弗里·爱泼斯坦和吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦作为安德鲁·蒙巴顿-温莎的客人在巴尔莫勒尔城堡的住宿情况，因为有指控称妇女被从王室拐卖。 [卫报]

paras.en: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, says she was "deeply distressed" by allegations that a collection of child sexual abuse images had been found at her father's former home. She also revealed that a letter containing "troubling allegations" about him had been sent to London police in 2018. The Metropolitan Police has since voluntarily referred itself to the police watchdog because it failed to pass on the letter to relevant overseas law enforcement agencies. [CBC, ITV]
paras.zh: 苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根表示，她对在她父亲的故居发现一系列儿童性虐待图片的指控感到“深感悲痛”。她还透露，一封包含有关他“令人不安的指控”的信已于2018年发送给伦敦警方。伦敦警察厅此后自愿将自己移交给警察监管机构，因为它未能将这封信转交给相关的海外执法机构。 [加拿大广播公司、英国独立电视台]

paras.en: The Royal Family welcomed the Sultan of Oman to Windsor for a state visit. [The Independent]
paras.zh: 王室欢迎阿曼苏丹来温莎进行国事访问。 [独立报]

paras.en: The Sultan of Oman, Haitham bin Tariq Al Said, left, speaks with King Charles, right, at a state banquet on Oct. 20 at Windsor Castle in Windsor, England. (Jordan Pettitt/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 10 月 20 日，在英国温莎城堡举行的国宴上，阿曼苏丹海瑟姆·本·塔里克·阿勒赛义德（左）与查尔斯国王（右）交谈。 （乔丹·佩蒂特/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: A teenager with a rare muscle disorder sang an Ed Sheeran song for the Princess of Wales during a visit to a children's hospice. [Ipswich Star]
paras.zh: 一名患有罕见肌肉疾病的青少年在参观儿童临终关怀医院时为威尔士王妃演唱了埃德·希兰的歌曲。 [伊普斯威奇星]

paras.en: When she was seven years old, Bayo Randle's great-great-grandmother Sarah Forbes Bonetta was presented to Queen Victoria at Windsor Castle as a "diplomatic gift" from an African king. Victoria would go on to pay for Bonetta's education, approve her marriage to one of west Africa's wealthiest men and become godmother to her eldest daughter. Now, as a biography is published, Randle has spoken of his family history. [The Guardian]
paras.zh: 巴约·兰德尔 (Bayo Randle) 的曾曾祖母莎拉·福布斯·博内塔 (Sarah Forbes Bonetta) 七岁时，作为非洲国王的“外交礼物”在温莎城堡送给维多利亚女王。维多利亚继续支付博内塔的教育费用，批准她与西非最富有的男人之一的婚姻，并成为她大女儿的教母。现在，随着传记的出版，兰德尔谈到了他的家族史。 [卫报]

paras.en: Catherine, Princess of Wales, centre, meets Charlotte Freegard, left, during a music therapy session at The Treehouse children's hospice in Ipswich, England, on Oct. 22. (Chris Radburn/Reuters)
paras.zh: 10 月 22 日，在英格兰伊普斯威奇的树屋儿童临终关怀中心举行的音乐治疗课程中，威尔士王妃凯瑟琳（中）会见夏洛特·弗里加德（左）。（克里斯·拉德伯恩/路透社）

articles.title: Mexico comes alive during annual Day of the Dead celebrations

paras.en: Mexico comes alive during annual Day of the Dead celebrations
paras.zh: 墨西哥在一年一度的亡灵节庆祝活动中活跃起来

paras.en: On the night of Nov. 1, families gather at cemeteries across the country to reconnect with their dead
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日晚上，家人聚集在全国各地的墓地，与死者重新取得联系。

paras.en: Bright orange marigolds, glowing candles and faces painted like the elegant skeletons known as catrinas fill the streets of Mexico every year during the country's Day of the Dead celebrations.
paras.zh: 每年墨西哥的亡灵节庆祝活动期间，明亮的橙色万寿菊、发光的蜡烛和被涂成优雅的卡特里娜骷髅的面孔都充满了墨西哥的街道。

paras.en: Festivities begin in October and lead up to Nov. 1 and 2, when the souls of deceased loved ones are believed to temporarily return to earth to reunite with their families.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动从 10 月开始，一直持续到 11 月 1 日和 2 日，据信已故亲人的灵魂将暂时返回地球与家人团聚。

paras.en: No one knows when the first observance took place, but it is rooted in agriculture-related beliefs from Mexico's pre-Hispanic era. Catholic traditions were incorporated into the celebration after the Spanish conquest in 1521.
paras.zh: 没有人知道第一次庆祝活动何时举行，但它植根于墨西哥前西班牙时代与农业相关的信仰。 1521 年西班牙征服后，天主教传统被纳入庆祝活动中。

paras.en: Performers in costume march in the annual Day of the Dead parade in Mexico City, Saturday, Oct. 31, 2026. (Rebecca Herrera/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 31 日星期六，墨西哥城一年一度的亡灵节游行中，穿着戏服的表演者。（Rebecca Herrera/美联社）

paras.en: Today, celebrations are marked by massive parades running along Mexico City's main avenue. Streets, businesses and markets are cloaked in orange Mexican marigold flowers, or cempasuchil, believed to light the path of the dead back to earth with their bright colours. Traditional pan de muerto, or bread of the dead, lines the display cases of bakeries.
paras.zh: 今天，庆祝活动的标志是沿着墨西哥城的主要大道举行大规模游行。街道、企业和市场都覆盖着橙色的墨西哥万寿菊花，人们相信它们明亮的颜色可以照亮死者返回地球的道路。面包店的展示柜上摆满了传统的亡灵面包（pan de muerto），即死者面包。

paras.en: Families decorate altars to their loved ones in their homes, placing treats, food and mezcal as offerings next to photos of their loved ones.
paras.zh: 家人在家里为亲人装饰祭坛，将美食、食物和梅斯卡尔酒作为祭品放在亲人的照片旁边。

paras.en: On the night of Nov. 1, families gather at cemeteries across the country to reconnect with their dead just as their ancestors have done for centuries.
paras.zh: 11 月 1 日晚上，家人聚集在全国各地的墓地，与死者重新取得联系，就像他们的祖先几个世纪以来所做的那样。

paras.en: Performers in costume march in the annual Day of the Dead parade in Mexico City, Saturday, Oct. 31, 2026. (Rebecca Herrera/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月 31 日星期六，墨西哥城一年一度的亡灵节游行中，穿着戏服的表演者。（Rebecca Herrera/美联社）

paras.en: But as the tradition and the Mexican capital have increasingly gained an international spotlight, and states like Oaxaca and Michoacan have seen an influx of tourists, some regions have experienced tensions around overtourism.
paras.zh: 但随着这一传统和墨西哥首都日益受到国际关注，瓦哈卡州和米却肯州等州游客大量涌入，一些地区因过度旅游而出现紧张局势。

paras.en: In Mexico City, many locals are skeptical of an annual parade featuring floats decorated with catrinas. The procession was created for the 2015 James Bond film Spectre and later incorporated into the city's celebrations, though it was not previously part of the tradition.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥城，许多当地人对一年一度的装饰有卡特里娜花的花车游行持怀疑态度。该游行是为 2015 年詹姆斯·邦德电影《007：幽灵党》而创建的，后来被纳入该市的庆祝活动，尽管之前它并不是这一传统的一部分。

paras.en: In Janitzio, a small island on a lake in the central state of Michoacan, where celebrations were recognized by UNESCO as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2008, authorities closed the pantheon to tourists for the first time this year. The closure came after the island's community council reported the collapse of damaged tombs, crosses and parts of the cemetery's perimeter wall because of the flood of people.
paras.zh: 米却肯州中部湖上的小岛贾尼茨奥 (Janitzio) 的庆祝活动于 2008 年被联合国教科文组织认定为人类非物质文化遗产，但当局今年首次对游客关闭了万神殿。岛上社区委员会报告称，由于人潮涌入，墓地、十字架和部分墓地围墙受损，导致墓地倒塌，随后关闭了墓地。

paras.en: Only local families and friends of those buried there would be allowed in.
paras.zh: 只有埋葬在那里的人的当地家人和朋友才被允许进入。

articles.title: German ministers pledge tough action after rioters damage stores in Frankfurt

paras.en: German ministers pledge tough action after rioters damage stores in Frankfurt
paras.zh: 德国部长承诺在法兰克福暴徒破坏商店后采取严厉行动

paras.en: Demonstrators took to city streets in Germany to demand better education and lower living costs
paras.zh: 示威者走上德国城市街头，要求更好的教育和降低生活成本

paras.en: German ministers threatened tough penalties for looters and rioters who damaged stores and injured more than 100 police officers in Frankfurt overnight, while still praising public forces for preventing larger-scale violence.
paras.zh: 德国部长们威胁要对法兰克福夜间破坏商店、打伤 100 多名警察的抢劫者和骚乱者进行严厉处罚，同时仍然赞扬公共力量阻止了更大规模的暴力事件。

paras.en: Frankfurt became the hot spot for violent protests late on Saturday, after tens of thousands of demonstrators took to the streets of dozens of German cities during the day to demand better education and lower living costs in protests led by the campaign group "Gen Z regelt" ("Gen Z takes charge").
paras.zh: 周六晚些时候，法兰克福成为暴力抗议的热点，此前数万名示威者白天走上德国数十个城市的街头，在“Z世代掌权”运动团体领导的抗议活动中要求提供更好的教育和降低生活成本。

paras.en: In Frankfurt's financial hub, hooded rioters damaged 17 shops and stores, of which five were looted, Roman Poseck, interior minister of the state of Hesse, told a press conference on Sunday.
paras.zh: 黑森州内政部长罗曼·波塞克 (Roman Poseck) 在周日的新闻发布会上表示，在法兰克福金融中心，蒙面暴徒破坏了 17 家商店，其中 5 家遭到抢劫。

paras.en: He said police deployed 1,300 officers, with more than 100 injured in clashes. Police arrested 54 people aged between 13 and 29.
paras.zh: 他说，警方出动了 1,300 名警察，冲突中造成 100 多人受伤。警方逮捕了 54 名年龄在 13 岁至 29 岁之间的人。

paras.en: "I am shocked by what I have seen, and there is no point in sugar-coating it. Let me make this very clear: things cannot go on like this," Poseck said.
paras.zh: 波塞克说：“我对我所看到的感到震惊，粉饰它是没有意义的。让我明确表示：事情不能像这样继续下去。”

paras.en: Poseck said most of those arrested were German nationals, adding that many of those involved in the disturbances were of a migrant background, citing information from the police.
paras.zh: 波塞克表示，大多数被捕者是德国国民，并补充说，根据警方提供的信息，参与骚乱的许多人都有移民背景。

paras.en: "Police currently estimate that they are dealing with between 1,000 and 1,500 violent troublemakers, predominantly from a migrant background."
paras.zh: “警方目前估计他们正在处理 1,000 至 1,500 名暴力麻烦制造者，其中大部分来自移民背景。”

paras.en: Frankfurt police reported violent disturbances including windows being smashed and petrol bombs being thrown at the emergency services.
paras.zh: 法兰克福警方报告称，发生了暴力骚乱，包括窗户被砸碎以及向紧急服务部门投掷汽油弹。

paras.en: "The rioters and looters will be identified and held accountable," German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt told the Bild tabloid on Sunday
paras.zh: 德国内政部长亚历山大·多布林特周日对《图片报》小报表示：“骚乱者和抢劫者将被查明并追究责任。”

paras.en: "This breach of the peace must be followed by tough penalties."
paras.zh: “这种破坏和平的行为必须受到严厉的惩罚。”

paras.en: He accused "violent left-wing groups and troublemakers from the migrant community" of hijacking the otherwise peaceful protests, without elaborating.
paras.zh: 他指责“暴力左翼团体和移民社区的麻烦制造者”劫持了原本和平的抗议活动，但没有详细说明。

paras.en: Dobrindt said the police strategy of maintaining a large presence while deploying officers across multiple locations had worked.
paras.zh: 多布林特表示，警方在多个地点部署警力的同时维持大量警力的策略已经奏效。

paras.en: "Excesses of violence like those in Paris were prevented thanks to our highly committed police forces," Dobrindt, a member of the conservative Christian Social Union, said.
paras.zh: 保守派基督教社会联盟成员多布林特表示：“由于我们高度敬业的警察部队，像巴黎这样的过度暴力事件得以避免。”

paras.en: In France, protests continued largely peacefully for a third weekend after extensive riots and looting on October 17 damaged shops, public buildings and businesses.
paras.zh: 在法国，继 10 月 17 日发生大规模骚乱和抢劫，商店、公共建筑和企业受损后，抗议活动已连续第三个周末基本和平进行。

articles.title: Donald Trump loses allies after elections in Serbia and Brazil

paras.en: The midterm elections in the United States are just around the corner: On Tuesday, November 3, American voters will choose their representatives to the US Congress. The right-wing-conservative Republican party of President Donald Trump currently has a majority in both chambers.
paras.zh: 美国中期选举在即：11月3日星期二，美国选民将选出美国国会代表。唐纳德·特朗普总统领导的右翼保守共和党目前在参众两院均占多数。

paras.en: But in other parts of the world election results are already in. The majority of voters in both Serbia and Brazil cast their ballots for left-wing parties. Those results will not influence the midterms in the US, but the victories of the Student List in Serbia and the incumbent president, Luiz Inacio "Lula" da Silva, in Brazil are bad news for Trump all the same.
paras.zh: 但在世界其他地区，选举结果已经出来。塞尔维亚和巴西的大多数选民都把票投给了左翼政党。这些结果不会影响美国的中期选举，但塞尔维亚学生名单和巴西现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·“卢拉”·达席尔瓦的胜利对特朗普来说仍然是坏消息。

paras.en: In Serbia, he has lost an important European ally in outgoing president Aleksandar Vucic. And in Brazil, the Trump camp had been hoping Flavio Bolsonaro would triumph.
paras.zh: 在塞尔维亚，他失去了即将卸任的总统亚历山大·武契奇（Aleksandar Vucic）这一重要的欧洲盟友。在巴西，特朗普阵营一直希望弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗能够获胜。

paras.en: "Trump was a strong supporter of both Jair Bolsonaro, the Trump-like figure who served as president before Lula defeated him in 2022, and of his son Flavio," says Lawrence J. Haas, a senior fellow for US foreign policy at the American Foreign Policy Council, who was communications director for Al Gore, Bill Clinton's vice president, in the 1990s. "Trump wasn't happy about the defeat of either Bolsonaro," he continues, "and he doesn't feel warmly toward Lula. So relations will remain cool at best."
paras.zh: 美国外交政策委员会美国外交政策高级研究员劳伦斯·哈斯 (Lawrence J. Haas) 表示，“特朗普是贾尔·博尔索纳罗 (Jair Bolsonaro) 和他儿子弗拉维奥 (Flavio) 的坚定支持者。贾尔·博尔索纳罗是与特朗普类似的人物，在 2022 年卢拉击败特朗普之前曾担任总统。 “特朗普对博尔索纳罗的失败并不满意，”他继续说道，“他对卢拉也没有热情。因此，两国关系最多只能保持冷淡。”

paras.en: Trump declared Brazilian election looked "rigged"
paras.zh: 特朗普宣称巴西选举看起来“被操纵”

paras.en: Flavio Bolsonaro is under investigation in Brazil for alleged corruption and money laundering. After losing the election, he fled the country for Florida. The US State Department granted him and his family entry visas in spite of the pending legal action.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗因涉嫌腐败和洗钱而在巴西接受调查。选举失败后，他逃离该国前往佛罗里达州。尽管法律诉讼尚未结束，美国国务院仍向他和他的家人发放了入境签证。

paras.en: Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat. Instead, he claims there were irregularities in the vote. This is very reminiscent of Trump, who continues to claim – falsely – that Joe Biden and the Democratic Party "stole" the US election in 2020. Trump's comments on Bolsonaro's defeat sounded very familiar. "It looked like another rigged election, frankly," the US president said on Monday. "Elections have to be indisputable – and it looked very bad to me."
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗拒绝承认失败。相反，他声称投票存在违规行为。这很容易让人想起特朗普，他继续错误地声称乔·拜登和民主党“偷走了”2020年美国大选。特朗普对博尔索纳罗落败的评论听起来非常熟悉。 “坦率地说，这看起来像是另一场被操纵的选举，”美国总统周一表示。 “选举必须是无可争议的——但对我来说，这看起来非常糟糕。”

paras.en: Aleksandar Vucic had ruled Serbia as president with an iron fist since 2017. He resigned just before these elections in order to stand as prime minister, a role he previously held from 2014 to 2017. Vucic has commented in the past that he and President Trump are like-minded people. Trump's eldest son, Donald Jr., visited Vucic in Belgrade shortly before the US presidential elections in November 2024, and again a few months later.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·武契奇自 2017 年以来一直以总统身份铁腕统治塞尔维亚。他在选举前夕辞职，以担任总理，此前他曾在 2014 年至 2017 年担任总理。武契奇过去曾表示，他和特朗普总统是志同道合的人。特朗普的长子小唐纳德在 2024 年 11 月美国总统大选前夕访问了贝尔格莱德的武契奇，几个月后又再次访问。

paras.en: The US Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC), which is closely connected with Trump's MAGA ("Make America Great Again") movement, recently announced that it was organizing a meeting in Belgrade in November, at which Vucic was to be a keynote speaker. It is unclear whether this is still the case.
paras.zh: 与特朗普的MAGA（“让美国再次伟大”）运动密切相关的美国保守党政治行动会议（CPAC）最近宣布将于11月在贝尔格莱德组织一次会议，武契奇将在会上发表主旨演讲。目前尚不清楚情况是否仍然如此。

paras.en: Another thing Vucic and Trump have in common is that the soon-to-be-ex-president of Serbia has a much more positive attitude toward Russian president Vladimir Putin than do most other European heads of state. Vucic did not join EU countries in imposing sanctions on Russia after it launched its war of aggression against Ukraine. Belgrade still buys Russian raw materials, and Serbian state media under Vucic presented a more positive image of Russia than of the EU.
paras.zh: 武契奇和特朗普的另一个共同点是，这位即将成为塞尔维亚前总统的人对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的态度比大多数其他欧洲国家元首要积极得多。在俄罗斯发动侵略乌克兰战争后，武契奇没有与欧盟国家一起对俄罗斯实施制裁。贝尔格莱德仍然购买俄罗斯原材料，武契奇领导下的塞尔维亚官方媒体对俄罗斯的形象比对欧盟的形象更为积极。

paras.en: Trump also seems increasingly inclined toward Moscow. His special envoy Steve Witkoff recently described Putin as a "humanitarian," while, in an interview, Trump himself openly admitted that he got on better with Putin than with the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The end of the Vucic government now means that Trump has lost one of his few allies in Europe who takes a similar view.
paras.zh: 特朗普似乎也越来越倾向于莫斯科。他的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫最近将普京描述为“人道主义者”，而特朗普本人在接受采访时公开承认，他与普京的关系比与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的关系更好。武契奇政府的终结现在意味着特朗普失去了他在欧洲为数不多的持类似观点的盟友之一。

paras.en: There's still a chance of an outcome in the Israeli elections that might be to Trump's liking. With more than 96% of votes counted, the right-wing bloc led by prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu is in the lead. However, Trump ally Netanyahu has lost his majority, and the coalition negotiations will be very difficult.
paras.zh: 以色列选举仍有可能出现特朗普喜欢的结果。目前计票已超过 96%，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领导的右翼集团处于领先地位。然而，特朗普的盟友内塔尼亚胡已经失去了多数席位，联合政府谈判将会非常困难。

paras.en: Trump and Netanyahu have been close allies since well before February this year, when they joined forces to launch a war against Iran. In 2018, during his first term in office, Trump moved the US embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. This was controversial, because both Israel and Palestinians claim Jerusalem as their capital. Netanyahu's camp welcomed the decision.
paras.zh: 特朗普和内塔尼亚胡早在今年二月联手对伊朗发动战争之前就一直是亲密盟友。 2018年，特朗普在第一任期内将美国驻以色列大使馆从特拉维夫迁至耶路撒冷。这是有争议的，因为以色列和巴勒斯坦都声称耶路撒冷是他们的首都。内塔尼亚胡阵营对这一决定表示欢迎。

paras.en: Today, the United States is still by far Israel's most important partner, while Israel is an important regional ally for the US. It is not clear what their relationship would be like with a different Israeli government. If Netanyahu remains in power, little, if anything, will change.
paras.zh: 如今，美国仍然是以色列最重要的伙伴，而以色列则是美国重要的地区盟友。目前尚不清楚他们与不同的以色列政府的关系会是什么样。如果内塔尼亚胡继续掌权，即使有什么变化，也不会发生什么变化。

paras.en: No rosy prospects for Trump in the midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普的中期选举前景并不乐观

paras.en: With Vucic's defeat, Trump has lost a loyal ally. And Lula's victory means, for him, that a disagreeable president remains in power. None of this is good for Trump, but foreign policy analyst Haas said it won't influence the important midterm elections in his country. "Americans will be voting [...] on the basis of issues that affect them, and how they feel about the party in power."
paras.zh: 随着武契奇的落选，特朗普失去了一个忠实的盟友。对卢拉来说，他的胜利意味着一位令人讨厌的总统继续掌权。这一切对特朗普都没有好处，但外交政策分析师哈斯表示，这不会影响他的国家重要的中期选举。 “美国人将根据影响他们的问题以及他们对执政党的看法进行投票。”

paras.en: But this doesn't bode well for Trump, either. "Trump has the lowest approval rating of any president on the eve of a mid-term election since Harry Truman in 1946," Haas explained. "Americans are very concerned about issues of affordability, [and] they strongly oppose the US-Iran war."
paras.zh: 但这对特朗普来说也不是好兆头。哈斯解释说：“自 1946 年哈里·杜鲁门以来，特朗普在中期选举前夕的支持率是所有总统中最低的。” “美国人非常关心负担能力问题，[并且]他们强烈反对美伊战争。”

paras.en: Benjamin Alvarez Gruber in Miami contributed to this report, which was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 迈阿密的本杰明·阿尔瓦雷斯·格鲁伯 (Benjamin Alvarez Gruber) 对这份报告做出了贡献，该报告最初是用德语撰写的。

articles.title: Biological weapons: The weaponization of disease

paras.en: Artificial intelligence could potentially be misused to develop biological weapons. This may sound like science fiction, but scientists, security services, and international organizations are all looking at how to deal with this scenario.
paras.zh: 人工智能可能被滥用来开发生物武器。这听起来像是科幻小说，但科学家、安全部门和国际组织都在研究如何应对这种情况。

paras.en: Pathogens can be analyzed and altered with ever greater precision thanks to ongoing developments in biotechnology. Meanwhile, AI is able to evaluate vast quantities of data at astonishing speeds. As a result, experts are warning that, in the long term, modern technologies could also be misused to develop biological weapons.
paras.zh: 由于生物技术的不断发展，可以更精确地分析和改变病原体。与此同时，人工智能能够以惊人的速度评估大量数据。因此，专家警告说，从长远来看，现代技术也可能被滥用来开发生物武器。

paras.en: Security services are concerned. In October 2026, Ken McCallum, head of the British domestic intelligence service MI5, warned that artificial intelligence could increase the risk from existing, or new, biological weapons – including from non-state actors.
paras.zh: 安全部门受到关注。 2026 年 10 月，英国国内情报机构军情五处负责人肯·麦卡勒姆警告称，人工智能可能会增加现有或新型生物武器（包括非国家行为者）的风险。

paras.en: Fine line between valid research and misuse
paras.zh: 有效研究与滥用之间的界限

paras.en: A report by the American AI company Anthropic in September 2026 highlights the topicality of the debate. Anthropic said it had identified and blocked numerous attempts to use its AI assistant Claude in connection with possible biological weapon research. The report said these attempts included grant applications for so-called "gain-of-function" research, as well as projects to research avian influenza variants that were potentially the most transmissible to mammals.
paras.zh: 美国人工智能公司 Anthropic 2026 年 9 月的一份报告凸显了这场争论的话题性。 Anthropic 表示，它已经发现并阻止了多次利用其人工智能助手 Claude 进行可能的生物武器研究的尝试。报告称，这些尝试包括所谓的“功能获得”研究的拨款申请，以及研究可能最容易传播给哺乳动物的禽流感变种的项目。

paras.en: At the same time, Anthropic stressed that, although it could have a military application, such research could also relate to medical prevention. The difficulty in distinguishing between legitimate science and its possible misuse is one of the biggest problems in terms of the control of modern biotechnologies.
paras.zh: 同时，Anthropic强调，虽然它可能具有军事应用，但此类研究也可能与医疗预防有关。区分合法科学及其可能的滥用的困难是现代生物技术控制方面的最大问题之一。

paras.en: Concerns about biological weapons are by no means new. Many pathogens — bacteria, viruses, fungi, and certain biological toxins — have the potential for weaponization. Familiar diseases include plague, smallpox, and botulinum toxin, but anthrax is one of the most notorious biological agents. Its resistant spores can survive a long time in the environment, and it has also been the focus of research by state biological weapons programs.
paras.zh: 对生物武器的担忧绝不是新鲜事。许多病原体——细菌、病毒、真菌和某些生物毒素——都有武器化的潜力。常见的疾病包括鼠疫、天花和肉毒杆菌毒素，但炭疽是最臭名昭著的生物制剂之一。其抗性孢子可以在环境中长期存活，也一直是国家生物武器计划研究的重点。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the United Nations Office for Disarmament Affairs define a biological weapon as the targeted release of such biological substances for the purpose of injuring people, animals, or plants.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）和联合国裁军事务厅将生物武器定义为有针对性地释放此类生物物质以伤害人、动物或植物。

paras.en: A biological weapon usually has two components: The biological substance itself, and a system for disseminating it. Experts refer to these as the "agent," such as a virus or bacterium, and the "delivery mechanism." Examples of the latter include missiles, spraying systems, and contaminated food.
paras.zh: 生物武器通常有两个组成部分：生物物质本身和传播生物物质的系统。专家将它们称为“媒介”，例如病毒或细菌，以及“传递机制”。后者的例子包括导弹、喷雾系统和受污染的食物。

paras.en: Biological weapons belong to the so-called ABC weapons, alongside atomic (nuclear) and chemical weapons. They are often also counted as weapons of mass destruction.
paras.zh: 生物武器与原子（核武器）和化学武器一起属于所谓的ABC武器。它们通常也被视为大规模杀伤性武器。

paras.en: How do they differ from chemical weapons?
paras.zh: 它们与化学武器有何不同？

paras.en: Biological and chemical weapons differ in their mode of operation. Chemical weapons injure people through the toxic effects of chemical substances such as sarin or mustard gas. They will often take effect within minutes, or even seconds. Examples of the use of chemical weapons are the gas attacks in World War I, which involved chlorine gas, and later mustard gas; and the deployment of the nerve gas sarin in the Syrian civil war and by Saddam Hussein in Iraq.
paras.zh: 生物武器和化学武器的操作方式不同。化学武器通过沙林毒气或芥子气等化学物质的毒性作用对人造成伤害。它们通常会在几分钟甚至几秒钟内生效。使用化学武器的例子有第一次世界大战中的毒气袭击，其中使用了氯气，后来又使用了芥子气；叙利亚内战和萨达姆·侯赛因在伊拉克使用神经毒气沙林。

paras.en: Biological weapons, on the other hand, cause infectious disease. The effects become apparent only hours, days, or even weeks after they have been deployed. Some pathogens are also capable of spreading from person to person, meaning that the outcome is difficult to predict.
paras.zh: 另一方面，生物武器会引起传染病。仅在部署数小时、数天甚至数周后，效果才会显现出来。有些病原体还能够在人与人之间传播，这意味着结果很难预测。

paras.en: To summarize: Chemical weapons kill or injure through immediate toxicity, whereas biological weapons cause diseases. The possibility of human-to-human transmission makes the effect of a biological weapon particularly hard to calculate.
paras.zh: 总而言之：化学武器通过直接毒性造成死亡或伤害，而生物武器则引起疾病。人与人之间传播的可能性使得生物武器的影响特别难以计算。

paras.en: Are biological weapons subject to a worldwide ban?
paras.zh: 生物武器是否受到全球禁止？

paras.en: Biological weapons are prohibited under international law. The first Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) came into force in 1975. This prohibits the development, stockpiling, acquisition, retention, production, and transfer of biological and toxin-based weapons.
paras.zh: 国际法禁止生物武器。第一个《生物武器公约》(BWC) 于 1975 年生效。该公约禁止开发、储存、获取、保留、生产和转让生物和毒素武器。

paras.en: The Convention, which has been ratified by 189 countries, can be seen as a development of the Geneva Protocol of 1925, which banned the use of biological weapons as a method of warfare. Only a few countries have not signed the agreement, or have signed but not ratified it, including Israel, Egypt, and Syria. All those who have acceded to the Convention have also committed themselves to destroying all stocks, production sites, and means of conveyance.
paras.zh: 该公约已获得 189 个国家的批准，可以被视为 1925 年《日内瓦议定书》的发展，该议定书禁止使用生物武器作为战争方法。只有少数国家尚未签署该协议，或已签署但未批准该协议，包括以色列、埃及和叙利亚。所有加入《公约》的国家也承诺销毁所有库存、生产场地和运输工具。

paras.en: Chemical weapons are also internationally banned, but their control is seen as much more highly developed. The Chemical Weapons Convention is implemented by the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), which can carry out inspections and oversee the destruction of chemical weapons stocks.
paras.zh: 化学武器也在国际上受到禁止，但人们认为化学武器的控制更为发达。 《化学武器公约》由禁止化学武器组织（OPCW）负责执行，该组织可以对化学武器库存进行检查并监督销毁情况。

paras.en: There is still no comparable system for controlling biological weapons. States fear that inspection could expose sensitive research data pertaining to medicine, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry. This is why the control of biological weapons relies to a great extent on transparency, voluntary reporting, and good faith.
paras.zh: 目前还没有类似的控制生物武器的系统。各州担心检查可能会暴露与医学、生物技术或制药行业有关的敏感研究数据。这就是为什么生物武器的控制在很大程度上依赖于透明度、自愿报告和诚信。

paras.en: One of the best-known examples of why the ban on biological weapons is insufficient on its own to prevent their use occurred in the United States in 2001. A few weeks after the attacks of September 11, several people received letters containing anthrax spores. 22 were infected, and five died.
paras.zh: 2001 年美国发生了一个最著名的例子，说明为什么生物武器禁令本身不足以阻止其使用。9 月 11 日袭击发生几周后，一些人收到了含有炭疽孢子的信件。 22人感染，5人死亡。

paras.en: Why are biological weapons so hard to expose and control?
paras.zh: 为什么生物武器如此难以暴露和控制？

paras.en: Finding biological weapons programs is much harder than controlling the production of nuclear or chemical weapons. Many technologies that could be used to develop biological weapons also have civilian applications. The same laboratory equipment used to develop vaccines and medicines could, in theory, also be used for military research.
paras.zh: 寻找生物武器计划比控制核武器或化学武器的生产要困难得多。许多可用于开发生物武器的技术也有民用用途。理论上，用于开发疫苗和药物的实验室设备也可以用于军事研究。

paras.en: Experts refer to this as the problem of dual use. Research can be done for peaceful medical purposes and, at the same time, have a military application.
paras.zh: 专家将此称为双重用途问题。研究可以用于和平医疗目的，同时也可以具有军事应用。

paras.en: Furthermore, a biological attack can initially look like a natural outbreak of disease. It is often only possible after extensive investigation to establish whether a pathogen was deliberately released or occurred naturally.
paras.zh: 此外，生物攻击最初看起来像是疾病的自然爆发。通常只有经过广泛调查才能确定病原体是故意释放还是自然发生。

paras.en: Perhaps that is also why biological weapons have been deployed at various times throughout history. Historical reports range from the poisoning of wells to catapulting the corpses of plague victims over the walls of a besieged town. The effectiveness of these methods is, however, disputed.
paras.zh: 也许这也是历史上不同时期部署生物武器的原因。历史报道包括从水井中毒到将瘟疫受害者的尸体弹射到被围困城镇的城墙上。然而，这些方法的有效性存在争议。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Ethnic Germans in Kazakhstan face legacy of the Soviet Union

paras.en: She wants to keep history alive. Yunna Kinereish, 22, is studying public relations in Kazakhstan's modern capital, Astana. She describes herself as a Kazakh German.
paras.zh: 她想让历史永存。 22 岁的 Yunna Kinereish 正在哈萨克斯坦现代首都阿斯塔纳学习公共关系。她称自己是哈萨克族德国人。

paras.en: "I am German by ethnicity. But I also feel that I'm Kazakh, because I keep the traditions with my family, and I have this mentality," she told DW.
paras.zh: “我是德国人。但我也觉得自己是哈萨克人，因为我保留了家人的传统，而且我有这种心态，”她告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Kinereish, who belongs to the Wiedergeburt (Revival) Association of Germans in Kazakhstan, is one of 223,000 Kazakh Germans living in the Central Asian republic of Kazakhstan today.
paras.zh: Kinereish 属于哈萨克斯坦德国人 Wiedergeburt（复兴）协会，是当今居住在中亚哈萨克斯坦共和国的 223,000 名哈萨克斯坦德国人之一。

paras.en: Kinereish recently acted in a play at the association's youth theater that told the fate of her Russian German forebears.
paras.zh: 基内雷什最近在该协会的青年剧院演出了一部戏剧，讲述了她的俄罗斯德国祖先的命运。

paras.en: From the 18th century onward, Germans were incentivized to leave Germany and settle in the Russian empire, including in Ukraine's Black Sea region.
paras.zh: 从 18 世纪开始，德国人被激励离开德国并在俄罗斯帝国定居，包括乌克兰的黑海地区。

paras.en: But after the armies of Hitler's Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union in 1941, Soviet dictator Josef Stalinstarted deporting hundreds of thousands of Germans living in Russia and Ukraine to Siberia and Kazakhstan.
paras.zh: 但在 1941 年希特勒纳粹德国军队入侵苏联后，苏联独裁者约瑟夫·斯大林开始将居住在俄罗斯和乌克兰的数十万德国人驱逐到西伯利亚和哈萨克斯坦。

paras.en: Innocent people who had nothing to do with Nazi Germany's invasion and atrocities were collectively held responsible by the Soviet power and denounced as spies and collaborators.
paras.zh: 与纳粹德国的入侵和暴行无关的无辜者被苏联政权集体追究责任，并被斥为间谍和通敌者。

paras.en: There were more than a million deportees, of whom at least 200,000 died as a result of expulsion, hunger, and forced labor.
paras.zh: 被驱逐者超过一百万，其中至少二十万人因驱逐、饥饿和强迫劳动而死亡。

paras.en: "My family is part of this history, these terrible times. They were driven out of the Ukrainian village Kleinwärter, a settlement of ethnic Germans in Ukraine."
paras.zh: “我的家人是这段历史、这段可怕时代的一部分。他们被赶出了乌克兰的克莱因瓦尔特村，那里是乌克兰德裔的一个定居点。”

paras.en: Yunna Kinereish says she was very moved by the personal stories she and her friends had brought to the stage at the House of Friendship, where the association has its office. "It's not easy for me, because it all touches my heart very deeply. I actually feel like crying. But when I'm on stage ..., I have to be strong."
paras.zh: 云娜·基内雷什 (Yunna Kinereish) 表示，她和朋友们在友谊之家的舞台上讲述的个人故事让她深受感动，该协会的办公室就设在那里。 “这对我来说并不容易，因为这一切都深深地触动了我的心。我真的很想哭。但是当我在舞台上时……我必须坚强。”

paras.en: The modern-looking House of Friendship in the capital Astana is the center for German culture in the city. Financed primarily by the German government, it offers language courses, engages in social work and fosters a culture of remembrance, focusing on the themes of deportation and repression under the Soviet regime.
paras.zh: 首都阿斯塔纳的友谊之家外观现代，是该市德国文化的中心。它主要由德国政府资助，提供语言课程，从事社会工作并培育纪念文化，重点关注苏联政权下的驱逐和镇压主题。

paras.en: Yunna Kinereish doesn't only present the history of her people on stage: She is also documenting it on film. In 2025, she made a film about German women incarcerated in ALZhIR (Akmolinsk Camp for Wives of Traitors to the Motherland), among the most infamous in the Soviet Gulag system.
paras.zh: Yunna Kinereish 不仅在舞台上展示她的人民的历史：她还在电影中记录它。 2025 年，她拍摄了一部关于被关押在 ALZhIR（阿克莫林斯克祖国叛徒妻子营地）的德国妇女的电影，该营地是苏联古拉格体系中最臭名昭著的营地之一。

paras.en: During Stalin's brutal campaign of political repression and state-sponsored terror in the 1930s, a period known as the Great Terror, the Soviet Union established its biggest camp system in Kazakhstan. 18,000 women passed through the ALZhIR camp alone. These women were imprisoned there only because their husbands had been convicted of being traitors or enemies of the people. Among them were 167 ethnic German women, whose stories are told in the film.
paras.zh: 在 1930 年代斯大林残酷的政治镇压和国家支持的恐怖活动（被称为“大恐怖”）期间，苏联在哈萨克斯坦建立了最大的集中营系统。仅 ALZhIR 营地就有 18,000 名妇女通过。这些妇女被关押在那里只是因为她们的丈夫被判为叛徒或人民敌人。其中有167名德裔女性，影片讲述了她们的故事。

paras.en: The memorial for the ALZhIR women's camp is located just outside the gates of Astana, which only became the capital in 1997.
paras.zh: ALZhIR 妇女营纪念碑位于阿斯塔纳城门外，阿斯塔纳于 1997 年才成为首都。

paras.en: Astana's roads are permanently clogged with traffic. There are almost no pedestrians, and no cyclists at all. The city is growing, with new buildings shooting up all along the outskirts of the city. Beyond them is the barren steppe; the village of Akmol is about an hour's drive away.
paras.zh: 阿斯塔纳的道路长期拥堵。几乎没有行人，更没有骑自行车的人。这座城市正在不断发展，新的建筑在城市的郊区拔地而起。越过他们，就是贫瘠的草原； Akmol村距离酒店约有一个小时的车程。

paras.en: Before entering the actual ALZhIR museum, the visitor passes through the Arch of Grief, a huge steel construction that commemorates the suffering and forced labor the women endured. The museum itself contains personal items that belonged to the female prisoners, models of their primitive quarters, original documents and photographs.
paras.zh: 在进入真正的 ALZhIR 博物馆之前，参观者会经过悲伤拱门，这是一座巨大的钢结构建筑，旨在纪念妇女所遭受的痛苦和强迫劳动。博物馆本身包含女囚犯的个人物品、她们原始宿舍的模型、原始文件和照片。

paras.en: One of the photos is of Gertrud Platais, a woman with German roots who spent years incarcerated in ALZhIR. Platais was a print worker from Lower Silesia, part of modern-day Poland. She married Karl Eduard Platais and became a Soviet citizen. In 1938, during the Great Terror, her husband was arrested. Gertrud was convicted, too as a "relative of a traitor to the homeland."
paras.zh: 其中一张照片是格特鲁德·普拉泰斯 (Gertrud Platais) 拍摄的，她是一位有德国血统的女性，曾在 ALZhIR 被监禁多年。普拉泰斯是一位来自下西里西亚（现代波兰的一部分）的印刷工人。她与卡尔·爱德华·普拉泰斯结婚并成为苏联公民。 1938年，大恐怖期间，她的丈夫被捕。格特鲁德也被定罪为“祖国叛徒亲属”。

paras.en: She was transferred to ALZhIR, in a region where temperatures hit 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit) in summer and minus 40 degreees Celsius in winter. Here, she was forced to work as an embroiderer until 1946. After this, she was banished for life to the huge Karaganda Corrective Labor Camp, known as Karlag. Gertrud Platais wasn't rehabilitated until 1956. Hers is just one story documenting the terror of the Soviet system on Kazakh soil.
paras.zh: 她被转移到 ALZhIR，该地区夏季气温达到 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），冬季气温为零下 40 摄氏度。在这里，她被迫从事刺绣工作，直到 1946 年。此后，她被终身流放到规模庞大的卡拉干达劳改营（即卡拉格）。格特鲁德·普拉泰斯 (Gertrud Platais) 直到 1956 年才获得平反。她的故事只是记录苏联制度在哈萨克斯坦土地上的恐怖的一个故事。

paras.en: Karlag was by far the biggest camp system and its complex covered an area about 22 times the size of New York City. Karlag was not just a prison camp, but a huge economic and agricultural complex. Almost one million people passed through it between 1931 and 1959.
paras.zh: 卡拉格是迄今为止最大的营地系统，其占地面积约为纽约市面积的 22 倍。卡拉格不仅仅是一个战俘营，而且是一个巨大的经济和农业综合体。 1931 年至 1959 年间，近一百万人经过这里。

paras.en: Around 10,000 prisoners are believed to have died here between 1940 and 1950 alone: of starvation, cold, sickness, and the effects of forced labor.
paras.zh: 据信，仅 1940 年至 1950 年间，就有大约 10,000 名囚犯死于饥饿、寒冷、疾病和强迫劳动的影响。

paras.en: The museum sits in the middle of the Kazakh steppe, near the city of Karaganda, about 250 kilometers south of Astana. It is located in the building that used to house the camp system administration. Visiting German historians and specialists are slightly puzzled: People were not tortured or tormented in this building, it was simply where the administration was done.
paras.zh: 该博物馆坐落在哈萨克草原中部，靠近卡拉干达市，距阿斯塔纳以南约 250 公里。它位于曾经是营地系统管理部门的大楼内。来访的德国历史学家和专家感到有些困惑：这座建筑里的人们并没有受到酷刑或折磨，这只是行政管理的地方。

paras.en: Here, interrogation and torture cells have been reconstructed, and everything is underscored by melodramatic music pouring from ubiquitous loudspeakers. It comes across as staged rather than authentic. As at the ALZhIR memorial, the Karlag museum has few visitors. Even well-educated young Kazakhs probably don't know about it."
paras.zh: 在这里，审讯和酷刑室被重建，一切都被无处不在的扩音器中传来的煽情音乐所强调。它给人的感觉是舞台表演，而不是真实的。与 ALZhIR 纪念馆一样，卡拉格博物馆的游客也很少。即使是受过良好教育的年轻哈萨克人也可能不知道这一点。”

paras.en: Many people in Kazakhstan, and certain areas of politics, have almost no interest in coming to terms with the country's often brutal history," says Katherine M. Erdman. An American anthropologist and archaeologist at the Nazarbayev University in Astana, she has been researching the Gulag system for about a decade now.
paras.zh: 哈萨克斯坦的许多人和某些政治领域几乎没有兴趣接受这个国家残酷的历史。”凯瑟琳·M·埃德曼说。她是阿斯塔纳纳扎尔巴耶夫大学的美国人类学家和考古学家，她研究古拉格制度已有大约十年的时间。

paras.en: "The landscape has been shaped by forced labor"
paras.zh: “强迫劳动塑造了景观”

paras.en: "We wanted to find out where exactly the camps were, and how they can still be recognized today." Erdman and her students relied on modern technology such as drone flights, but conducting interviews and research on the ground was also a part of it.
paras.zh: “我们想知道这些营地的具体位置，以及它们今天如何仍能被认出。”埃德曼和她的学生依靠无人机飞行等现代技术，但在地面进行采访和研究也是其中的一部分。

paras.en: "In many regions, the landscape has been shaped by forced labor," Erdman says. Factories were often constructed alongside the primitive living quarters. Houses were built using bricks made by forced laborers.
paras.zh: “在许多地区，强迫劳动塑造了当地的面貌，”埃德曼说。工厂常常建在原始居住区旁边。房屋是用强迫劳工制作的砖块建造的。

paras.en: The researchers share their findings directly with neighbors and with local administrations. "Often we're just met with apathy, or flat-out rejection," says Erdman. At a time of economic and social advancement, many don't want to be reminded of the inglorious aspects of the past.
paras.zh: 研究人员直接与邻居和当地政府分享他们的发现。 “我们经常遇到的只是冷漠，或者是断然拒绝，”埃德曼说。在经济和社会进步的时代，许多人不想被提醒过去不光彩的方面。

paras.en: Erdman says there is a desire to demonstrate to the international community that the country is dealing with the dark side of its history, but that she often experiences lack of interest and even rejection. The academic has been conducting research in Kazakhstan for a decade, but there is no state funding for a further lectureship.
paras.zh: 埃德曼说，她希望向国际社会表明，该国正在处理其历史的黑暗面，但她经常感到缺乏兴趣，甚至遭到拒绝。这位学者已经在哈萨克斯坦进行了十年的研究，但没有国家资助进一步的讲学。

paras.en: The Kazakh German Yunna Kinereish is one of the young people in Kazakhstan who want to ensure that the past is not forgotten. "My ancestors survived the Gulag system in Kazakhstan," she tells DW. "So it's important to me that we don't forget our roots, and that what our forefathers experienced and suffered is passed on."
paras.zh: 哈萨克斯坦裔德国人尤娜·基涅雷什 (Yunna Kinereish) 是哈萨克斯坦希望确保过去不被遗忘的年轻人之一。 “我的祖先在哈萨克斯坦的古拉格系统中幸存下来，”她告诉德国之声。 “所以对我来说重要的是我们不要忘记我们的根，我们的祖先所经历和遭受的苦难将会被传承下去。”

paras.en: This article, originally published in German, was written in the context of a study trip organized by the Federal Foundation for the Study of the Communist Dictatorship in Germany. Since 1998, the foundation, funded by the German taxpayer, has dedicated itself to studying and reappraising the former communist dictatorships in Germany, the GDR, and other countries.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表，是在德国共产主义独裁联邦研究基金会组织的一次考察旅行中撰写的。自1998年以来，该基金会由德国纳税人资助，致力于研究和重新评估德国、东德和其他国家的前共产主义独裁政权。

articles.title: Russia detains minor over alleged Moscow attack plot after US warning

paras.en: Russian authorities have detained a teenager suspected of planning an attack at a popular Moscow park after receiving a warning from the United States, according to Russia’s Interfax news agency, citing the Federal Security Service (FSB).
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国际文传电讯社援引联邦安全局（FSB）的消息称，俄罗斯当局在收到美国警告后拘留了一名涉嫌计划在莫斯科一个受欢迎的公园发动袭击的青少年。

paras.en: The FSB said the suspect, a Russian citizen, posted photos on TikTok wearing a balaclava and tactical clothing and holding what appeared to be an automatic weapon, Interfax reported on Sunday.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社周日报道，俄罗斯联邦安全局表示，嫌疑人是一名俄罗斯公民，他在 TikTok 上发布了身穿巴拉克拉法帽和战术服、手持似乎是自动武器的照片。

paras.en: The suspect, who has not been identified, also reportedly shared photos taken at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve in southern Moscow with the caption: “I found a place.”
paras.zh: 据报道，这名嫌疑人的身份尚未确定，他还分享了在莫斯科南部察里津诺博物馆保护区拍摄的照片，并配文：“我找到了一个地方。”

paras.en: The FSB said a search of the suspect’s home uncovered the clothing and accessories seen in the photos, Interfax reported. The security service also said that the teen’s phone showed searches related to terrorist attacks and mass killings, as well as a subscription to a neo-Nazi Telegram channel.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，联邦安全局表示，搜查了嫌疑人的家，发现了照片中的衣服和配饰。安全部门还表示，这名青少年的手机显示了与恐怖袭击和大规模杀戮有关的搜索，以及订阅了新纳粹电报频道。

paras.en: The detention came after the US embassy in Moscow issued a security alert on Saturday warning of a “credible threat of a mass casualty event” at the Tsaritsyno Museum Reserve, a popular palace and park complex.
paras.zh: 此次拘留是在美国驻莫斯科大使馆周六发布安全警报后发出的，警告称察里津诺博物馆保护区（一座颇受欢迎的宫殿和公园建筑群）存在“大规模伤亡事件的可信威胁”。

paras.en: The embassy urged people to avoid the area and said the US government was coordinating with Russian authorities on a response.
paras.zh: 大使馆敦促人们避开该地区，并表示美国政府正在与俄罗斯当局协调应对措施。

paras.en: The park was temporarily closed on Saturday following the warning.
paras.zh: 接到警告后，公园于周六暂时关闭。

paras.en: “We are grateful to the American side for providing the information,” the FSB said in its statement.
paras.zh: “我们感谢美方提供的信息，”金融稳定委员会在声明中表示。

paras.en: Russia’s Investigative Committee is now considering what legal action to take against the suspect, the FSB said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦安全局表示，俄罗斯调查委员会目前正在考虑对嫌疑人采取何种法律行动。

paras.en: The US has previously warned Russia about potential attacks, including in March 2024, weeks before an attack on a Moscow concert hall by an affiliate of the ISIL group that killed more than 140 people.
paras.zh: 美国此前曾就潜在袭击向俄罗斯发出警告，包括在 2024 年 3 月，即“伊斯兰国”组织附属机构对莫斯科音乐厅发动袭击、造成 140 多人死亡的几周前。

paras.en: The latest warning comes despite longstanding tensions between Washington and Moscow over Russia’s war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 尽管华盛顿和莫斯科之间因俄罗斯乌克兰战争而关系长期紧张，但最新警告还是发出了。

articles.title: Al Jazeera marks 30 years of transforming news in Middle East and beyond

paras.en: Doha, Qatar – As Al Jazeera marks its 30th anniversary with a special commemorative event, the media network’s history is a timeline of milestones and challenges – from risks, obstacles and attacks, to international awards and recognition from the communities whose stories it strives to tell.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔多哈 — — 半岛电视台通过特别纪念活动庆祝其成立 30 周年，该媒体网络的历史就是一部充满里程碑和挑战的时间表——从风险、障碍和攻击，到国际奖项和其努力讲述故事的社区的认可。

paras.en: Launched on November 1, 1996, the network broke new ground in Arab broadcasting, bringing previously marginalised political perspectives into the mainstream and creating space for debate on issues seldom openly discussed on regional television.
paras.zh: 该网络于 1996 年 11 月 1 日推出，在阿拉伯广播领域开辟了新天地，将以前被边缘化的政治观点带入主流，并为地区电视上很少公开讨论的问题创造了辩论空间。

paras.en: On Sunday, the network hosted an event to commemorate its enduring legacy at its headquarters in the Qatari capital, Doha, attended by the Emir of Qatar Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani and other delegates.
paras.zh: 周日，该网络在卡塔尔首都多哈的总部举办了一场纪念其不朽遗产的活动，卡塔尔埃米尔谢赫塔米姆·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼和其他代表出席了活动。

paras.en: Since its launch, Al Jazeera was not “just a screen”, said Al Jazeera’s Director General Sheikh Nasser bin Faisal Al Thani at the anniversary event. “It was a promise that journalism can be free and responsible, and that ‘opinion and the other opinion’ is not just a slogan, but it’s a position you take.”
paras.zh: 半岛电视台总干事谢赫·纳赛尔·本·费萨尔·阿勒萨尼在周年纪念活动中表示，自推出以来，半岛电视台“不仅仅是一个屏幕”。 “这是一个承诺，新闻业可以是自由和负责任的，‘观点和其他观点’不仅仅是一个口号，而是你所采取的立场。”

paras.en: For three decades, Al Jazeera “has helped transform the way news is covered in the Arab world”, Director of News Raed Fakih said in a statement, hailing the network for making room for “voices, issues and perspectives that had not been given the space they deserved”.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台新闻总监拉德·法基赫在一份声明中表示，三十年来，半岛电视台“帮助改变了阿拉伯世界的新闻报道方式”，并赞扬该网络为“尚未得到应有空间的声音、问题和观点”腾出了空间。

paras.en: “Today, as we mark Al Jazeera’s 30th anniversary, we are building on that editorial legacy to broaden the scope of our coverage and give greater prominence to a wider range of events and viewpoints,” he added.
paras.zh: “今天，在我们纪念半岛电视台成立 30 周年之际，我们正在以社论遗产为基础，扩大我们的报道范围，并更加突出更广泛的事件和观点，”他补充道。

paras.en: The anniversary coincides with a significant restructuring of Al Jazeera Media Network’s Arabic-language news services, separating rolling breaking news coverage, live event broadcasting, and more in-depth reporting across three channels.
paras.zh: 周年纪念日恰逢半岛电视台媒体网络阿拉伯语新闻服务进行重大重组，将滚动突发新闻报道、现场活动广播和更深入的报道分开三个渠道。

paras.en: Since Qatar’s late Father Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani launched the independent channel – a first in the Arab world – the network has promised to provide “the opinion and the other opinion”.
paras.zh: 自从卡塔尔已故神父埃米尔谢赫·哈马德·本·哈利法·阿勒萨尼开通阿拉伯世界首个独立频道以来，该网络就承诺提供“观点和其他观点”。

paras.en: It launched its first TV broadcast as an Arabic-language satellite news channel in 1996 from Doha and has since then grown into the Al Jazeera Media Network, with several outlets in multiple languages. A private corporation for public benefit, the network now includes television channels, websites and other digital platforms.
paras.zh: 它于 1996 年在多哈作为阿拉伯语卫星新闻频道推出了第一个电视广播，此后发展成为半岛电视台媒体网络，拥有多个多语言频道。该网络是一家致力于公益的私营公司，目前包括电视频道、网站和其他数字平台。

paras.en: But as governments have banned it, and as its offices have been bombed in many parts of the world, the network has exacted a huge cost for staying on air.
paras.zh: 但由于各国政府对其予以禁止，并且其在世界许多地方的办公室遭到轰炸，该网络为继续播出而付出了巨大的代价。

paras.en: Yet it has been instrumental in covering key events in the last three decades in the region and beyond.
paras.zh: 然而，它在报道过去三十年该地区及其他地区的重大事件方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: In 2001, when the United States attacked Afghanistan, Al Jazeera was the only foreign broadcaster in Kabul, its updates and pictures travelling the world.
paras.zh: 2001年，当美国袭击阿富汗时，半岛电视台是喀布尔唯一的外国广播机构，其更新和图片传遍世界各地。

paras.en: Then in 2011, millions followed the Arab Spring uprising live on Al Jazeera. Its coverage won a prestigious Peabody Award.
paras.zh: 2011 年，数百万人通过半岛电视台直播阿拉伯之春起义。它的报道赢得了著名的皮博迪奖。

paras.en: However, the network’s reporting has led to numerous threats over the years. Exclusive pictures have made Al Jazeera hard to ignore, but have also made the network a target.
paras.zh: 然而，多年来该网络的报告导致了许多威胁。独家图片让半岛电视台难以忽视，但也让该网络成为攻击目标。

paras.en: In 2003, a US strike hit its Baghdad office, killing correspondent Tareq Ayyoub. Two dozen Al Jazeera journalists have been killed since.
paras.zh: 2003年，美国对其巴格达办事处发动空袭，导致记者塔里克·阿尤布（Tareq Ayyoub）身亡。此后，已有两打半岛电视台记者被杀。

paras.en: In 2022, an Israeli soldier shot Palestinian correspondent Shireen Abu Akleh in Jenin, the 12th Al Jazeera journalist killed in 19 years. Another 12 were then killed in just 30 months, every one of them by Israel during its genocidal war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 2022年，一名以色列士兵在杰宁枪杀了巴勒斯坦记者Shireen Abu Akleh，这是19年来第12位半岛电视台记者被杀。短短 30 个月内，又有 12 人被杀害，他们都是以色列在加沙的种族灭绝战争中杀害的。

paras.en: One of them was Anas al-Sharif, who for many viewers was the face of the war. In August 2025, an Israeli strike killed him and four colleagues as it hit a press tent outside al-Shifa Hospital.
paras.zh: 阿纳斯·谢里夫就是其中之一，对许多观众来说，他就是战争的代言人。 2025 年 8 月，以色列的一次袭击击中了希法医院外的新闻帐篷，导致他和四名同事丧生。

paras.en: “To the martyrs of Al Jazeera, to our colleagues who departed while carrying out their duties, we say to them today, you are part and parcel of Al Jazeera’s promise,” Al Jazeera’s Sheikh Nasser said at the event on Sunday.
paras.zh: “对于半岛电视台的烈士，对于在履行职责时离开的同事，我们今天对他们说，你们是半岛电视台承诺的重要组成部分，”半岛电视台的谢赫·纳赛尔在周日的活动中说道。

paras.en: Meanwhile, across the region, governments have closed the network’s bureaus and pulled the channel’s licences.
paras.zh: 与此同时，整个地区的政府都关闭了该网络的分支机构，并吊销了该频道的牌照。

paras.en: In 2024, Israel banned the network and raided its Ramallah office. Months later, the Palestinian Authority suspended it.
paras.zh: 2024 年，以色列禁止该网络并突袭其拉马拉办事处。几个月后，巴勒斯坦权力机构暂停了该计划。

paras.en: Overall, at least nine governments have tried to silence Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 总体而言，至少有九个政府试图压制半岛电视台。

paras.en: Despite the challenges, Al Jazeera’s broadcast continues, with more than 3,000 staff working out of more than 70 bureaus across the globe.
paras.zh: 尽管面临挑战，半岛电视台的广播仍在继续，全球 70 多个分社的 3,000 多名工作人员在工作。

paras.en: Alongside its digital divisions, as well as its English channel that launched in 2006, Al Jazeera reaches more than 430 million homes.
paras.zh: 除了其数字部门以及 2006 年推出的英语频道外，半岛电视台还覆盖超过 4.3 亿家庭。

paras.en: The network on Sunday also launched The Core, an artificial intelligence (AI) initiative first announced in December 2025 in collaboration with Google Cloud. The initiative aims to integrate AI into newsroom operations, helping journalists manage information, coordinate coverage and make better use of the network’s reporting archives.
paras.zh: 该网络周日还推出了 The Core，这是一项与 Google Cloud 合作于 2025 年 12 月首次宣布的人工智能 (AI) 计划。该计划旨在将人工智能融入新闻编辑室的运营中，帮助记者管理信息、协调报道并更好地利用网络的报道档案。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Al Jazeera Balkans was also relaunched in a new digital-first format, opening a new chapter in its journalism in the region.
paras.zh: 与此同时，半岛电视台巴尔干半岛也以新的数字优先格式重新启动，为其在该地区的新闻事业翻开了新的篇章。

paras.en: While the network’s shelves are packed with hundreds of awards, it continues its mission of serving as a voice of the voiceless.
paras.zh: 尽管该网络的书架上摆满了数百个奖项，但它仍然继续履行为无声者发声的使命。

articles.title: Hebron siege continues for 10th day as Israel threatens wider offensive

paras.en: Israeli forces are maintaining their siege on Hebron for the 10th consecutive day, threatening to expand their offensive and forcing more Palestinian families from their homes.
paras.zh: 以色列军队连续十天维持对希伯伦的围困，威胁要扩大攻势，迫使更多巴勒斯坦家庭离开家园。

paras.en: The lockdown in the occupied West Bank city was enforced after an attack on October 23 near Hebron in which two Israeli soldiers were killed.
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日，希伯伦附近发生袭击事件，造成两名以色列士兵死亡，随后，被占领的约旦河西岸城市实施了封锁。

paras.en: More than 3,300 Palestinians have since been displaced or affected, with homes destroyed and businesses shut, according to the local municipality.
paras.zh: 据当地市政府称，自那以后，已有 3,300 多名巴勒斯坦人流离失所或受到影响，房屋被毁，企业关闭。

paras.en: Mayor Yousef al-Jabari told Al Jazeera on Saturday that daily economic losses were estimated to exceed 12 million shekels ($3.8m), with more than $1.9m worth of damage to infrastructure, along with losses in the health and environmental sectors estimated at about $160,000.
paras.zh: 市长优素福·贾巴里周六告诉半岛电视台，每日经济损失估计超过 1200 万谢克尔（380 万美元），基础设施损失超过 190 万美元，健康和环境部门的损失估计约为 16 万美元。

paras.en: He said Israeli forces have demolished 15 homes and other structures and forced 327 businesses to close. About 80,000 students have been unable to attend school for 10 days, he added.
paras.zh: 他说，以色列军队拆除了 15 所房屋和其他建筑物，并迫使 327 家企业关闭。他补充说，大约8万名学生已经10天无法上学。

paras.en: The mayor said Hebron accounts for about 40 percent of the Palestinian economy and the siege amounts to “collective punishment”.
paras.zh: 市长表示，希伯伦约占巴勒斯坦经济的 40%，围困相当于“集体惩罚”。

paras.en: Palestinian families in and around the city fear the army could soon extend its attacks.
paras.zh: 该市及其周边地区的巴勒斯坦家庭担心军队可能很快就会扩大袭击范围。

paras.en: Israeli arrests of Palestinians in Hebron and other cities in the occupied West Bank continued on Sunday.
paras.zh: 周日，以色列继续在希伯伦和被占领的约旦河西岸其他城市逮捕巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: Israeli forces arrested 10 Palestinian teachers in Masafer Yatta, south of Hebron and seized their vehicle, reported the Palestinian news agency Wafa.
paras.zh: 据巴勒斯坦瓦法通讯社报道，以色列军队在希伯伦南部的马萨费尔亚塔逮捕了 10 名巴勒斯坦教师，并没收了他们的车辆。

paras.en: Video shared by Palestinian media and verified by Al Jazeera showed the Israeli military raiding a school run by the United Nations in the Shufat refugee camp in occupied East Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦媒体分享并经半岛电视台核实的视频显示，以色列军队袭击了被占领的东耶路撒冷舒法特难民营内联合国开办的一所学校。

paras.en: The United Nations humanitarian office, OCHA, said Israeli settlers carried out 397 attacks on Palestinians across the occupied West Bank in October, the highest monthly figure since monitoring began in 2006, Wafa said.
paras.zh: 瓦法表示，联合国人道主义事务协调办公室表示，10 月份，以色列定居者在被占领的约旦河西岸对巴勒斯坦人发动了 397 次袭击，这是自 2006 年开始监测以来的最高月度数字。

paras.en: Between October 20 and 26, settler attacks targeted 49 Palestinian communities, mostly while Palestinians harvested olives on their land.
paras.zh: 10 月 20 日至 26 日期间，定居者袭击了 49 个巴勒斯坦社区，大部分是巴勒斯坦人在自己的土地上收获橄榄时进行的。

paras.en: Nine children were among 57 Palestinians injured by settlers and Israeli forces: 34 by military gunfire and physical assaults and 23 in settler attacks.
paras.zh: 被定居者和以色列军队打伤的 57 名巴勒斯坦人中有 9 名儿童：其中 34 人因军事枪击和人身攻击而受伤，23 人因定居者袭击而受伤。

paras.en: Since the start of 2015, Israeli authorities have issued 9,518 demolition or stop-work notices against Palestinian property in the occupied West Bank, reported the Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission. The Palestinian government commission added that 344 of those notices were given in the first nine months of this year.
paras.zh: 据殖民和隔离墙抵抗委员会报告，自 2015 年初以来，以色列当局已针对被占领西岸的巴勒斯坦财产发出了 9,518 份拆除或停工通知。巴勒斯坦政府委员会补充说，其中 344 份通知是在今年前 9 个月发出的。

articles.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州的参议员竞选面临着破坏候选人的指控。并且，赫格斯驱逐了陆军将军

paras.en: It is the final stretch before Election Day on Tuesday and candidates are making final campaign stops and delivering closing arguments. President Trump has been campaigning for at-risk Republicans, but he has abruptly switched to virtual rallies.
paras.zh: 这是周二选举日之前的最后阶段，候选人正在进行最后的竞选活动并发表结案陈词。特朗普总统一直在为面临风险的共和党人竞选，但他突然转向虚拟集会。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's tour to boost voter turnout has focused largely on competitive Republican-leaning states, NPR's Saige Miller tells Up First. He's hosting 19 telerallies alongside in-person events. The shift in strategy, plus polling data, suggests that Republicans may face challenges, at least in the House, Miller says. Trump knows he's a key motivator for his party, but his strategy could also backfire by energizing Democrats.
paras.zh: - NPR 的 Saige Miller 告诉 Up First，特朗普为提高选民投票率而进行的巡演主要集中在有竞争力的倾向共和党的州。他主持了 19 场电视集会以及现场活动。米勒表示，策略的转变加上民意调查数据表明共和党人可能面临挑战，至少在众议院是这样。特朗普知道他是民主党的关键推动者，但他的策略也可能因激励民主党而适得其反。

paras.en: - 🎧 Alaska's governor has ordered an investigation following a New York Times report on the state's toss-up U.S. Senate race. The article revealed that Democratic campaign operatives were attempting to recruit a candidate, whom Republicans claim could confuse voters and siphon support from GOP incumbent Dan Sullivan. The candidate also shares the name Dan Sullivan. Democrat Mary Peltola, a former congresswoman, aims to flip the seat. Alaska Public Media's Liz Ruskin spoke with election law experts, who found no applicable laws but noted that the conduct described crosses moral and ethical lines.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在《纽约时报》报道该州美国参议院选举悬而未决的情况后，阿拉斯加州州长已下令对此进行调查。文章透露，民主党竞选人员正试图招募一名候选人，共和党人声称该候选人可能会迷惑选民并窃取共和党现任总统丹·沙利文的支持。该候选人的名字也为丹·沙利文。前国会女议员、民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉(Mary Peltola)的目标是翻转席位。阿拉斯加公共媒体的莉兹·罗斯金与选举法专家进行了交谈，专家们没有找到适用的法律，但指出所描述的行为跨越了道德和伦理界限。

paras.en: - ➡️ The Department of Justice subpoenaed election workers in Los Angeles amid rising tensions with California officials over the Trump administration's efforts to identify noncitizens on voter rolls.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 由于特朗普政府试图识别选民名册上的非公民身份，司法部与加州官员之间的紧张关系日益紧张，司法部传唤了洛杉矶的选举工作人员。

paras.en: - ➡️ At the start of this election cycle, Democrats appeared unlikely to gain Senate seats because many races were in red states. But the ongoing war in Iran has changed the landscape. Here are the key Senate races to watch.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 在本次选举周期开始时，民主党似乎不太可能获得参议院席位，因为许多竞选都在红色州进行。但伊朗持续的战争改变了局势。以下是值得关注的关键参议院竞选。

paras.en: - ➡️ NPR member stations are compiling essential info for voters, from guides to local races. Discover resources in your community here.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 成员电台正在为选民收集重要信息，从指南到当地种族。在这里发现您社区中的资源。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed Army Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia, who oversaw planning at the Pentagon. Sylvia was also part of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. His removal comes as the U.S. and Israel prepare for a new potential round of attacks against Iran. Although Sylvia held a senior position in strategy, planning and policy, he was not directly involved in day-to-day operations regarding the Iran conflict.
paras.zh: 国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯解雇了负责五角大楼规划的陆军中将布雷特·西尔维亚。西尔维娅也是参谋长联席会议的成员。他被免职之际，美国和以色列正准备对伊朗发动新一轮潜在袭击。尽管西尔维娅在战略、规划和政策方面担任高级职务，但他并未直接参与有关伊朗冲突的日常行动。

paras.en: - 🎧 The Pentagon is investigating a leak but has not provided details, NPR's Greg Myre says. Hegseth has dismissed several generals and admirals, often without explanation. These firings have disrupted senior military operations, Myre says. The U.S. currently has two aircraft carriers in the Arabian Sea, with a third, the USS Theodore Roosevelt, en route. According to Myre, it is unusual for the U.S. to have multiple carriers in one region. The last time it stationed three in the Middle East was during the 2003 invasion of Iraq.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的格雷格·迈尔 (Greg Myre) 表示，五角大楼正在调查泄密事件，但尚未提供详细信息。赫格塞斯解雇了几位将军和海军上将，而且往往没有给出任何解释。迈雷说，这些解雇扰乱了高级军事行动。美国目前在阿拉伯海有两艘航空母舰，第三艘航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号正在航行中。迈尔表示，美国在一个地区拥有多家运营商的情况并不常见。上一次在中东驻扎三艘是在2003年入侵伊拉克期间。

paras.en: Thousands of military veterans with VA-backed mortgages have faced higher interest rates and monthly payments since last year, after the Trump administration shut down a key part of the VA's home loan program. Before it was shut down, the Veterans Affairs Servicing Purchase (VASP) program, created under the Biden administration, helped tens of thousands of veterans who had fallen behind on their payments by rolling missed payments into a new, low-interest mortgage. The mortgage industry and housing groups warned the administration not to kill the program without first creating a viable replacement. Without one, vets had to modify loans at higher interest rates. An NPR investigation found that more than 15,000 veterans experienced monthly payment increases of at least $150 after their loans were modified due to financial hardship. More than 700 veterans saw their payments rise by $1,000 or more.
paras.zh: 自去年特朗普政府关闭退伍军人管理局住房贷款计划的一个关键部分后，数千名拥有退伍军人管理局支持的抵押贷款的退伍军人面临着更高的利率和月供。在拜登政府创建的退伍军人事务服务购买（VASP）计划被关闭之前，该计划通过将拖欠的付款转入新的低息抵押贷款，帮助了数万名拖欠付款的退伍军人。抵押贷款行业和住房团体警告政府，在没有首先制定可行的替代方案之前，不要终止该计划。如果没有这一条件，退伍军人就必须以更高的利率修改贷款。 NPR 的一项调查发现，超过 15,000 名退伍军人因经济困难而修改贷款后，每月付款至少增加 150 美元。 700 多名退伍军人的付款增加了 1,000 美元或更多。

paras.en: by Rob Stein, NPR's science desk correspondent and senior editor
paras.zh: 作者：Rob Stein，NPR 科学台记者兼高级编辑

paras.en: I've been doing stories about the organ transplantation system for decades. One of the most fundamental guiding ethical principles in organ donation has long been the "dead donor rule." That rule, stated simply, says: Organs should only be retrieved for transplants from a person who is dead, and death should never be accelerated to try to boost the chances their organs will be usable. To make sure that's the case, there's long been a strict firewall between the doctors and nurses trying to save patients in the hospital, and the organ retrieval teams standing by to try to procure their organs.
paras.zh: 几十年来我一直在写有关器官移植系统的故事。长期以来，器官捐献最基本的道德指导原则之一就是“死亡捐献者规则”。这条规则简单地说就是：只能从死者身上取出器官用于移植，并且永远不应该为了增加器官可用的机会而加速死亡。为了确保情况确实如此，医院里试图抢救病人的医生和护士与随时待命试图获取他们器官的器官检索小组之间一直存在着严格的防火墙。

paras.en: But over the years, I've heard many stories from family members who nevertheless felt pressured to donate their loved one's organs. So when I got a tip that the Organ Procurement & Transplantation Network, which runs the nation's organ system, was planning to relax that firewall, I instantly knew that was a big story.
paras.zh: 但多年来，我从家庭成员那里听到了许多故事，他们仍然感到捐献亲人器官的压力。因此，当我得知负责管理国家器官系统的器官采购和移植网络计划放松防火墙时，我立即知道这是一个大新闻。

paras.en: I rushed to confirm the documentation that the network's board of directors had indeed endorsed the change, which would go into effect Nov. 18. I then reached out to bioethicists and others for their reaction to this major change. The revision was part of a set of new policies designed to boost donations and improve patient safety. Those changes were spurred by disturbing revelations about mistakes, including patients literally being wheeled into the operating room to remove their organs when they were still alive. Some of the changes were praised as improving safety. But many bioethicists and even some transplant surgeons and patient and organ donation advocates say relaxing the firewall between care and organ retrieval teams is dangerous. The fear is it could lead to families and caregivers discontinuing treatment too soon, and deepening distrust in the organ donation system.
paras.zh: 我赶紧确认文件，证明网络董事会确实批准了这一变更，该变更将于 11 月 18 日生效。然后我联系了生物伦理学家和其他人，了解他们对这一重大变更的反应。此次修订是旨在增加捐赠和改善患者安全的一系列新政策的一部分。这些变化是由于有关错误的令人不安的揭露而引发的，包括患者在活着的时候被推入手术室切除器官。其中一些变化因提高安全性而受到称赞。但许多生物伦理学家，甚至一些移植外科医生以及患者和器官捐赠倡导者表示，放松护理和器官检索团队之间的防火墙是危险的。人们担心这可能会导致家人和护理人员过早停止治疗，并加深对器官捐献系统的不信任。

paras.en: I explored what these rule changes will mean for organ donors. You can read about it here.
paras.zh: 我探讨了这些规则的变化对器官捐献者意味着什么。您可以在这里阅读相关内容。

paras.en: Check out what NPR is watching, reading and listening to this weekend:
paras.zh: 看看 NPR 本周末正在观看、阅读和收听的节目：

paras.en: 🍿 Movies: It's officially Halloweekend a.k.a. the perfect time to watch a horror movie. Clayface embraces body horror to tell the origin story of the eponymous Batman villain. Tom Rhys Harries stars as an actor who turns to AI and nanotechnology for a radical solution after a mob boss disfigures him.
paras.zh: 🍿 电影：万圣节周末正式到来，又名观看恐怖电影的最佳时间。泥脸拥抱身体恐怖，讲述同名蝙蝠侠恶棍的起源故事。汤姆·里斯·哈里斯 (Tom Rhys Harries) 饰演一名演员，在被黑帮老大毁容后，他求助于人工智能和纳米技术来寻求彻底的解决方案。

paras.en: 📺 TV: HBO's War features Dominic West and Sienna Miller as a British couple battling it out in a high-stakes divorce. Their fierce legal teams intensify the drama.
paras.zh: 📺 电视剧：HBO 的《战争》讲述了多米尼克·韦斯特 (Dominic West) 和西耶娜·米勒 (Sienna Miller) 饰演一对英国夫妇在一场高风险离婚中的斗争。他们凶猛的法律团队加剧了这场戏剧性的事件。

paras.en: 📚 Books: Elizabeth McCracken's Seven Stories About Tammy weaves together interconnected short stories about a family's experiences with the eldest son's girlfriend.
paras.zh: 📚 书籍：伊丽莎白·麦克拉肯（Elizabeth McCracken）的《关于塔米的七个故事》将相互关联的短篇故事编织在一起，讲述了一个家庭与大儿子女友的经历。

paras.en: 🎵 Music: Slovakian singer Adéla has spent her life preparing for pop stardom. She has recently gained attention with her hit song "Nicole Kidman." In this interview with NPR's World Cafe, she discusses the music industry and her debut album, PRIMA.
paras.zh: 🎵 音乐：斯洛伐克歌手阿德拉一生都在为成为流行歌星做准备。她最近凭借热门歌曲“妮可·基德曼”而受到关注。在接受 NPR World Cafe 采访时，她讨论了音乐产业和她的首张专辑《PRIMA》。

paras.en: ❓ Quiz: This week brought pre-midterm drama. Plus, the rest of the world also held elections. Stay sharp — you'll nail at least three questions.
paras.zh: ❓ 测验：本周带来了期中考试前的戏剧。此外，世界其他地区也举行了选举。保持敏锐——你至少会解决三个问题。

paras.en: - Sir Patrick Stewart, who played Professor X in the X-Men franchise and the captain of the starship USS Enterprise on Star Trek: The Next Generation, died on Wednesday at 86.
paras.zh: - 帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士于周三去世，享年 86 岁。

paras.en: - A new study in Science shows that a species of bird called the Manx shearwater experiences jet lag similar to humans. Researchers found that during long flights across the Atlantic, these birds become disoriented as their internal clock falls out of sync with the sun.
paras.zh: - 《科学》杂志上的一项新研究表明，一种名为马恩岛海鸥的鸟类会经历与人类类似的时差反应。研究人员发现，在跨越大西洋的长途飞行中，这些鸟类会因为生物钟与太阳不同步而变得迷失方向。

paras.en: - In this week's installment of Far-Flung Postcards, NPR's Jane Arraf sends greetings from the former home of English mystery novelist Agatha Christie, located on the banks of the Tigris River in Baghdad. The house now stands abandoned and crumbling.
paras.zh: - 在本周的《遥远的明信片》中，美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的简·阿拉夫 (Jane Arraf) 从位于巴格达底格里斯河畔的英国悬疑小说家阿加莎·克里斯蒂 (Agatha Christie) 的故居发出了问候。这座房子现在被遗弃并且摇摇欲坠。

articles.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
paras.zh: 区块链情报公司将朝鲜与币安 6.3B 美元黑客事件联系起来

paras.en: A U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm says a North Korean unit was likely behind the hack that impacted more than $6 billion on Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange.
paras.zh: 一家总部位于美国的区块链情报公司表示，朝鲜单位可能是此次黑客攻击的幕后黑手，此次黑客攻击给全球最大的加密货币交易所币安造成了超过 60 亿美元的损失。

paras.en: Binance said it worked with blockchain partners to freeze roughly $3 billion in affected assets. It said Friday that it was beginning to recover assets for users.
paras.zh: 币安表示，它与区块链合作伙伴合作冻结了大约 30 亿美元的受影响资产。该公司周五表示，已开始为用户追回资产。

paras.en: The cryptocurrency exchange said deposits were unaffected, while withdrawals have been suspended and are expected to resume in the next day or two. It said it will cover all losses.
paras.zh: 该加密货币交易所表示，存款不受影响，而提款已暂停，预计将在未来一两天内恢复。它表示将弥补所有损失。

paras.en: The company said on X that an initial investigation suggested the incident may have involved a compromised laptop, but that a subsequent investigation uncovered additional "points of breach."
paras.zh: 该公司在 X 上表示，初步调查表明该事件可能涉及一台遭到入侵的笔记本电脑，但随后的调查发现了其他“违规点”。

paras.en: TRM, in a post on its website Thursday, attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, which it described as North Korea's elite hacking unit. "We make this judgment with high confidence," the firm said.
paras.zh: TRM 周四在其网站上发布帖子，将此次攻击归咎于 TraderTraitor，并将其描述为朝鲜的精英黑客组织。该公司表示：“我们非常有信心地做出这一判断。”

paras.en: "An attacker moved approximately USD 6.36 billion out of Binance wallets on ten blockchains, most of it in about 20 minutes," TRM said. That would make the hack the largest cryptocurrency theft on record, it said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“攻击者从十个区块链上的币安钱包中转移了约 63.6 亿美元，其中大部分在大约 20 分钟内转移。”据称，这将使此次黑客攻击成为有记录以来最大的加密货币盗窃案。

paras.en: In February last year, another cryptocurrency exchange, Bybit, suffered a $1.5 billion hit when it was hacked. The FBI said North Korea and TraderTraitor were responsible for the hack.
paras.zh: 去年2月，另一家加密货币交易所Bybit遭受黑客攻击，损失达15亿美元。美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 表示，朝鲜和 TraderTraitor 对此次黑客攻击负有责任。

paras.en: "Several features of this attack match earlier North Korea-linked heists, including the Bybit hack," TRM said.
paras.zh: TRM 表示：“这次攻击的几个特征与之前与朝鲜有关的抢劫事件相符，包括 Bybit 黑客攻击。”

paras.en: Blockchain analysis company Chainalysis also believed the Binance hack was "likely done by DPRK group TraderTraitor," its co-founder and CEO Jonathan Levin wrote on X. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name.
paras.zh: 区块链分析公司 Chainaanalysis 的联合创始人兼首席执行官 Jonathan Levin 在 X 上写道，币安的黑客攻击“很可能是由 DPRK 组织 TraderTraitor 所为”。DPRK 代表朝鲜民主主义人民共和国，这是朝鲜的官方名称。

paras.en: Asked about the potential ties to North Korea, a Binance spokesperson said only that the company is "working closely with our law enforcement partners to confirm the identity of the criminals and bring them to justice."
paras.zh: 当被问及与朝鲜的潜在联系时，币安发言人仅表示，该公司正在“与我们的执法合作伙伴密切合作，以确认犯罪分子的身份并将他们绳之以法”。

paras.en: Experts say North Korea has turned to crypto hacking and other illicit cyber activities as a source of badly needed foreign currency to support its troubled economy and fund its nuclear program in the wake of tough U.N. sanctions and other difficulties.
paras.zh: 专家表示，在联合国严厉制裁和其他困难之后，朝鲜已转向加密黑客和其他非法网络活动作为急需的外汇来源，以支持其陷入困境的经济并为其核计划提供资金。

paras.en: In December 2022, South Korea's spy agency said North Korean hackers had stolen an estimated 1.5 trillion won ($1.1 billion) in cryptocurrency and other virtual assets in the past five years, more than half of it in 2022 alone. It said North Korea's capacity to steal digital assets was considered among the best in the world.
paras.zh: 2022 年 12 月，韩国间谍机构表示，朝鲜黑客在过去五年中窃取了估计 1.5 万亿韩元（11 亿美元）的加密货币和其他虚拟资产，仅 2022 年就窃取了一半以上。报告称，朝鲜窃取数字资产的能力被认为是世界上最好的。

paras.en: Changpeng Zhao, also known as CZ, founded Binance in 2017. In 2023, he pleaded guilty to a felony linked to failing to prevent money laundering on the platform, and stepped down as the company's CEO. U.S. President Donald Trump pardoned Zhao in 2025.
paras.zh: 赵长鹏，又名 CZ，于 2017 年创立了币安。2023 年，他承认了与未能防止平台洗钱有关的重罪，并辞去了公司首席执行官的职务。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于 2025 年赦免了赵。

paras.en: Zhao posted Thursday on X that "User funds are safe!" but added that the theft "does look like a hack on Binance." He added that while he doesn't manage Binance anymore, "as a shareholder, I expect all user funds will be fully covered."
paras.zh: 赵周四在X上发帖称“用户资金是安全的！”但他补充说，这起盗窃事件“看起来确实像是对币安的黑客攻击”。他补充说，虽然他不再管理币安，但“作为股东，我预计所有用户资金都将得到全额保障。”

paras.en: The event, meanwhile, also raises questions about why stronger approval controls were not in place, said Kok Tin Gan, cofounder and CEO of cybersecurity firm NyxLab.
paras.zh: 与此同时，网络安全公司 NyxLab 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Kok Tin Gan 表示，此次活动也引发了人们的疑问，即为什么没有实施更强有力的审批控制。

paras.en: "This looks like one signature that gave the attacker a never-expiring, full-access token to a Binance hot wallet," he said, referring to cryptocurrency wallets that hold users' "private keys," or unique authorizations, digitally and which are connected to the internet.
paras.zh: 他说：“这看起来像是一个签名，它为攻击者提供了一个永不过期、完全访问币安热钱包的令牌。”他指的是以数字方式保存用户“私钥”或唯一授权并连接到互联网的加密货币钱包。

paras.en: Binance said on X it had "found no evidence of any wallet private key leak" and that the company would release more technical details when its probe is complete.
paras.zh: 币安在 X 上表示，“没有发现任何钱包私钥泄露的证据”，该公司将在调查完成后发布更多技术细节。

articles.title: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing
articles.author: Jennifer Pak

paras.en: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing
paras.zh: 本周北京政治会议的要点

paras.en: BEIJING— China's ruling Communist Party concluded its most important meeting of the year, confirming the expulsion of 33 senior party members, as leader Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign continues to widen.
paras.zh: 北京——随着领导人习近平的反腐败运动继续扩大，中国执政的共产党结束了今年最重要的会议，确认开除 33 名高级党员。

paras.en: The political meeting, known as the fifth plenum, began on Monday and wrapped up on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这次政治会议被称为五中全会，于周一开始，周四结束。

paras.en: Of the 376 full and alternate central committee members originally named in 2022, only 279 attended – more than a quarter absent. Many of them are believed to be under investigation.
paras.zh: 在 2022 年最初任命的 376 名正式和候补中央委员会成员中，只有 279 人出席——超过四分之一缺席。据信其中许多人正在接受调查。

paras.en: The focus of the meeting was on anti-corruption and discipline, but Joseph Torigian, a professor of Chinese studies at American University in Washington D.C., says the meeting sends another signal amid wide speculation that he will seek a fourth term in office next year.
paras.zh: 会议的焦点是反腐败和纪律问题，但华盛顿特区美利坚大学中国研究教授约瑟夫·托里吉安(Joseph Torigian)表示，在人们普遍猜测他明年将寻求第四个任期的情况下，这次会议发出了另一个信号。

paras.en: "This is Xi Jinping setting up for the next party congress next year by ensuring that everybody is on the same page as him," he says.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是习近平为明年下届党代会做的准备，确保每个人都与他意见一致。”

paras.en: The meeting reveals how much work Xi thinks his party still has to do to become a more effective, loyal governing institution, according to Neil Thomas, senior fellow on Chinese politics at the Asia Society Policy Institute.
paras.zh: 亚洲协会政策研究所中国政治高级研究员尼尔·托马斯表示，这次会议揭示了习近平认为中共还需要做多少工作才能成为一个更有效、更忠诚的执政机构。

paras.en: That is something he said Americans should also pay attention to, because it impacts the U.S. calculus on how willing China would be to use force over Taiwan, the South China Sea and disputes with the U.S.
paras.zh: 他说，这也是美国人应该关注的事情，因为这会影响美国对中国在台湾、南海以及与美国的争端问题上使用武力的意愿的考量。

paras.en: "The focus of this fifth plenum suggests to me that Xi is unlikely to take that risk until he feels more comfortable with the party that he leads," Thomas says.
paras.zh: 托马斯说：“在我看来，这次五中全会的焦点表明，习近平不太可能冒这个风险，除非他对自己领导的政党感到更加满意。”

paras.en: Here are other major takeaways from the meeting:
paras.zh: 以下是会议的其他主要内容：

paras.en: Among the 33 expelled party members are Zhang Youxia, formerly China's most senior military general and Liu Jianchao, a senior Chinese diplomat previously tipped to be the next foreign minister.
paras.zh: 被开除党籍的33名党员中包括前中国最高军事将领张又侠和此前被认为将担任下一任外交部长的中国高级外交官刘建超。

paras.en: China's military leadership ranks has "almost completely been purged in the last three or four years," according to Thomas.
paras.zh: 托马斯表示，中国的军事领导层“在过去三四年里几乎被彻底清洗”。

paras.en: However, one man not only survived the purges, but has been elevated – general Zhang Shengmin. He has been a key player in Xi's anti-corruption campaign. At the meeting he was promoted to the Politburo, which consists of more than 20 of the party's top officials. His promotion, according to Thomas, reinforces the importance of anti-corruption work in the military.
paras.zh: 然而，有一个人不仅在清洗中幸存下来，而且还得到了提升——张胜民将军。他一直是习近平反腐败运动的关键人物。在这次会议上，他被提升为政治局委员，该政治局由20多名党内高级官员组成。托马斯表示，他的晋升凸显了军队反腐败工作的重要性。

paras.en: "There's a lot of churn going on," Torigian says. "That raises questions about just who [Xi's] going to look to to fill in the ranks when there's a big succession coming up at the next Party congress next year."
paras.zh: “正在发生很多流失，”托里吉安说。 “这引发了这样的问题：明年的党代表大会上将出现重大继任者，习近平将寻找谁来填补这一空缺。”

paras.en: One of the key themes out of the meeting was strengthening party governance.
paras.zh: 会议的主题之一是加强党的执政能力建设。

paras.en: Xi is looking to maintain the party's conviction from one generation to the next by convincing people to "put the Chinese Communist Party at the center of their lives and not their own selfish interests," according to Torigian.
paras.zh: 托里吉安表示，习近平希望说服人们“把中国共产党置于生活的中心，而不是个人利益的中心”，从而一代又一代地维护党的信念。

paras.en: He adds that this is a topic close to Xi's heart on how a communist regime can "maintain its purity and not degrade and collapse" like many other communist parties have in other countries.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这是习近平关心的一个话题，即共产主义政权如何能够像其他国家的许多其他共产党一样“保持纯洁性，而不是堕落和崩溃”。

paras.en: Tackling corruption to "pointless formalities"
paras.zh: 将腐败问题归咎于“毫无意义的手续”

paras.en: Xi's anti-corruption campaign started when he came into power in late 2012.
paras.zh: 习近平2012年底上台后就开始了反腐败运动。

paras.en: Since then, 7.9 million individuals have been punished, including over 960 senior officials, Zhang Fuhai, Deputy Secretary of the Communist party's Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, told reporters on Friday.
paras.zh: 中共中央纪律检查委员会副书记张福海周五对记者表示，自此以来，已有 790 万人受到处罚，其中包括 960 多名高级官员。

paras.en: "The fight against corruption remains serious, complicated, and eradicating the breeding ground for corruption remains a formidable task," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“反腐败斗争依然严峻复杂，铲除腐败滋生土壤的任务依然艰巨。”

paras.en: Xi has also complained about excessive formalities and bureaucracy, which according to Torigian is party language for going through the motions, having lots of meetings "but never actually achieving anything."
paras.zh: 习近平还抱怨过度的手续和官僚主义，托里吉安认为，这是走走过场的党用语，召开大量会议，“但从未真正取得任何成果”。

paras.en: At the same time, there will be more regular reporting from discipline inspectors to central authorities to add scrutiny on local officials.
paras.zh: 与此同时，纪检人员将更加定期地向中央报告，以加强对地方官员的监督。

paras.en: But to avoid attracting the attention of the discipline system, local officials may play things really safe, leading to more inertia, less experimentation, and "may end up having the opposite effect to what Xi intended," Thomas said.
paras.zh: 但托马斯表示，为了避免引起纪律系统的注意，地方官员可能会采取非常谨慎的做法，从而导致更多的惰性、更少的尝试，“最终可能会产生与习近平的意图相反的效果”。

paras.en: No insight gleaned at the plenum on Xi's successor
paras.zh: 全会上没有收集到有关习近平继任者的任何见解

paras.en: Few political watchers believe Xi will pick a successor at the next party congress, and nobody knows exactly what he will do when he is ready to step down, according to Torigian.
paras.zh: 托里吉安表示，很少有政治观察家相信习近平会在下届党代表大会上挑选继任者，也没有人确切知道他准备下台时会做什么。

paras.en: Full decisions from the meeting, and perhaps deliverables, are expected to be published in the coming days.
paras.zh: 会议的全部决定以及可能的交付成果预计将在未来几天内公布。

paras.en: Additional research by Jasmine Ling in Beijing.
paras.zh: Jasmine Ling 在北京进行的补充研究。
