It offers an incredible 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers (17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR after). The balance transfer fee (5%; $5 min.) is higher than some cards, but if you want an equally long intro APR on purchases and balance transfers, this card is hard to beat.
paras.zh: 如果您的首要任务是尽可能长时间地避免信用卡利息，那么这张简单的卡是一个不错的选择。从购买账户开户和合格余额转账起，它提供令人难以置信的 0% 介绍年利率 21 个月（之后为 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率）。余额转账费用（5%；至少 5 美元）比某些卡要高，但如果您想要购买和余额转账时有同样长的年利率介绍，那么这张卡很难被击败。

paras.en: These cards are designed for people looking to pay off a large purchase or transfer a balance — so our ratings emphasize interest-free periods, fee structures, and how much time you really get to pay things down.
paras.zh: 这些卡是为那些希望还清大额购买或转移余额的人而设计的，因此我们的评级强调免息期、费用结构以及您真正还清贷款的时间。

paras.en: We don’t penalize cards for a lack of long-term rewards here – this category is all about interest savings, and our ratings reflect that.
paras.zh: 我们不会因为缺乏长期奖励而对信用卡进行处罚——这一类别主要是为了节省利息，我们的评级反映了这一点。

paras.en: We combine these factors with an evaluation of brand reputation and customer satisfaction to ensure you're getting the best high limit card recommendations. Our aim is to maintain a balanced best-of list featuring top-scoring high limit credit cards from reputable brands. 'Best for' category selections on this page are determined by our editors, and a single card may be recognized in multiple categories.
paras.zh: 我们将这些因素与品牌声誉和客户满意度评估相结合，以确保您获得最佳的高限额卡推荐。我们的目标是维持一个平衡的最佳列表，其中包括来自知名品牌的得分最高的高限额信用卡。此页面上的“最佳”类别选择由我们的编辑确定，单张卡片可能会在多个类别中被识别。

paras.en: Ordering within lists is influenced by advertiser compensation, including featured placements at the top of a given list, but our product recommendations are NEVER influenced by advertisers. Learn more about how Motley Fool Money rates credit cards.
paras.zh: 列表中的排序受到广告商补偿的影响，包括给定列表顶部的特色展示位置，但我们的产品推荐永远不会受到广告商的影响。详细了解 Motley Fool Money 如何对信用卡进行评级。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is best for people carrying high-interest debt or planning a large purchase they want to spread out over time.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡最适合背负高息债务或计划长期进行大额购买的人士。

paras.en: You get nearly two years of breathing room with no interest, which can save a lot of money while you pay things off.
paras.zh: 您将获得近两年的无息喘息空间，这可以在您还清债务的同时节省大量资金。

paras.en: If you're looking for cash back or travel rewards, this is not the card for you. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card has no rewards program and no welcome bonus. It loses most of its value the moment the intro period ends.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻求现金返还或旅行奖励，那么这张卡不适合您。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡没有奖励计划，也没有欢迎奖金。一旦介绍期结束，它就失去了大部分价值。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card's headline feature is 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers. (A 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR applies after.)
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的主要特点是，自开户购买和合格余额转账起 21 个月内，年利率为 0%。 （此后适用 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率。）

paras.en: That's one of the longest 0% APR periods you'll find anywhere -- which is why it earned Motley Fool Money's award for Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 这是您能在任何地方找到的最长的 0% 年利率卡之一 - 这就是为什么它获得 Motley Fool Money 颁发的 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡奖。

paras.en: This long intro APR is particularly handy for large balances (think anything $5,000+). The longer the promo window, the less you need to pay each month to clear your balance while paying no interest.
paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡支付每月的电话费时，该卡包含手机保护功能。每次盗窃或损坏索赔的赔付额最高为 600 美元，免赔额为 25 美元，并且每 12 个月最多可以提出两次索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的最低信用额度为 1,000 美元，分数和收入越高，通常获得的信用额度也越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用状况单独设置您的限额，因此两个申请人可以获得截然不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

paras.zh: 富国银行是 Motley Fool Money 的广告合作伙伴。乔尔·奥利里 (Joel O'Leary) 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 没有持有上述任何股票的头寸。 Motley Fool 有披露政策。

paras.zh: The Motley Fool 拥有 Visa 的股份并推荐该公司。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派别试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时间，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的奇妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通将比私家车多花一到两个小时。

articles.title: Texas firefighters rescue distressed raccoon after its head gets stuck in a hole in a tree

paras.en: Raccoons are known for getting into all kinds of things while out scavenging for food. They will tip over garbage cans, rip open bags and even climb into an attic looking for food if they can find a way in.
paras.zh: 众所周知，浣熊在外出寻找食物时会陷入各种事物中。他们会翻倒垃圾桶、撕开袋子，如果能找到办法，甚至会爬进阁楼寻找食物。

paras.en: They will also use tree hollows for dens. Assuming, of course, that they fit into said tree hollow — which isn’t always the case, as firefighters in Austin, Texas, found out last week when a raccoon got its head stuck in a hole in a tree.
paras.zh: 他们还将利用树洞作为巢穴。当然，假设它们适合所说的树洞——但情况并非总是如此，正如德克萨斯州奥斯汀市的消防员上周发现的那样，一只浣熊的头卡在了树洞里。

paras.en: A concerned neighbor called the Austin Fire Department to see if they could help the trash panda out. It wasn’t reported if the raccoon was after food or if it was in the market for a den when it became stuck in the tree.
paras.zh: 一位忧心忡忡的邻居给奥斯汀消防局打电话，询问他们是否可以帮助这只垃圾熊猫。目前还没有报道浣熊被卡在树上时是在寻找食物还是在市场上寻找巢穴。

paras.en: What was reported is that the firefighters answered the call, used a Jaws of Life-type tool, and freed the stuck animal from the hole in the tree.
paras.zh: 据报道，消防队员响应了呼叫，使用了“生命之颚”类型的工具，将被困的动物从树洞中救了出来。

paras.en: The raccoon’s apparent limpness as it was lowered to the ground caused concern that its scavenging days were behind it. The firefighters addressed those concerns.
paras.zh: 当浣熊被放倒在地时，它明显的软弱无力，让人担心它吃腐肉的日子已经过去了。消防员解决了这些问题。

paras.en: "RACCOON RESCUE UPDATE: HE’S OKAY! For everyone who has been concerned about the raccoon Austin firefighters recently rescued from a tree, we have good news!" the Austin Firefighter Association wrote.
paras.zh: “浣熊救援最新消息：他没事！对于所有关心奥斯汀消防员最近从树上救出的浣熊的人来说，我们有好消息！”奥斯汀消防员协会写道。

paras.en: "Although the video may make it look like the raccoon is unconscious or has passed away when crews free him and lower him to the ground using a tool called a catch pole, we’re happy to report that he was alive and unharmed!"
paras.zh: “虽然视频可能会让浣熊看起来失去知觉或已经死亡，但当工作人员使用一种称为捕捉杆的工具将其释放到地面时，我们很高兴地报告说，它还活着并且没有受伤！”

paras.en: Perhaps the raccoon was simply embarrassed by the miscalculation of the size of its head in relation to the size of the hole. I'm sure it's not the first nor will it be the last raccoon to do so.
paras.zh: 也许浣熊只是因为错误地计算了自己头部的大小与洞的大小而感到尴尬。我确信这不是第一只也不会是最后一只这样做的浣熊。

paras.en: "After what we can only imagine was a long, stressful struggle with his head stuck in the tree, our little friend was understandably tired. But when firefighters handed him over to Animal Control, he was okay!," the update continued.
paras.zh: “我们只能想象，在他的头卡在树上进行了漫长而紧张的挣扎之后，我们的小朋友很累，这是可以理解的。但是当消防队员将他交给动物控制中心时，他没事了！”更新继续说道。

paras.en: "Thank you to everyone who reached out and showed concern for this little guy. We’re glad this rescue had a happy ending!"
paras.zh: “感谢所有关心这个小家伙的人。我们很高兴这次救援有一个圆满的结局！”

paras.en: What more can you ask for from a raccoon with its head stuck in a tree hollow story than a happy ending?
paras.zh: 对于一只头卡在树洞里的浣熊的故事，除了一个幸福的结局，你还能要求什么呢？

articles.title: 'Squad' rakes in record $2.35M while slamming the door on cop donations

paras.en: A joint fundraising committee for four progressive House Democrats has raised a record $2.35 million so far this election cycle, while barring donations from the Fraternal Order of Police, according to federal filings and the committee’s disclosure.
paras.zh: 根据联邦文件和委员会披露的信息，四名进步的众议院民主党人组成的联合筹款委员会在本次选举周期迄今为止已筹集了创纪录的 235 万美元，同时禁止警察兄弟会捐款。

paras.en: The Squad Victory Fund is authorized by Reps. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y.; Ilhan Omar, D-Minn.; Ayanna Pressley, D-Mass.; and Rashida Tlaib, D-Mich. The fundraising gives the four lawmakers and their allied political groups a shared vehicle to collect and distribute campaign contributions.
paras.zh: The Squad Victory Fund is authorized by Reps. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, D-N.Y.;伊尔汗·奥马尔 (Ilhan Omar)，明尼苏达州民主党人；阿亚娜·普莱斯利 (Ayanna Pressley)，马萨诸塞州民主党人；和拉希达·特莱布（Rashida Tlaib），密歇根州民主党人。 The fundraising gives the four lawmakers and their allied political groups a shared vehicle to collect and distribute campaign contributions.

paras.en: The fund’s donor rules also make clear which groups it says it will not accept money from, and one is the Fraternal Order of Police, the nation’s largest police organization. It also bars donations from corporations, federal lobbyists and fossil fuel interests. The disclosure does not explain the FOP exclusion.
paras.zh: 该基金的捐助规则还明确规定不会接受哪些团体的资金，其中之一就是美国最大的警察组织警察兄弟会。它还禁止企业、联邦游说者和化石燃料利益集团的捐赠。该披露并未解释 FOP 排除。

paras.en: The fund’s other participants include four allied PACs. Contributions are generally divided equally among the eight participants, with each slated to receive 12.5%, though donors may designate their contributions for a specific participant.
paras.zh: 该基金的其他参与者包括四个联合 PAC。捐款通常在八个参与者之间平均分配，每个参与者预计获得 12.5%，不过捐赠者可以将其捐款指定给特定的参与者。

paras.en: The fund has raised $2,351,388.02 in the 2025–2026 election cycle, its highest total to date, according to its FEC summary.
paras.zh: 根据 FEC 的摘要，该基金在 2025-2026 年选举周期中筹集了 2,351,388.02 美元，这是迄今为止的最高总额。

paras.en: Through March 31, 2026, it had spent about $1.6 million and reported roughly $68,000 in cash on hand. The committee remains active, so those figures may change.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，该公司已支出约 160 万美元，手头现金约为 68,000 美元。该委员会仍然活跃，因此这些数字可能会发生变化。

paras.en: Contributions are not tax-deductible, the disclosure notes.
paras.zh: 披露指出，捐款不可免税。

articles.title: Shootings near 3 college communities leave 1 dead, at least 21 injured

paras.en: Shootings in three college communities over the weekend left one person dead and at least 21 others injured.
paras.zh: 周末，三个大学社区发生枪击事件，造成 1 人死亡、至少 21 人受伤。

paras.en: Indiana, Delaware and Alabama police are each investigating shootings in crowded parties near college communities, according to police and university statements.
paras.zh: 据警方和大学声明，印第安纳州、特拉华州和阿拉巴马州警方正在调查大学社区附近拥挤聚会中发生的枪击事件。

paras.en: Seven were hospitalized in Bloomington, Indiana, near Indiana University's homecoming, while the University of Delaware is still counting victims (six are reportedly hospitalized) and the Magic City Classic football game between Alabama A&M and Alabama State near Legion Field in Birmingham, Alabama, left at least one dead and eight wounded.
paras.zh: 印第安纳州布卢明顿市印第安纳大学返校节附近有 7 人住院，特拉华大学仍在统计遇难者人数（据报道有 6 人住院），阿拉巴马州伯明翰军团球场附近的阿拉巴马农工大学和阿拉巴马州立大学之间的魔术城经典橄榄球赛造成至少 1 人死亡、8 人受伤。

paras.en: After midnight near Indiana University, officers monitoring a large crowd around Kirkwood Avenue and Dunn Street heard shots around 1:30 a.m. ET and saw a man with a firearm running from the area, Bloomington police said.
paras.zh: 布卢明顿警方称，午夜过后，印第安纳大学附近，监视柯克伍德大道和邓恩街周围一大群人群的警察在东部时间凌晨 1 点 30 分左右听到枪声，并看到一名持枪男子从该地区逃跑。

paras.en: Officers took the man into custody near Dunn Meadow, and recovered a gun and shell casings in the area. Police said it remains unclear whether the suspect fired any shots.
paras.zh: 警方在邓恩梅多附近拘留了该男子，并在该地区找到了一把枪和弹壳。警方表示，目前尚不清楚嫌疑人是否开枪。

paras.en: No deaths were reported in Bloomington, and police said they did not know whether there were additional victims.
paras.zh: 布卢明顿没有死亡报告，警方表示不知道是否还有其他受害者。

paras.en: A disturbance in the crowd may have preceded the shooting, police said. Indiana University police and Indiana State Police assisted in the response.
paras.zh: 警方表示，枪击事件发生前可能发生了人群骚乱。印第安纳大学警察和印第安纳州警察协助应对。

paras.en: In Newark, Delaware, a shooting on Saturday night rocked the University of Delaware.
paras.zh: 在特拉华州纽瓦克，周六晚上发生的枪击事件震惊了特拉华大学。

paras.en: "We are deeply concerned about the shooting on Main Street Saturday night, which has impacted our entire community," the school's director of media relations Peter Bothum told Fox News Digital in a statement. "We are grateful to the Newark Police Department, which is leading the investigation. Wee will continue to communicate confirmed information, which will be shared on a dedicated alerts page (udel.edu/about/alerts) and updated as we learn more."
paras.zh: 学校媒体关系总监彼得·博瑟姆（Peter Bothum）在一份声明中告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“我们对周六晚上发生在大街上的枪击事件深感担忧，这影响了我们整个社区。” “我们感谢领导调查的纽瓦克警察局。Wee 将继续传达已确认的信息，这些信息将在专门的警报页面 (udel.edu/about/alerts) 上共享，并在我们了解更多信息时进行更新。”

paras.en: University President Laura Carlson said victims were receiving care and thanked Newark police, campus police and other first responders for providing on-scene care.
paras.zh: 大学校长劳拉·卡尔森表示，受害者正在接受护理，并感谢纽瓦克警察、校园警察和其他急救人员提供的现场护理。

paras.en: "I am writing to you about the shooting last night in Newark on Main Street, although it is difficult to know what to say when violence like this erupts in our community," she wrote in an email to the school community.
paras.zh: 她在给学校社区的一封电子邮件中写道：“我写信给你们，是关于昨晚在纽瓦克大街发生的枪击事件，尽管当我们社区爆发这样的暴力事件时，很难知道该说些什么。”

paras.en: "We are all impacted," she continued. "I ask that you keep the victims in your thoughts and hearts as they receive care. Please also recognize the impact and toll on our students and community members who were on Main Street last night and witnessed this violence."
paras.zh: “我们都受到了影响，”她继续说道。 “我请求你们在受害者接受护理时将他们放在心上。也请认识到昨晚在大街上目睹这一暴力事件对我们的学生和社区成员造成的影响和损失。”

paras.en: The university did not provide a confirmed number of victims or say whether anyone had died, but a report indicated at least six were hospitalized. The investigation is being led by Newark police. The school urged students and staff to follow its campus alerts page for confirmed updates.
paras.zh: 该大学没有提供确认的受害者人数，也没有透露是否有人死亡，但一份报告显示至少有六人住院。调查由纽瓦克警方领导。学校敦促学生和教职员工关注其校园警报页面以获取确认的更新。

paras.en: In Birmingham, Alabama, one person was killed and eight others were wounded Saturday night after the Magic City Classic football game near Legion Field, police said. Officers found nine people with gunshot wounds in the 400 block of Graymont Avenue West shortly after 7:50 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 警方称，周六晚上，阿拉巴马州伯明翰军团球场附近的魔术城经典橄榄球赛结束后，造成一人死亡、八人受伤。晚上 7 点 50 分后不久，警方在格雷蒙特大道西 400 号街区发现了 9 人受枪伤。等。

paras.en: One victim was in critical condition and seven others were stable, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，一名受害者情况危急，另外七人情况稳定。

paras.en: Michael Pickett, chief of the Birmingham Police Department, said most spectators and families had left the stadium property after the game, but the shooting happened nearby, where vendors were set up along Graymont Avenue.
paras.zh: 伯明翰警察局局长迈克尔·皮克特表示，比赛结束后，大多数观众和家人都离开了体育场，但枪击事件发生在附近，格雷蒙特大道沿线设有摊贩。

paras.en: He said he was "very grateful that more people weren’t injured."
paras.zh: 他说，他“非常庆幸没有更多人受伤”。

paras.en: Police spokesperson De'Rell Freeman said one person had been detained and transported to police headquarters for questioning, and "multiple weapons" had been found and secured.
paras.zh: 警方发言人德雷尔·弗里曼表示，一名人员已被拘留并被送往警察总部接受审问，并发现并保管了“多件武器”。

paras.en: Alabama State and Alabama A&M are historically Black universities and archrivals whose annual contest has been played for more than 100 years. Nearly 70,000 fans attended Saturday's game, won by Alabama A&M 31-28. The event draws some of the largest crowds in the country for games played in their college football division.
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州立大学和阿拉巴马农工大学在历史上都是黑人大学，也是主要竞争对手，它们的年度竞赛已经举办了 100 多年。近 70,000 名球迷观看了周六的比赛，阿拉巴马农工大学以 31-28 获胜。该活动吸引了全国最大的一些观众观看大学橄榄球赛的比赛。

paras.en: The Magic City Classic has such a deep history that Alabama State coach Eddie Robinson Jr., a former NFL linebacker and alumnus of the school, proposed creating a Hall of Fame for the game.
paras.zh: 魔术城经典赛有着悠久的历史，以至于前 NFL 线卫、该校校友、阿拉巴马州立大学主教练小埃迪·罗宾逊 (Eddie Robinson Jr.) 提议为这项比赛设立名人堂。

paras.en: In addition to the shootings near campuses, police in Dallas say four people are dead and 15 are injured following three separate shootings in a Dallas neighborhood. Police Chief Daniel Comeaux said police are still trying to determine if the shootings were related or what led to them. Comeaux said some arrests were made but he did not specify how many or what charges were involved.
paras.zh: 除了校园附近的枪击事件外，达拉斯警方还表示，达拉斯一个社区发生了三起枪击事件，造成 4 人死亡、15 人受伤。警察局长丹尼尔·科莫表示，警方仍在试图确定枪击事件是否相关或导致枪击事件的原因。科莫表示逮捕了一些人，但他没有具体说明涉及多少人或涉及什么罪名。

paras.en: "This is a really big scene. It's spread out," Comeaux said. "We are interviewing some individuals right now that we have arrested, still trying to figure out exactly how it ties into all the shootings out here."
paras.zh: “这是一个非常大的场景。它是分散的，”科莫说。 “我们现在正在采访一些已被逮捕的人，仍在试图弄清楚它与这里的所有枪击事件有何联系。”

paras.en: In Fayetteville, Arkansas, six people were taken to hospitals with gunshot wounds from a shooting that happened early Sunday. No arrests have been made, police said in a news release. A preliminary investigation indicates an altercation preceded the shooting.
paras.zh: 在阿肯色州费耶特维尔，周日早些时候发生的枪击事件中，六人因枪伤被送往医院。警方在新闻稿中表示，尚未逮捕任何人。初步调查显示，枪击事件前曾发生过争吵。

paras.en: Fox News' Bradford Betz and Angelica Stabile and The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的布拉德福德·贝茨和安吉莉卡·斯塔比尔以及美联社对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: UK willing to spend £450m a year on EU students if it can join Made in Europe scheme
articles.author: Kiran Stacey, Lisa O’Carroll and Jessica Elgot

paras.en: Ministers are prepared to spend as much as £450m a year to give students from the EU discounted university fees, the Guardian has learned, but only if Brussels allows the UK access to its Made in Europe industrial programme.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》获悉，部长们准备每年花费高达 4.5 亿英镑，为欧盟学生提供大学学费折扣，但前提是布鲁塞尔允许英国参与其“欧洲制造”工业计划。

paras.en: The UK government has drawn up plans to allow students arriving from the continent pay the same fees as British students, sources say, and is willing to spend hundreds of millions of pounds compensating universities to do so.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，英国政府已制定计划，允许来自欧洲大陆的学生支付与英国学生相同的费用，并愿意花费数亿英镑补偿大学这样做。

paras.en: British officials insist, however, they will only make concessions on fees if the EU allows Britain entry to its proposed protectionist industrial scheme, which will impose trade restrictions on countries outside the bloc.
paras.zh: 然而，英国官员坚称，只有欧盟允许英国加入其拟议的保护主义工业计划，他们才会在费用上做出让步，该计划将对欧盟以外的国家施加贸易限制。

paras.en: On Sunday the former chancellor Rachel Reeves praised the prime minister, Andy Burnham, for a willingness to think boldly about the UK’s relationship with Europe – saying she believed Britain’s future was within the EU. But in her first major intervention since leaving the Treasury when Burnham took office, she said those forging a path back towards EU membership had to make compelling arguments to the public.
paras.zh: 周日，前财政大臣雷切尔·里夫斯赞扬首相安迪·伯纳姆愿意大胆思考英国与欧洲的关系，称她相信英国的未来在欧盟之内。但在伯纳姆上任后离开财政部后的首次重大干预中，她表示，那些开辟重返欧盟之路的人必须向公众提出令人信服的论点。

paras.en: Ministers hope if such an agreement is reached at a Brussels summit later this month it will unlock millions of pounds’ worth of benefits for British companies looking to do business in the EU, and show that the prime minister’s attempts to forge much closer ties with the bloc are paying off.
paras.zh: 部长们希望，如果本月晚些时候在布鲁塞尔峰会上达成这样的协议，将为寻求在欧盟开展业务的英国公司带来价值数百万英镑的利益，并表明首相与欧盟建立更紧密关系的努力正在取得回报。

paras.en: But giving EU students cheaper access to British universities could prove controversial domestically, especially when many graduates are calling for changes to their own student loan repayment plans.
paras.zh: 但让欧盟学生以更便宜的价格进入英国大学可能会在国内引起争议，特别是当许多毕业生呼吁改变自己的学生贷款偿还计划时。

paras.en: One person with knowledge of the talks said: “We are willing to give the Europeans what they want on fees, but we will have to get something significant in return. The biggest prize we are pushing for right now is access to Made in Europe, so there is a deal to be done there.”
paras.zh: 一位了解谈判情况的人士表示：“我们愿意在费用上给予欧洲人他们想要的东西，但我们必须得到一些有意义的回报。我们现在争取的最大奖励是获得欧洲制造的机会，因此有一项协议需要在那里达成。”

paras.en: A government spokesperson said: “We are building an ambitious, close relationship with the EU that will strengthen our economy, protect British industry, and create more opportunities for young people across the UK.”
paras.zh: 一位政府发言人表示：“我们正在与欧盟建立雄心勃勃的密切关系，这将加强我们的经济，保护英国工业，并为英国各地的年轻人创造更多机会。”

paras.en: Negotiators have been thrashing out a series of deals for months to be finalised at the long-awaited summit on 20 November. Burnham wants to use it to show his commitment to much closer ties with the EU and to lay out options for how the relationship could develop in the future, including full re-entry.
paras.zh: 几个月来，谈判代表们一直在商讨一系列协议，最终将在期待已久的 11 月 20 日峰会上敲定。伯纳姆希望利用它来表明他对与欧盟建立更密切关系的承诺，并为未来关系的发展提出选择，包括完全重返欧盟。

paras.en: In a speech at Harvard on Monday, Reeves will say the UK’s “economic interests, common values and basic geographical reality all point towards Europe”. Praising Burnham’s “willingness to face reality head-on”, she will say it is vital the British government can “prove to the public the benefits of a closer relationship and prove to Europe that we are serious and open to compromise”.
paras.zh: 里夫斯周一在哈佛大学发表演讲时表示，英国的“经济利益、共同价值观和基本地理现实都指向欧洲”。她赞扬伯纳姆“愿意直面现实”，并表示英国政府能够“向公众证明更密切关系的好处，并向欧洲证明我们是认真的，愿意妥协”，这一点至关重要。

paras.en: Before the summit, agreement is understood to have largely been reached in a number of areas, including on emissions trading, agricultural products and a youth mobility scheme, with reports suggesting up to 80,000 young Europeans could be allowed to come to Britain to work, live and study. EU member states had demanded between 100,000 and 150,000, with some arguing in favour of no quota.
paras.zh: 据了解，在峰会之前，双方已在多个领域基本达成一致，包括排放交易、农产品和青年流动计划，有报道称，最多可允许8万名欧洲年轻人来英国工作、生活和学习。欧盟成员国的要求在 10 万到 15 万之间，其中一些国家主张不实行配额。

paras.en: The two sides are also nearing agreement to allow Britain access to European biometric databases, the Guardian has learned, which could help the UK government track asylum seekers.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》获悉，两国还接近达成协议，允许英国访问欧洲生物识别数据库，这可能有助于英国政府追踪寻求庇护者。

paras.en: British access to the Made in Europe scheme, which is due to be finalised next year, and European demands for cheaper fees for students at British universities are the two remaining hurdles.
paras.zh: 英国加入将于明年敲定的“欧洲制造”计划，以及欧洲要求英国大学学生降低学费是剩下的两个障碍。

paras.en: EU officials say they want their students to pay fees of just over £9,000 a year rather than international fees, which can rise above £60,000. The demand briefly brought negotiations to a standstill this year, with British officials saying they had been blindsided by its inclusion in talks.
paras.zh: 欧盟官员表示，他们希望学生每年支付 9,000 多英镑的费用，而不是国际费用，后者可能会超过 60,000 英镑。这一要求使今年的谈判一度陷入停滞，英国官员表示，这一要求被纳入谈判，让他们措手不及。

paras.en: The first draft of a joint statement will be presented to EU ambassadors on Wednesday with room for text to be added or deleted up to 20 November. The agreement will include fresh commitments to strengthen efforts to end the small boat crossings in the Channel, including commitments to explore the possibility of restoring the UK’s access to EU databases.
paras.zh: 联合声明初稿将于周三提交给欧盟大使，并在 11 月 20 日之前添加或删除文本。该协议将包括新的承诺，以加强努力结束英吉利海峡的小船穿越，包括承诺探索恢复英国访问欧盟数据库的可能性。

paras.en: EU diplomats say top of the UK’s shopping list is access to Eurodac, an EU database that holds fingerprints of all asylum seekers from the age of six. But they also warn there will be challenges for the UK as the database was not built for law enforcement, and sharing data with a non-EU member may not be supported by all states.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交官表示，英国的首要购物清单是访问 Eurodac，这是一个欧盟数据库，保存了所有六岁以上寻求庇护者的指纹。但他们也警告说，英国将面临挑战，因为该数据库不是为执法而建立的，而且并非所有国家都支持与非欧盟成员国共享数据。

paras.en: Member states are pushing for firm language on fees while the UK holds out for guarantees on Made in Europe. France dropped its opposition to the inclusion of the UK in the Industrial Accelerator Act with a proposal any country in the single market on 1 January 2020 could be involved as along as it dynamically aligned on trade measures.
paras.zh: 成员国正在推动对费用采取坚定的措辞，而英国则坚持对“欧洲制造”做出保证。法国放弃了对英国纳入《工业加速器法案》的反对，并提议自 2020 年 1 月 1 日起，单一市场中的任何国家都可以参与其中，只要其在贸易措施上动态协调一致。

paras.en: Ten days ago, with talks still deadlocked, the EU discussed “decoupling” the discussion on fees from the joint statement at the summit entirely, deferring any agreement for six months. But EU diplomats still hope for an agreement to allow talks to flourish for what one called “the real reset”.
paras.zh: 十天前，在谈判仍陷入僵局的情况下，欧盟讨论将费用讨论与峰会联合声明完全“脱钩”，将任何协议推迟六个月。但欧盟外交官仍然希望达成协议，让谈判能够蓬勃发展，实现所谓的“真正的重置”。

paras.en: Sources have told the Guardian the government is willing to concede on fees and is prepared to pay cash-strapped universities for the income they will lose. Treasury officials have been drawing up estimates for how much such a policy will cost under various scenarios, including different levels of discounts for European students and different levels of demand for British university courses.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉《卫报》，政府愿意在费用上让步，并准备向资金短缺的大学支付他们将损失的收入。财政部官员一直在估算此类政策在各种情况下的成本，包括对欧洲学生的不同程度的折扣以及对英国大学课程的不同需求水平。

paras.en: Two sources who have seen the costings have told the Guardian that under the most expensive scenario, which involves reducing fees to the same level as domestic students’ and very high levels of demand, the government could end up paying £450m a year. Another source said the true cost was likely to be lower, while a government official described the figure as “speculative”.
paras.zh: 两位看过成本计算的消息人士告诉《卫报》，在最昂贵的情况下，即把费用降低到与国内学生相同的水平，并且需求水平非常高，政府最终可能每年支付 4.5 亿英镑。另一位消息人士称，真正的成本可能会更低，而一位政府官员则将这一数字描述为“推测”。

paras.en: Mark Corver, an analyst of university funding and director at Campus Numerics, previously calculated it would cost the sector £140m in the first year and £400m across the three-year period of a typical course.
paras.zh: 大学经费分析师兼 Campus Numerics 主管马克·科弗 (Mark Corver) 此前计算，该行业第一年将花费 1.4 亿英镑，而典型课程的三年期间将花费 4 亿英镑。

paras.en: UK negotiators are only willing to give way on fees if they get a guarantee that British companies will be treated the same as those from the EU under the new industrial scheme.
paras.zh: 英国谈判代表只有在保证英国公司将在新工业计划下获得与欧盟公司相同的待遇的情况下才愿意在费用上让步。

paras.en: The UK was excluded from the definition of “European” for the purposes of the scheme, prompting warnings from the British government and the UK car industry. More recently, however, France – which was the principal opponent of Britain’s inclusion in the scheme – shifted its position with a new proposal to allow British manufacturers into the system as long as the UK accepted “dynamic alignment” on EU tariffs.
paras.zh: 出于该计划的目的，英国被排除在“欧洲”的定义之外，这引发了英国政府和英国汽车行业的警告。然而，最近，法国——英国加入该计划的主要反对者——改变了立场，提出了一项新提案，只要英国接受欧盟关税的“动态调整”，就允许英国制造商加入该体系。

paras.en: This could cause a problem for the UK, which has much lower tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles than in the EU. Jonathan Reynolds, the business secretary, recently told the Guardian he would not set tariff policy in response to pressure from Brussels.
paras.zh: 这可能会给英国带来问题，因为英国对中国电动汽车的关税比欧盟低得多。英国商务大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹最近告诉《卫报》，他不会为了应对布鲁塞尔的压力而制定关税政策。

paras.en: The UK is also working on securing access to the Schengen Information System II – a database holding records of fugitives, missing persons and stolen goods, which gives real-time alerts on their cross-border movements.
paras.zh: 英国还在努力确保访问申根信息系统II——一个保存逃犯、失踪人员和被盗物品记录的数据库，该数据库可以对其跨境活动提供实时警报。

paras.en: The EU commissioner responsible for migration, Magnus Brunner, had been due to meet the home secretary, Shabana Mahmood, in London two weeks ago to flesh out that text, but after a last-minute cancellation, work has continued between officials at the Cabinet Office and the European Commission.
paras.zh: 负责移民事务的欧盟专员马格努斯·布伦纳(Magnus Brunner)原定于两周前在伦敦会见内政大臣沙巴纳·马哈茂德(Shabana Mahmood)，以充实该文本，但在最后一刻取消后，内阁办公室和欧盟委员会官员之间的工作仍在继续。

articles.title: Ukraine defies Trump to resume attacks on Russian oil refineries
articles.author: Luke Harding in Kyiv

paras.en: Ukraine has resumed its attacks on Russian oil refineries in defiance of pressure from Donald Trump ahead of the US midterm elections, with a ceasefire in the occupied town of Oleshky due to end late on Sunday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰不顾美国中期选举前唐纳德·特朗普的压力，恢复了对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，被占领的奥列什基镇的停火将于周日晚些时候结束。

paras.en: Russian state media said on Sunday Ukrainian long-range drones had set fire to the Kstovo refinery in Nizhny Novgorod oblast overnight, soon after a major strike against another big refinery in Samara oblast, owned by the Russian state energy giant Rosneft.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体周日称，乌克兰远程无人机连夜点燃了下诺夫哥罗德州的克斯托沃炼油厂，此前不久，俄罗斯国家能源巨头俄罗斯石油公司旗下萨马拉州的另一家大型炼油厂遭到了重大打击。

paras.en: The Wall Street Journal had reported that Ukraine had given in to pressure from the White House to stop bombing Russian energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，乌克兰迫于白宫压力，停止轰炸俄罗斯能源基础设施。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials, however, told the Kyiv Independent newspaper that they never agreed to a demand from Jared Kushner, the US president’s son-in-law, to pause refinery strikes for 30 days. The raids on Russia restarted on Friday, Kremlin officials said, complaining that Kyiv was now “simply ignoring” US wishes.
paras.zh: 然而，乌克兰官员告诉《基辅独立报》，他们从未同意美国总统女婿贾里德·库什纳暂停炼油厂罢工 30 天的要求。克里姆林宫官员表示，对俄罗斯的袭击于周五重新启动，并抱怨基辅现在“根本无视”美国的意愿。

paras.en: Trump has blamed the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, for the rise in global fuel prices, and last month lifted US sanctions on Russian diesel.
paras.zh: 特朗普将全球燃油价格上涨归咎于乌克兰总统泽连斯基，并于上个月解除了美国对俄罗斯柴油的制裁。

paras.en: Zelenskyy has not acknowledged the latest refinery attacks, in an apparent attempt to avoid angry US reprisals. Instead, he said his armed forces had hit a defence industry enterprise in Russia’s Rostov region that made missiles. A Pantsir missile system was destroyed, he said, as part of Ukraine’s ongoing “long-range sanctions”.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基没有承认最近发生的炼油厂袭击事件，显然是为了避免美国愤怒的报复。相反，他说他的武装部队袭击了俄罗斯罗斯托夫地区一家制造导弹的国防工业企业。他说，作为乌克兰正在进行的“远程制裁”的一部分，“铠甲”导弹系统被摧毁。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said his country was obliged to retaliate because of a remorseless campaign by Moscow, using drones and ballistic missiles, against vulnerable city-based energy facilities. Four Ukrainian regions were hit by Russia overnight, with electricity cut as a result in hundreds of thousands of households.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，由于莫斯科使用无人机和弹道导弹对脆弱的城市能源设施进行无情的打击，俄罗斯有义务进行报复。乌克兰四个地区一夜间遭受俄罗斯袭击，数十万户家庭停电。

paras.en: “The intensity of the strikes is very high, and the Russians are seeking to maximally exploit the deficit of ballistic missile interceptors,” the Ukrainian president said on Telegram. Kyiv experienced power cuts lasting eight to 10 hours on Sunday after a critical thermal power plant was damaged.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统在 Telegram 上表示：“袭击的强度非常高，俄罗斯正在寻求最大程度地利用弹道导弹拦截弹的不足。”周日，基辅一座重要的火力发电厂受损，停电持续八到十个小时。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Russia was suffering record losses, with 54,400 military personnel killed and wounded in October – the highest monthly figure since the full-scale war began. He said Ukraine recaptured 96.2 sqkm (37 sq miles) of its territory last month, 10.4 sqkm (4 sq miles) more than Moscow managed to seize, and emphasised: “Russia is losing.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，俄罗斯遭受了创纪录的损失，10月份有54,400名军事人员伤亡——这是自全面战争开始以来的最高月度数字。他表示，乌克兰上个月夺回了 96.2 平方公里（37 平方英里）的领土，比莫斯科夺回的领土多了 10.4 平方公里（4 平方英里），并强调：“俄罗斯正在失败。”

paras.en: The latest attacks came as a six-day local ceasefire brokered by the US first lady, Melania Trump, was due to come to an end in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. Hundreds of residents were reunited with their loved ones over the weekend in northern Ukraine, with both sides hailing the evacuation mission as a success.
paras.zh: 最近的袭击发生之际，由美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的为期六天的当地停火即将在俄罗斯占领的奥列什基镇结束。周末，数百名居民在乌克兰北部与亲人团聚，双方都称赞疏散任务取得了成功。

paras.en: Ukrainian observers say the Russian military used the truce to reinforce its positions and to swap hungry and exhausted troops garrisoned in Oleskhy. The town sits on the left bank of the Dnipro River, to the east, and is opposite the larger city of Kherson, which Ukraine recaptured in autumn 2022. A renewed Russian onslaught is inevitable, the observers believe.
paras.zh: 乌克兰观察家表示，俄罗斯军方利用停战协议来巩固阵地，并交换驻扎在奥列斯基的饥饿和疲惫的部队。该镇位于第聂伯河左岸东侧，与乌克兰于 2022 年秋季重新夺回的大城市赫尔松相对。观察家认为，俄罗斯的新一轮进攻是不可避免的。

paras.en: The pope said on Sunday he hoped cooperation between Russia and Ukraine in implementing the Oleshky ceasefire – the most significant since 2022 – would pave the way for broader peace efforts.
paras.zh: 教皇周日表示，他希望俄罗斯和乌克兰在实施奥列什基停火方面的合作 — — 这是 2022 年以来最重要的停火 — — 将为更广泛的和平努力铺平道路。

paras.en: “I hope that the cooperation between the parties, which made this necessary humanitarian gesture possible, will strengthen their willingness to engage in dialogue,” he said during his Sunday prayer.
paras.zh: 他在周日的祈祷中表示：“我希望各方之间的合作能够增强他们进行对话的意愿，从而使这一必要的人道主义姿态成为可能。”

paras.en: Trilateral talks involving Russia, Ukraine and the US are likely to take place later this month, with Kremlin officials saying on Sunday that Vladimir Putin was willing to talk directly with Zelenskyy by phone. They added that European leaders who support Ukraine should not be involved in any such call.
paras.zh: 涉及俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国的三边会谈可能会在本月晚些时候举行，克里姆林宫官员周日表示，弗拉基米尔·普京愿意通过电话直接与泽伦斯基交谈。他们补充说，支持乌克兰的欧洲领导人不应参与任何此类呼吁。

paras.en: There is little prospect of a wider breakthrough, however, as the Russian president’s maximalist demands remain unchanged. He is insisting that Ukraine give up all of the eastern Donetsk oblast – which Russia has been unable to seize since 2014 – as well as further territory in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia provinces which the Kremlin does not control, but says it has “annexed”.
paras.zh: 然而，由于俄罗斯总统的最高要求保持不变，取得更广泛突破的前景不大。他坚持要求乌克兰放弃整个东顿涅茨克州——俄罗斯自2014年以来一直无法夺取该州——以及赫尔松省和扎波罗热省的更多领土，克里姆林宫并不控制这些领土，但称其已经“吞并”了这些领土。

articles.title: Negotiators ‘braced for worst’ over US-Iran talks to reopen strait of Hormuz
articles.author: Patrick Wintour Diplomatic editor

paras.en: Officials from the Gulf states are “braced for the worst” as they wait for Washington’s response to an Iranian proposal that could reopen the strait of Hormuz before the US midterm elections on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 海湾国家的官员正在“做好最坏的打算”，等待华盛顿对伊朗提议的回应，该提议可能在周二美国中期选举前重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: Indirect talks in Doha ran into a third day on Sunday, with Qatar trying to negotiate the release of more than $6bn in Iranian assets, which could lead to the reopening of the strait of Hormuz and the restart of negotiations on Iran’s nuclear programme.
paras.zh: 周日在多哈举行的间接谈判进入第三天，卡塔尔试图通过谈判释放超过 60 亿美元的伊朗资产，这可能导致霍尔木兹海峡的重新开放以及伊朗核计划谈判的重启。

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates envoy Anwar Gargash said that another round of escalation was not in the interests of Iran or any of its neighbours. But he added: “We are also, as we have shown before, braced for the worst.”
paras.zh: 阿联酋特使安瓦尔·加尔加什表示，新一轮升级不符合伊朗或其任何邻国的利益。但他补充道：“正如我们之前所表明的那样，我们也做好了最坏情况的准备。”

paras.en: He added: “Relations with Iran are essential, because Iran is our neighbour and we do not want to see it get caught up in a prolonged crisis.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“与伊朗的关系至关重要，因为伊朗是我们的邻居，我们不希望看到它陷入长期危机。”

paras.en: Qatar’s mediation continued despite unidentified missiles striking a Pakistan-bound Qatari LNG tanker near the strait of Hormuz on Friday. The attack came despite the ship receiving direct clearance and safe-passage approval from Tehran just hours earlier.
paras.zh: 尽管周五不明导弹袭击了霍尔木兹海峡附近一艘开往巴基斯坦的卡塔尔液化天然气油轮，但卡塔尔的调解仍在继续。尽管这艘船在几个小时前刚刚获得德黑兰的直接许可和安全通行批准，但袭击还是发生了。

paras.en: In a bid to overcome the lack of trust on both sides, Qatar has been focusing its efforts on reaching an agreement for a plan to compress the process by which the US lifts sanctions, and then Iran reopens the strait of Hormuz and starts nuclear talks. Iran has agreed to cut the timetable from seven to two days,
paras.zh: 为了克服双方缺乏信任的问题，卡塔尔一直集中精力达成协议，计划压缩美国解除制裁的进程，然后伊朗重新开放霍尔木兹海峡并启动核谈判。伊朗已同意将时间表从七天缩短为两天，

paras.en: Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, said he hoped the US would choose “diplomacy over other paths”. He said Iran was ready for both defence and diplomacy, depending on Washington’s “rationality”. Araghchi said there were currently no plans for direct talks with Washington.
paras.zh: 伊朗外长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，他希望美国选择“外交而不是其他道路”。他表示，伊朗已做好国防和外交准备，这取决于华盛顿的“理性”。阿拉格奇表示，目前没有与华盛顿直接对话的计划。

paras.en: Araghchi has not been attending the mediation in Doha and is due to go to Turkmenistan on Monday, but other Iranian diplomats are heavily involved.
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇没有参加多哈的调解，定于周一前往土库曼斯坦，但其他伊朗外交官也积极参与其中。

paras.en: Donald Trump said on Saturday that the US had knocked out much of Iran’s military but still had to “take care of” one or two targets, as Tehran warned of reprisals if attacked.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普周六表示，美国已经消灭了伊朗的大部分军队，但仍必须“处理”一两个目标，德黑兰警告称，如果遭到袭击，将进行报复。

paras.en: Trump maintained that negotiations with Iran to end the war, which was started by the US and Israel in February, were “going fine but you know they’re not very reliable”.
paras.zh: 特朗普坚称，美国和以色列于二月份启动的与伊朗结束战争的谈判“进展顺利，但你知道它们不太可靠”。

paras.en: Earlier on Saturday, the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, said the US was open to a diplomatic solution, while Iran’s security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, disclosed that he had received a letter from the US vice-president, JD Vance, seeking to revive talks.
paras.zh: 周六早些时候，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，美国对外交解决方案持开放态度，而伊朗安全负责人莫森·雷扎伊透露，他收到了美国副总统万斯的一封信，寻求恢复谈判。

paras.en: Rezaei noted what he described as a positive change in “tone” from the US side but said he had yet to respond.
paras.zh: 雷扎伊指出，他所说的美国方面的“语气”发生了积极的变化，但表示他尚未做出回应。

paras.en: Speaking to Al Jazeera on Saturday, Araghchi said Iran had offered to open the strait of Hormuz within two days of the US acting to lift the blockade on oil ships, stop blocking the release of Iranian assets and end sanctions on Iranian oil exports.
paras.zh: 阿拉格奇周六在接受半岛电视台采访时表示，在美国采取行动解除对石油船只的封锁、停止阻止释放伊朗资产并结束对伊朗石油出口的制裁后，伊朗已提出在两天内开放霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: Ali Nikzad, the deputy speaker of Iran’s parliament, once again signalled that Tehran would be unwilling to discuss its nuclear programme, saying: “Our enemies must understand that the Iranian nation has made a decision not to negotiate on the nuclear issue under any circumstances or under any pressure. This great nation gave its enemies enough opportunity to negotiate in this area, but was faced with repeated breaches of promises and illegal bombing of part of peaceful nuclear facilities.”
paras.zh: 伊朗议会副议长阿里·尼克扎德再次暗示德黑兰不愿讨论其核计划，他表示：“我们的敌人必须明白，伊朗民族已经决定在任何情况下或在任何压力下都不就核问题进行谈判。这个伟大的国家给了敌人足够的机会在这一领域进行谈判，但却面临着一再违背承诺和非法轰炸部分和平核设施的情况。”

paras.en: Rezaei claimed Trump was being hounded by a war that he claimed was having wider international repercussions than the Vietnam war. He told Iranian TV on Saturday: “Today, wherever Trump goes, he must answer why he started the war against Iran. There is no family in America that has not endured the pressure caused by the war in Iran.”
paras.zh: 雷扎伊声称特朗普受到一场战争的困扰，他声称这场战争的国际影响比越南战争更广泛。他周六告诉伊朗电视台：“今天，无论特朗普走到哪里，他都必须回答他为什么发动对伊朗的战争。美国没有一个家庭没有承受过伊朗战争造成的压力。”

articles.title: Watch: Heidi Klum as giant severed hand for Halloween bash

paras.en: Watch: Heidi Klum as giant severed hand for Halloween bash
paras.zh: 观看：海蒂·克鲁姆在万圣节狂欢中扮演巨型断手

paras.en: The supermodel and TV host Heidi Klum continued her pose as the queen of Halloween by transforming into a giant, bloodied and severed hand for her annual costume party on 31 October.
paras.zh: 超级名模兼电视主持人海蒂·克鲁姆 (Heidi Klum) 继续扮演万圣节女王的角色，在 10 月 31 日举行的年度化装舞会上变身为一只巨大、血迹斑斑、被砍断的手。

paras.en: Klum, 53, was completely unrecognisable arriving at her event in what she described as her own chopped-off "left hand".
paras.zh: 53 岁的克鲁姆 (Klum) 出席活动时，她的“左手”被砍掉了，她的脸已经完全认不出来了。

paras.en: This year was the 25th anniversary of the party, which has provided viral pop culture moments over the years, like when Klum dressed up as a worm in 2022.
paras.zh: 今年是该派对举办的 25 周年，多年来，该派对为流行文化提供了病毒般的瞬间，比如 2022 年克鲁姆装扮成蠕虫。

articles.title: India's opposition holds mega rally seeking election chief's resignation

paras.en: Tens of thousands gathered in Delhi for a rally demanding the resignation of India's chief election commissioner over a controversial revision of voter lists.
paras.zh: 数万人聚集在德里举行集会，要求印度首席选举专员因对选民名单进行有争议的修改而辞职。

paras.en: Organised by the opposition INDIA bloc and led by Rahul Gandhi's Congress party, the protest drew many of the alliance's most prominent leaders in a show of strength against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.
paras.zh: 这次抗议活动由反对派印度集团组织，由拉胡尔·甘地领导的国大党领导，吸引了该联盟许多最著名的领导人，以展示反对总理纳伦德拉·莫迪政府的实力。

paras.en: Protesters waved flags and chanted "Save the vote, save the country" and "Vote thief, give up power".
paras.zh: 抗议者挥舞旗帜，高呼“拯救选票，拯救国家”和“选票贼，放弃权力”。

paras.en: It was the latest in a series of protests over electoral roll revision that the opposition says has removed eligible voters to benefit the Bharatiya Janata Party. The BJP and the Election Commission deny the allegations.
paras.zh: 这是针对选举名册修改的一系列抗议活动中的最新一起，反对派称，选举名册修改已删除了符合资格的选民，以使印度人民党受益。印度人民党和选举委员会否认这些指控。

paras.en: The crowds gathered at Ramlila Maidan, a sprawling ground in central Delhi known for hosting major political and cultural events. Some protesters sang and danced to patriotic Bollywood songs, while others waited beneath a large canopy in the colours of the Indian flag to hear opposition leaders speak.
paras.zh: 人群聚集在拉姆利拉迈丹，这是德里市中心的一片广阔土地，以举办重大政治和文化活动而闻名。一些抗议者随着宝莱坞的爱国歌曲载歌载舞，而另一些抗议者则在印度国旗颜色的大天篷下等待，聆听反对派领导人的讲话。

paras.en: Gandhi and several senior opposition leaders arrived at the venue in an open jeep, travelling through crowds of cheering supporters.
paras.zh: 甘地和几位反对派高级领导人乘坐敞篷吉普车穿过欢呼的支持者人群抵达会场。

paras.en: The event was also attended by Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, alongside leaders of regional parties such as Mamata Banerjee, Akhilesh Yadav, Mehbooba Mufti, Supriya Sule and Tejashwi Yadav.
paras.zh: 国大党领导人索尼娅·甘地和马利卡琼·哈尔格，以及玛玛塔·班纳吉、阿克希勒什·亚达夫、梅赫布巴·穆夫蒂、苏普里亚·苏莱和特贾什维·亚达夫等地区政党领导人也出席了此次活动。

paras.en: Addressing the crowds, Rahul Gandhi said those gathered had sent a message to Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
paras.zh: 拉胡尔·甘地向人群发表讲话说，聚集的人们已向莫迪、内政部长阿米特·沙阿和首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔发出了信息。

paras.en: "This is not the voice of a single political party or of politicians. It is the voice of India's youth, women, farmers and workers," he said.
paras.zh: “这不是单一政党或政客的声音。这是印度青年、妇女、农民和工人的声音，”他说。

paras.en: "We will not allow democracy to be destroyed in India. We will not allow the constitution to be destroyed."
paras.zh: “我们不会允许印度的民主被摧毁。我们不会允许宪法被摧毁。”

paras.en: Other opposition leaders echoed Gandhi's criticism of the Election Commission. Congress president Kharge said the alliance would continue its campaign until Kumar resigned, while Banerjee pledged to keep fighting against what she described as threats to democracy.
paras.zh: 其他反对派领导人也响应了甘地对选举委员会的批评。国大党主席哈格表示，该联盟将继续开展竞选活动，直至库马尔辞职，而班纳吉则承诺继续打击她所说的对民主的威胁。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters in Delhi on Sunday, senior BJP leader and federal minister JP Nadda accused the opposition of trying to create unrest and destabilise the government under the guise of defending democracy.
paras.zh: 印度人民党高级领导人兼联邦部长 JP Nadda 周日在德里对记者发表讲话，指责反对派试图以捍卫民主为幌子制造骚乱并破坏政府稳定。

paras.en: He described the rally as a "calculated conspiracy to plunge the nation into anarchy - in the name of democracy".
paras.zh: 他将这次集会描述为“一场精心策划的阴谋，旨在以民主的名义使国家陷入无政府状态”。

paras.en: At the centre of the dispute is an exercise known as the Special Intensive Revision (SIR), which has resulted in more than 130 million names being removed from India's draft electoral rolls.
paras.zh: 争议的核心是一项名为“特别强化修订”(SIR) 的行动，该行动已导致超过 1.3 亿人的名字从印度的选民名单中删除。

paras.en: The Election Commission says the exercise is intended to remove duplicate registrations and the names of people who have died, moved away or are otherwise ineligible to vote. It says eligible voters who have been wrongly excluded can seek to have their names restored.
paras.zh: 选举委员会表示，此举的目的是消除重复登记以及已死亡、搬走或因其他原因而无投票资格的人的姓名。它说，被错误排除在外的合格选民可以寻求恢复自己的名字。

paras.en: But opposition parties allege that the process is removing legitimate voters and could benefit the governing BJP in future elections.
paras.zh: 但反对党声称，这一过程正在消除合法选民，并可能在未来的选举中使执政的印度人民党受益。

paras.en: The controversy deepened in September when The Indian Express newspaper reported, external that Kumar had made key decisions about the revision despite repeated objections from the two other election commissioners.
paras.zh: 9 月份，《印度快报》对外报道称，尽管其他两名选举委员一再反对，但库马尔还是做出了有关修订的关键决定，争议进一步加深。

paras.en: The poll panel said differences of opinion were normal in any institution and did not affect its functioning.
paras.zh: 民意调查小组表示，意见分歧在任何机构都是正常的，不会影响其运作。

paras.en: Sunday's rally followed weeks of protests over the voter-list revision, including demonstrations by student groups and the Gen Z-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP).
paras.zh: 周日的集会是在针对选民名单修改进行了数周的抗议活动之后举行的，其中包括学生团体和 Z 世代领导的蟑螂党 (CJP) 的示威活动。

paras.en: Last month, Gandhi led tens of thousands on a march from central Delhi's Connaught Place to the Supreme Court, demanding Kumar's resignation.
paras.zh: 上个月，甘地率领数万人从德里市中心的康诺特广场游行至最高法院，要求库马尔辞职。

paras.en: The CJP also backed Sunday's rally but chose not to participate. Its founder Abhijeet Dipke said the group wanted to maintain its independence from established political parties.
paras.zh: CJP 也支持周日的集会，但选择不参加。其创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 表示，该组织希望保持独立于现有政党的地位。

paras.en: The event took place under strict conditions imposed by Delhi Police. According to local media reports, organisers were required to end the gathering by 5pm, install CCTV cameras at the venue and ensure that protesters did not march beyond the designated grounds.
paras.zh: 该活动是在德里警方规定的严格条件下举行的。据当地媒体报道，组织者被要求在下午5点前结束集会，在会场安装闭路电视摄像头，并确保抗议者不会超出指定场地。

paras.en: The restrictions came against a backdrop of tensions over the policing of demonstrations in the capital. On 10 October, several leaders of the CJP were detained during protests against Kumar, while BBC reporters witnessed police dragging demonstrators away and beating some with batons.
paras.zh: 这些限制是在首都示威活动治安紧张的背景下出台的。 10 月 10 日，CJP 的几名领导人在针对库马尔的抗议活动中被拘留，而 BBC 记者则目睹警察将示威者拖走并用警棍殴打一些人。

paras.en: At Ramlila Maidan, however, the atmosphere was largely peaceful, with people of different ages and professions turning out to express their concerns about the integrity of India's elections.
paras.zh: 然而，拉姆利拉迈丹的气氛基本上是和平的，不同年龄和职业的人们纷纷表达了对印度选举公正性的担忧。

paras.en: "We don't even know if this is a people's mandate or a stolen mandate," Isha, a development sector professional from Delhi, told the BBC.
paras.zh: 来自德里的发展部门专业人士伊莎告诉英国广播公司：“我们甚至不知道这是人民的授权还是窃取的授权。”

paras.en: Deepro Guha, a lawyer from Delhi, said he was concerned about the way the revision had been carried out.
paras.zh: 来自德里的律师迪普罗·古哈 (Deepro Guha) 表示，他对修订的实施方式感到担忧。

paras.en: "It's important because voting is the basis of democracy. If people's names are removed without any explanation, there is a problem," he said.
paras.zh: “这很重要，因为投票是民主的基础。如果人们的名字在没有任何解释的情况下被删除，那就有问题了，”他说。

paras.en: On Saturday, opposition leaders also staged a symbolic impeachment of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, accusing him of undermining the electoral process.
paras.zh: 周六，反对派领导人还对首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔进行了象征性弹劾，指责他破坏选举进程。

paras.en: The proceedings were purely symbolic and had no legal standing. Under Indian law, the chief election commissioner can only be removed through a formal parliamentary process.
paras.zh: 该诉讼纯粹是象征性的，没有法律地位。根据印度法律，首席选举专员只能通过正式的议会程序被罢免。

paras.en: But the move was another show of unity by the INDIA bloc, an alliance of opposition parties formed in 2023 to to take on Modi's BJP.
paras.zh: 但此举是印度集团的又一次团结表现，印度集团是一个由反对党组成的联盟，成立于 2023 年，旨在对抗莫迪领导的印度人民党。

paras.en: Modi did not directly comment on the mock impeachment, but at public rallies on Friday and Saturday he accused opposition parties of trying to create chaos and undermining the dignity of the constitution.
paras.zh: 莫迪没有直接对模拟弹劾发表评论，但在周五和周六的公开集会上，他指责反对党试图制造混乱并破坏宪法的尊严。

articles.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say

paras.en: Israeli strikes in Gaza have killed at least eight people, including a child, according to hospitals, despite a year-old ceasefire.
paras.zh: 据医院称，尽管已经停火一年，但以色列对加沙的袭击已造成至少八人死亡，其中包括一名儿童。

paras.en: In Gaza City to the north, hospital officials said a missile attack hit a group of civilians next to Cairo School in the Al-Rimal neighbourhood, killing three people, including a four-year-old boy.
paras.zh: 在北部的加沙城，医院官员表示，一次导弹袭击袭击了 Al-Rimal 社区开罗学校附近的一群平民，造成三人死亡，其中包括一名四岁男孩。

paras.en: In the southern city of Khan Younis, the Hamas-run ministry of interior said a drone attack targeted a group of police officers in the Al-Mawasi area, killing five, as they were carrying out their routine duties.
paras.zh: 在南部城市汗尤尼斯，哈马斯控制的内政部表示，一次无人机袭击了马瓦西地区的一群警察，造成五人死亡，当时他们正在执行日常职责。

paras.en: The Israeli military said it had carried out two attacks on what it described as military operatives but has not yet provided evidence or further information.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，已对所谓的军事人员发动了两次袭击，但尚未提供证据或进一步信息。

paras.en: Outside Gaza City's Shifa Hospital, video showed a crowd of men gathered to pray next to two body bags and the tiny body of the child, which was wrapped in a white towel.
paras.zh: 在加沙市希法医院外，视频显示一群男子聚集在两个裹尸袋和用白色毛巾包裹着的孩子的小尸体旁边祈祷。

paras.en: "My son and his child were martyred. They were sitting in their tent, bothering no one, and nothing else was happening in the area when suddenly, a missile struck them, and they were martyred," Ali Oweis told AFP news agency. "There is no ceasefire; the war is ongoing -- don't you see?"
paras.zh: 阿里·欧维斯告诉法新社：“我的儿子和他的孩子都殉难了。他们坐在帐篷里，没有打扰任何人，该地区也没有发生任何其他事情，突然，一枚导弹击中了他们，他们就殉难了。” “没有停火；战争仍在继续——你明白吗？”

paras.en: At Nasser hospital in Khan Younis, women despaired as body bags lay on the floor, video showed. The interior ministry named the five police officers killed, who were between the ages of 23 and 53, and called the attack a "horrific massacre".
paras.zh: 视频显示，在汗尤尼斯的纳赛尔医院，尸体袋躺在地板上，妇女们感到绝望。内政部点名了五名遇难警察的名字，他们的年龄在23岁至53岁之间，并称这次袭击是一场“可怕的屠杀”。

paras.en: A ceasefire came into force in Gaza in October last year, but Israeli air strikes have continued almost every day.
paras.zh: 加沙停火于去年10月生效，但以色列的空袭几乎每天都在持续。

paras.en: Since then, 1,580 people have been killed, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Israel says it is targeting Hamas, but often civilians are also killed.
paras.zh: 据加沙哈马斯管理的卫生部称，自那以后已有 1,580 人被杀，联合国认为该数字是可靠的。以色列称其目标是哈马斯，但平民也经常被杀害。

paras.en: Meanwhile, a peace plan for Gaza, brokered by the Trump administration, has stalled.
paras.zh: 与此同时，由特朗普政府斡旋的加沙和平计划陷入停滞。

paras.en: The ceasefire saw thousands of Palestinians held by Israel released in return for all of the 48 remaining hostages held in Gaza, and an agreement to end the war - which was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken hostage.
paras.zh: 停火协议中，以色列扣押的数千名巴勒斯坦人被释放，以换取加沙地带剩余的 48 名人质，并达成结束战争的协议。这场战争是由哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列的袭击引发的，当时约 1,200 人被杀，251 人被扣为人质。

paras.en: Since the war began, 74,594 people have been killed in Gaza, according to the territory's health ministry.
paras.zh: 据该地区卫生部称，自战争开始以来，加沙已有 74,594 人丧生。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
